Training architecture and inference architecture cannot be the same.
oZh: 训练架构和推理架构具有相同的需求与注意事项。
训练架构只关注硬件需求，而推理架构只关注软件需求。

Natural language processing
Data analytics
oZh: 推荐系统
自然语言处理
数据分析
questions.e: Recommender systems (RecSys) are unique because they often involve massive amounts of tabular data and "sparse" features (like user IDs and item IDs) that require massive embedding tables. Merlin addresses these specific challenges through its core components: NVTabular: A library for fast feature engineering and preprocessing that can handle terabytes of data. HugeCTR: A high-efficiency neural network training framework specifically designed for the large embedding tables found in recommender models. Merlin Models: A library of standard, high-quality implementations for popular recommender architectures (like Two-Tower or DLRM).Integration with Triton: It seamlessly deploys models to the Triton Inference Server to ensure low-latency recommendations in production.
questions.eZh: 参考答案：A（推荐系统）。原题未附中文解析，可在「来源」里看社区讨论。

questions.q: In training and inference architecture requirements, what is the main difference between training and inference?
questions.qZh: 在训练和推理的架构需求方面，训练与推理的主要区别是什么？
o: Training requires real-time processing, while inference requires large amounts of data.
Training requires large amounts of data, while inference requires real-time processing.
Training and inference both require large amounts of data.
Training and inference both require real-time processing.
oZh: 训练需要实时处理，而推理需要海量数据。
训练需要海量数据，而推理需要实时处理。
训练和推理都需要海量数据。
训练和推理都需要实时处理。
questions.e: Training involves feeding a model large volumes of data so it can learn patterns and adjust its internal parameters. This process is computationally intensive and data-heavy, but it does not usually need to happen in real time. Inference is when the trained model is used to make predictions on new data. In many applications (like chatbots, fraud detection, or recommendation systems), inference must happen quickly or in real time, but it typically processes much smaller amounts of data at once.

questions.q: What factors have led to significant breakthroughs in Deep Learning?
questions.qZh: 哪些因素促成了深度学习的重大突破？
o: Advances in hardware, availability of fast internet connections, and improvements in training algorithms

Advances in smartphones, social media sites, and improvements in statistical techniques.

questions.e: ✅ Correct answer: C. Advances in hardware, availability of large datasets, and improvements in training algorithms. Three major factors have driven significant breakthroughs in deep learning: 1. Advances in hardware: GPUs and specialized accelerators enable parallel computation and faster neural network training. 2. Availability of large datasets: More training data helps deep neural networks learn complex patterns and generalize better. 3. Improvements in training algorithms: Better optimization techniques, activation functions, and neural network architectures improve training efficiency and accuracy. Why not the other options? - A: Fast internet connections are useful for data transfer but are not a primary driver of deep learning breakthroughs. - B: The Bag of Words algorithm is a traditional text representation technique, not a major general driver of deep learning progress. - D: Smartphones and social media contribute to data generation, but this option misses the broader hardware and training algorithm advances.
questions.eZh: 参考答案：C（硬件的进步、大型数据集的可用性以及训练算法的改进。）。原题未附中文解析，可在「来源」里看社区讨论。

questions.e: The answer is C. 4. In an AI cluster, you typically have four separate “fabrics”: Scale-Up Fabric Connects the GPUs within a single node (e.g., NVLink/NVSwitch). Management Network Handles out-of-band tasks, such as provisioning, health checks, and firmware updates.

Option B assigns training to TensorRT and request handling to cuDNN, which are not their roles. Option C misstates all three components. Option D confuses CUDA and TensorRT with the functions of cuDNN.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 与该工作流相符，因为 CUDA 提供 GPU 计算，cuDNN 提供深度学习操作，TensorRT 支持优化的推理。选项 B 将训练分配给 TensorRT、将请求处理分配给 cuDNN，而这两者并非它们的职责。选项 C 错误描述了全部三个组件。选项 D 混淆了 CUDA 和 TensorRT 与 cuDNN 的功能。

questions.q: Choose two statements that correctly describe the different requirements of training and inference.
questions.qZh: 选择两项陈述，正确描述训练与推理各自不同的要求。
o: Training usually performs forward and backward computations and updates model parameters, so it must retain information needed to calculate gradients.
Inference must calculate gradients and update model parameters for every prediction, so its memory needs are generally greater than training needs.
A production service that prioritizes low response time may optimize inference for latency, while a service processing many queued requests may prioritize throughput.
Training is best suited to CPUs because model parameter updates are sequential, while GPUs are mainly useful for running one prediction at a time.
Inference can use reduced numerical precision when the model and application support it, which may improve performance while maintaining acceptable output quality.
oZh: 训练通常要执行前向和反向计算并更新模型参数，因此必须保留计算梯度所需的信息。
推理必须为每次预测计算梯度并更新模型参数，因此其内存需求通常高于训练。
以低响应时间为优先的生产服务可能会针对延迟优化推理，而处理大量排队请求的服务可能会优先考虑吞吐。
训练最适合使用 CPU，因为模型参数更新是串行的，而 GPU 主要适用于一次运行一个预测。
当模型和应用都支持时，推理可以使用降低的数值精度，这可能在保持可接受输出质量的同时提升性能。
questions.e: Options A, C, and E are correct. Training needs forward and backward computations for parameter updates, while inference can be tuned for response time or throughput and may use reduced precision. Option B incorrectly assigns gradient updates to inference. Option D mischaracterizes both CPU and GPU roles and incorrectly limits GPUs to single predictions.
questions.eZh: 选项 A、C、E 正确。训练需要前向和反向计算来更新参数，而推理可以针对响应时间或吞吐进行调优，并可使用降低的精度。选项 B 错误地将梯度更新归到推理。选项 D 错误描述了 CPU 与 GPU 的作用，并错误地将 GPU 限制为单次预测。

questions.q: Which statement best classifies the forecasting model and its relationship to AI, machine learning, and deep learning?
questions.qZh: 哪项陈述最好地对该预测模型及其与 AI、机器学习和深度学习之间的关系进行了分类？
o: The model is deep learning, which is a form of machine learning within the broader field of AI, because it learns from examples using a neural network with multiple layers.
The model is AI but not machine learning, because demand forecasting is a business task rather than a computing task.
The model is machine learning but not AI, because AI refers only to systems that use hand-written rules.
The model is AI and deep learning, but it is not machine learning, because deep learning is separate from machine learning.
oZh: 该模型属于深度学习，而深度学习是更广泛 AI 领域中机器学习的一种形式，因为它使用多层的神经网络从示例中学习。
该模型属于 AI 但不属于机器学习，因为需求预测是业务任务而非计算任务。
该模型属于机器学习但不属于 AI，因为 AI 仅指使用手写规则的系统。
该模型属于 AI 和深度学习，但不属于机器学习，因为深度学习独立于机器学习。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the forecasting model learns from historical examples using multiple neural network layers, making it deep learning within machine learning and AI. Option B wrongly excludes learned software from AI. Option C incorrectly limits AI to rules. Option D wrongly treats deep learning as separate from machine learning.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为该预测模型使用多层神经网络从历史示例中学习，因此属于机器学习和 AI 范畴下的深度学习。选项 B 错误地将学习型软件排除在 AI 之外。选项 C 错误地将 AI 限定为规则系统。选项 D 错误地将深度学习视为独立于机器学习。

questions.q: Which metric should the team use to select the model?
questions.qZh: 团队应使用哪项指标来选择模型？
o: Mean absolute error
Mean squared error
Proportion of explained variance
Classification accuracy
oZh: 平均绝对误差
均方误差
可解释方差比例
分类准确率
questions.e: Mean absolute error is the best fit because the utility penalizes typical absolute forecast deviations and the team wants large outliers to have limited influence. Option B is not correct because squaring errors gives unusually large deviations more weight. Option C does not directly express typical error in the forecast units. Option D is for classification, not continuous demand forecasts.
questions.eZh: 平均绝对误差是最合适的选择，因为该效用函数会惩罚典型的绝对预测偏差，而团队希望大幅异常值的影响有限。选项 B 不正确，因为对误差取平方会让异常大的偏差获得更大权重。选项 C 无法直接以预测结果的单位表达典型误差。选项 D 适用于分类，而非连续的需求预测。

questions.q: The junior analyst must assess whether the apparent improvement is reliable before reporting it. Choose two actions.
questions.qZh: 初级分析师在报告之前，必须评估表面上的改善是否可靠。选择两项操作。
o: Compare missing-value rates by clinic and collection month before interpreting the trend.
Exclude every clinic with any missing records so the remaining dataset is complete.
Record the sensor firmware change and examine measurements before and after it separately.
Replace all missing readings with zero so every clinic contributes the same number of records.
Report the overall trend immediately because the dataset contains several million measurements.
Remove the firmware-change period without documenting the decision.
oZh: 在解读趋势之前，先按诊所和采集月份比较缺失值比例。
排除所有存在任何缺失记录的诊所，使剩余数据集完整无缺。
记录传感器固件变更，并分别检查变更前后的测量数据。
将所有缺失读数替换为零，使每个诊所贡献相同数量的记录。
立即报告整体趋势，因为该数据集包含数百万条测量记录。
移除固件变更期间的数据，但不作任何记录说明。
questions.e: Comparing missingness by clinic and month can reveal a sampling pattern that affects the apparent trend, while examining the documented firmware change can identify a measurement shift. Option B may create selection bias by discarding entire clinics. Option D treats missing values as real zeros. Option E relies on dataset size instead of checking data quality. Option F hides a potentially relevant factor.
questions.eZh: 按诊所和月份比较缺失情况可以揭示影响表面趋势的抽样模式，而检查有记录的固件变更可以识别测量值的偏移。选项 B 会丢弃整个诊所，可能造成选择偏差。选项 D 把缺失值当作真实的零值处理。选项 E 依赖数据集规模而非检查数据质量。选项 F 掩盖了一个可能相关的因素。

questions.q: Which visualization best communicates the results while preserving the weekly pattern for both cohorts?
questions.qZh: 哪种可视化方式在保留两个队列每周规律的同时，最能传达结果？
o: A line chart with week on the horizontal axis and a separate series for each cohort
A pie chart showing each cohort's share of all recorded visits
A histogram combining the visit counts from both cohorts
A scatterplot of cohort labels against individual visit identifiers
oZh: 以周为横轴、每个队列使用单独序列的折线图
显示各队列在全部记录就诊量中所占比例的饼图
将两个队列的就诊计数合并绘制的直方图
以队列标签对单个就诊标识符绘制的散点图
questions.e: A line chart with separate cohort series shows how weekly visit counts change over time and makes the timing of the difference visible. Option B shows proportions, not the weekly trend. Option C combines the cohorts and removes the comparison the team needs. Option D plots identifiers that do not convey a meaningful relationship between cohort and weekly counts.
questions.eZh: 按队列分列序列的折线图展示了每周就诊量随时间的变化，并使差异出现的时间点清晰可见。选项 B 展示的是比例，而非每周趋势。选项 C 将两个队列合并，消除了团队所需的对比。选项 D 绘制的是标识符，无法体现队列与每周计数之间的有意义关系。

questions.q: Which monitoring action is the best next step?
questions.qZh: 哪项监控操作是最佳的下一步？
o: Track GPU memory use alone and increase memory capacity if it is high.
Monitor host CPU load and storage throughput without collecting GPU telemetry.
Correlate GPU temperature and clock frequency with power draw and thermal throttling indicators.
Add GPUs to the node because reduced throughput always indicates too few accelerators.
oZh: 仅跟踪 GPU 显存使用情况，若占用较高则增加显存容量。
监控主机 CPU 负载和存储吞吐量，而不采集 GPU 遥测数据。
将 GPU 温度和时钟频率与功耗以及热节流指标进行关联分析。
为节点添加 GPU，因为吞吐量下降总是意味着加速器不足。
questions.e: Option C is correct because the throughput drop coincides with high temperature and lower clock frequency, which can indicate thermal throttling. Option A is not correct because memory use is stable. Option B omits the GPU measures that match the observed change. Option D is not justified without evidence that the workload lacks GPU capacity.
questions.eZh: 选项 C 正确，因为吞吐量下降与高温和较低的时钟频率同时出现，这可能表明发生了热节流。选项 A 不正确，因为显存使用情况是稳定的。选项 B 遗漏了与所观察到的变化相对应的 GPU 指标。选项 D 在没有证据表明工作负载缺乏 GPU 容量的情况下缺乏依据。

questions.q: Choose two actions that would best address the allocation and isolation problems.
questions.qZh: 选择两项最能解决资源分配和隔离问题的操作。
o: Configure GPUs as Slurm GRES resources so the scheduler can track and allocate them.
Place every GPU job in one partition and allow only one job to run at a time.
Ask each user to select a GPU by setting CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES manually.
Enable Slurm cgroup device constraints so a job can access only its allocated GPU devices.
Schedule jobs using CPU and memory requests only, and rely on applications to share GPUs.
Record each node's GPU count in an inventory without associating GPU resources with jobs.
oZh: 将 GPU 配置为 Slurm GRES 资源，以便调度器能够跟踪和分配它们。
把所有 GPU 作业放入同一个分区，并且每次只允许运行一个作业。
要求每个用户通过手动设置 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES 来选择 GPU。
启用 Slurm cgroup 设备约束，使作业只能访问分配给它的 GPU 设备。
仅使用 CPU 和内存请求来调度作业，并依赖应用程序自行共享 GPU。
在清单中记录每个节点的 GPU 数量，但不将 GPU 资源与作业关联。
questions.e: Options A and D are correct because GRES lets Slurm schedule GPU resources, while cgroup device constraints restrict job access to the allocated devices. Option B unnecessarily serializes work without fixing device access. Option C relies on user settings. Option E ignores GPU allocation, and option F records inventory without enabling scheduling or isolation.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 D 正确，因为 GRES 让 Slurm 能够调度 GPU 资源，而 cgroup 设备约束会将作业访问限制在已分配的设备上。选项 B 在没有解决设备访问问题的前提下不必要地串行化工作。选项 C 依赖用户自行设置。选项 E 忽略了 GPU 分配，而选项 F 只记录清单，无法实现调度或隔离。

questions.q: Choose two checks the platform team should complete before deploying the virtualized GPU service.
questions.qZh: 选择两项平台团队在部署虚拟化 GPU 服务之前应完成的检查。
o: Verify that the GPU model, hypervisor, NVIDIA vGPU software, and driver combination is supported, including required licensing.
Assume assigning an entire GPU to each VM will allow several VMs to share that same physical GPU.
Use MIG and NVIDIA vGPU as interchangeable features because both always provide the same isolation and profiles.
Select vGPU profiles according to each workload's GPU memory and compute needs, along with its sharing and isolation requirements.
Size each VM using only its vCPU and system memory requirements because GPU workloads do not need separate planning.
oZh: 确认 GPU 型号、hypervisor、NVIDIA vGPU 软件与驱动程序的组合受支持，包括所需的许可。
假定为每个 VM 分配整个 GPU 就能让多个 VM 共享同一块物理 GPU。
把 MIG 和 NVIDIA vGPU 当作可互换的特性，因为两者始终提供相同的隔离和配置档位。
根据每个工作负载的 GPU 显存与算力需求，以及其共享和隔离要求来选择 vGPU 配置档位。
仅依据 vCPU 和系统内存需求来规划每个 VM，因为 GPU 工作负载无需单独规划。
questions.e: Options A and D are correct because vGPU deployment depends on a supported software and hardware stack, and profiles must fit workload needs and sharing requirements. Option B describes whole-GPU assignment, not sharing. Option C treats distinct technologies as interchangeable. Option E ignores GPU memory and compute needs when sizing VMs.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 D 正确，因为 vGPU 部署依赖于受支持的软硬件技术栈，且配置档位必须契合工作负载需求与共享要求。选项 B 描述的是整卡分配，而非共享。选项 C 将不同的技术视为可互换。选项 E 在规划 VM 时忽略了 GPU 显存和算力需求。

questions.q: What NVIDIA tool should a data center administrator use to monitor NVIDIA GPUs?
questions.qZh: 数据中心管理员应使用哪款 NVIDIA 工具来监控 NVIDIA GPU？
o: NVIDIA System Monitor
NetQ
DCGM
oZh: NVIDIA System Monitor
NetQ
DCGM
questions.e: The NVIDIA Data Center GPU Manager (DCGM) is the recommended tool for data center administrators to monitor NVIDIA GPUs. It provides real-time health monitoring, telemetry (e.g., utilization, temperature), and diagnostics, tailored for large-scale deployments. NetQ focuses on network monitoring, and there’s no “NVIDIA System Monitor” in this context, making DCGM the correct choice. (Note: The document incorrectly lists D; C is intended.) (Reference: NVIDIA DCGM Documentation, Overview Section)
questions.eZh: NVIDIA Data Center GPU Manager (DCGM) 是推荐数据中心管理员用于监控 NVIDIA GPU 的工具。它提供实时健康监控、遥测（例如利用率、温度）以及诊断功能，专为大规模部署而设计。NetQ 侧重网络监控，而此处并不存在“NVIDIA System Monitor”，因此 DCGM 是正确选择。（注意：文档中错误地列出了 D；本意应为 C。）（参考：NVIDIA DCGM 文档，概述章节）

questions.q: Which NVIDIA product is used for data preparation in an AI workflow?
questions.qZh: 在 AI 工作流中，哪款 NVIDIA 产品用于数据准备？
o: DOCA
RAPIDS
DLSS
oZh: DOCA
RAPIDS
DLSS
questions.e: NVIDIA identifies RAPIDS as the correct product for data preparation. NVIDIA AI Enterprise documentation describes NVIDIA RAPIDS as “GPU-accelerated data science libraries for data preparation, machine learning, and graph analytics.” RAPIDS is therefore the correct answer because it accelerates data science and data preparation workflows on GPUs. DOCA is primarily for data center infrastructure and DPU software development, while DLSS is an AI-powered graphics rendering technology, not a data-preparation product for AI workflows.
questions.eZh: NVIDIA 将 RAPIDS 认定为用于数据准备的正确产品。NVIDIA AI Enterprise 文档将 NVIDIA RAPIDS 描述为“用于数据准备、机器学习和图分析的 GPU 加速数据科学库”。因此 RAPIDS 是正确答案，因为它能在 GPU 上加速数据科学与数据准备工作流。DOCA 主要面向数据中心基础设施和 DPU 软件开发，而 DLSS 是一项 AI 驱动的图形渲染技术，并非面向 AI 工作流的数据准备产品。

questions.q: Which protocol is most critical for low-latency GPU-to-GPU transfers in large AI clusters using Ethernet?
questions.qZh: 在使用 Ethernet 的大型 AI 集群中，对于低延迟的 GPU 间数据传输，哪个协议最为关键？
o: DCTCP with ECN-based congestion control.
PFC-only lossless Ethernet without RDMA.
RDMA over Converged Ethernet, or RoCE.
iWARP, RDMA on TCP over Ethernet.
oZh: 采用基于 ECN 的拥塞控制的 DCTCP。
仅使用 PFC 的无损 Ethernet，不带 RDMA。
融合以太网上的 RDMA，即 RoCE。
iWARP，即在 Ethernet 上基于 TCP 的 RDMA。
questions.e: RoCE is the correct answer because it provides RDMA over Ethernet for low-latency, efficient data movement. NVIDIA networking documentation states: “Remote Direct Memory Access (RDMA) is the remote memory management capability that allows server-to-server data movement directly between application memory without any CPU involvement.” It then states: “RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) is a mechanism to provide this efficient data transfer with very low latencies on lossless Ethernet networks.” NVIDIA DOCA documentation similarly states that RoCE extends RDMA functionality to lossless Ethernet networks, delivering “high-throughput, ultra-low latency communication.” This is especially important for large AI clusters because distributed training requires fast GPU-to-GPU and node-to-node communication. NVIDIA states that Spectrum-X builds on Ethernet with RoCE extensions to enhance performance for AI, bringing InfiniBand-style best practices such as adaptive routing and congestion control to Ethernet. Why the other options are incorrect: DCTCP and ECN can support congestion control, but they are not the core GPU-to-GPU low-latency data-transfer protocol. PFC-only Ethernet without RDMA does not provide the direct memory-access benefit. iWARP is RDMA over TCP, but NVIDIA AI Ethernet designs emphasize RoCE for high-performance AI networking.
questions.eZh: RoCE 是正确答案，因为它在 Ethernet 上提供 RDMA，实现低延迟、高效的数据传输。NVIDIA 网络文档指出：“远程直接内存访问 (RDMA) 是一种远程内存管理能力，允许在完全不涉及 CPU 的情况下，直接在应用内存之间进行服务器到服务器的数据传输。”随后又指出：“融合以太网上的 RDMA (RoCE) 是一种机制，用于在无损 Ethernet 网络上以极低延迟提供这种高效的数据传输。”NVIDIA DOCA 文档同样指出，RoCE 将 RDMA 功能扩展到无损 Ethernet 网络，提供“高吞吐、超低延迟的通信”。这对大型 AI 集群尤为重要，因为分布式训练需要快速的 GPU 间和节点间通信。NVIDIA 表示，Spectrum-X 在 Ethernet 基础上扩展 RoCE 以提升 AI 性能，将自适应路由和拥塞控制等 InfiniBand 风格的最佳实践带入 Ethernet。其他选项不正确的原因：DCTCP 和 ECN 可支持拥塞控制，但它们并不是 GPU 间低延迟数据传输的核心协议。不带 RDMA 的仅 PFC Ethernet 无法提供直接内存访问的收益。iWARP 是基于 TCP 的 RDMA，但 NVIDIA 的 AI Ethernet 设计强调使用 RoCE 来实现高性能 AI 网络。

questions.q: Why use NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage in an AI cluster?
questions.qZh: 为什么在 AI 集群中使用 NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage？
o: Improves TCP/IP data transmission speeds between GPUs and CPUs.
Simplifies traditional CPU-centric storage input/output paths.
Enables peer-to-peer memory transfers between GPUs and NVMe storage.
Increases GPU clock rate by offloading storage read/write.
oZh: 提升 GPU 与 CPU 之间 TCP/IP 数据传输的速度。
简化以 CPU 为中心的传统存储输入/输出路径。
支持 GPU 与 NVMe 存储之间的对等内存传输。
通过卸载存储读写来提高 GPU 时钟频率。
questions.e: NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage is used to create a direct data path between storage and GPU memory. NVIDIA’s GPUDirect Storage Overview Guide states: “GPUDirect® Storage (GDS) enables a direct data path for direct memory access (DMA) transfers between GPU memory and storage, which avoids a bounce buffer through the CPU.” It also says this direct path can relieve system bandwidth bottlenecks and reduce CPU latency and utilization load. NVIDIA’s GPUDirect Storage technical blog further explains that GPUDirect Storage enables “a direct data path between local or remote storage, like NVMe or NVMe over Fabric (NVMe-oF), and GPU memory.” Therefore, the correct answer is C: it enables peer-to-peer memory transfers between GPUs and NVMe storage. Why the other options are incorrect: GPUDirect Storage is not primarily about TCP/IP transmission between GPUs and CPUs. It does simplify and bypass parts of the traditional CPU-centric storage path, but the more precise answer is direct GPU-memory-to-storage transfer. It does not increase GPU clock rates.
questions.eZh: NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage 用于在存储与 GPU 内存之间构建直接数据路径。NVIDIA 的《GPUDirect Storage 概述指南》指出：“GPUDirect® Storage (GDS) 支持在 GPU 内存与存储之间为直接内存访问 (DMA) 传输建立直接数据路径，从而避免经由 CPU 进行弹跳缓冲区拷贝。”它还指出，这条直接路径可缓解系统带宽瓶颈，并降低 CPU 延迟与负载占用。NVIDIA 的 GPUDirect Storage 技术博客进一步说明，GPUDirect Storage 可实现“本地或远程存储（如 NVMe 或 NVMe over Fabric (NVMe-oF)）与 GPU 内存之间的直接数据路径”。因此，正确答案是 C：它支持 GPU 与 NVMe 存储之间的对等内存传输。其他选项不正确的原因：GPUDirect Storage 主要并不是关于 GPU 与 CPU 之间的 TCP/IP 传输。它确实简化并绕过了一部分以 CPU 为中心的传统存储路径，但更准确的答案是 GPU 内存与存储之间的直接传输。它不会提高 GPU 时钟频率。

questions.q: Which of the following is a best practice for addressing model drift in AI operations?
questions.qZh: 以下哪一项是应对 AI 运维中模型漂移的最佳实践？
o: Increase hardware resources when accuracy drops.
Monitor deployed models regularly and retrain with fresh data.
Permit changes in input data distributions over time.
Allow the model to generalize to any data.
oZh: 准确率下降时增加硬件资源。
定期监控已部署的模型，并用新数据重新训练。
允许输入数据分布随时间发生变化。
让模型能够泛化到任意数据。
questions.e: The correct answer is B because model drift is an operational issue where production model performance changes as data, user behavior, or business conditions change. NVIDIA’s recommender systems best-practices documentation states that production modules should be continuously monitored: “Modules are continuously monitored so that the quality of the recommendation can be measured in real time through a range of KPIs.” It further explains that these modules “trigger full retraining should model drift occur, such as when certain KPIs fall below known established baselines.” NVIDIA’s TAO Toolkit guidance also supports retraining as the correct response to drift: “To avoid model drift or to accommodate changing business requirements, retrain your model regularly.” Why the other options are incorrect: Increasing hardware resources may improve throughput or latency, but it does not fix degraded model accuracy caused by drift. Permitting input distributions to change without controls is a cause of drift, not a mitigation. Assuming a model will generalize to any data is not a valid AI operations practice. The verified best practice is to monitor deployed models and retrain or update them with fresh, representative data.
questions.eZh: 正确答案是 B，因为模型漂移属于运维问题：当数据、用户行为或业务条件发生变化时，生产环境中的模型性能随之改变。NVIDIA 的推荐系统最佳实践文档指出，生产模块应被持续监控：“模块会被持续监控，从而可以通过一系列 KPI 实时衡量推荐质量。”它进一步说明，这些模块“会在发生模型漂移时触发完全重新训练，例如当某些 KPI 低于已知既定基线时”。NVIDIA TAO Toolkit 指南同样支持将重新训练作为应对漂移的正确做法：“为避免模型漂移或适应不断变化的业务需求，请定期重新训练模型。”其他选项不正确的原因：增加硬件资源可能提升吞吐或降低延迟，但无法解决漂移导致的模型准确率下降。放任输入分布变化而不加管控是造成漂移的原因，而非缓解手段。假定模型能泛化到任意数据并不是有效的 AI 运维实践。经验证的最佳实践是监控已部署的模型，并用新鲜且具代表性的数据重新训练或更新模型。

questions.q: What is a key advantage of dynamic, priority-based job scheduling in an AI cluster?
questions.qZh: 在 AI 集群中，基于优先级的动态作业调度有什么关键优势？
o: It operates completely independently of job priority, user role, or service-level objectives defined for different workloads.
It is designed primarily for lightly utilized or idle clusters, where there is little or no contention for resources.
It ensures time-critical or high-priority workloads receive prompt access to constrained compute resources when contention occurs.
It allocates identical resource shares to every submitted job, regardless of workload type or business impact.
oZh: 它的运行完全独立于作业优先级、用户角色或为不同工作负载所定义的服务级别目标。
它主要面向资源利用率低或处于空闲状态的集群，那里几乎不存在资源争用。
它确保时间紧迫或高优先级的工作负载在发生资源争用时能够及时获取受限的计算资源。
无论工作负载类型或业务影响如何，它都为每个提交的作业分配相同的资源份额。
questions.e: The correct answer is C because priority-based scheduling is specifically intended to allocate scarce GPU resources according to workload importance. NVIDIA Run:ai documentation states: “Optimized workload scheduling — Ensure high-priority jobs get GPU resources. Workloads dynamically receive resources based on demand.” NVIDIA also explains that the Run:ai Scheduler “allows the prioritization of workloads across different departments and projects within the organization at large scales, based on the resource distribution set by the system administrator.” NVIDIA’s scheduler concepts further confirm that “Workload’s priority sets the scheduling precedence within a project,” and that high-priority workloads can preempt lower-priority preemptible workloads in the same scheduling queue. Therefore, the key advantage is that urgent or high-priority workloads can receive timely access to constrained compute resources when resource contention occurs.
questions.eZh: 正确答案是 C，因为基于优先级的调度旨在按照工作负载的重要性分配稀缺的 GPU 资源。NVIDIA Run:ai 文档指出：“优化的工作负载调度 —— 确保高优先级作业获得 GPU 资源。工作负载根据需求动态获取资源。”NVIDIA 还说明，Run:ai 调度器“能够依据系统管理员设定的资源分配，在整个组织范围内大规模地对不同部门和项目的工作负载进行优先级排序”。NVIDIA 的调度器概念进一步确认：“工作负载的优先级决定其在项目内的调度优先次序”，并且在同一调度队列中，高优先级工作负载可以抢占低优先级的可抢占工作负载。因此，关键优势在于：当资源发生争用时，紧急或高优先级的工作负载能够及时获取受限的计算资源。

questions.q: What is a direct benefit of using GPUDirect RDMA for multi-server workloads?
questions.qZh: 对多服务器工作负载使用 GPUDirect RDMA 的直接收益是什么？
o: Raises GPU base memory clock speeds.
Offloads data movement from CPUs.
Allows CPUs to prioritize scheduling.
Compresses transferred data.
oZh: 提高 GPU 显存基础时钟频率。
将数据移动工作从 CPU 上卸载。
让 CPU 能够优先进行调度。
压缩所传输的数据。
questions.e: GPUDirect RDMA is used in multi-server GPU workloads to enable a direct peer-to-peer data path between GPU memory and NVIDIA networking devices. NVIDIA states that GPUDirect RDMA provides “a direct P2P data path” between GPU memory and NVIDIA host networking devices, which reduces GPU-to-GPU communication latency and “completely offloads the CPU.” This means the direct benefit is that CPU involvement in GPU-to-GPU network communication is removed or greatly reduced. The option “Offloads data movement from CPUs” is therefore correct. NVIDIA’s GPUDirect page also explains that network adapters and storage drives can directly read and write GPU memory, “eliminating unnecessary memory copies,” decreasing CPU overhead, and reducing latency. Why the other options are incorrect: GPUDirect RDMA does not raise GPU memory clock speeds, does not primarily act as a CPU scheduling feature, and does not compress transferred data. Its purpose is direct data movement between GPU memory and network/storage devices to reduce latency, reduce unnecessary copies, and lower CPU overhead.
questions.eZh: GPUDirect RDMA 用于多服务器 GPU 工作负载，在 GPU 内存与 NVIDIA 网络设备之间建立直接的对等数据路径。NVIDIA 表示，GPUDirect RDMA 在 GPU 内存与 NVIDIA 主机网络设备之间提供“直接 P2P 数据路径”，从而降低 GPU 间通信延迟并“完全卸载 CPU”。这意味着直接收益是 CPU 在 GPU 间网络通信中的参与被消除或大幅减少。因此“将数据移动工作从 CPU 上卸载”是正确答案。NVIDIA 的 GPUDirect 页面还说明，网络适配器和存储驱动器可以直接读写 GPU 内存，“消除不必要的内存拷贝”，降低 CPU 开销并减少延迟。其他选项不正确的原因：GPUDirect RDMA 不会提高 GPU 显存时钟频率，也不主要充当 CPU 调度特性，更不会压缩所传输的数据。它的目的是在 GPU 内存与网络/存储设备之间直接传输数据，以降低延迟、减少不必要的拷贝并降低 CPU 开销。

questions.q: In the field of Artificial Intelligence, there is a hierarchical structure of subsets that delineates the relationship between different areas of study and application within AI. What is the hierarchical structure of subsets?
questions.qZh: 在人工智能领域，存在一个划分子集的层级结构，用于界定 AI 内不同研究与应用领域之间的关系。这个子集的层级结构是什么？
o: Generative AI, Deep Learning, Machine Learning.
Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI.

Machine Learning, Generative AI, Deep Learning. B The correct hierarchy is Machine Learning → Deep Learning → Generative AI. NVIDIA explains that “Deep learning is a subset of AI and machine learning that uses multi-layered artificial neural networks.” NVIDIA’s deep learning glossary also states that “Deep learning is a subset of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML)” and describes the progression of AI, machine learning, and deep learning. o: Clustering
Supervised

Reinforcement C Reinforcement learning is the correct answer because the robot learns through interaction with an environment and improves behavior based on feedback. NVIDIA Isaac Lab documentation states: “In reinforcement learning, the robot interacts with its environment, trying different actions and receiving feedback in the form of rewards or penalties. The goal is to maximize the cumulative reward over time.” NVIDIA also states that reinforcement learning is foundational for many sim-to-real robotics approaches, enabling robots to learn complex behaviors in simulated environments before transferring those skills to the real world. Why the other options are incorrect: Clustering is unsupervised learning used to group data, not to train an agent through actions and rewards. Supervised learning uses labeled examples, but the question describes an autonomous robot learning actions through real-world interaction and task completion, which matches reinforcement learning. questions.q: Before expanding an AI cluster, which facility items must be validated?

questions.q: Which of the following best describes Word2vec?

A statistical technique used to analyze word frequency in a text corpus.

A database management system designed for storing and querying word data.

用于分析文本语料库中词频的一种统计技术。

为存储和查询词数据而设计的一种数据库管理系统。
questions.e: Word2vec is a technique developed by Google that uses shallow neural networks to learn vector representations (embeddings) of words, capturing their semantic relationships based on context in large text corpora.

questions.q: In the context of language models, what does an autoregressive model predict?
questions.qZh: 在语言模型的语境下，自回归模型预测什么？
o: The probability of the next token in a text given the previous tokens.
The probability of the next token using a Monte Carlo sampling of past tokens.
The next token solely using recurrent network or LTSM cells.
The probability of the next token by looking at the previous and future input tokens.
oZh: 给定前面的 token，预测文本中下一个 token 的概率。
通过对过往 token 进行蒙特卡洛采样来预测下一个 token 的概率。
仅使用循环网络或 LTSM 单元预测下一个 token。
通过同时查看前面的和后面的输入 token 来预测下一个 token 的概率。
questions.e: An autoregressive language model generates text by predicting the next token (word, subword, or character) based on all the tokens that came before it. For example: Input: "The capital of France is" The model predicts the probability distribution for the next token, such as: Paris → 90% Lyon → 5% Marseille → 3% Others → 2% It then selects or samples the next token and repeats the process.

questions.q: In large-language models, what is the purpose of the attention mechanism?

To determine the order in which words are generated.
To capture the order of the words in the input sequence.
To assign weights to each word in the input sequence.
oZh: 衡量输出序列中各词的重要性。
确定词语的生成顺序。
捕获输入序列中词语的顺序。
为输入序列中的每个词分配权重。
questions.e: The attention mechanism allows a model to focus on the most relevant parts of the input when generating each output token. Instead of treating all words equally, attention dynamically weighs different tokens based on their importance in context.
questions.eZh: 参考答案：D（为输入序列中的每个词分配权重。）。原题未附中文解析，可在「来源」里看社区讨论。

questions.q: In the transformer architecture, what is the purpose of positional encoding?

To encode the semantic meaning of each token in the input sequence.
To add information about the order of each token in the input sequence.
To encode the importance of each token in the input sequence.

编码输入序列中每个 token 的语义含义。
为输入序列中每个 token 的顺序添加信息。
编码输入序列中每个 token 的重要性。

Propagating the error backward through the network. Computing gradients for each weight. Updating the weights (typically using Gradient Descent or an optimizer such as Adam) to reduce the error. This process is repeated over many training iterations until the model learns to make accurate predictions.

questions.q: What is a foundation model in the context of Large Language Models (LLMs)?

任何在大规模海量数据上训练、旨在充当可适配于各种下游任务的起点的模型。
任何经人工智能安全研究所验证、可作为构建基于 transformer 的应用基础的模型。
任何基于奠基论文《Attention is all you need》、且使用循环神经网络和卷积层的模型。

questions.q: Why is layer normalization important in transformer architectures?

To compress the model size for efficient storage.
To stabilize the learning process by adjusting the inputs across the features.
To encode positional information within the sequence.

压缩模型体积以便高效存储。
通过在各个特征之间调整输入来稳定学习过程。

questions.e: Layer Normalization helps stabilize and speed up the training of Transformer models by normalizing the activations across the features of each token. This keeps values within a consistent range, reducing training instability and helping gradients flow more effectively through deep networks.

questions.q: Why do we need positional encoding in transformer-based models?

questions.q: What value will the parameter have after this gradient descent update?
