questions.e: Option B is correct because gradient descent subtracts the learning rate times the gradient, giving 0.40 minus 0.1 times 0.8, or 0.32. Option A adds the gradient contribution instead of subtracting it. Option C makes no update. Option D multiplies the learning rate and gradient but omits the parameter's starting value.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为梯度下降会减去学习率与梯度的乘积，即 0.40 减去 0.1 乘以 0.8，结果为 0.32。选项 A 是将梯度的贡献相加而非相减。选项 C 没有做任何更新。选项 D 将学习率与梯度相乘，但遗漏了参数的初始值。

questions.topic: Fundamentals of Machine Learning and Neural Networks
questions.q: What limitation should the team expect from this model configuration?
questions.qZh: 团队应当预期这一模型配置具有什么局限？
o: The model can distinguish the two sequences because each token has a unique learned embedding.
The model cannot distinguish sequence order from token content using these layers alone.
The model will produce identical representations for every token in both sequences.
The model cannot calculate attention weights unless the tokens are supplied one at a time.
oZh: 由于每个 token 都有各自唯一的学习嵌入，模型能够区分这两个序列。
仅凭这些层，模型无法区分序列顺序与 token 内容。
模型会为两个序列中的每个 token 产生完全相同的表示。
除非一次只提供一个 token，否则模型无法计算注意力权重。
questions.e: Option B is correct because unmasked self-attention without positional information does not provide a signal that distinguishes token order. Option A confuses token identity with position. Option C is too strong, since token content can produce different representations. Option D is incorrect because self-attention processes a sequence of token representations together.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为不含位置信息的无掩码自注意力并未提供可区分 token 顺序的信号。选项 A 混淆了 token 身份与位置。选项 C 表述过强，因为 token 内容可以产生不同的表示。选项 D 错误，因为自注意力会同时处理整个 token 表示序列。

questions.topic: Fundamentals of Machine Learning and Neural Networks
questions.q: Which change most directly addresses the training behavior?
questions.qZh: 哪种改动能最直接地解决该训练表现问题？
o: Increase the learning rate so each update moves farther toward the minimum.
Reduce the learning rate so updates are less likely to overshoot the minimum.
Replace the loss function with accuracy so the update direction is more stable.
Add another hidden layer so the optimizer has more parameters to adjust.
oZh: 提高学习率，使每次更新朝最小值移动得更远。
降低学习率，使更新更不容易越过最小值。
将损失函数替换为准确率，使更新方向更加稳定。
再增加一个隐藏层，让优化器有更多参数可供调整。
questions.e: Option B is correct because the repeated overshooting and rising loss indicate that the update step may be too large, so reducing the learning rate is the direct adjustment. Option A would make overshooting more likely. Option C substitutes a non-differentiable metric for the training loss. Option D changes model capacity without addressing the unstable update size.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为反复越过最小值且损失上升表明更新步长可能过大，因此降低学习率是最直接的调整方式。选项 A 会让越过最小值的情况更容易发生。选项 C 用不可微的度量替代了训练损失。选项 D 改变的是模型容量，并未解决更新步长不稳定的问题。

questions.q: Which prompt revision is most likely to produce consistent, machine-readable results?
questions.qZh: 哪种提示改写最有可能产生一致且可被机器解析的结果？
o: Ask the model to extract the fields and return a clear answer, using its judgment when information is missing.
Instruct the model to return only a JSON object with the specified keys, copy values from the source, and use null for missing fields.
Ask the model to explain its extraction choices before presenting the requested fields.
Ask the model to produce a concise response and let the downstream system infer the field names.
oZh: 要求模型抽取各字段并给出明确答案，在信息缺失时由其自行判断。
指示模型只返回带有指定键的 JSON 对象，数值从源内容中照抄，缺失字段使用 null。
要求模型在给出所需字段之前，先解释其抽取决策的理由。
要求模型给出简洁回复，由下游系统推断字段名称。
questions.e: Option B is correct because the required JSON keys and null policy directly address the team's parsing failures and inconsistent handling of missing values. Option A leaves both the output structure and missing-value behavior open to interpretation. Option C adds prose that can break parsing. Option D does not guarantee that the model will provide stable field names.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为明确的 JSON 键和 null 策略直接针对团队的解析失败以及缺失值处理不一致的问题。选项 A 将输出结构和缺失值行为都留待解释。选项 C 增加了可能破坏解析的成段文字。选项 D 无法保证模型会提供稳定的字段名称。

questions.q: Which prompt change best addresses the inconsistent summaries while keeping the model's response tied to the supplied reports?
questions.qZh: 哪种提示改动既能解决摘要前后不一致的问题，又能让模型的回复紧扣所提供的报告？
o: Ask for a more confident summary and tell the model to fill gaps using its general knowledge.
Specify the audience, request a concise summary under fixed headings, and instruct the model to distinguish report findings from recommendations.
Ask the model to produce several alternative summaries so the team can choose the most persuasive one.
Tell the model to summarize each report in one sentence without specifying what information matters.
oZh: 要求给出更笃定的摘要，并指示模型用其通用知识填补空缺。
明确受众，要求在固定标题下给出简洁摘要，并指示模型区分报告发现与建议。
要求模型生成若干备选摘要，以便团队挑选最有说服力的一个。
指示模型用一句话概括每份报告，但不指定哪些信息重要。
questions.e: Option B is correct because fixed headings and a clear distinction between findings and recommendations address the team's format and unsupported-claim problems. Option A invites information beyond the reports. Option C increases variation instead of defining a consistent response. Option D adds a length limit but does not guide which decision-relevant details to include.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为固定标题以及对发现与建议的清晰区分，直接针对团队的格式问题和无依据的论断问题。选项 A 会引入报告之外的信息。选项 C 增加了差异性，而非定义出一致的回答。选项 D 只增加了长度限制，但未指导应包含哪些与决策相关的细节。

questions.q: Which prompt strategy should the team use to reduce confusion between the two labels?
questions.qZh: 团队应采用哪种提示策略来减少两个标签之间的混淆？
o: Add several representative examples, including borderline cases, with the intended label and a consistent output format.
Repeat the two label names several times and ask the model to choose the more suitable one.
Provide one example for only the more frequent label and request a detailed explanation for every new ticket.
Ask the model to create its own definitions for the labels before classifying each ticket.
oZh: 加入若干有代表性的示例（含边界案例），并给出预期标签和一致的输出格式。
多次重复两个标签名称，并要求模型选择更合适的一个。
只为出现频率更高的标签提供一个示例，并要求对每个新工单给出详细解释。
要求模型在分类每个工单之前，先自行创建标签定义。
questions.e: Option A is correct because labeled examples, especially borderline cases, show how the team applies the two categories and establish the expected response format. Option B repeats the names without clarifying their distinction. Option C provides no guidance for the less frequent label. Option D lets the model redefine categories that the team has already established.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为带标签的示例（尤其是边界案例）展示了团队如何应用这两个类别，并确立了预期的响应格式。选项 B 只是重复名称，并未澄清二者的区别。选项 C 未为出现较少的标签提供任何指导。选项 D 允许模型重新定义团队已经确定的类别。

questions.q: Which post-training method best fits the team’s available data and alignment goal?
questions.qZh: 哪种后训练方法最契合团队现有的数据和对齐目标？
o: Continue supervised fine-tuning on ideal answers without using the ranked comparisons
Apply direct preference optimization using the ranked response pairs
Increase the model’s sampling temperature during inference
Add a retrieval system that returns the company’s policy documents
oZh: 在理想答案上继续进行监督微调，而不使用排序后的对比数据。
利用排序后的回复对应用直接偏好优化。
在推理期间提高模型的采样温度。
添加一个返回公司政策文档的检索系统。
questions.e: Option B is correct because the team already has ranked safe and unsafe response pairs, which direct preference optimization can use to move behavior toward preferred responses without first training a separate reward model. Option A does not use the ranking signal. Option C changes randomness rather than alignment. Option D supplies policy text but does not train the model to follow it reliably.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为团队已经拥有排序后的安全与不安全回复对，直接偏好优化可以利用这些数据将模型行为转向更受偏好的回复，而无需先训练一个单独的奖励模型。选项 A 没有利用排序信号。选项 C 改变的是随机性而非对齐效果。选项 D 提供了政策文本，但没有训练模型可靠地遵循这些政策。

questions.q: Which action best addresses the alignment failure while preserving fair treatment across applicant groups?
questions.qZh: 哪种做法既能解决对齐失效问题，又能保证对各申请者群体一视同仁？
o: Create policy-reviewed preference comparisons that reject decisions based on protected traits, then use them for preference-based alignment
Remove protected-trait fields from the final response after the model has made its recommendation
Apply a general toxicity filter to block offensive words in the assistant’s output
Increase the amount of general text used for continued pretraining
oZh: 创建经过政策审查的偏好对比，拒绝基于受保护特征的决策，然后用其进行基于偏好的对齐。
在模型给出建议之后，再从最终回复中移除受保护特征字段。
应用通用的毒性过滤器，阻止助手输出中的冒犯性词汇。
增加用于持续预训练的通用文本量。
questions.e: Option A is correct because policy-reviewed preference comparisons can teach the model to favor recommendations that do not rely on protected traits, directly addressing the observed disparity. Option B can hide a trait in the output without changing the underlying decision. Option C targets offensive wording, not discriminatory recommendations. Option D does not provide a fairness preference signal.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为经过政策审查的偏好对比可以教会模型偏好不依赖受保护特征的推荐，从而直接解决所观察到的差异。选项 B 只能把特征从输出中隐藏，却无法改变底层的决策。选项 C 针对的是冒犯性措辞，而非歧视性推荐。选项 D 未提供任何公平性偏好信号。

questions.q: Which alignment change is the best fit for this requirement?
questions.qZh: 哪项对齐（alignment）调整最符合该需求？
o: Use safety preference examples that favor a brief refusal for harmful requests and a safe alternative for benign educational requests
Refuse every request that mentions chemistry, regardless of the user’s purpose
Add a system instruction asking the model to be careful, without changing its alignment data
Increase the model’s parameter count so it can distinguish more types of requests
oZh: 使用安全偏好示例：对有害请求给出简短拒绝，对无害的教育类请求给出安全的替代方案
无论用户目的如何，拒绝所有提及化学的请求
添加系统指令要求模型谨慎行事，但不修改其对齐数据
增加模型的参数量，使其能够区分更多类型的请求
questions.e: Option A is correct because the examples teach the model to refuse harmful instructions while retaining useful responses to safe educational questions. Option B blocks benign content along with harmful content. Option C relies only on an instruction and does not address the team’s stated need for a post-training change. Option D does not specify a safety behavior or provide a safety signal.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为这些示例教会模型拒绝有害指令，同时对安全的教育类问题保持有用的回答。选项 B 在屏蔽有害内容的同时也屏蔽了良性内容。选项 C 仅依赖指令，未能满足团队明确提出的后训练变更需求。选项 D 既未规定安全行为，也未提供安全信号。

questions.q: Which visualization would best reveal the category-specific change?
questions.qZh: 哪种可视化最能揭示该类别的特定变化？
o: A single line showing the overall monthly average score
A pie chart showing the latest month's score by category
Small-multiple line charts, one per category, with a shared vertical scale
A stacked bar chart showing monthly response counts by category
oZh: 一条显示整体月度平均分的单一折线
一个饼图，显示最新一个月各类别的得分
小倍数折线图，每个类别一张，共用统一的纵轴刻度
一个堆叠柱状图，显示各类别每月的响应数量
questions.e: Option C is correct because separate category trends on a shared scale would reveal the billing decline even as the overall score stays stable. Option A hides that decline in the aggregate. Option B shows only one month and cannot show change over time. Option D shows response volume rather than the score pattern.
questions.eZh: 选项 C 正确，因为共用刻度下各分类别独立的趋势能够揭示账单类别的下滑，即使总体得分保持稳定。选项 A 将该下滑隐藏在汇总值中。选项 B 只显示一个月，无法体现随时间的变化。选项 D 展示的是响应量而非得分走势。

questions.q: Which visualization should the team use?
questions.qZh: 团队应使用哪种可视化？
o: A row-normalized confusion matrix, with intended intents on rows and predicted intents on columns
A bar chart of overall accuracy for each intended intent
A pie chart showing the proportion of predictions assigned to each intent
A line chart showing accuracy in the order requests were reviewed
oZh: 一个按行归一化的混淆矩阵，行表示真实意图，列表示预测意图
一个柱状图，展示每个真实意图的整体准确率
一个饼图，展示分配到各意图的预测占比
一条折线图，按请求评审的先后顺序展示准确率
questions.e: Option A is correct because row normalization shows the misclassification rate for each intended intent, despite the uneven intent frequencies, and the matrix reveals the specific pairs being confused. Option B summarizes accuracy but does not show which intents are mistaken for one another. Option C shows prediction proportions, not correctness. Option D relates accuracy to review order, which is not the team’s concern.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为按行归一化可以显示每个真实意图的误分类率，不受各意图频次不均的影响，同时矩阵还能揭示具体被混淆的意图组合。选项 B 汇总了准确率，但未显示哪些意图被相互误判。选项 C 展示的是预测占比，而非正确性。选项 D 将准确率与评审顺序关联，而这不是团队关注的问题。

questions.q: Which visualization should the analyst use to assess whether the system's stated confidence corresponds to its observed answer accuracy?
questions.qZh: 分析师应使用哪种可视化来评估系统给出的置信度是否与其实际观测到的答案准确率相符？
o: A reliability diagram plotting mean confidence against empirical accuracy
A histogram of confidence scores without correctness information
A bar chart of total correct and incorrect answers
A scatter plot of answer length against confidence
oZh: 一张可靠性图（reliability diagram），将平均置信度与经验准确率对比绘制
一张不含正确性信息的置信度分数直方图
一个柱状图，展示正确与错误答案的总数
一张散点图，将答案长度与置信度对比绘制
questions.e: Option A is correct because plotting empirical accuracy against mean confidence reveals whether the system is overconfident or underconfident across confidence levels. Option B shows confidence distribution but not whether answers are correct. Option C summarizes total outcomes without showing how accuracy varies with confidence. Option D compares answer length with confidence, not confidence with observed accuracy.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为将经验准确率与平均置信度对比绘制，可以揭示系统在各置信度区间是过度自信还是信心不足。选项 B 展示置信度分布，但未反映答案是否正确。选项 C 汇总了总体结果，却未显示准确率如何随置信度变化。选项 D 比较的是答案长度与置信度，而非置信度与实际观测准确率。

questions.q: Which run record would best support a reliable comparison and later reproduction of the adapter that performed best?
questions.qZh: 哪份运行记录最能支撑对表现最佳的适配器（adapter）进行可靠比较和后续复现？
o: The final evaluation score, the prompt used for evaluation, and the date of the run
The model and tokenizer revisions, dataset snapshot, training configuration, random seed, evaluation results, and saved adapter
The adapter weights and the training loss from the last step
The model name, the best evaluation score, and a note that the run used the usual settings
oZh: 最终评估分数、用于评估的提示词（prompt）以及运行日期
模型与分词器（tokenizer）版本、数据集快照、训练配置、随机种子、评估结果以及保存的适配器
适配器权重以及最后一步的训练损失
模型名称、最佳评估分数，以及一条说明该次运行使用了常规设置的备注
questions.e: Option B is correct because it records the model, data, configuration, and artifacts needed to interpret and reproduce the run. Option A omits training provenance and the adapter. Option C lacks the data and settings, and its final training loss does not explain evaluation performance. Option D relies on an undefined description of usual settings.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为它记录了解释并复现该次运行所需的模型、数据、配置与产物。选项 A 缺少训练来源信息和适配器。选项 C 缺少数据和设置，其最终训练损失也无法解释评估表现。选项 D 依赖“常规设置”这一未定义的描述。

questions.q: How should the team summarize these results before claiming that one configuration performs better?
questions.qZh: 在声称某项配置表现更优之前，团队应如何汇总这些结果？
o: Use the single highest score from each configuration because it represents the best achievable outcome
Combine the generated answers from all runs and evaluate them as if they came from one model
Report only the median score for each configuration because it removes the effect of random variation
Report the results from each run along with the mean and spread, and avoid basing the claim on the best run alone
oZh: 使用每个配置中的最高分，因为它代表了可达到的最佳结果
合并所有运行生成的答案，并将其视作来自同一个模型来评估
仅报告每个配置的中位数，因为它消除了随机波动的影响
报告每次运行的结果以及均值和离散程度，不要仅凭最佳的一次运行来下结论
questions.e: Option D is correct because the repeated runs expose variation, so reporting individual scores with the mean and spread gives a more reliable comparison. Option A overstates performance by selecting favorable runs. Option B merges outputs from separate models. Option C hides how much the runs vary and does not show whether the result is consistent.
questions.eZh: 选项 D 正确，因为多次重复运行会暴露波动，因此同时报告各次分数、均值和离散程度能给出更可靠的比较。选项 A 通过挑选有利运行夸大了性能。选项 B 把来自不同模型的输出混为一谈。选项 C 掩盖了各次运行之间的差异程度，也未体现结果是否稳定。

questions.q: Which checkpoint should the team record as the best result for this experiment?
questions.qZh: 团队应将哪个检查点（checkpoint）记录为本次实验的最佳结果？
o: The final checkpoint, because it includes the greatest number of training updates
The checkpoint with the highest score on the fixed held-out task evaluation
The checkpoint with the lowest training loss, even though its held-out score is lower
An average of all saved checkpoints, without evaluating that combined model
oZh: 最终检查点，因为它包含最多的训练更新步数
在固定的留出任务评估上得分最高的检查点
训练损失最低的检查点，尽管其留出集得分更低
所有已保存检查点的平均值，且未对该组合模型进行评估
questions.e: Option B is correct because the team defined task score on the held-out evaluation as the comparison measure, and that score peaks before the final update. Option A ignores the observed decline. Option C favors training fit despite weaker held-out performance. Option D selects a model that was never evaluated under the stated measure.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为团队已将留出集评估上的任务得分定义为比较依据，而该得分在最后一次更新之前就已达到峰值。选项 A 忽略了已观察到的性能下滑。选项 C 偏重训练拟合度，尽管留出集表现更弱。选项 D 选取了一个从未按既定指标评估过的模型。

questions.q: Which preprocessing approach best limits leakage between the training and validation sets?
questions.qZh: 哪种预处理方式最能限制训练集与验证集之间的泄漏？
o: Group records by their originating manual family, then assign each family entirely to one split.
Randomly assign individual records to splits after removing records with identical text.
Place records with the newest publication dates in validation and all older records in training.
Assign records to splits by product category, while allowing pages from the same manual family in both.
oZh: 按记录所属的手册系列分组，然后将每个系列整体分配到同一个数据划分中。
在移除文本完全相同的记录后，将单条记录随机分配到各个划分中。
将发布日期最新的记录放入验证集，其余较旧的记录放入训练集。
按产品类别将记录分配到各个划分，同时允许同一手册系列的页面同时出现在两边。
questions.e: Option A is correct because assigning each manual family to only one split keeps copied or closely related pages from appearing in both training and validation. Option B is not correct because nonidentical versions can still share substantial content. Option C is not correct because publication date does not prevent related pages from crossing splits. Option D is not correct because a category can contain related pages in both sets.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为将每个手册系列只分配到一个划分，可以避免内容复制或高度相似的页面同时出现在训练集和验证集中。选项 B 不正确，因为文本不完全相同的版本仍可能共享大量内容。选项 C 不正确，因为发布日期并不能阻止相关页面跨越划分。选项 D 不正确，因为同一类别中可能包含出现在两边的相关页面。

questions.q: Which normalization approach is most appropriate for this dataset?
questions.qZh: 哪种规范化方式最适合该数据集？
o: Convert all text to lowercase, remove punctuation, and replace every serial number with a shared placeholder.
Normalize Unicode text to NFC, standardize line endings and whitespace, and preserve letter case and punctuation.
Transliterate all non-ASCII characters to ASCII and remove diacritical marks from names.
Apply aggressive compatibility normalization and delete punctuation to make all records visually uniform.
oZh: 将所有文本转为小写，移除标点，并将每个序列号替换为统一的占位符。
将 Unicode 文本规范化为 NFC，统一换行符与空白字符，并保留字母大小写和标点。
将所有非 ASCII 字符音译为 ASCII，并从名称中去掉变音符号。
执行激进的兼容性规范化并删除标点，使所有记录在视觉上保持一致。
questions.e: Option B is correct because it standardizes equivalent Unicode forms and whitespace while retaining case-sensitive codes and meaningful punctuation. Option A is not correct because lowercasing and replacing serials can erase distinctions needed in the records. Option C is not correct because transliteration changes customer names. Option D is not correct because aggressive transformations can alter symbols and remove information.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为它统一了等价的 Unicode 形式和空白字符，同时保留了区分大小写的代码和有意义的标点。选项 A 不正确，因为转为小写和替换序列号可能抹去记录中所需的区分信息。选项 C 不正确，因为音译会改变客户名称。选项 D 不正确，因为激进的转换可能改变符号含义并丢失信息。

questions.q: Which method should the team use to prepare the documents for training?
questions.qZh: 团队应采用哪种方法为训练准备文档？
o: Split documents into equal character-count segments, then tokenize each segment with any available tokenizer.
Use the target model's tokenizer, split documents into chunks within its token limit at suitable boundaries, and retain source metadata.
Count whitespace-separated words and treat that count as the model's token count, then truncate every document at the same word index.
Tokenize with a different model's tokenizer, then merge any chunk that ends in the middle of a paragraph.
oZh: 将文档切分为等字符数的片段，然后用任意可用的分词器对每个片段进行分词。
使用目标模型的分词器，在合适的边界处将文档切分为不超过其 token 上限的块，并保留源元数据。
统计以空白分隔的单词数量并将其视为模型的 token 数，然后在相同的单词索引处截断每个文档。
使用另一个模型的分词器进行分词，然后合并所有在段落中间结束的块。
questions.e: Option B is correct because it uses the target model's tokenization and respects the stated context limit while retaining document provenance. Option A is not correct because character counts do not reliably constrain token counts. Option C is not correct because whitespace-separated words are not equivalent to model tokens. Option D is not correct because a different tokenizer can produce incompatible chunk lengths.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为它使用目标模型的分词方式，遵守既定的上下文长度限制，同时保留文档来源信息。选项 A 不正确，因为字符数无法可靠地约束 token 数。选项 C 不正确，因为以空白分隔的单词并不等同于模型 token。选项 D 不正确，因为不同的分词器可能产生长度不兼容的块。

questions.q: Which experiment plan best tests the hypothesis that the newer model version produces higher-quality answers?
questions.qZh: 哪项实验方案最能检验“新版模型能生成更高质量答案”这一假设？
o: Run both versions on the same prompt set, keep generation settings fixed, randomize response order, and have reviewers who do not know the version score answer quality.
Run each version on a different set of prompts, then compare the average reviewer scores.
Run the newer version at a higher temperature and the older version at a lower temperature, then compare their scores.
Run both versions on the same prompts, but let reviewers know which version produced each answer and ask them to score only the newer version.
oZh: 在同一组提示词上运行两个版本，保持生成设置不变，随机化响应顺序，并由不知道版本的评审人员对答案质量评分。
每个版本使用不同的提示词集合运行，然后比较评审平均分。
以更高的 temperature 运行新版模型、以更低的 temperature 运行旧版模型，然后比较分数。
在同一组提示词上运行两个版本，但让评审知道每个答案来自哪个版本，并要求他们只给新版模型打分。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the shared prompt set controls for prompt difficulty, fixed settings isolate the model version, and blinded review reduces rating bias. Option B is not correct because different prompts can create a score difference unrelated to the model. Option C changes two factors. Option D introduces reviewer bias and does not score both versions.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为共用提示词集合控制了提示词难度，固定设置隔离出模型版本因素，盲评则降低了评分偏差。选项 B 不正确，因为不同的提示词可能造成与模型无关的分数差异。选项 C 同时改变了两个因素。选项 D 引入了评审偏差，且未对两个版本都进行评分。

questions.q: Which plan best tests whether the effect of temperature on answer quality differs between the two model versions?
questions.qZh: 哪项方案最能检验 temperature 对答案质量的影响在两个模型版本之间是否存在差异？
o: Test only the newer model at both temperatures, then compare its scores with the older model's existing score from a previous evaluation.
Test both model versions at both temperature settings using the same balanced prompt set, and compare quality scores across all four combinations.
Test the older model at the lower temperature and the newer model at the higher temperature, using a different prompt set for each.
Test each model at one temperature chosen by its development team, then compare the two resulting quality scores.
oZh: 仅在两种 temperature 下测试新模型，然后将其分数与旧模型在先前评估中的已有分数比较。
使用同一组均衡的提示词集合，在两种 temperature 设置下测试两个模型版本，并比较全部四种组合的质量分数。
以较低的 temperature 测试旧模型、以较高的 temperature 测试新模型，并各自使用不同的提示词集合。
在由各自开发团队选定的单一 temperature 下测试每个模型，然后比较两个所得的质量分数。
questions.e: Option B is correct because testing every model and temperature combination allows the team to compare the temperature effect within each version and determine whether those effects differ. Option A lacks a current older-model comparison at both settings. Option C confounds model version, temperature, and prompt set. Option D cannot separate the effects of model version and temperature.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为测试所有模型与 temperature 的组合，可以让团队在每个版本内部比较 temperature 的影响，并判断这些影响是否存在差异。选项 A 缺少旧模型在两种设置下的当期对照。选项 C 混淆了模型版本、temperature 和提示词集合三个因素。选项 D 无法区分模型版本与 temperature 各自的影响。

questions.q: Which implementation best meets the team's requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪种实现最符合团队的要求？
o: Read the complete file into a list, then transform the list and write the results.
Use an iterator that reads, transforms, and writes one record at a time.
Start several worker processes, but first load the complete file into memory for them.
Increase the machine's memory allocation so the existing implementation can finish.
oZh: 将整个文件读入列表，然后对列表进行转换并写出结果。
使用迭代器，每次读取、转换并写出一条记录。
启动若干工作进程，但事先仍需将整个文件加载到内存中供其使用。
增加机器的内存配额，使现有实现能够运行完毕。
questions.e: Option B is correct because an iterator can read and transform one record at a time, keeping memory use independent of the file size. Option A is not correct because it retains every record in memory. Option C is not correct because parallel workers do not remove the initial full-file allocation. Option D is not correct because more memory postpones failure rather than fixing unbounded retention.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为迭代器可以逐条读取并转换记录，使内存占用与文件大小无关。选项 A 不正确，因为它会把每条记录都保留在内存中。选项 C 不正确，因为并行工作进程并未消除最初的全文件内存分配。选项 D 不正确，因为增加内存只是推迟失败，并未解决无上限保留的问题。

questions.q: Which refactoring best meets the team's requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪种重构最符合团队的要求？
o: Create a base report class that requires every feature to use the same fixed section order.
Extract a renderer that accepts ordered sections and formatting functions, while each feature supplies its own section order.
Keep the separate implementations and add a shared test that checks their output.
Store formatting functions in a mutable global registry that each feature changes before rendering.
oZh: 创建一个基类报告类，要求每个功能都使用相同的固定章节顺序。
抽取出一个渲染器，接收有序的章节列表和格式化函数，由各功能自行提供其章节顺序。
保留各自独立的实现，并新增一个用于检查其输出的共享测试。
将格式化函数存放在一个可变全局注册表中，各功能在渲染前对其进行修改。
questions.e: Option B is correct because it centralizes shared rendering behavior while allowing each feature to provide its required order and formatting. Option A is not correct because a fixed order violates the feature-specific layout requirement. Option C is not correct because a shared test does not remove duplicated code. Option D is not correct because changing shared global state can cause features to affect one another.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为它将共享的渲染行为集中起来，同时允许各功能提供各自所需的顺序和格式。选项 A 不正确，因为固定顺序违背了各功能定制布局的要求。选项 C 不正确，因为共享测试并不能消除重复代码。选项 D 不正确，因为修改共享全局状态可能导致各功能相互影响。

questions.q: Which change best makes the calculation independently testable and predictable for different contracts?
questions.qZh: 哪项变更最能使该计算逻辑可独立测试，并且对不同合同可预测？
o: Keep the global pricing table and add a lock around every calculation.
Reset the global pricing table at the start of each test and retain the current function design.
Pass the applicable pricing schedule as an explicit input to a calculation function that does not change shared state.
Cache each calculated total using only the usage amount as the cache key.
oZh: 保留全局价格表，并在每次计算周围加锁。
在每个测试开始时重置全局价格表，并保持现有的函数设计。
将适用的价格方案作为显式输入传给一个不修改共享状态的计算函数。
仅以使用量作为缓存键，缓存每个计算出的总额。
questions.e: Option C is correct because explicit pricing inputs let tests and callers select a contract without changing process-wide state. Option A is not correct because a lock prevents simultaneous access but does not remove hidden dependencies. Option B is not correct because resetting globals still makes results depend on shared mutable state. Option D is not correct because the same usage can have different costs under different schedules.
questions.eZh: 选项 C 正确，因为显式的价格输入让测试和调用方无需修改进程级状态即可选择相应的合同。选项 A 不正确，因为加锁只能防止并发访问，并未消除隐藏依赖。选项 B 不正确，因为重置全局变量后，结果仍依赖于共享的可变状态。选项 D 不正确，因为相同的用量在不同价格方案下可能产生不同费用。

questions.q: Which approach satisfies the team's requirement?
questions.qZh: 哪种做法满足团队的要求？
o: Load the base checkpoint with AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained, then pass that model and the adapter directory to PeftModel.from_pretrained with is_trainable=False.
Load the adapter directory with AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained and use the result directly for inference.
Pass the base model and adapter directory to get_peft_model as its two arguments.
Pass the adapter directory and then the base model to PeftModel.from_pretrained with is_trainable=False.
oZh: 使用 AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained 加载基础检查点，然后将该模型与适配器目录一并传入 PeftModel.from_pretrained，并设置 is_trainable=False。
使用 AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained 加载适配器目录，并将结果直接用于推理。
将基础模型和适配器目录作为两个参数传给 get_peft_model。
先传入适配器目录、再传入基础模型给 PeftModel.from_pretrained，并设置 is_trainable=False。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the team has a separate base checkpoint and adapter, and PeftModel.from_pretrained attaches the adapter to the loaded base without merging it. Option B treats the adapter directory as a complete checkpoint. Option C passes a path where get_peft_model expects a PEFT configuration. Option D reverses the arguments required by PeftModel.from_pretrained.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为团队拥有独立的基础检查点和适配器，而 PeftModel.from_pretrained 可在不合并权重的情况下将适配器附加到已加载的基础模型上。选项 B 把适配器目录当作完整检查点。选项 C 传入的是路径，而 get_peft_model 需要的是 PEFT 配置对象。选项 D 的参数顺序与 PeftModel.from_pretrained 所需相反。

questions.q: An internal model registry contains several checkpoints, and an engineering team must verify that a candidate checkpoint declares a causal-generation architecture before requesting a GPU allocation. The review job runs on a CPU-only worker, must not download or instantiate tensor weights, and only needs the checkpoint's configuration metadata. Which Transformers call best fits this check?
questions.qZh: 某个内部模型注册表包含多个检查点，工程团队必须在申请 GPU 配额之前确认候选检查点声明的是因果生成（causal-generation）架构。该审核作业运行在仅含 CPU 的工作节点上，不得下载或实例化张量权重，只需要检查点的配置元数据。哪一个 Transformers 调用最适合这项检查？
o: Call AutoConfig.from_pretrained(checkpoint_id) and inspect config.architectures.
Call AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint_id) and inspect model.config.architectures.
Call AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint_id) and inspect tokenizer.model_input_names.
Create a text-generation pipeline for checkpoint_id and inspect pipeline.model.config.architectures.
oZh: 调用 AutoConfig.from_pretrained(checkpoint_id) 并检查 config.architectures。
调用 AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(checkpoint_id) 并检查 model.config.architectures。
调用 AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(checkpoint_id) 并检查 tokenizer.model_input_names。
为 checkpoint_id 创建 text-generation pipeline 并检查 pipeline.model.config.architectures。
questions.e: Option A is correct because AutoConfig.from_pretrained retrieves the checkpoint configuration, allowing the CPU-only review to inspect its architectures field without instantiating model weights. Option B is not correct because AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained loads model weights, which violates the worker's constraint. Option C is not correct because tokenizer.model_input_names describes tokenizer inputs, not the checkpoint architecture. Option D is not correct because creating a text-generation pipeline initializes a model rather than performing metadata-only inspection.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为 AutoConfig.from_pretrained 可获取检查点的配置，使仅用 CPU 的审核流程无需实例化模型权重即可检查其 architectures 字段。选项 B 不正确，因为 AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained 会加载模型权重，违反该工作节点的限制。选项 C 不正确，因为 tokenizer.model_input_names 描述的是分词器的输入，而非检查点的架构。选项 D 不正确，因为创建 text-generation pipeline 会初始化模型，而非仅做元数据检查。

questions.q: Which change best preserves the application’s existing request flow while routing inference to the NVIDIA NIM service?
questions.qZh: 哪项变更能在将推理路由到 NVIDIA NIM 服务的同时，最大限度保留应用现有的请求流程？
o: Set the client base URL to the NIM service endpoint and use a model identifier served by that NIM instance.
Replace the chat-completions request with a direct call to the model’s GPU process.
Keep the public provider URL and change only the model identifier to the NIM model name.
Convert each user request into a training-data record before sending it to NIM.
oZh: 将客户端的 base URL 设置为 NIM 服务端点，并使用该 NIM 实例所服务的模型标识符。
用对模型 GPU 进程的直接调用替换 chat-completions 请求。
保留公有提供方的 URL，仅将模型标识符改为 NIM 模型名称。
在将每个用户请求发送给 NIM 之前，先将其转换为一条训练数据记录。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the application already supports a configurable base URL and chat-completions requests, which lets it route those requests to the NIM service. Option B bypasses the service API. Option C continues sending requests to the public provider. Option D changes inference requests into an unrelated data-processing task.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为应用本身已支持可配置的 base URL 和 chat-completions 请求，从而可将请求路由到 NIM 服务。选项 B 绕过了服务 API。选项 C 仍会将请求发送到公有提供方。选项 D 将推理请求变成了毫不相关的数据处理任务。

questions.q: Which Kubernetes probe configuration best prevents requests from reaching the NIM container before its model is ready?
questions.qZh: 哪种 Kubernetes 探针配置最能避免在模型就绪之前把请求转发到 NIM 容器？
o: Use a readiness probe against the NIM `/v1/health/ready` endpoint.
Use a liveness probe against `/v1/health/live` as the only probe, and route traffic as soon as the process starts.
Use a readiness probe against `/v1/models` and treat any HTTP response as proof that model inference is ready.
Delay traffic by a fixed number of seconds after container startup, without checking the service.
oZh: 使用针对 NIM `/v1/health/ready` 端点的就绪探针（readiness probe）。
仅使用针对 `/v1/health/live` 的存活探针（liveness probe），并在进程启动后立即转发流量。
使用针对 `/v1/models` 的就绪探针，并将任何 HTTP 响应都视为模型推理已就绪的证据。
在容器启动后固定延迟若干秒再转发流量，而不检查服务状态。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the readiness endpoint reports whether the NIM service is ready to receive requests, including after model initialization. Option B checks process liveness rather than readiness. Option C does not use the readiness check. Option D relies on a fixed delay that may be too short or unnecessarily long.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为就绪端点会报告 NIM 服务是否已准备好接收请求，包括模型初始化完成后的状态。选项 B 检查的是进程存活而非就绪状态。选项 C 未使用就绪检查。选项 D 依赖固定的延迟，该延迟可能过短或过长。

questions.q: Which approach best protects the credential used by the application to call the internal inference gateway?
questions.qZh: 哪种做法最能保护应用调用内部推理网关所使用的凭据？
o: Place the credential in a Kubernetes Secret, grant access only to the application workload, and exclude it from request logs.
Add the credential to the container image so every replica has an identical value at build time.
Store the credential in the application source repository and restrict repository access to the deployment team.
Pass the credential as a query parameter so the gateway can identify it without reading an authorization header.
oZh: 将凭据放入 Kubernetes Secret，仅授权应用工作负载访问，并将其排除在请求日志之外。
将凭据加入容器镜像，使每个副本在构建时都拥有相同的取值。
将凭据存放在应用源代码仓库中，并将仓库访问权限限制为部署团队。
将凭据作为查询参数传递，以便网关无需读取 authorization 头即可识别它。
questions.e: Option A is correct because runtime secret delivery and limited workload access reduce exposure, while excluding credentials from logs prevents accidental disclosure. Option B embeds the value in an image that may be copied or inspected. Option C leaves it in source history. Option D can expose credentials in URL logs and other request records.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为运行时下发密钥和限制工作负载访问可降低暴露风险，而将凭据排除在日志之外可防止意外泄露。选项 B 把该值嵌入到可能被复制或查看的镜像中。选项 C 会将其留在源代码历史中。选项 D 可能在 URL 日志和其他请求记录中暴露凭据。

questions.q: How can Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) help developers to build a trustworthy AI system?
questions.qZh: 检索增强生成（RAG）如何帮助开发者构建值得信赖的 AI 系统？
o: RAG can enhance the security features of AI systems, ensuring confidential computing and encrypted traffic.
RAG can improve the energy efficiency of AI systems, reducing their environmental impact and cooling requirements.
RAG can align AI models with one another, improving the accuracy of AI systems through cross-checking.
RAG can generate responses that cite reference material from an external knowledge base, ensuring transparency and verifiability.
oZh: RAG 可以增强 AI 系统的安全特性，确保机密计算和流量加密。
RAG 可以提升 AI 系统的能效，降低其环境影响和散热要求。
RAG 可以使 AI 模型相互对齐，通过交叉校验提升 AI 系统的准确性。
RAG 可以生成引用外部知识库参考材料的回答，从而确保透明性与可验证性。
questions.e: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances trustworthy AI by generating responses that cite reference material from an external knowledge base, ensuring transparency and verifiability, as discussed in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. RAG combines a retriever to fetch relevant documents with a generator to produce responses, allowing outputs to be grounded in verifiable sources, reducing hallucinations and improving trust. Option A is incorrect, as RAG does not focus on security features like confidential computing. Option B is wrong, as RAG is unrelated to energy efficiency. Option C is inaccurate, as RAG does not align models but integrates retrieved knowledge. The course notes: “RAG enhances trustworthy AI by generating responses with citations from external knowledge bases, improving transparency and verifiability of outputs.”
questions.eZh: 如 NVIDIA《生成式 AI 与大语言模型》课程中所述，检索增强生成（RAG）通过生成引用外部知识库中参考材料的回答来增强可信 AI。RAG 将用于获取相关文档的检索器与用于生成回答的生成器相结合，使输出基于可验证的来源，从而减少幻觉、提升可信度。选项 A 错误，因为 RAG 并不侧重于机密计算等安全特性。选项 B 错误，因为 RAG 与能效无关。选项 C 不准确，因为 RAG 并不会让模型相互对齐，而是融合检索到的知识。课程要点：“RAG 通过生成带有外部知识库引用的回答来增强可信 AI，提升输出的透明性与可验证性。”

questions.q: Which library is used to accelerate data preparation operations on the GPU?
questions.qZh: 哪个库用于在 GPU 上加速数据准备操作？
o: cuML
XGBoost
cuDF
cuGraph
oZh: cuML
XGBoost
cuDF
cuGraph
questions.e: cuDF is a GPU-accelerated data manipulation library within the RAPIDS ecosystem, designed to speed up data preparation operations such as filtering, joining, and aggregating large datasets. As highlighted in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course, cuDF provides pandas-like functionality for data preprocessing but leverages GPU parallelism to achieve significant performance improvements, making it ideal for data science workflows involving large-scale data preparation. Option A, cuML, is incorrect, as it focuses on machine learning algorithms, not data preparation. Option B, XGBoost, is a gradient boosting framework, not a data preparation library. Option D, cuGraph, is used for graph analytics, not general data preparation. The course notes: “RAPIDS cuDF accelerates data preparation operations by enabling GPU-based processing, offering pandas-like functionality with significant speedups for tasks like data filtering and transformation.”
questions.eZh: cuDF 是 RAPIDS 生态中的 GPU 加速数据操作库，旨在加速过滤、连接以及对大型数据集进行聚合等数据准备操作。如 NVIDIA《生成式 AI 与大语言模型》课程所强调的，cuDF 提供类 pandas 的数据预处理功能，同时利用 GPU 并行性获得显著的性能提升，非常适合涉及大规模数据准备的数据科学工作流。选项 A（cuML）错误，因为它专注于机器学习算法，而非数据准备。选项 B（XGBoost）是梯度提升框架，不是数据准备库。选项 D（cuGraph）用于图分析，而非通用数据准备。课程要点：“RAPIDS cuDF 通过基于 GPU 的处理加速数据准备操作，提供类 pandas 的功能，并为数据过滤、转换等任务带来显著提速。”

questions.q: Imagine you are training an LLM consisting of billions of parameters and your training dataset is significantly larger than the available RAM in your system. Which of the following would be an alternative?
questions.qZh: 假设你正在训练一个由数十亿参数组成的大语言模型（LLM），而你的训练数据集明显大于系统中可用的 RAM。以下哪一种是可用的替代方案？
o: Using the GPU memory to extend the RAM capacity for storing the dataset and move the dataset in and out of the GPU, using the PCI bandwidth possibly.
Using a memory-mapped file that allows the library to access and operate on elements of the dataset without needing to fully load it into memory.
Discarding the excess of data and pruning the dataset to the capacity of the RAM, resulting in reduced latency during inference.
Eliminating sentences that are syntactically different by semantically equivalent, possibly reducing the risk of the model hallucinating as it is trained to get to the point.
oZh: 利用 GPU 显存扩展 RAM 容量以存储数据集，并通过 PCI 带宽在 GPU 与主机之间来回传输数据集。
使用内存映射文件（memory-mapped file），使该库无需将数据集完整加载到内存中，即可访问和处理其中的元素。
丢弃多余的数据，将数据集裁剪到 RAM 的容量上限，从而降低推理期间的延迟。
消除那些句法不同但语义等价的句子，因为模型在训练中学会直奔要点，从而可能降低模型产生幻觉的风险。
questions.e: When training an LLM with a dataset larger than available RAM, using a memory-mapped file is an effective alternative, as discussed in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. Memory-mapped files allow the system to access portions of the dataset directly from disk without loading the entire dataset into RAM, enabling efficient handling of large datasets. This approach leverages virtual memory to map file contents to memory, reducing memory bottlenecks. Option A is incorrect, as moving large datasets in and out of GPU memory via PCI bandwidth is inefficient and not a standard practice for dataset storage. Option C is wrong, as discarding data reduces model quality and is not a scalable solution. Option D is inaccurate, as eliminating semantically equivalent sentences is a specific preprocessing step that does not address memory constraints. The course states: “Memory-mapped files enable efficient training of LLMs on large datasets by accessing data from disk without loading it fully into RAM, overcoming memory limitations.”
questions.eZh: 当使用大于可用 RAM 的数据集训练 LLM 时，使用内存映射文件是一种有效的替代方案，正如 NVIDIA 的《Generative AI 与大语言模型（LLMs）》课程中所讨论的。内存映射文件允许系统直接从磁盘访问数据集的部分内容，而无需将整个数据集加载到 RAM 中，从而实现对大型数据集的高效处理。该方法利用虚拟内存将文件内容映射到内存中，降低了内存瓶颈。选项 A 不正确，因为通过 PCI 带宽在 GPU 显存中来回传输大型数据集效率低下，并非数据集存储的标准做法。选项 C 错误，因为丢弃数据会降低模型质量，并且不是可扩展的解决方案。选项 D 不准确，因为消除语义等价的句子只是某一步特定的预处理操作，无法解决内存受限的问题。课程中指出：“内存映射文件使 LLM 能够高效地在大规模数据集上训练——直接从磁盘读取数据而无需完整加载到 RAM 中，从而突破内存限制。”

questions.q: What is the fundamental role of LangChain in an LLM workflow?
questions.qZh: LangChain 在大语言模型（LLM）工作流中的根本作用是什么？
o: To act as a replacement for traditional programming languages.
To reduce the size of AI foundation models.
To orchestrate LLM components into complex workflows.
To directly manage the hardware resources used by LLMs.
oZh: 作为传统编程语言的替代品。
缩减 AI 基础模型的体积。
将 LLM 的各个组件编排成复杂的工作流。
直接管理 LLM 所使用的硬件资源。
questions.e: LangChain is a framework designed to simplify the development of applications powered by large language models (LLMs) by orchestrating various components, such as LLMs, external data sources, memory, and tools, into cohesive workflows. According to NVIDIA’s documentation on generative AI workflows, particularly in the context of integrating LLMs with external systems, LangChain enables developers to build complex applications by chaining together prompts, retrieval systems (e.g., for RAG), and memory modules to maintain context across interactions. For example, LangChain can integrate an LLM with a vector database for retrieval-augmented generation or manage conversational history for chatbots. Option A is incorrect, as LangChain complements, not replaces, programming languages. Option B is wrong, as LangChain does not modify model size. Option D is inaccurate, as hardware management is handled by platforms like NVIDIA Triton, not LangChain.
questions.eZh: LangChain 是一个旨在简化大语言模型（LLM）应用开发的框架，它把大语言模型、外部数据源、记忆（memory）和工具等各类组件编排成内聚的工作流。根据 NVIDIA 关于生成式 AI 工作流的文档，特别是在将 LLM 与外部系统集成的场景中，LangChain 通过将提示词、检索系统（例如用于 RAG）和记忆模块串联起来，使开发者能够构建复杂应用，并跨交互保持上下文。例如，LangChain 可以将 LLM 与向量数据库集成以实现检索增强生成，或为聊天机器人管理对话历史。选项 A 不正确，因为 LangChain 是编程语言的补充而非替代。选项 B 错误，因为 LangChain 并不会改变模型规模。选项 D 不准确，因为硬件管理由 NVIDIA Triton 等平台负责，而非 LangChain。

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of applying various image transformation techniques (e.g., flipping, rotation, zooming) to a dataset?
questions.qZh: 对数据集应用各种图像变换技术（例如翻转、旋转、缩放）的主要目的是什么？
o: To simplify the model's architecture, making it easier to interpret the results.
To artificially expand the dataset's size and improve the model's ability to generalize.
To ensure perfect alignment and uniformity across all images in the dataset.
To reduce the computational resources required for training deep learning models.
oZh: 简化模型架构，使结果更易于解释。
人为扩充数据集的规模，并提升模型的泛化能力。
确保数据集中所有图像完美对齐且风格统一。
减少训练深度学习模型所需的计算资源。
questions.e: Image transformation techniques such as flipping, rotation, and zooming are forms of data augmentation used to artificially increase the size and diversity of a dataset. NVIDIA’s Deep Learning AI documentation, particularly for computer vision tasks using frameworks like DALI (Data Loading Library), explains that data augmentation improves a model’s ability to generalize by exposing it to varied versions of the training data, thus reducing overfitting. For example, flipping an image horizontally creates a new training sample that helps the model learn invariance to certain transformations. Option A is incorrect because transformations do not simplify the model architecture. Option C is wrong, as augmentation introduces variability, not uniformity. Option D is also incorrect, as augmentation typically increases computational requirements due to additional data processing.
questions.eZh: 翻转、旋转、缩放等图像变换技术属于数据增强（data augmentation），用于人为扩大数据集的规模与多样性。NVIDIA 的深度学习 AI 文档（尤其是使用 DALI（Data Loading Library）等框架的计算机视觉任务部分）说明，数据增强通过让模型接触训练数据的多种变体来提升其泛化能力，从而减少过拟合。例如，将图像水平翻转会生成一个新的训练样本，帮助模型学会对某些变换保持不变性。选项 A 不正确，因为这些变换不会简化模型架构。选项 C 错误，因为增强引入的是变化性，而非统一性。选项 D 同样不正确，因为数据增强通常由于额外的数据处理而增加计算开销。

questions.q: In the field of AI experimentation, what is the GLUE benchmark used to evaluate performance of?
questions.qZh: 在 AI 实验领域，GLUE 基准测试用于评估哪方面的性能？
o: AI models on speech recognition tasks.
AI models on image recognition tasks.
AI models on a range of natural language understanding tasks.
AI models on reinforcement learning tasks.
oZh: AI 模型在语音识别任务上的性能。
AI 模型在图像识别任务上的性能。
AI 模型在一系列自然语言理解任务上的性能。
AI 模型在强化学习任务上的性能。
questions.e: The General Language Understanding Evaluation (GLUE) benchmark is a widely used standard for evaluating AI models on a diverse set of natural language understanding (NLU) tasks, as covered in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. GLUE includes tasks like sentiment analysis, question answering, and textual entailment, designed to test a model’s ability to understand and reason about language across multiple domains. It provides a standardized way to compare model performance on NLU. Option A is incorrect, as GLUE does not evaluate speech recognition. Option B is wrong, as it pertains to image recognition, unrelated to GLUE. Option D is inaccurate, as GLUE focuses on NLU, not reinforcement learning. The course states: “The GLUE benchmark is used to evaluate AI models on a range of natural language understanding tasks, providing a comprehensive assessment of their language processing capabilities.”
questions.eZh: 通用语言理解评估（General Language Understanding Evaluation，GLUE）基准是广泛使用的标准，用于在一系列多样化的自然语言理解（NLU）任务上评估 AI 模型，NVIDIA 的《Generative AI 与大语言模型（LLMs）》课程对此有相关讲解。GLUE 包含情感分析、问答、文本蕴含等任务，旨在测试模型跨多个领域理解并推理语言的能力。它为比较模型在 NLU 上的表现提供了标准化方式。选项 A 不正确，因为 GLUE 不评估语音识别。选项 B 错误，因为它涉及图像识别，与 GLUE 无关。选项 D 不准确，因为 GLUE 关注的是 NLU 而非强化学习。课程中指出：“GLUE 基准用于在一系列自然语言理解任务上评估 AI 模型，为其语言处理能力提供全面评估。”

questions.q: What is Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)?
questions.qZh: 什么是检索增强生成（Retrieval Augmented Generation，RAG）？
o: RAG is an architecture used to optimize the output of an LLM by retraining the model with domain-specific data.
RAG is a methodology that combines an information retrieval component with a response generator.
RAG is a method for manipulating and generating text-based data using Transformer-based LLMs.
RAG is a technique used to fine-tune pre-trained LLMs for improved performance.
oZh: RAG 是一种通过使用领域特定数据重新训练模型来优化 LLM 输出的架构。
RAG 是一种将信息检索组件与响应生成器相结合的方法论。
RAG 是一种使用基于 Transformer 的大语言模型来操作和生成文本数据的方法。
RAG 是一种用于微调预训练 LLM 以提升性能的技术。
questions.e: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a methodology that enhances the performance of large language models (LLMs) by integrating an information retrieval component with a generative model. As described in the seminal paper by Lewis et al. (2020), RAG retrieves relevant documents from an external knowledge base (e.g., using dense vector representations) and uses them to inform the generative process, enabling more accurate and contextually relevant responses. NVIDIA’s documentation on generative AI workflows, particularly in the context of NeMo and Triton Inference Server, highlights RAG as a technique to improve LLM outputs by grounding them in external data, especially for tasks requiring factual accuracy or domain-specific knowledge. Option A is incorrect because RAG does not involve retraining the model but rather augments it with retrieved data. Option C is too vague and does not capture the retrieval aspect, while Option D refers to fine-tuning, which is a separate process.
questions.eZh: 检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation，RAG）是一种方法论，它通过将信息检索组件与生成式模型相结合来提升大语言模型（LLM）的性能。如 Lewis 等人（2020）的开创性论文所述，RAG 从外部知识库中检索相关文档（例如使用稠密向量表示），并用其辅助生成过程，从而实现更准确、更具上下文相关性的回答。NVIDIA 关于生成式 AI 工作流的文档（特别是涉及 NeMo 和 Triton Inference Server 的部分）强调，RAG 是一种通过将输出锚定在外部数据上来改进 LLM 输出的技术，尤其适用于需要事实准确性或领域知识的任务。选项 A 不正确，因为 RAG 不涉及重新训练模型，而是用检索到的数据增强模型。选项 C 过于笼统，没有体现检索这一要点；而选项 D 指的是微调，那是另一个独立的过程。

questions.q: In neural networks, the vanishing gradient problem refers to what problem or issue?
questions.qZh: 在神经网络中，梯度消失问题指的是什么问题？
o: The problem of overfitting in neural networks, where the model performs well on the training data but poorly on new, unseen data.
The issue of gradients becoming too large during backpropagation, leading to unstable training.
The problem of underfitting in neural networks, where the model fails to capture the underlying patterns in the data.
The issue of gradients becoming too small during backpropagation, resulting in slow convergence or stagnation of the training process.
oZh: 神经网络中的过拟合问题，即模型在训练数据上表现良好，但在新的未见数据上表现不佳。
反向传播过程中梯度过大、导致训练不稳定的问题。
神经网络中的欠拟合问题，即模型未能捕捉数据中的潜在模式。
反向传播过程中梯度过小，导致训练过程收敛缓慢或停滞的问题。
questions.e: The vanishing gradient problem occurs in deep neural networks when gradients become too small during backpropagation, causing slow convergence or stagnation in training, particularly in deeper layers. NVIDIA’s documentation on deep learning fundamentals, such as in CUDA and cuDNN guides, explains that this issue is common in architectures like RNNs or deep feedforward networks with certain activation functions (e.g., sigmoid). Techniques like ReLU activation, batch normalization, or residual connections (used in transformers) mitigate this problem. Option A (overfitting) is unrelated to gradients. Option B describes the exploding gradient problem, not vanishing gradients. Option C (underfitting) is a performance issue, not a gradient-related problem.
questions.eZh: 梯度消失问题出现在深层神经网络中：反向传播时梯度过小，导致训练收敛缓慢或停滞，在较深的层中尤为明显。NVIDIA 关于深度学习基础的文档（如 CUDA 和 cuDNN 指南）说明，该问题常见于 RNN 或使用某些激活函数（例如 sigmoid）的深层前馈网络等架构。ReLU 激活、批归一化或残差连接（在 transformer 中使用）等技术可以缓解该问题。选项 A（过拟合）与梯度无关。选项 B 描述的是梯度爆炸问题，而非梯度消失。选项 C（欠拟合）属于性能问题，而非与梯度相关的问题。

questions.q: Which tool would you use to select training data with specific keywords?
questions.qZh: 你会使用哪种工具来筛选包含特定关键词的训练数据？
o: ActionScript
Tableau dashboard
JSON parser
Regular expression filter
oZh: ActionScript
Tableau dashboard
JSON 解析器
正则表达式过滤器
questions.e: Regular expression (regex) filters are widely used in data preprocessing to select text data containing specific keywords or patterns. NVIDIA’s documentation on data preprocessing for NLP tasks, such as in NeMo, highlights regex as a standard tool for filtering datasets based on textual criteria, enabling efficient data curation. For example, a regex pattern like .*keyword.* can select all texts containing “keyword.” Option A (ActionScript) is a programming language for multimedia, not data filtering. Option B (Tableau) is for visualization, not text filtering. Option C (JSON parser) is for structured data, not keyword-based text selection.

questions.q: In the context of preparing a multilingual dataset for fine-tuning an LLM, which preprocessing technique is most effective for handling text from diverse scripts (e.g., Latin, Cyrillic, Devanagari) to ensure consistent model performance?
questions.qZh: 在为微调大语言模型（LLM）准备多语言数据集的语境下，哪种预处理技术最适合处理来自不同文字体系（如拉丁文、西里尔文、天城文）的文本，以确保模型表现的一致性？
o: Normalizing all text to a single script using transliteration.
Applying Unicode normalization to standardize character encodings.
Removing all non-Latin characters to simplify the input.
Converting text to phonetic representations for cross-lingual alignment.
oZh: 使用音译将所有文本统一到单一文字体系。
应用 Unicode 规范化以统一字符编码。
移除所有非拉丁字符以简化输入。
将文本转换为语音表示，以实现跨语言对齐。
questions.e: When preparing a multilingual dataset for fine-tuning an LLM, applying Unicode normalization (e.g., NFKC or NFC forms) is the most effective preprocessing technique to handle text from diverse scripts like Latin, Cyrillic, or Devanagari. Unicode normalization standardizes character encodings, ensuring that visually identical characters (e.g., precomposed vs. decomposed forms) are represented consistently, which improves model performance across languages. NVIDIA’s NeMo documentation on multilingual NLP preprocessing recommends Unicode normalization to address encoding inconsistencies in diverse datasets. Option A (transliteration) may lose linguistic nuances. Option C (removing non-Latin characters) discards critical information. Option D (phonetic conversion) is impractical for text-based LLMs.
questions.eZh: 在为微调 LLM 准备多语言数据集时，应用 Unicode 规范化（例如 NFKC 或 NFC 形式）是处理拉丁文、西里尔文或天城文等不同文字体系文本的最有效的预处理技术。Unicode 规范化统一了字符编码，确保视觉上相同的字符（例如预组合形式与分解形式）得到一致表示，从而提升模型在各语言上的表现。NVIDIA 的 NeMo 多语言 NLP 预处理文档建议采用 Unicode 规范化，以解决多样化数据集中的编码不一致问题。选项 A（音译）可能损失语言上的细微差异。选项 C（移除非拉丁字符）会丢弃关键信息。选项 D（语音转换）对于基于文本的 LLM 而言并不实用。

questions.q: In Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) for Natural Language Understanding (NLU), which method is essential for understanding the contextual relationship between words in textual data?
questions.qZh: 在自然语言理解（NLU）的探索性数据分析（EDA）中，哪种方法对于理解文本数据中词语之间的上下文关系至关重要？
o: Computing the frequency of individual words to identify the most common terms in a text.
Applying sentiment analysis to gauge the overall sentiment expressed in a text.
Generating word clouds to visually represent word frequency and highlight key terms.
Creating n-gram models to analyze patterns of word sequences like bigrams and trigrams.
oZh: 计算单个词元的频率，以识别文本中最常见的术语。
应用情感分析来衡量文本所表达的整体情感。
生成词云，以可视化呈现词频并突出关键术语。
构建 n-gram 模型，以分析诸如二元组和三元组之类的词序列模式。
questions.e: In Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) for Natural Language Understanding (NLU), creating n-gram models is essential for understanding the contextual relationships between words, as highlighted in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. N-grams (e.g., bigrams, trigrams) capture sequences of words, revealing patterns and dependencies in text, such as common phrases or syntactic structures, which are critical for NLU tasks like text generation or classification. Unlike single-word frequency analysis, n-grams provide insight into how words relate to each other in context. Option A is incorrect, as computing word frequencies focuses on individual terms, missing contextual relationships. Option B is wrong, as sentiment analysis targets overall text sentiment, not word relationships. Option C is inaccurate, as word clouds visualize frequency, not contextual patterns. The course notes: “N-gram models are used in EDA for NLU to analyze word sequence patterns, such as bigrams and trigrams, to understand contextual relationships in textual data.”
questions.eZh: 在自然语言理解（NLU）的探索性数据分析（EDA）中，构建 n-gram 模型对于理解词语之间的上下文关系至关重要，NVIDIA 的《Generative AI 与大语言模型（LLMs）》课程对此有强调。N-gram（如二元组、三元组）能够捕获词语序列，揭示文本中的模式与依赖关系，例如常见短语或句法结构，这对文本生成或分类等 NLU 任务非常关键。与单词频率分析不同，n-gram 能揭示词语在上下文中彼此之间的关联。选项 A 不正确，因为计算词频关注的是单个词元，忽略了上下文关系。选项 B 错误，因为情感分析针对的是文本的整体情感，而非词语之间的关系。选项 C 不准确，因为词云可视化的是频率，而非上下文模式。课程中指出：“在 NLU 的 EDA 中使用 n-gram 模型来分析诸如二元组和三元组的词序列模式，从而理解文本数据中的上下文关系。”

questions.q: You are working with a data scientist on a project that involves analyzing and processing textual data to extract meaningful insights and patterns. There is not much time for experimentation and you need to choose a Python package for efficient text analysis and manipulation. Which Python package is best suited for the task?
questions.qZh: 你正与一位数据科学家合作开展一个项目，需要分析和处理文本数据以提取有意义的洞见和模式。实验时间不多，你需要选择一个 Python 包来高效地进行文本分析处理。以下哪个 Python 包最适合该任务？
o: NumPy
spaCy
Pandas
Matplotlib
oZh: NumPy
spaCy
Pandas
Matplotlib
questions.e: For efficient text analysis and manipulation in NLP projects, spaCy is the most suitable Python package, as emphasized in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. spaCy is a high-performance library designed specifically for NLP tasks, offering robust tools for tokenization, part-of-speech tagging, named entity recognition, dependency parsing, and word vector generation. Its efficiency and pre-trained models make it ideal for extracting meaningful insights from text under time constraints. Option A, NumPy, is incorrect, as it is designed for numerical computations, not text processing. Option C, Pandas, is useful for tabular data manipulation but lacks specialized NLP capabilities. Option D, Matplotlib, is for data visualization, not text analysis. The course highlights: “spaCy is a powerful Python library for efficient text analysis and manipulation, providing tools for tokenization, entity recognition, and other NLP tasks, making it ideal for processing textual data.”
questions.eZh: 在 NLP 项目中要进行高效的文本分析处理，spaCy 是最合适的 Python 包，正如 NVIDIA 的《Generative AI 与大语言模型（LLMs）》课程所强调的。spaCy 是一个专为 NLP 任务设计的高性能库，提供分词、词性标注、命名实体识别、依存句法分析和词向量生成等强大工具。它的高效性和预训练模型使它非常适合在时间紧张的情况下从文本中提取有意义的洞见。选项 A NumPy 不正确，因为它是为数值计算设计的，而非文本处理。选项 C Pandas 适用于表格数据处理，但缺乏专门的 NLP 能力。选项 D Matplotlib 用于数据可视化，而非文本分析。课程中强调：“spaCy 是一个用于高效文本分析处理的强大 Python 库，提供分词、实体识别等 NLP 工具，非常适合处理文本数据。”

questions.q: Which metric is commonly used to evaluate machine-translation models?
questions.qZh: 通常使用哪种指标来评估机器翻译模型？
o: F1 Score
BLEU score
ROUGE score
Perplexity
oZh: F1 分数
BLEU 分数
ROUGE 分数
困惑度（Perplexity）
questions.e: The BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy) score is the most commonly used metric for evaluating machine-translation models. It measures the precision of n-gram overlaps between the generated translation and reference translations, providing a quantitative measure of translation quality. NVIDIA’s NeMo documentation on NLP tasks, particularly machine translation, highlights BLEU as the standard metric for assessing translation performance due to its focus on precision and fluency. Option A (F1 Score) is used for classification tasks, not translation. Option C (ROUGE) is primarily for summarization, focusing on recall. Option D (Perplexity) measures language model quality but is less specific to translation evaluation.
questions.eZh: BLEU（Bilingual Evaluation Understudy）分数是评估机器翻译模型最常用的指标。它衡量生成的译文与参考译文之间 n-gram 重叠的精确率，为翻译质量提供量化度量。NVIDIA 关于 NLP 任务的 NeMo 文档（尤其是机器翻译部分）强调，BLEU 由于聚焦于精确性和流畅性，是评估翻译性能的标准指标。选项 A（F1 分数）用于分类任务，而非翻译。选项 C（ROUGE）主要用于摘要任务，侧重于召回率。选项 D（困惑度）衡量语言模型的质量，但对翻译评估的针对性较弱。

questions.q: Which of the following options describes best the NeMo Guardrails platform?

开发并设计能够解释和整合各种形式数据的先进机器学习模型。
通过监控并强制执行对预定义规则和法规的遵守，确保人工智能系统被合乎伦理地使用。
为语言模型语境下的生成式 AI 服务构建先进的数据工厂。
questions.e: The NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails platform is designed to ensure the ethical and safe use of AI systems, particularly LLMs, by enforcing predefined rules and regulations, as highlighted in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. It provides a framework to monitor and control LLM outputs, preventing harmful or inappropriate responses and ensuring compliance with ethical guidelines. Option A is incorrect, as NeMo Guardrails focuses on safety, not scalability or performance. Option B is wrong, as it describes model development, not guardrails. Option D is inaccurate, as it does not pertain to data factories but to ethical AI enforcement. The course notes: “NeMo Guardrails ensures the ethical use of AI by monitoring and enforcing compliance with predefined rules, enhancing the safety and trustworthiness of LLM outputs.”
questions.eZh: NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails 平台旨在确保 AI 系统（尤其是 LLM）被安全、合乎伦理地使用，它通过强制执行预定义的规则和法规来实现这一点，正如 NVIDIA 的《Generative AI 与大语言模型（LLMs）》课程所强调的。它提供了一个框架来监控和控制 LLM 的输出，防止有害或不当的回应，并确保符合伦理准则。选项 A 不正确，因为 NeMo Guardrails 关注的是安全，而非可扩展性或性能。选项 B 错误，它描述的是模型开发，而非护栏。选项 D 不准确，因为它与数据工厂无关，而是关乎伦理 AI 的执行约束。课程中指出：“NeMo Guardrails 通过监控并强制执行对预定义规则的遵守来确保 AI 的合乎伦理使用，提升 LLM 输出的安全性和可信度。”

questions.q: Why might stemming or lemmatizing text be considered a beneficial preprocessing step in the context of computing TF-IDF vectors for a corpus?
questions.qZh: 在为语料库计算 TF-IDF 向量的语境下，为什么对文本进行词干提取或词形还原可能被视为有益的预处理步骤？
o: It reduces the number of unique tokens by collapsing variant forms of a word into their root form, potentially decreasing noise in the data.
It enhances the aesthetic appeal of the text, making it easier for readers to understand the document’s content.
It increases the complexity of the dataset by introducing more unique tokens, enhancing the distinctiveness of each document.
It guarantees an increase in the accuracy of TF-IDF vectors by ensuring more precise word usage distinction.
oZh: 它通过将一个词的不同变体形式归并为其词根形式，减少了唯一词元的数量，从而可能降低数据中的噪声。
它提升了文本的美学观感，使读者更容易理解文档的内容。
它通过引入更多唯一词元增加了数据集的复杂度，增强了每篇文档的区分度。
它通过确保更精确的词形区分，保证了 TF-IDF 向量准确率的提升。
questions.e: Stemming and lemmatizing are preprocessing techniques in NLP that reduce words to their root or base form, as discussed in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. In the context of computing TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) vectors, these techniques are beneficial because they collapse variant forms of a word (e.g., “running,” “ran” to “run”) into a single token, reducing the number of unique tokens in the corpus. This decreases noise and dimensionality, improving the efficiency and effectiveness of TF-IDF representations for tasks like document classification or clustering. Option B is incorrect, as stemming and lemmatizing are not about aesthetics but about data preprocessing. Option C is wrong, as these techniques reduce, not increase, the number of unique tokens. Option D is inaccurate, as they do not guarantee accuracy improvements but rather reduce noise. The course states: “Stemming and lemmatizing reduce the number of unique tokens in a corpus by normalizing word forms, improving the quality of TF-IDF vectors by minimizing noise and dimensionality.”
questions.eZh: 词干提取和词形还原是 NLP 中将词语归约为其词根或基本形式的预处理技术，正如 NVIDIA 的《Generative AI 与大语言模型（LLMs）》课程所讨论的。在计算 TF-IDF（Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency，词频-逆文档频率）向量的语境下，这些技术之所以有益，是因为它们把一个词的不同变体形式（例如“running”“ran”归并为“run”）合并为单个词元，从而减少语料库中唯一词元的数量。这能降低噪声和维度，提升 TF-IDF 表示在文档分类或聚类等任务中的效率与效果。选项 A 不正确，因为词干提取和词形还原与美观无关，而是与数据预处理有关。选项 C 错误，因为这些技术是减少而非增加唯一词元的数量。选项 D 不准确，因为它们并不保证准确率提升，而是降低噪声。课程中指出：“词干提取和词形还原通过归一化词形，减少了语料库中唯一词元的数量，通过最小化噪声和维度提升 TF-IDF 向量的质量。”

questions.q: In the context of data preprocessing for Large Language Models (LLMs), what does tokenization refer to?
questions.qZh: 在大语言模型（LLM）的数据预处理语境下，分词（tokenization）指的是什么？
o: Splitting text into smaller units like words or subwords.
Converting text into numerical representations.
Removing stop words from the text.
Applying data augmentation techniques to generate more training data.
oZh: 将文本切分为诸如单词或子词之类更小的单元。
将文本转换为数值表示。
从文本中移除停用词。
应用数据增强技术以生成更多训练数据。

questions.q: You are working on developing an application to classify images of animals and need to train a neural model. However, you have a limited amount of labeled data. Which technique can you use to leverage the knowledge from a model pre-trained on a different task to improve the performance of your new model?
questions.qZh: 你正在开发一个对动物图像进行分类的应用，需要训练一个神经模型。然而，你手头的标注数据有限。你可以使用哪种技术来利用在另一项任务上预训练模型所学到的知识，从而提升新模型的性能？
o: Dropout
Random initialization
Transfer learning
Early stopping
oZh: Dropout（随机失活）
随机初始化（Random initialization）
迁移学习（Transfer learning）
早停（Early stopping）
questions.e: Transfer learning is a technique where a model pre-trained on a large, general dataset (e.g., ImageNet for computer vision) is fine-tuned for a specific task with limited data. NVIDIA’s Deep Learning AI documentation, particularly for frameworks like NeMo and TensorRT, emphasizes transfer learning as a powerful approach to improve model performance when labeled data is scarce. For example, a pre-trained convolutional neural network (CNN) can be fine-tuned for animal image classification by reusing its learned features (e.g., edge detection) and adapting the final layers to the new task. Option A (dropout) is a regularization technique, not a knowledge transfer method. Option B (random initialization) discards pre-trained knowledge. Option D (early stopping) prevents overfitting but does not leverage pre-trained models.
questions.eZh: 迁移学习是一种技术：先在大型通用数据集（如计算机视觉领域的 ImageNet）上预训练模型，再用有限数据针对特定任务进行微调。NVIDIA 的深度学习 AI 文档（尤其是 NeMo 和 TensorRT 等框架相关部分）强调，迁移学习是在标注数据稀缺时提升模型性能的强大方法。例如，一个预训练的卷积神经网络（CNN）可以通过复用其已学到的特征（如边缘检测）并调整最后几层来适配动物图像分类任务。选项 A（Dropout）是一种正则化技术，而不是知识迁移方法。选项 B（随机初始化）会丢弃预训练的知识。选项 D（早停）可防止过拟合，但并不能利用预训练模型。

questions.q: Which calculation is most commonly used to measure the semantic closeness of two text passages?
questions.qZh: 最常用于衡量两段文本语义接近程度的计算方法是什么？
o: Hamming distance
Jaccard similarity
Cosine similarity

Euclidean distance C Cosine similarity is the most commonly used metric to measure the semantic closeness of two text passages in NLP. It calculates the cosine of the angle between two vectors (e.g., word embeddings or sentence embeddings) in a high-dimensional space, focusing on the direction rather than magnitude, which makes it robust for comparing semantic similarity. NVIDIA’s documentation on NLP tasks, particularly in NeMo and embedding models, highlights cosine similarity as the standard metric for tasks like semantic search or text similarity, often using embeddings from models like BERT or Sentence-BERT. Option A (Hamming distance) is for binary data, not text embeddings. Option B (Jaccard similarity) is for set-based comparisons, not semantic content. Option D (Euclidean distance) is less common for text due to its sensitivity to vector magnitude. questions.q: In the evaluation of Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems, what do ‘validity’ and ‘reliability’ imply regarding the selection of evaluation metrics?
questions.qZh: 在自然语言处理（NLP）系统的评估中，“效度（validity）”和“信度（reliability）”对于评估指标的选择意味着什么？
o: Validity involves the metric’s ability to predict future trends in data, and reliability refers to its capacity to integrate with multiple data sources.
Validity ensures the metric accurately reflects the intended property to measure, while reliability ensures consistent results over repeated measurements.
Validity is concerned with the metric’s computational cost, while reliability is about its applicability across different NLP platforms.

Validity refers to the speed of metric computation, whereas reliability pertains to the metric’s performance in high-volume data processing. B In evaluating NLP systems, as discussed in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course, validity and reliability are critical for selecting evaluation metrics. Validity ensures that a metric accurately measures the intended property (e.g., BLEU for translation quality or F1-score for classification performance), reflecting the system’s true capability. Reliability ensures that the metric produces consistent results across repeated measurements under similar conditions, indicating stability and robustness. Together, these ensure trustworthy evaluations. Option A is incorrect, as validity is not about predicting trends, and reliability is not about data source integration. Option C is wrong, as validity and reliability are not primarily about computational cost or platform applicability. Option D is inaccurate, as validity and reliability do not focus on computation speed or high-volume processing. The course notes: “Validity ensures NLP evaluation metrics accurately measure the intended property, while reliability ensures consistent results across repeated evaluations, critical for robust system assessment.” [References: NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications course; NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., , ]

效度关注指标的计算成本，而信度则涉及其在不同 NLP 平台上的适用性。

效度指指标计算的速度，而信度则涉及指标在海量数据处理中的表现。B 在评估 NLP 系统时，正如 NVIDIA 的《Generative AI 与大语言模型（LLMs）》课程所讨论的，效度和信度对于选择评估指标至关重要。效度确保指标能准确测量其预期的属性（例如用 BLEU 衡量翻译质量、用 F1 分数衡量分类性能），反映系统的真实能力。信度确保指标在相似条件下重复测量时能产生一致的结果，表明其稳定性和鲁棒性。二者共同保证评估结果的可信度。选项 A 不正确，因为效度与预测趋势无关，信度也与数据源整合无关。选项 C 错误，因为效度和信度主要不是关于计算成本或平台适用性。选项 D 不准确，因为效度和信度并不关注计算速度或海量数据处理。课程中指出：“效度确保 NLP 评估指标准确测量其预期属性，而信度确保多次评估之间结果一致，这对稳健的系统评估至关重要。”[参考：NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications 课程；NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., , ]

questions.q: What is a Tokenizer in Large Language Models (LLM)?
questions.qZh: 大语言模型（LLM）中的 Tokenizer 是什么？
o: A method to remove stop words and punctuation marks from text data.
A machine learning algorithm that predicts the next word/token in a sequence of text.
A tool used to split text into smaller units called tokens for analysis and processing.

A technique used to convert text data into numerical representations called tokens for machine learning. C A tokenizer in the context of large language models (LLMs) is a tool that splits text into smaller units called tokens (e.g., words, subwords, or characters) for processing by the model. NVIDIA’s NeMo documentation on NLP preprocessing explains that tokenization is a critical step in preparing text data, with algorithms like WordPiece, Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE), or SentencePiece breaking text into manageable units to handle vocabulary constraints and out-of-vocabulary words. For example, the sentence “I love AI” might be tokenized into [“I”, “love”, “AI”] or subword units like [“I”, “lov”, “##e”, “AI”]. Option A is incorrect, as removing stop words is a separate preprocessing step. Option B is wrong, as tokenization is not a predictive algorithm. Option D is misleading, as converting text to numerical representations is the role of embeddings, not tokenization. [References:, NVIDIA NeMo Documentation: https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/intro.html, , ]

一种预测文本序列中下一个词/token 的机器学习算法。
一种将文本切分为称为 token 的更小单元以进行分析和处理的工具。

questions.q: When implementing data parallel training, which of the following considerations needs to be taken into account?
questions.qZh: 在实现数据并行训练时，需要考虑以下哪一项？
o: The model weights are synced across all processes/devices only at the end of every epoch.
A master-worker method for syncing the weights across different processes is desirable due to its scalability.
A ring all-reduce is an efficient algorithm for syncing the weights across different processes/devices.

The model weights are kept independent for as long as possible increasing the model exploration. C In data parallel training, where a model is replicated across multiple devices with each processing a portion of the data, synchronizing model weights is critical. As covered in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course, the ring all-reduce algorithm is an efficient method for syncing weights across processes or devices. It minimizes communication overhead by organizing devices in a ring topology, allowing gradients to be aggregated and shared efficiently. Option A is incorrect, as weights are typically synced after each batch, not just at epoch ends, to ensure consistency. Option B is wrong, as master-worker methods can create bottlenecks and are less scalable than all-reduce. Option D is inaccurate, as keeping weights independent defeats the purpose of data parallelism, which requires synchronized updates. The course notes: “In data parallel training, the ring all-reduce algorithm efficiently synchronizes model weights across devices, reducing communication overhead and ensuring consistent updates.” [References: NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications course; NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., ]
oZh: 模型权重仅在每个 epoch 结束时才在所有进程/设备之间同步。
由于具备可扩展性，采用 master-worker 方法在不同的进程之间同步权重是可取的。
ring all-reduce 是在不同进程/设备之间同步权重的一种高效算法。

尽可能长时间保持模型权重相互独立，以增加模型的探索。C 在数据并行训练中，模型被复制到多个设备上、每个设备处理一部分数据，此时同步模型权重至关重要。如 NVIDIA 的《Generative AI 与大语言模型（LLMs）》课程所讲解的，ring all-reduce 算法是在不同进程或设备之间同步权重的一种高效方法。它通过将设备组织成环形拓扑来最小化通信开销，使梯度能够高效地聚合与共享。选项 A 不正确，因为权重通常在每个 batch 之后就会同步，而不仅仅在 epoch 结束时同步，以确保一致性。选项 B 错误，master-worker 方法可能造成瓶颈，扩展性不如 all-reduce。选项 D 不准确，因为保持权重相互独立会违背数据并行的目的，而数据并行要求同步更新。课程中指出：“在数据并行训练中，ring all-reduce 算法能高效地在各设备之间同步模型权重，降低通信开销并确保更新的一致性。”[参考：NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications 课程；NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., ]

questions.q: You are using RAPIDS and Python for a data analysis project. Which pair of statements best explains how RAPIDS accelerates data science?
questions.qZh: 你正在使用 RAPIDS 和 Python 进行一个数据分析项目。哪一对陈述最能解释 RAPIDS 如何加速数据科学？
o: RAPIDS enables on-GPU processing of computationally expensive calculations and minimizes CPU-GPU memory transfers.
RAPIDS is a Python library that provides functions to accelerate the PCIe bus throughput via word-doubling.

RAPIDS provides lossless compression of CPU-GPU memory transfers to speed up data analysis. A RAPIDS is a suite of open-source libraries designed to accelerate data science workflows by leveraging GPU processing, as emphasized in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. It enables on-GPU processing of computationally expensive calculations, such as data preprocessing and machine learning tasks, using libraries like cuDF and cuML. Additionally, RAPIDS minimizes CPU-GPU memory transfers by performing operations directly on the GPU, reducing latency and improving performance. Options A and B are identical and correct, reflecting RAPIDS’ core functionality. Option C is incorrect, as RAPIDS does not focus on PCIe bus throughput or “word-doubling,” which is not a relevant concept. Option D is wrong, as RAPIDS does not rely on lossless compression for acceleration but on GPU-parallel processing. The course notes: “RAPIDS accelerates data science by enabling GPU-based processing of computationally intensive tasks and minimizing CPU-GPU memory transfers, significantly speeding up workflows.” [References: NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications course; NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., , ]

questions.q: Which of the following principles are widely recognized for building trustworthy AI? (Choose two.)
questions.qZh: 在构建可信 AI 时，以下哪些原则被广泛认可？（选择两项）
o: Conversational
Low latency
Privacy
Scalability

Nondiscrimination C, E In building Trustworthy AI, privacy and nondiscrimination are widely recognized principles, as emphasized in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. Privacy ensures that AI systems protect user data and maintain confidentiality, often through techniques like confidential computing or data anonymization. Nondiscrimination ensures that AI models avoid biases and treat all groups fairly, mitigating issues like discriminatory outputs. Option A, conversational, is incorrect, as it is a feature of some AI systems, not a Trustworthy AI principle. Option B, low latency, is a performance goal, not a trust principle. Option D, scalability, is a technical consideration, not directly related to trustworthiness. The course states: “Trustworthy AI principles include privacy, ensuring data protection, and nondiscrimination, ensuring fair and unbiased model behavior, critical for ethical AI development.” [References: NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications course; NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., ]

questions.q: Which of the following best describes the purpose of attention mechanisms in transformer models?
questions.qZh: 以下哪一项最准确地描述了 transformer 模型中注意力机制的用途？
o: To focus on relevant parts of the input sequence for use in the downstream task.
To compress the input sequence for faster processing.
To generate random noise for improved model robustness.

To convert text into numerical representations. A Attention mechanisms in transformer models, as introduced in "Attention is All You Need" (Vaswani et al., 2017), allow the model to focus on relevant parts of the input sequence by assigning higher weights to important tokens during processing. NVIDIA’s NeMo documentation explains that self-attention enables transformers to capture long-range dependencies and contextual relationships, making them effective for tasks like language modeling and translation. Option B is incorrect, as attention does not compress sequences but processes them fully. Option C is false, as attention is not about generating noise. Option D refers to embeddings, not attention. [References:, Vaswani, A., et al. (2017). "Attention is All You Need.", NVIDIA NeMo Documentation: https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/intro.html, , ]
oZh: 聚焦于输入序列中与下游任务相关的部分。
压缩输入序列以加快处理速度。
生成随机噪声以提升模型的鲁棒性。

将文本转换为数值表示。A Transformer 模型中的注意力机制，正如《Attention is All You Need》（Vaswani 等，2017）所引入的，使模型能够在处理过程中为重要 token 分配更高的权重，从而聚焦于输入序列中相关的部分。NVIDIA 的 NeMo 文档指出，自注意力使 transformer 能够捕捉长程依赖关系和上下文关联，从而在语言建模和翻译等任务上表现良好。选项 B 错误，因为注意力并非压缩序列，而是完整地处理序列。选项 C 不正确，因为注意力与生成噪声无关。选项 D 指的是嵌入（embedding），而不是注意力。[参考：, Vaswani, A., 等 (2017). “Attention is All You Need.”, NVIDIA NeMo 文档：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/intro.html, , ]

questions.q: When fine-tuning an LLM for a specific application, why is it essential to perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) on the new training dataset?
questions.qZh: 为特定应用微调大语言模型时，为什么必须对新训练数据集执行探索性数据分析（EDA）？
o: To uncover patterns and anomalies in the dataset
To select the appropriate learning rate for the model
To assess the computing resources required for fine-tuning

To determine the optimum number of layers in the neural network A Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) is a critical step in fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) to understand the characteristics of the new training dataset. NVIDIA’s NeMo documentation on data preprocessing for NLP tasks emphasizes that EDA helps uncover patterns (e.g., class distributions, word frequencies) and anomalies (e.g., outliers, missing values) that can affect model performance. For example, EDA might reveal imbalanced classes or noisy data, prompting preprocessing steps like data cleaning or augmentation. Option B is incorrect, as learning rate selection is part of model training, not EDA. Option C is unrelated, as EDA does not assess computational resources. Option D is false, as the number of layers is a model architecture decision, not derived from EDA. [References:, NVIDIA NeMo Documentation: https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/intro.html, , ]
oZh: 发现数据集中的模式和异常

questions.q: You have access to training data but no access to test data. What evaluation method can you use to assess the performance of your AI model?
questions.qZh: 你可以访问训练数据，但无法访问测试数据。可以使用哪种评估方法来评估 AI 模型的性能？
o: Cross-validation
Randomized controlled trial
Average entropy approximation

Greedy decoding A When test data is unavailable, cross-validation is the most effective method to assess an AI model’s performance using only the training dataset. Cross-validation involves splitting the training data into multiple subsets (folds), training the model on some folds, and validating it on others, repeating this process to estimate generalization performance. NVIDIA’s documentation on machine learning workflows, particularly in the NeMo framework for model evaluation, highlights k-fold cross-validation as a standard technique for robust performance assessment when a separate test set is not available. Option B (randomized controlled trial) is a clinical or experimental method, not typically used for model evaluation. Option C (average entropy approximation) is not a standard evaluation method. Option D (greedy decoding) is a generation strategy for LLMs, not an evaluation technique. [References:, NVIDIA NeMo Documentation: https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/model_finetuning.html, Goodfellow, I., et al. (2016). "Deep Learning." MIT Press., , ]
oZh: 交叉验证
随机对照试验
平均熵近似

贪心解码 A 当测试数据不可用时，交叉验证是仅利用训练数据集评估 AI 模型性能最有效的方法。交叉验证将训练数据划分为多个子集（折），在其中一部分折上训练模型、在其他折上进行验证，并重复该过程来估计泛化性能。NVIDIA 关于机器学习工作流的文档，特别是 NeMo 框架中关于模型评估的部分，将 k 折交叉验证列为在没有独立测试集时进行稳健性能评估的标准技术。选项 B（随机对照试验）是一种临床或实验方法，通常不用于模型评估。选项 C（平均熵近似）不是标准评估方法。选项 D（贪心解码）是 LLM 的生成策略，而不是评估技术。[参考：, NVIDIA NeMo 文档：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/model_finetuning.html, Goodfellow, I., 等 (2016). “Deep Learning.” MIT Press., , ]
