questions.q: What is the correct order of steps in an ML project?
questions.qZh: ML 项目中各步骤的正确顺序是什么？
o: Model evaluation, Data preprocessing, Model training, Data collection
Model evaluation, Data collection, Data preprocessing, Model training
Data preprocessing, Data collection, Model training, Model evaluation

Data collection, Data preprocessing, Model training, Model evaluation D The correct order of steps in a machine learning (ML) project, as outlined in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course, is: Data collection, Data preprocessing, Model training, and Model evaluation. Data collection involves gathering relevant data for the task. Data preprocessing prepares the data by cleaning, transforming, and formatting it (e.g., tokenization for NLP). Model training involves using the preprocessed data to optimize the model’s parameters. Model evaluation assesses the trained model’s performance using metrics like accuracy or F1-score. This sequence ensures a systematic approach to building effective ML models. Options A, B, and C are incorrect, as they disrupt this logical flow (e.g., evaluating before training or preprocessing before collecting data is not feasible). The course states: “An ML project follows a structured pipeline: data collection, data preprocessing, model training, and model evaluation, ensuring data is properly prepared and models are rigorously assessed.” [References: NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications course; NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., ]
oZh: 模型评估、数据预处理、模型训练、数据收集
模型评估、数据收集、数据预处理、模型训练
数据预处理、数据收集、模型训练、模型评估

数据收集、数据预处理、模型训练、模型评估 D 机器学习（ML）项目中各步骤的正确顺序，正如 NVIDIA《生成式 AI 与大语言模型》课程所列，为：数据收集、数据预处理、模型训练和模型评估。数据收集涉及为该任务收集相关数据。数据预处理通过清洗、转换和格式化来准备数据（例如 NLP 中的分词）。模型训练使用预处理后的数据来优化模型参数。模型评估使用准确率或 F1 分数等指标评估训练后模型的性能。该顺序确保了构建高效 ML 模型的系统化方法。选项 A、B 和 C 错误，因为它们破坏了这一逻辑流程（例如在训练之前就评估，或在收集数据之前就预处理，都是不可行的）。课程指出：“ML 项目遵循结构化的流水线：数据收集、数据预处理、模型训练和模型评估，确保数据得到恰当准备、模型得到严格评估。”[参考：NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications 课程；NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., ]

o: NVIDIA TensorRT
NVIDIA DALI
NVIDIA Triton

NVIDIA NeMo D The NVIDIA NeMo framework is designed to support the development and customization of large language models (LLMs), including techniques like prompt engineering, prompt learning (e.g., prompt tuning), and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA), as emphasized in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. questions.q: Which of the following claims is correct about TensorRT and ONNX?
questions.qZh: 关于 TensorRT 和 ONNX，以下哪项说法是正确的？
o: TensorRT is used for model deployment and ONNX is used for model interchange.
TensorRT is used for model deployment and ONNX is used for model creation.
TensorRT is used for model creation and ONNX is used for model interchange.

TensorRT is used for model creation and ONNX is used for model deployment. A NVIDIA TensorRT is a deep learning inference library used to optimize and deploy models for high-performance inference, while ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange) is a format for model interchange, enabling models to be shared across different frameworks, as covered in NVIDIA’s Generative AI and LLMs course. TensorRT optimizes models (e.g., via layer fusion and quantization) for deployment on NVIDIA GPUs, while ONNX ensures portability by providing a standardized model representation. Option B is incorrect, as ONNX is not used for model creation but for interchange. Option C is wrong, as TensorRT is not for model creation but optimization and deployment. Option D is inaccurate, as ONNX is not for deployment but for model sharing. The course notes: “TensorRT optimizes and deploys deep learning models for inference, while ONNX enables model interchange across frameworks for portability.” [References: NVIDIA Building Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing Applications course; NVIDIA Introduction to Transformer-Based Natural Language Processing., ]

questions.q: In the context of a natural language processing (NLP) application, which approach is most effective for implementing zero-shot learning to classify text data into categories that were not seen during training?
questions.qZh: 在自然语言处理（NLP）应用的场景下，哪种方法最适合实现零样本学习，将文本数据分类到训练期间未出现过的类别中？
o: Use rule-based systems to manually define the characteristics of each category.
Use a large, labeled dataset for each possible category.
Train the new model from scratch for each new category encountered.

Use a pre-trained language model with semantic embeddings. D Zero-shot learning allows models to perform tasks or classify data into categories without prior training on those specific categories. In NLP, pre-trained language models (e.g., BERT, GPT) with semantic embeddings are highly effective for zero-shot learning because they encode general linguistic knowledge and can generalize to new tasks by leveraging semantic similarity. NVIDIA’s NeMo documentation on NLP tasks explains that pre-trained LLMs can perform zero-shot classification by using prompts or embeddings to map input text to unseen categories, often via techniques like natural language inference or cosine similarity in embedding space. Option A (rule-based systems) lacks scalability and flexibility. Option B contradicts zero-shot learning, as it requires labeled data. Option C (training from scratch) is impractical and defeats the purpose of zero-shot learning. [References:, NVIDIA NeMo Documentation: https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/intro.html, Brown, T., et al. (2020). "Language Models are Few-Shot Learners.", , ]
oZh: 使用基于规则的系统，手动定义每个类别的特征。
为每个可能的类别使用大规模标注数据集。
为遇到的每个新类别从头训练新模型。

使用带有语义嵌入的预训练语言模型。D 零样本学习使模型无需针对特定类别进行先前训练，即可执行任务或将数据分类到相应类别。在 NLP 中，带有语义嵌入的预训练语言模型（如 BERT、GPT）对零样本学习非常有效，因为它们编码了通用语言知识，并能借助语义相似度泛化到新任务。NVIDIA NeMo 中关于 NLP 任务的文档指出，预训练 LLM 可以通过提示或嵌入将输入文本映射到未见过的类别来执行零样本分类，通常借助自然语言推理或嵌入空间中的余弦相似度等技术。选项 A（基于规则的系统）缺乏可扩展性和灵活性。选项 B 与零样本学习的定义相矛盾，因为它需要标注数据。选项 C（从头训练）不切实际，且违背了零样本学习的初衷。[参考：, NVIDIA NeMo 文档：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/intro.html, Brown, T., 等 (2020). “Language Models are Few-Shot Learners.”, , ]

questions.q: What is the main difference between forward diffusion and reverse diffusion in diffusion models of Generative AI?
questions.qZh: 在生成式 AI 的扩散模型中，前向扩散与反向扩散的主要区别是什么？
o: Forward diffusion focuses on generating a sample from a given noise vector, while reverse diffusion reverses the process by estimating the latent space representation of a given sample.
Forward diffusion uses feed-forward networks, while reverse diffusion uses recurrent networks.
Forward diffusion uses bottom-up processing, while reverse diffusion uses top-down processing to generate samples from noise vectors.

Forward diffusion focuses on progressively injecting noise into data, while reverse diffusion focuses on generating new samples from the given noise vectors. D Diffusion models, a class of generative AI models, operate in two phases: forward diffusion and reverse diffusion. According to NVIDIA’s documentation on generative AI (e.g., in the context of NVIDIA’s work on generative models), forward diffusion progressively injects noise into a data sample (e.g., an image or text embedding) over multiple steps, transforming it into a noise distribution. Reverse diffusion, conversely, starts with a noise vector and iteratively denoises it to generate a new sample that resembles the training data distribution. This process is central to models like DDPM (Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models). Option A is incorrect, as forward diffusion adds noise, not generates samples. Option B is false, as diffusion models typically use convolutional or transformer-based architectures, not recurrent networks. Option C is misleading, as diffusion does not align with bottom-up/top-down processing paradigms. [References:, NVIDIA Generative AI Documentation: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-data-science/generative-ai/, Ho, J., et al. (2020). "Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models.", , ]
oZh: 前向扩散侧重于从给定的噪声向量生成样本，而反向扩散则通过估计给定样本的隐空间表示来逆转该过程。
前向扩散使用前馈网络，而反向扩散使用循环网络。
前向扩散采用自下而上的处理方式，而反向扩散采用自上而下的处理方式，从噪声向量生成样本。

Implementing complex algorithms to enhance AI’s problem-solving capabilities.
Developing AI systems with autonomy from human decision-making.

Option B (complex algorithms) may improve performance but not societal alignment. Option C (autonomy) can conflict with ethical oversight, making it less desirable. questions.q: In the Transformer architecture, which of the following statements about the Q (query), K (key), and V (value) matrices is correct?
questions.qZh: 在 Transformer 架构中，关于 Q（query）、K（key）和 V（value）矩阵，以下哪项说法是正确的？
o: Q, K, and V are randomly initialized weight matrices used for positional encoding.
K is responsible for computing the attention scores between the query and key vectors.
Q represents the query vector used to retrieve relevant information from the input sequence.

V is used to calculate the positional embeddings for each token in the input sequence. C In the transformer architecture, the Q (query), K (key), and V (value) matrices are used in the self-attention mechanism to compute relationships between tokens in a sequence. According to "Attention is All You Need" (Vaswani et al., 2017) and NVIDIA’s NeMo documentation, the query vector (Q) represents the token seeking relevant information, the key vector (K) is used to compute compatibility with other tokens, and the value vector (V) provides the information to be retrieved. The attention score is calculated as a scaled dot-product of Q and K, and the output is a weighted sum of V. Option C is correct, as Q retrieves relevant information. Option A is incorrect, as Q, K, and V are not used for positional encoding. Option B is wrong, as attention scores are computed using both Q and K, not K alone. Option D is false, as positional embeddings are separate from V. [References:, Vaswani, A., et al. (2017). "Attention is All You Need.", NVIDIA NeMo Documentation: https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/intro.html, , , ]
oZh: Q、K 和 V 是用于位置编码的随机初始化权重矩阵。
K 负责计算 query 向量与 key 向量之间的注意力分数。
Q 表示用于从输入序列中检索相关信息的 query 向量。

V 用于计算输入序列中每个 token 的位置嵌入。C 在 Transformer 架构中，Q（query）、K（key）和 V（value）矩阵用于自注意力机制，以计算序列中 token 之间的关系。根据《Attention is All You Need》（Vaswani 等，2017）和 NVIDIA 的 NeMo 文档，query 向量（Q）表示寻求相关信息的 token，key 向量（K）用于计算与其他 token 的兼容性，value 向量（V）提供待检索的信息。注意力分数通过 Q 与 K 的缩放点积计算，输出则是 V 的加权和。选项 C 正确，因为 Q 用于检索相关信息。选项 A 错误，因为 Q、K 和 V 不用于位置编码。选项 B 错误，因为注意力分数由 Q 和 K 共同计算，而不是仅靠 K。选项 D 不正确，因为位置嵌入独立于 V。[参考：, Vaswani, A., 等 (2017). “Attention is All You Need.”, NVIDIA NeMo 文档：https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/stable/nlp/intro.html, , , ]

A backup dataset used only if the primary one fails

questions.topic: Core Machine Learning and AI Knowledge
questions.q: Which change best addresses the training instability while retaining both objectives?
questions.qZh: 哪项改动在保留两个目标的同时最能解决训练不稳定问题？
o: Normalize the objectives or otherwise adjust their weights so neither objective dominates the shared encoder gradients.
Remove the caption objective because retrieval is the primary task.
Increase the caption objective weight to make its learning signal more consistent.
Use the unmodified sum of the objectives because both are calculated from the same training examples.
oZh: 对两个目标进行归一化或以其他方式调整其权重，使任何一个目标都不会主导共享编码器的梯度。
移除字幕目标，因为检索才是主要任务。
提高字幕目标的权重，使其学习信号更加一致。
直接使用未加修改的两个目标之和，因为两者都基于相同的训练样本计算。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the caption objective currently dominates the shared encoder gradients, so balancing the objectives addresses the stated instability while preserving both. Option B is not correct because the team must retain caption supervision. Option C would increase the existing imbalance. Option D ignores the different gradient contributions.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为字幕目标目前在共享编码器的梯度中占据主导地位，因此平衡两个目标既解决了所述的不稳定问题，又保留了两者。选项 B 不正确，因为团队必须保留字幕监督信号。选项 C 会加剧现有的不平衡。选项 D 忽略了不同目标梯度贡献的差异。

questions.topic: Core Machine Learning and AI Knowledge
questions.q: Which architectural change most directly addresses the gradient problem described?
questions.qZh: 哪一项架构改动最能直接解决上述梯度问题？
o: Add residual connections that pass block inputs forward, using a projection when dimensions do not match.
Increase the number of hidden layers while keeping every layer connected only to its immediate predecessor.
Replace the hidden layers with a single linear layer so gradients cannot pass through nonlinearities.
Add dropout to every layer while leaving the network's connections unchanged.
oZh: 添加残差连接，将各模块的输入向前传递，并在维度不匹配时使用投影层。
增加隐藏层数量，同时保持每一层只与其直接前一层相连。
用单个线性层替换隐藏层，使梯度无法穿过非线性激活。
在每一层添加 dropout，同时保持网络连接方式不变。
questions.e: Option A is correct because residual paths give gradients a route across multiple blocks, and a projection can align dimensions when needed. Option B adds depth without addressing the stated gradient weakening. Option C removes the network's nonlinear capacity. Option D changes regularization but does not create a direct path for gradients.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为残差路径为梯度提供了跨越多个模块的传递通道，必要时投影层可对齐维度。选项 B 只是增加深度，并未解决所述的梯度减弱问题。选项 C 移除了网络的非线性能力。选项 D 改变了正则化方式，但没有为梯度建立直接通路。

questions.topic: Core Machine Learning and AI Knowledge
questions.q: Which transfer-learning approach best fits these constraints?
questions.qZh: 哪种迁移学习方法最符合这些约束条件？
o: Keep both encoders fixed and train a small task-specific head on their combined representations.
Initialize both encoders randomly and train every parameter using the small paired dataset.
Freeze the image encoder and replace the pretrained text encoder with a randomly initialized encoder.
Keep both encoders and the task head fixed so the original representations cannot change.
oZh: 保持两个编码器固定，在其融合后的表示上训练一个小的任务专用头部。
随机初始化两个编码器，并使用小型配对数据集训练全部参数。
冻结图像编码器，并用随机初始化的编码器替换预训练好的文本编码器。
保持两个编码器和任务头部均固定，使原始表示无法改变。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the small paired dataset can train a task-specific head while the pretrained encoders retain useful representations. Option B discards the benefit of pretraining and requires learning all parameters from limited data. Option C disrupts the pretrained image-text representation. Option D leaves no trainable parameters for adapting the model to the task.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为小型配对数据集足以训练任务专用头部，同时预训练编码器保留有用的表示。选项 B 丢弃了预训练带来的优势，且需要从有限数据中学习全部参数。选项 C 破坏了预训练的图文表示。选项 D 未留下任何可训练参数，无法针对任务对模型进行适配。

questions.q: Which visualization would best support the team’s review?
questions.qZh: 哪种可视化方式最能支持团队的评审？
o: Show a separate image overlay for each selected caption token, using a consistent color scale and labeling the maps as attention weights rather than proof of causation.
Average all token and attention-head maps into one overlay, then describe the brightest region as the image feature that caused the caption.
Show only the caption text and the image, because attention weights cannot be presented in a visual analysis.
Rescale each map independently and compare the brightest colors across tokens as if they represented equal attention values.
oZh: 为每个选定的字幕 token 分别显示图像叠加图，使用统一的色阶，并将这些图标注为注意力权重而非因果关系的证明。
将所有 token 和注意力头的图平均为一张叠加图，然后把最亮的区域描述为导致该字幕的图像特征。
仅显示字幕文本和图像，因为注意力权重无法在可视化分析中呈现。
对每张图独立重新缩放，并跨 token 比较最亮的颜色，就如同它们代表相同的注意力数值。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the token-specific overlays preserve which image regions received attention for each noun, while a shared scale supports comparison. Option B combines distinct maps and makes an unsupported causal claim. Option C omits the evidence the team wants to inspect. Option D makes color intensity incomparable by changing the scale for each map.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为针对各 token 的叠加图保留了每个名词所关注的图像区域，而统一色阶便于比较。选项 B 合并了不同的图，并提出了缺乏依据的因果主张。选项 C 省略了团队希望查验的证据。选项 D 为每张图单独改变色阶，使颜色强度无法相互比较。

questions.q: Which analysis would best reveal whether the change in successful resolution is associated with channel or site, rather than only reflecting a change in case volume?
questions.qZh: 哪种分析最能揭示成功解决率的变化是与渠道还是与站点相关，而非仅仅反映案件量的变化？
o: Plot monthly case counts for each site and use the largest count as the indicator of successful resolution.
Plot monthly resolution rates by channel and site, include the number of cases behind each rate, and retain a consistent time axis.
Combine all sites and channels into one monthly resolution rate so that local differences do not distract from the trend.
Rank sites by their total number of resolved cases across the entire period and compare the resulting totals.
oZh: 绘制各站点每月的案件数量，并以最大的数量作为成功解决的指标。
按渠道和站点绘制每月的解决率，附上每个比率对应的案件数量，并保持时间轴一致。
将所有站点和渠道合并为单一的月度解决率，以免局部差异干扰对趋势的判断。
按整个周期内已解决案件的总数对站点进行排名，并比较所得总量。
questions.e: Option B is correct because rates show the share of cases resolved, while site, channel, and case counts help distinguish subgroup patterns from changes in volume. Option A measures volume, not resolution success. Option C hides differences among sites and channels. Option D also favors sites with more cases and removes the month-by-month pattern.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为比率反映已解决案件所占的份额，而站点、渠道和案件数量有助于将子群体模式与案件量变化区分开来。选项 A 衡量的是数量，而非解决成效。选项 C 掩盖了站点和渠道之间的差异。选项 D 同样偏向案件较多的站点，并丢失了逐月变化的模式。

questions.q: Which analysis is the most suitable next step for identifying factors associated with the higher correction rate?
questions.qZh: 在识别与较高纠正率相关因素方面，哪项分析是最合适的下一步？
o: Compare correction rates across scan sources within each document type, show group sizes, and report the proportion of records with missing correction labels.
Compare the total number of corrections for each scan source, without dividing by the number of documents processed.
Combine all document types and scan sources, then compare one overall correction rate for records with complete labels.
Order scan sources by their average confidence score and treat the highest average as evidence of the lowest correction rate.
oZh: 在每种文档类型内比较不同扫描来源的纠正率，呈现各组规模，并报告纠正标签缺失的记录所占比例。
比较各扫描来源的纠正总次数，不除以所处理的文档数量。
合并所有文档类型和扫描来源，然后比较标签完整记录的一个总体纠正率。
按平均置信度得分对扫描来源排序，并将最高平均值视为纠正率最低的证据。
questions.e: Option A is correct because comparing rates within document types can reveal whether scan source is associated with corrections, while group sizes and missing labels show limits in the data. Option B confuses correction frequency with correction rate. Option C hides subgroup relationships and excludes missing-label information. Option D substitutes confidence for observed corrections.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为按文档类型比较比率能够揭示扫描来源是否与纠正相关，而各组规模和标签缺失情况则反映了数据的局限。选项 B 混淆了纠正频次与纠正率。选项 C 掩盖了子群体之间的关系，并排除了标签缺失的信息。选项 D 用置信度替代了实际观察到的纠正情况。

questions.q: Which test is most likely to reveal whether the preprocessing pipeline paired each photograph with its correct spoken description?
questions.qZh: 哪项测试最有可能揭示预处理流程是否将每张照片与其正确的语音描述正确配对？
o: Join records using a stable sample ID, then inspect a sample of joined records against their source files.
Compare the total number of photographs and audio files before and after preprocessing.
Check that every photograph and audio file can be opened by the pipeline.
Shuffle the completed records and confirm that the training loss changes.
oZh: 使用稳定的样本 ID 连接记录，然后抽取一部分连接后的记录与其源文件进行核对。
比较预处理前后照片文件与音频文件的总数。
检查每张照片和音频文件是否都能被该流程打开。
打乱已完成的记录顺序，并确认训练损失发生变化。
questions.e: Option A is correct because a stable ID preserves the intended pairing despite the tables being sorted independently, and source inspection checks that pairing directly. Option B is not correct because equal counts do not show that records match. Option C is not correct because readable files can still be paired incorrectly. Option D is not correct because a loss change does not identify a pairing error.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为稳定的 ID 能在各表独立排序的情况下保持预期配对，而源文件核查可直接验证配对是否正确。选项 B 不正确，因为数量相同并不能说明记录相互匹配。选项 C 不正确，因为文件可读仍可能配对错误。选项 D 不正确，因为损失变化无法定位配对错误。

questions.q: Which evaluation plan gives the clearest evidence that the model change improved answer accuracy?
questions.qZh: 哪种评估方案能最清晰地证明模型改动提升了答案准确率？
o: Compare both versions on the same held-out examples with verified answers and identical generation settings.
Compare the new version on recent requests with the old version on requests from the previous month.
Evaluate the new version on its training examples and compare its score with the old version's validation score.
Use different generation settings for each version so each can produce its strongest answers.
oZh: 在同一批答案经过核验的留出样本上比较两个版本，并使用完全相同的生成设置。
在近期请求上评估新版本，在上个月的请求上评估旧版本。
在新版本的训练样本上进行评估，并将其得分与旧版本的验证得分比较。
为每个版本使用不同的生成设置，使各自都能产出最优答案。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the shared held-out examples, verified answers, and identical settings make accuracy differences comparable. Option B is not correct because changes in request mix could explain the score difference. Option C is not correct because training examples are not comparable with validation examples. Option D is not correct because different settings confound the model-version comparison.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为共享的留出样本、核验过的答案以及相同的设置使准确率差异具有可比性。选项 B 不正确，因为请求组合的变化可能解释得分差异。选项 C 不正确，因为训练样本与验证样本不可比。选项 D 不正确，因为不同的设置会对模型版本的比较造成混杂。

questions.q: Which experiment best tests whether the model's explanation actually depends on the visual evidence it cites?
questions.qZh: 哪个实验最能检验模型的解释是否真的依赖于其所引用的视觉证据？
o: Compare answers and explanations on matched cases with the image present and with the image removed, while keeping the product text unchanged.
Ask the model to produce a longer explanation for each case and check whether it mentions more image details.
Display image-token attention maps for several cases and treat high attention as proof that the explanation is grounded.
Compare the model's explanations with its training prompts without changing the input modalities.
oZh: 在有图像和移除图像两种条件下，对匹配案例比较答案与解释，同时保持产品文本不变。
让模型为每个案例生成更长的解释，并检查其是否提及更多图像细节。
展示若干案例的图像 token 注意力图，并将高注意力视为解释有据可依的证明。
在输入模态不变的前提下，将模型的解释与其训练提示词进行比较。
questions.e: Option A is correct because removing only the image tests whether the cited visual evidence affects the answer or explanation while the text stays fixed. Option B is not correct because explanation length does not demonstrate dependence on the image. Option C is not correct because attention alone does not establish that the explanation is grounded. Option D is not correct because unchanged inputs do not test modality dependence.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为仅移除图像，可以在文本保持不变的情况下检验所引用的视觉证据是否影响答案或解释。选项 B 不正确，因为解释长度并不能证明对图像的依赖。选项 C 不正确，因为仅有注意力不足以确立解释的可靠性。选项 D 不正确，因为输入未变无法检验对模态的依赖。

questions.q: Which ingestion approach best preserves the information needed for a multimodal retrieval system?
questions.qZh: 哪种摄取方式最能保留多模态检索系统所需的信息？
o: Extract plain text from each PDF and discard the original pages because the text is sufficient for retrieval.
Keep the original PDFs and capture page-level text, images, tables, and layout references as retrievable content.
Convert every page to an image and discard its text layer so all content uses one data type.
Extract diagrams and tables into separate image files without retaining their source page information.
oZh: 从每个 PDF 中提取纯文本并丢弃原始页面，因为文本已足以满足检索需求。
保留原始 PDF，并将页面级文本、图像、表格和版面引用一并捕获为可检索内容。
将每一页转换为图像并丢弃其文本层，使所有内容都使用同一种数据类型。
将图表和表格提取为独立的图像文件，而不保留其来源页面的信息。
questions.e: Option B is correct because retaining page-level text, images, tables, and layout references preserves content that plain text extraction may lose. Option A is not correct because it discards diagrams and table structure. Option C is not correct because it removes searchable text. Option D is not correct because detached images lose useful page context.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为保留页面级文本、图像、表格和版面引用，可以保留纯文本提取可能丢失的内容。选项 A 不正确，因为它丢弃了图示和表格结构。选项 C 不正确，因为它移除了可检索的文本。选项 D 不正确，因为分离出来的图像会丢失有用的页面上下文。

questions.q: Which preparation step should the team use before submitting the recordings to the speech service?
questions.qZh: 在将录音提交到语音服务之前，团队应采用哪个准备步骤？
o: Change the sample-rate metadata to 16 kHz without modifying the audio samples.
Decode each recording, downmix stereo audio to mono, and resample the waveform to 16 kHz PCM.
Convert each recording to stereo 16 kHz PCM and preserve the original sample values.
Keep each recording in its existing format and add a field that states it is compatible with the service.
oZh: 将采样率元数据改为 16 kHz，而不修改音频采样点。
对每段录音进行解码，将立体声音频下混为单声道，并将波形重采样为 16 kHz PCM。
将每段录音转换为立体声 16 kHz PCM，并保留原始采样值。
保持每段录音的现有格式不变，并添加一个字段说明其与该服务兼容。
questions.e: Option B is correct because decoding, downmixing, and resampling produce mono 16 kHz PCM as required, while changing metadata alone does not alter the waveform. Option A is not correct because relabeling leaves the original rate unchanged. Option C is not correct because the service requires mono audio. Option D is not correct because a compatibility label does not convert the files.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为解码、下混和重采样可生成符合要求的单声道 16 kHz PCM，而仅更改元数据不会改变波形。选项 A 不正确，因为仅重新标注并不会改变原始采样率。选项 C 不正确，因为该服务要求单声道音频。选项 D 不正确，因为兼容性标签并不能转换文件。

questions.q: Which change is the best first step to increase serving efficiency while checking that answer quality remains acceptable?
questions.qZh: 在验证回答质量仍可接受的前提下，哪个改动是提升服务效率的最佳第一步？
o: Use NVIDIA Model Optimizer to quantize the model for FP8 inference, then deploy it with TensorRT-LLM and evaluate latency and answer quality.
Increase the maximum batch size immediately, without changing the memory limit.
Increase the maximum image resolution so the model receives more visual detail.
Replace the image encoder with a larger encoder before measuring the current deployment.
oZh: 使用 NVIDIA Model Optimizer 将模型量化为适合 FP8 推理的形式，然后使用 TensorRT-LLM 进行部署，并评估延迟和回答质量。
在不改变内存限制的情况下立即增大最大批大小（batch size）。
提高最大图像分辨率，使模型获得更多视觉细节。
在测量当前部署之前，用更大的编码器替换图像编码器。
questions.e: Option A is correct because FP8 inference on the H100 can reduce computation and memory demands, and quality checks can confirm that the required answer standard is met. Option B is not correct because a larger batch can worsen the existing memory limit. Option C is not correct because larger images add computation. Option D is not correct because a larger encoder adds cost rather than addressing the measured bottleneck.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为在 H100 上采用 FP8 推理可以降低计算和内存开销，并且质量检查可以确认达到了要求的回答标准。选项 B 不正确，因为更大的批处理会加剧现有的内存限制问题。选项 C 不正确，因为更大的图像会增加计算量。选项 D 不正确，因为更大的编码器只会增加成本，而没有解决已测量到的瓶颈。

questions.q: Which training configuration change best addresses the low GPU utilization while preserving the required effective batch size?
questions.qZh: 在保持所需有效批大小（effective batch size）的前提下，哪项训练配置改动最能解决 GPU 利用率偏低的问题？
o: Increase the per-GPU microbatch and reduce gradient accumulation by a corresponding amount.
Increase the learning rate in proportion to the number of gradient accumulation steps.
Increase gradient accumulation further so each optimizer update uses more microbatches.
Run validation more often during training to keep the GPUs occupied.
oZh: 增大每张 GPU 的微批大小（microbatch），并按相应幅度减少梯度累积。
按梯度累积步数的比例提高学习率。
进一步增加梯度累积，使每次优化器更新使用更多微批。
在训练期间更频繁地执行验证，以让 GPU 保持忙碌。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the available memory headroom permits a larger microbatch, which can improve GPU utilization while a matching reduction in accumulation preserves the effective batch size. Option B is not correct because accumulation steps do not determine a proportional learning rate change. Option C is not correct because it increases accumulation and does not use the available memory. Option D is not correct because validation consumes time rather than improving training utilization.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为可用的内存余量允许使用更大的微批，从而提升 GPU 利用率，而等量减少累积步数可以保持有效批大小不变。选项 B 不正确，因为累积步数并不能决定学习率的同比调整。选项 C 不正确，因为它增加了累积量，却没有利用可用的内存。选项 D 不正确，因为验证只会消耗时间，无法提升训练利用率。

questions.q: What should the team do next to support a reliable client integration?
questions.qZh: 为了支持可靠的客户端集成，团队下一步应做什么？
o: Agree with the client on file formats, dimensions, failure behavior, and acceptance criteria, then validate a representative end-to-end flow in staging.
Convert every generated image to JPEG and deploy the change directly to production before the pilot.
Ask the client to change its application to accept every format and dimension the model may return.
Continue generating images in staging and report the number of successful outputs at the end of the pilot.
oZh: 与客户端就文件格式、尺寸、失败行为和验收标准达成一致，然后在预发布环境中验证一条有代表性的端到端流程。
将每张生成的图像转换为 JPEG，并在试点之前直接将该变更部署到生产环境。
要求客户端修改其应用，以接受模型可能返回的所有格式和尺寸。
继续在预发布环境中生成图像，并在试点结束时报告成功输出的数量。
questions.e: Option A is correct because it resolves the undocumented interface requirements and checks the agreed behavior in the client staging environment before the pilot. Option B assumes JPEG conversion solves every integration issue and skips validation. Option C shifts an undefined requirement to the client. Option D reports progress but leaves the known incompatibility unresolved.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为它解决了尚未成文的接口需求，并在试点前于客户端预发布环境中验证了达成一致的行为。选项 B 假定转换为 JPEG 就能解决所有集成问题，并跳过了验证。选项 C 把未定义的需求转嫁给了客户端。选项 D 只是汇报进度，未解决已知的兼容性问题。

questions.q: Which prompt change best addresses the team’s output requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪项提示词（prompt）改动最能满足团队的输出要求？
o: Instruct the model to use only the supplied changes, preserve each change’s shipped or planned status, and return the notes under the three required headings with bullets of no more than 20 words and no introduction.
Tell the model to write polished, engaging release notes and rely on its knowledge of common software release practices to fill any gaps.
Ask the model to rewrite planned changes as shipped when that makes the notes read more clearly, while keeping the three headings.
Set the model’s temperature to zero and keep the existing generic prompt so its release notes become more consistent.
oZh: 指示模型仅使用所提供的变更内容，保留每项变更“已发布”或“计划中”的状态，并在三个规定标题下返回说明，每个要点不超过 20 个词，且不加引言。
让模型撰写润色且有吸引力的发布说明，并依靠其对常见软件发布实践的了解来填补缺失内容。
让模型在这样能让说明读起来更清晰时，将计划中的变更改写为已发布，同时保留三个标题。
将模型的 temperature 设为零，并保留现有的通用提示词，使其发布说明更加一致。
questions.e: Option A is correct because it explicitly limits claims to the supplied changes, preserves status, and specifies the required headings and bullet length. Option B is not correct because outside knowledge can introduce unsupported claims and does not enforce the format. Option C is not correct because it misrepresents planned work as shipped. Option D is not correct because a lower temperature does not add the missing content and formatting instructions.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为它明确将陈述限制在所提供的变更范围内，保留了状态，并规定了标题结构和要点长度。选项 B 不正确，因为引入外部知识可能导致无依据的陈述，且无法强制执行格式要求。选项 C 不正确，因为它把计划中的工作错误地表述为已发布。选项 D 不正确，因为降低 temperature 并不会补充缺失的内容和格式指令。

questions.q: Which implementation best meets the team’s requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪种实现最能满足团队的要求？
o: Train the U-Net to predict added noise from progressively corrupted training images, then generate by repeatedly denoising random noise. For reconstruction mode, use the U-Net as an encoder-decoder that maps an input image to a reconstructed image.
Train the U-Net only to reconstruct input images, then pass random noise through it once at inference and treat its output as a generated image.
Train the U-Net to predict added noise, but generate images by passing random noise through it once without iterative denoising. Use a separate pretrained decoder for reconstruction.
Train the U-Net to map random noise directly to images using paired examples, then use its noise-prediction output as the reconstruction of an input image.
oZh: 训练 U-Net 从逐步加噪的图像中预测所添加的噪声，然后通过反复去噪随机噪声来生成图像。对于重建模式，将 U-Net 作为编码器-解码器，把输入图像映射为重建图像。
仅训练 U-Net 重建输入图像，然后在推理时将随机噪声一次性通过该网络，并把其输出视为生成的图像。
训练 U-Net 预测所添加的噪声，但生成图像时仅将随机噪声一次性通过该网络，而不进行迭代去噪。重建则使用另一个预训练的解码器。
使用配对样本训练 U-Net 将随机噪声直接映射为图像，然后将其噪声预测输出用作输入图像的重建结果。
questions.e: Option A is correct because it uses iterative denoising from random noise for generation and an image-to-image reconstruction path for the autoencoder mode, while retaining the required U-Net backbone. Option B is not correct because reconstruction training alone does not teach the model to generate from noise. Option C is not correct because one denoising pass and a separate decoder miss the requirements. Option D is not correct because noise prediction does not reconstruct an input image.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为它在生成时采用从随机噪声出发的迭代去噪，在自编码器模式下采用图像到图像的重建路径，同时保留了所需的 U-Net 骨干网络。选项 B 不正确，因为仅做重建训练无法让模型学会从噪声生成图像。选项 C 不正确，因为单次去噪和独立解码器都不满足要求。选项 D 不正确，因为噪声预测并不能重建输入图像。

questions.q: Which data-use policy best meets the stated privacy and consent requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪种数据使用政策最能满足既定的隐私和知情同意要求？
o: Use every document because customers submitted them through the company portal, then remove names after training.
Use only documents with documented consent for model training, exclude unnecessary personal details, and apply the agreed retention limit.
Use all documents for training, since restricting access to the resulting model protects the original information.
Replace the documents with synthetic data, even though the organization has not checked whether the synthetic data reflects the authorized records.
oZh: 使用全部文档，理由是客户通过公司门户提交了这些文档，并在训练之后再删除姓名。
仅使用已有明确知情同意记录的文档进行模型训练，排除不必要的个人详情，并执行约定的保留期限。
使用全部文档进行训练，因为限制对所得模型的访问可以保护原始信息。
用合成数据替换文档，尽管该组织并未核查合成数据是否反映了已获授权的记录。
questions.e: Option B is correct because the contract requires documented consent for training, and the policy also limits personal data and retention. Option A is not correct because portal submission does not establish the specified consent. Option C is not correct because access controls do not cure unauthorized use. Option D is not correct because unverified synthetic data does not satisfy the consent requirement.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为合同要求训练必须取得有记录的知情同意，并且该政策同时限制了个人数据和保留期限。选项 A 不正确，因为通过门户提交并不构成所要求的知情同意。选项 C 不正确，因为访问控制无法弥补未授权使用。选项 D 不正确，因为未经核验的合成数据不满足知情同意要求。

questions.q: Which action is the best next step to reduce the identified bias risk?
questions.qZh: 为降低已识别的偏差风险，下一步最好的措施是什么？
o: Keep the current dataset and rely on the overall accuracy score, since it is above the launch threshold.
Add more examples from the underrepresented group without checking consent or whether the examples match the intended use.
Review authorized data for representation gaps, obtain suitable consented examples where needed, and assess model outcomes across relevant groups before release.
Remove group labels from the training records and assume that this prevents the model from learning biased patterns.
oZh: 保持当前数据集不变，并依赖总体准确率分数，因为该分数已高于上线阈值。
增加来自代表性不足群体的样本，但不考虑知情同意，也不检查这些样本是否与预期用途匹配。
检查已授权数据中的代表性缺口，在需要时获取合适的、已获知情同意的样本，并在发布前评估模型在各相关群体上的表现。
从训练记录中移除群体标签，并假设这样可以防止模型学到有偏的模式。
questions.e: Option C is correct because it addresses the known representation gap while respecting consent and checking outcomes across groups. Option A is not correct because a strong overall score can hide poor results for a smaller group. Option B is not correct because it ignores consent and data suitability. Option D is not correct because removing labels does not remove bias already reflected in other features.
questions.eZh: 选项 C 正确，因为它在尊重知情同意的前提下解决了已知的代表性缺口，并检查了各群体上的表现。选项 A 不正确，因为总体分数较高可能掩盖某个较小群体上的糟糕结果。选项 B 不正确，因为它忽略了知情同意和数据适用性。选项 D 不正确，因为移除标签并不能消除已反映在其他特征中的偏差。

questions.q: Which approach best uses the available technology while addressing the assistant's trustworthiness risks?
questions.qZh: 哪种方案既充分利用了现有技术，又应对了该助手可信度方面的风险？
o: Add NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails with defined input and output policies, and retain review and escalation for cases the rails do not resolve.
Fine-tune the assistant to refuse sensitive requests and treat that training as proof that it cannot disclose restricted information.
Enable detailed logging of every conversation and give all support staff access so they can identify unsafe responses.
Increase the model's refusal frequency through a system prompt and remove other safeguards to reduce response delay.
oZh: 添加 NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails 并定义输入与输出策略，同时针对护栏无法处理的场景保留人工审核与升级机制。
微调该助手使其拒绝敏感请求，并把这种训练视为其不会泄露受限信息的证明。
启用对每次对话的详细日志记录，并让所有支持人员都能访问，以便识别不安全的回答。
通过系统提示词提高模型的拒绝频率，并移除其他防护措施以降低响应延迟。
questions.e: Option A is correct because NeMo Guardrails can enforce defined conversational policies, while review and escalation address cases that automated controls miss. Option B is not correct because fine-tuning alone cannot prove that sensitive disclosures will never occur. Option C is not correct because broad access to detailed logs creates additional privacy risk. Option D is not correct because a prompt alone is not an adequate safeguard.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为 NeMo Guardrails 可以执行已定义的对话策略，而人工审核与升级机制可处理自动化控制遗漏的场景。选项 B 不正确，因为仅靠微调无法证明敏感信息泄露绝不会发生。选项 C 不正确，因为广泛开放详细日志的访问会带来额外的隐私风险。选项 D 不正确，因为仅靠提示词不足以构成有效的防护措施。

questions.q: Which metric is commonly used for evaluating Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) models?
questions.qZh: 通常用于评估自动语音识别（ASR）模型的指标是哪一个？
o: CTC Loss
F1 Score
Mean Opinion Score (MOS)
Word Error Rate (WER)
oZh: CTC Loss
F1 Score
Mean Opinion Score (MOS)
Word Error Rate (WER)
questions.e: Word Error Rate is the standard evaluation metric for ASR systems. It measures the edit distance between the model's transcription and a human reference transcript, computed as (Substitutions + Deletions + Insertions) / Number of reference words, expressed as a percentage. Lower WER indicates better transcription accuracy. Its character-level analogue, Character Error Rate (CER), is used for languages without clear word boundaries or for morphologically complex languages. The distractors target common confusions: CTC (Connectionist Temporal Classification) Loss (A) is a *training* objective used to align variable-length audio input with variable-length text output in ASR models like DeepSpeech — it optimizes the model but is not itself a post-hoc evaluation metric on held-out accuracy. F1 Score (B) evaluates classification tasks with defined positive/negative classes, such as keyword spotting or wake-word detection, not full transcription. Mean Opinion Score (C) is a subjective, human-rated metric used to evaluate speech *synthesis* quality (TTS) or perceived audio naturalness — the inverse task of ASR — not transcription accuracy. On NVIDIA's Riva and NeMo ASR pipelines, WER is the benchmark reported against datasets like LibriSpeech, and it remains the figure typically referenced in the exam's Multimodal Data and Experimentation domains when discussing speech model evaluation.
questions.eZh: 词错误率（Word Error Rate）是 ASR 系统的标准评估指标。它衡量模型转写结果与人工参考转写之间的编辑距离，计算方式为 (替换 + 删除 + 插入) / 参考词数，并以百分比表示。WER 越低表示转写准确度越高。其字符级对应指标字符错误率（CER）适用于没有清晰词边界的语言或形态复杂的语言。干扰项针对的是常见的混淆：CTC（Connectionist Temporal Classification）Loss（A）是一种*训练*目标，用于在 DeepSpeech 等 ASR 模型中对齐变长音频输入与变长文本输出——它用于优化模型，本身并不是在留出数据上进行的评估指标。F1 Score（B）用于评估具有明确正负类别的分类任务，例如关键词检测或唤醒词检测，而不是完整转写。Mean Opinion Score（C）是一种主观的人工评分指标，用于评估语音*合成*质量（TTS）或音频自然度——这正是 ASR 的相反任务——而不是转写准确度。在 NVIDIA 的 Riva 和 NeMo ASR 流水线中，WER 是针对 LibriSpeech 等数据集所报告的基准指标，在本考试的多模态数据与实验相关主题中讨论语音模型评估时，通常引用的也正是这一数值。

questions.q: During the process of data cleansing, which of the following steps is NOT typically performed?
questions.qZh: 在数据清洗过程中，以下哪一步通常*不会*执行？
o: Identifying and handling missing values
Transforming data into a different format
Collecting additional data
Removing duplicates
oZh: 识别并处理缺失值
将数据转换为其他格式
收集额外数据
移除重复项
questions.e: Data cleansing (or data cleaning) operates on data you already have: it identifies and resolves quality issues within an existing dataset — handling missing values (A), removing duplicate records (D), correcting formatting or type inconsistencies (B), fixing structural errors, and standardizing units or encodings. Collecting additional data (C) belongs to a conceptually earlier and separate phase of the pipeline: data acquisition or data collection, which determines what data enters the pipeline in the first place, rather than what is done to improve the quality of data already collected. This distinction matters operationally: a cleansing step is typically deterministic and reversible against the existing dataset (you can inspect, log, and audit exactly which rows were dropped or imputed), whereas collecting more data is a scoping decision that may require new labeling budgets, new consent/privacy review, or new data-source integration — a materially different workflow with different stakeholders. That said, insufficient data volume discovered *during* cleansing (e.g., after removing corrupted records the sample size becomes too small for the target class) can trigger a decision to go back and collect more — but that action itself is not classified as a cleansing step; it is the trigger for restarting an earlier pipeline stage.
questions.eZh: 数据清洗（或数据清洁）作用于你已有的数据：它在现有数据集内部识别并解决质量问题——处理缺失值（A）、移除重复记录（D）、修正格式或类型不一致（B）、修复结构错误，以及统一度量单位或编码。收集额外数据（C）属于流水线中概念上更早且独立的阶段：数据获取或数据收集，它决定哪些数据最初进入流水线，而不是对已收集数据的质量做改进。这一区别在实际操作中很重要：清洗步骤通常针对现有数据集是确定且可逆的（你可以检查、记录并审计具体哪些行被删除或插补），而收集更多数据属于范围决策，可能需要新的标注预算、新的同意/隐私审查或新的数据源集成——这是一个利益相关方都不同的、实质上不同的工作流。尽管如此，如果在*清洗过程中*发现数据量不足（例如移除损坏记录后样本量对目标类别而言变得过小），可能会触发回退并收集更多数据的决定——但该动作本身并不属于清洗步骤，而是重启更早流水线阶段的触发条件。

questions.q: You are evaluating the performance of an AI model for facial recognition. What is an important consideration when evaluating the model for bias?
questions.qZh: 你正在评估一个用于人脸识别的 AI 模型的性能。在评估该模型的偏见时，重要的考量因素是什么？
o: The model's processing speed in recognizing faces of different races.
The model's accuracy in recognizing individuals of different races.
The model's ability to recognize various facial expressions.
The model's compatibility with different operating systems.
oZh: 模型识别不同种族人脸时的处理速度。
模型识别不同种族个体的准确率。
模型识别各种面部表情的能力。
模型与不同操作系统的兼容性。
questions.e: Bias evaluation for facial recognition centers on measuring whether the model's accuracy — true positive rate, false positive rate, false match rate — is consistent across demographic subgroups (race, gender, age), rather than assuming a single aggregate accuracy figure represents performance fairly for all groups. This concern is well grounded empirically: independent benchmarking, including NIST's Face Recognition Vendor Test studies, has repeatedly documented substantial accuracy disparities across demographic groups in widely deployed facial recognition systems, with error rates for some subgroups measured many times higher than for others — a direct consequence of training data underrepresentation and the representativeness-bias issue covered elsewhere in this domain. Processing speed (A) is a performance/latency engineering concern, not a bias or fairness concern — a model could process all demographic groups at identical speed while still exhibiting severe accuracy disparities between them. Facial expression recognition capability (C) addresses a different task dimension (emotion/expression classification) than the identity-recognition bias question being asked. Operating system compatibility (D) is a software-deployment/engineering concern entirely unrelated to model fairness. Subgroup accuracy disparities in facial recognition carry serious real-world consequences — misidentification risk in law enforcement or access-control contexts — which is why disaggregated (per-subgroup) evaluation, not just aggregate accuracy, is considered a baseline requirement under Trustworthy AI bias auditing practice.
questions.eZh: 人脸识别的偏见评估，核心在于测量模型的准确率——真正例率、假正率、误匹配率——在不同人口统计子群体（种族、性别、年龄）之间是否保持一致，而不是假定单一的总体准确率能够公平地代表所有群体的表现。这一关切有充分的实证依据：包括 NIST 的 Face Recognition Vendor Test 研究在内的独立基准测试，多次记录到广泛部署的人脸识别系统在不同人口统计群体之间存在显著的准确率差距，某些子群体的错误率被测得高出其他群体数倍——这是训练数据代表性不足以及本领域其他部分所讨论的代表性偏见问题直接导致的后果。处理速度（A）属于性能/延迟工程层面的考量，而不是偏见或公平性层面的考量——一个模型可能对所有人口统计群体具有完全相同的处理速度，却仍然在它们之间表现出严重的准确率差距。人脸表情识别能力（C）针对的是另一个任务维度（情绪/表情分类），与此处提出的身份识别偏见问题不同。操作系统兼容性（D）属于软件部署/工程层面的考量，与模型公平性完全无关。人脸识别中的子群体准确率差距会带来严重的现实后果——在执法或访问控制场景中的误识别风险——因此，分组（按子群体）评估，而不仅仅是总体准确率，被视为可信 AI 偏见审计实践中的基线要求。

questions.q: In machine learning, what is the purpose of data normalization?
questions.qZh: 在机器学习中，数据归一化的目的是什么？
o: To remove irrelevant data from the dataset.
To increase the complexity of the dataset.
To convert data into a specific format for easier analysis.
To reduce the dimensionality of the dataset.
oZh: 从数据集中移除无关数据。
增加数据集的复杂度。
将数据转换为特定格式，以便更容易地进行分析。
降低数据集的维度。
questions.e: Normalization rescales numeric features onto a common, well-defined range or distribution — for example, min-max scaling to [0,1], or standardization to zero mean and unit variance (z-score) — so that features measured on different scales contribute comparably to model training. Among the options given, "converting data into a specific format for easier analysis" is the closest description of this rescaling purpose, though the more precise technical framing is: normalization standardizes the scale of feature values to stabilize and accelerate optimization. This matters mechanically because many algorithms are scale-sensitive: gradient descent converges faster and more stably when input features share a comparable range (large-scale features would otherwise dominate the loss gradient), distance-based methods (k-NN, k-means, SVMs with RBF kernels) require comparable scales for distance calculations to be meaningful, and regularization terms penalize weight magnitude uniformly, which only makes sense if inputs are on comparable scales. It is important to distinguish normalization from the other three options: it does not remove data (A, which is cleansing/filtering), does not increase complexity (B, the opposite of its intent), and does not reduce dimensionality (D, which describes techniques like PCA or feature selection — an entirely separate preprocessing goal focused on the number of features, not their scale).
questions.eZh: 归一化将数值特征重新缩放到统一的、明确定义的范围或分布上——例如 min-max 缩放到 [0,1]，或标准化为零均值、单位方差（z-score）——使以不同量纲度量的特征在模型训练中具有可比的贡献。在给出的选项中，“将数据转换为特定格式以便更容易地分析”最接近对这一缩放目的的描述，不过更精确的技术表述是：归一化统一了特征值的尺度，以稳定并加速优化。这一点在机制上很重要，因为许多算法对尺度敏感：当输入特征处于相近范围时，梯度下降收敛更快也更稳定（否则大尺度特征会主导损失梯度）；基于距离的方法（k-NN、k-means、使用 RBF 核的 SVM）要求尺度可比，距离计算才有意义；而正则化项对权重幅度进行统一惩罚，只有在输入处于可比尺度时才有意义。必须将归一化与其余三个选项区分开：它不移除数据（A，那属于清洗/过滤），不增加复杂度（B，与其意图相反），也不降低维度（D，后者描述的是 PCA 或特征选择等技术——一个完全独立的预处理目标，关注的是特征数量而非其尺度）。

questions.q: What role does 'late fusion' play in multimodal machine learning?
questions.qZh: “后融合（late fusion）”在多模态机器学习中起什么作用？
o: It refers to the process of combining multiple modalities at the decision level.
It refers to the process of combining multiple modalities at the training stage.
It refers to the process of combining multiple modalities at the feature level.
It refers to the process of combining multiple modalities at the preprocessing stage.
oZh: 它指在决策层面组合多种模态的过程。
它指在训练阶段组合多种模态的过程。
它指在特征层面组合多种模态的过程。
它指在预处理阶段组合多种模态的过程。
questions.e: Late fusion trains separate, independent models for each modality — each producing its own prediction, score, or decision — and combines those outputs only at the final decision stage, typically via averaging, weighted voting, a learned meta-classifier (stacking), or simple rule-based aggregation. This is the direct counterpart to early fusion (combination at the raw/feature input level, tested elsewhere in this set) and to intermediate/hybrid fusion (combination at one or more mid-network representation levels). Late fusion's key practical advantage is modularity and robustness: because each modality's model operates independently until the final combination step, a missing or corrupted modality at inference time degrades performance gracefully rather than catastrophically — the surviving modalities' models can still contribute a prediction. It also allows each modality-specific model to be trained, validated, and even updated independently, which simplifies engineering in production systems. Its main disadvantage is that it cannot capture fine-grained, low-level cross-modal interactions, since by the time information reaches the fusion point, each modality has already been reduced to a high-level decision. Options C and D describe feature-level and preprocessing-level combination respectively — both inconsistent with "late" in the fusion terminology, which specifically denotes the decision/output stage. Option B describes a training-schedule concept unrelated to fusion architecture.
questions.eZh: 后融合为每种模态分别训练独立模型——各自产生自己的预测、分数或决策——并仅在最终决策阶段组合这些输出，通常通过取平均、加权投票、学习得到的元分类器（stacking）或简单的基于规则的聚合来实现。它是早期融合（在原始/特征输入层面组合，本题集其他题目有涉及）和中间/混合融合（在一个或多个网络中间表示层组合）的直接对应物。后融合的关键实际优势在于模块化和鲁棒性：由于每种模态的模型在最终组合步骤之前都独立运行，推理时某个模态缺失或损坏只会导致性能平缓下降，而不是灾难性失败——其余模态的模型仍可给出预测。它还允许各模态专属的模型独立训练、验证甚至更新，从而简化生产系统中的工程实现。其主要缺点是无法捕捉细粒度的低层次跨模态交互，因为当信息到达融合点时，每种模态已被归约为高层决策。选项 C 和 D 分别描述特征层面和预处理层面的组合——均与融合术语中的“后”不符，后者特指决策/输出阶段。选项 B 描述的是与融合架构无关的训练调度概念。

questions.q: In the transformer architecture, what is the purpose of positional encoding?
questions.qZh: 在 transformer 架构中，位置编码（positional encoding）的目的是什么？
o: To encode the semantic meaning of each token in the input sequence.
To add information about the order of each token in the input sequence.
To remove redundant information from the input sequence.
To encode the importance of each token in the input sequence.
oZh: 对输入序列中每个 token 的语义含义进行编码。
补充输入序列中每个 token 的顺序信息。
移除输入序列中的冗余信息。
对输入序列中每个 token 的重要性进行编码。
questions.e: Unlike recurrent architectures, which process tokens sequentially and thereby inherently encode order through the sequence of computation, the transformer's self-attention mechanism processes all tokens in parallel and is permutation-invariant by construction — attention scores between tokens do not inherently depend on their position in the sequence. Positional encoding solves this by injecting explicit information about each token's position into its input representation, typically by adding a positional vector (computed via fixed sinusoidal functions in the original "Attention Is All You Need" formulation, or learned as trainable embeddings in many modern variants) to the token's embedding before it enters the attention layers. Without this, "the cat sat on the mat" and "the mat sat on the cat" would be indistinguishable to the self-attention mechanism, since the same set of token embeddings would be processed identically regardless of order. Semantic meaning (option A) is the role of the token embeddings themselves, learned separately from positional information — the two are combined (typically summed) but serve distinct purposes. Positional encoding does not remove information (C); it adds it. And while attention weights do effectively encode a learned notion of token importance relative to a query (option D), that importance-weighting mechanism is a separate, downstream function of the attention layers, not the role of positional encoding itself, which only supplies order information as an input feature.
questions.eZh: 与循环架构不同，循环架构按顺序处理 token，通过计算顺序天然地编码了顺序信息；而 transformer 的自注意力机制并行处理所有 token，其构造上对排列是不变的——token 之间的注意力得分并不天然依赖于它们在序列中的位置。位置编码通过将每个 token 位置的显式信息注入其输入表示来解决这一问题，通常做法是在 token 的 embedding 进入注意力层之前加上一个位置向量（在最初的《Attention Is All You Need》方案中通过固定的正弦函数计算，在许多现代变体中则作为可训练的 embedding 学习得到）。没有位置编码，“the cat sat on the mat”与“the mat sat on the cat”对自注意力机制而言将无法区分，因为无论顺序如何，处理的都是同一组 token embedding。语义含义（选项 A）是 token embedding 自身的职责，它与位置信息分开学习——两者会结合（通常是相加），但作用各不相同。位置编码不会移除信息（C），而是添加信息。虽然注意力权重确实在某种程度上编码了相对于某个查询的、经过学习的 token 重要性（选项 D），但这种重要性加权机制是注意力层的另一个下游功能，并非位置编码本身的职责——位置编码只提供顺序信息作为输入特征。

questions.q: You have a dataset containing information about sales performance for different regions in the last ten years. Which type of data visualization would be most appropriate to compare the sales performance across regions on a year-by-year basis?
questions.qZh: 你有一个数据集，包含过去十年不同地区的销售业绩信息。哪种数据可视化最适合逐年比较各地区的销售业绩？
o: Scatter plot
Line chart
Bar chart
Pie chart
oZh: 散点图
折线图
柱状图
饼图
questions.e: Reviewer note: Marked answer (D, pie chart) is inconsistent with standard data-visualization practice for year-by-year, multi-region comparison; a line chart (B) is the technically defensible choice. I need to flag this one directly: the marked answer (D, pie chart) does not hold up technically, and I won't present it as correct just because it's what the answer key says. A pie chart shows the proportional breakdown of a whole at a single point in time — it has no mechanism for representing a trend across ten years, and using ten overlapping pie charts (one per year) to compare regional performance would be one of the least readable choices available, not the most appropriate. The technically correct choice is a line chart (B): with ten years of data per region, a line chart plots each region as a separate series across a shared time axis, making year-over-year trends, growth rates, inflection points, and cross-region divergence immediately visible — exactly the "year-by-year" comparison the question specifies. A grouped/clustered bar chart (C) is a reasonable secondary choice if the emphasis is discrete year-to-year comparison rather than continuous trend, but it becomes visually cluttered with ten years × multiple regions. A scatter plot (A) is better suited to examining the relationship between two continuous variables (e.g., sales vs. marketing spend) than to a time-series comparison across categories. If this exact answer appears on a live exam or official material, treat D with skepticism — this explanation reflects standard data visualization practice, not the source document's marked key.
questions.eZh: 审阅者备注：标注答案（D，饼图）与逐年的多地区比较这一标准数据可视化实践不一致；折线图（B）才是技术上站得住脚的选择。我需要直接指出这一点：标注答案（D，饼图）在技术上并不成立，我不会仅仅因为它是答案键就把它当作正确答案。饼图展示的是整体在某个时点的比例构成——它没有机制来表达跨越十年的趋势，而使用十个重叠的饼图（每年一个）来比较各地区表现，会是最难读的选择之一，而不是最合适的选择。技术上正确的选择是折线图（B）：每个地区有十年数据，折线图把每个地区作为独立系列绘制在共享的时间轴上，使逐年趋势、增长率、拐点以及地区间的分化一目了然——这正是题目所要求的“逐年”比较。若重点是离散的逐年对比而非连续趋势，分组/簇状柱状图（C）是合理的选择，但在十年 × 多个地区的情况下会显得杂乱。散点图（A）更适合考察两个连续变量之间的关系（例如销售额与营销支出），而非跨类别的时间序列比较。如果这个答案出现在真实考试或官方材料中，请对 D 保持怀疑——本解析反映的是标准数据可视化实践，而非源文档标注的答案键。

questions.q: Which of the following best describes the role of machine learning in handling multimodal data?
questions.qZh: 以下哪项最能描述机器学习在处理多模态数据中的作用？
o: To focus on textual data analysis.
To reduce the amount of data needed for accurate predictions.
To eliminate the need for human intervention in data analysis.
To enable models to learn from and interpret diverse data types.
oZh: 专注于文本数据分析。
减少获得准确预测所需的数据量。
消除数据分析中人工干预的必要性。
使模型能够从多种数据类型中学习并对其进行解释。
questions.e: Machine learning's role in multimodal contexts is to build models capable of jointly learning from, aligning, and interpreting heterogeneous data types — text, images, audio, video, time series, and beyond — extracting patterns and relationships that span modality boundaries rather than treating each stream in isolation. This is the general framing that unifies the more specific concepts tested elsewhere in this domain (fusion strategies, shared embedding spaces, cross-modal attention): all of them are mechanisms in service of this broader goal of learning from diverse data types jointly. Option A incorrectly narrows the scope to text alone, contradicting the entire premise of multimodal learning. Option B is not a defining characteristic — multimodal models often require *more*, not less, data to learn reliable cross-modal correspondences, though they can improve sample efficiency for a given task relative to a comparably-performing unimodal model by exploiting complementary signal across modalities; this is a possible benefit, not the defining role. Option C overstates ML's function; human oversight, labeling, validation, and bias auditing remain integral to responsible multimodal system development, particularly under Trustworthy AI principles — ML augments rather than eliminates human involvement in the broader data-analysis workflow.
questions.eZh: 机器学习在多模态语境中的作用，是构建能够联合学习、对齐并解释异构数据类型的模型——文本、图像、音频、视频、时间序列等等——从而提取跨越模态边界的模式与关系，而不是孤立地处理每个数据流。这是统一本领域其他更具体概念（如融合策略、共享 embedding 空间、跨模态注意力）的总体框架：它们都是服务于“从多种数据类型中联合学习”这一更宏观目标的机制。选项 A 错误地将范围缩小到仅文本，这与多模态学习的全部前提相矛盾。选项 B 并非其定义性特征——多模态模型往往需要*更多*而非更少的数据来学习可靠的跨模态对应关系，尽管相对于性能相当的纯单模态模型，它们可以利用跨模态的互补信号来提升特定任务的样本效率；这是一种可能的收益，而非定义性作用。选项 C 夸大了 ML 的功能；在可信赖 AI 原则下，人工监督、数据标注、验证与偏差审计仍是负责任的多模态系统开发中不可或缺的环节——ML 是增强而非取代人工在整个数据分析流程中的参与。

questions.q: How is the optimization of a multimodal model different from a unimodal model in terms of gradient vanishing?
questions.qZh: 就梯度消失而言，多模态模型的优化与单模态模型有何不同？
o: Unimodal models have a higher risk of gradient vanishing compared to multimodal models, as the focus on a single modality allows for better gradient flow and stability.
Multimodal models have a higher risk of gradient vanishing compared to unimodal models, as the combination of multiple modalities increases the complexity of the model architecture.
Both multimodal and unimodal models have an equal risk of gradient vanishing, as the optimization process is independent of the number of modalities.
Gradient vanishing is not a concern in either multimodal or unimodal models, as modern optimization techniques have overcome this issue.
oZh: 单模态模型比多模态模型面临更高的梯度消失风险，因为专注于单一模态有利于更顺畅的梯度流动和更稳定的训练。
多模态模型比单模态模型面临更高的梯度消失风险，因为组合多种模态会增加模型架构的复杂度。
多模态模型与单模态模型面临梯度消失的风险相同，因为优化过程与模态数量无关。
在多模态模型和单模态模型中梯度消失都不是问题，因为现代优化技术已经克服了这一问题。
questions.e: Multimodal architectures are generally deeper and structurally more complex than their unimodal counterparts: they typically combine multiple modality-specific encoder branches (each potentially deep in its own right, e.g., a vision transformer plus a language transformer) with additional fusion layers stacked on top. This increased effective depth and the heterogeneous gradient paths flowing back through fusion points create more opportunities for gradients to shrink as they propagate backward through many successive layers and combination operations — the classic vanishing gradient problem, where early layers receive vanishingly small weight updates and effectively stop learning. Imbalanced convergence rates across modality branches (one modality dominating gradient signal while another stagnates) is a related, multimodal-specific optimization challenge that compounds this risk. This doesn't mean unimodal models are immune to vanishing gradients — they clearly are not, which is precisely why techniques like residual connections, normalization layers, and careful initialization were developed for deep unimodal networks in the first place. But the *comparative* claim in this question — that multimodal architectures face elevated risk due to added structural complexity — reflects a genuine, actively researched challenge in multimodal optimization, addressed through techniques like modality-specific learning rates, gradient blending, and careful fusion-layer design.
questions.eZh: 多模态架构通常比其对应的单模态架构更深、结构更复杂：它们一般会把多个模态专属的编码器分支（每个分支本身可能就很深，例如一个 vision transformer 加上一个 language transformer）与额外的融合层叠加在一起。这种有效深度的增加，以及经由融合点回传的异质梯度路径，为梯度在连续多层和多种组合操作中反向传播时不断缩小创造了更多机会——这正是经典的梯度消失问题：早期层获得的权重更新微乎其微，实际上停止了学习。各模态分支之间收敛速率不均衡（某一模态主导梯度信号而另一模态停滞）是多模态特有的相关优化难题，会加剧这一风险。这并不意味着单模态模型免疫于梯度消失——它们显然并非如此，这恰恰是残差连接、归一化层和精心初始化等技术最初就是为深层单模态网络开发出来的原因。但本题的*比较性*论断——多模态架构因额外的结构复杂度而面临更高风险——反映了多模态优化中一个真实且被积极研究的挑战，其应对手段包括模态专属学习率、梯度混合以及精心的融合层设计。

questions.q: In multimodal machine learning, what does 'early fusion' refer to?
questions.qZh: 在多模态机器学习中，“early fusion”（早期融合）指的是什么？
o: Integrating different modalities at the beginning of the model pipeline.
Ignoring certain modalities and only using one modality for analysis and prediction.
Training separate models for each modality and then combining their predictions.
Implementing the model in the early stages of development of the ML solution.
oZh: 在模型流程的初期整合不同的模态。
忽略某些模态，仅使用一种模态进行分析和预测。
为每种模态分别训练模型，然后合并它们的预测结果。
在 ML 解决方案的开发早期实现该模型。
questions.e: Early fusion concatenates or otherwise combines raw or lightly processed features from each modality before they enter the main model pipeline, producing a single joint input representation that a downstream network learns from jointly. This contrasts with late fusion (option C), where separate unimodal models process each modality independently and their outputs — logits, embeddings, or decisions — are combined only at the end, and with intermediate/hybrid fusion, where combination happens at one or more intermediate feature layers. Early fusion's advantage is that it allows the model to learn cross-modal correlations from the earliest layers, potentially capturing low-level interactions that later fusion stages would miss. Its disadvantage is sensitivity to modality-specific noise, differing sampling rates, and missing modalities: if one input stream is corrupted or absent, the joint representation degrades more severely than in late fusion, where the surviving modality's model can still function independently. Option B describes unimodal reduction, not fusion at all, and option D confuses a data-processing strategy with a project-management timeline — an easy distractor to eliminate. Exam questions frequently test the ability to distinguish early, late, and hybrid fusion by identifying *where* in the pipeline combination occurs, so anchor your answer to pipeline stage rather than performance characteristics.
questions.eZh: 早期融合会在各模态的原始或轻度处理后的特征进入主流模型管线之前，将其拼接或以其他方式组合，从而产生单一的联合输入表示，供下游网络进行联合学习。这与后期融合（选项 C）形成对比——后者由独立的单模态模型分别处理各模态，仅在最后才合并其输出（logits、embedding 或决策）；也不同于中间/混合融合——后者在一个或多个中间特征层上完成组合。早期融合的优势在于能让模型从最浅层就学习跨模态相关性，从而可能捕捉到后期融合阶段会遗漏的低层交互。它的缺点是对模态特有的噪声、不同的采样率以及模态缺失较为敏感：如果某一路输入流被污染或缺失，联合表示的退化程度会比后期融合更严重，因为后者中存活模态的模型仍可独立工作。选项 B 描述的是单模态降级，而非融合；选项 D 则把数据处理策略与项目管理时间线混为一谈——这是一个很容易排除的干扰项。考试题经常考查区分早期、后期和混合融合的能力，判断依据是组合发生在管线的*哪个位置*，因此应以管线阶段而非性能特征为锚点。

questions.q: What are some methods to overcome limited throughput between CPU and GPU?
questions.qZh: 有哪些方法可以克服 CPU 与 GPU 之间受限的吞吐？
o: Increase the clock speed of the CPU.
Increase the number of CPU cores.
Using techniques like memory pooling.
Upgrade the GPU to a higher-end model.
oZh: 提高 CPU 的时钟频率。
增加 CPU 核心数量。
使用内存池（memory pooling）等技术。
将 GPU 升级为更高端的型号。
questions.e: CPU-GPU data transfer over the PCIe (or NVLink) bus is frequently a throughput bottleneck in ML pipelines, particularly when small, frequent transfers dominate rather than large batched ones — each transfer incurs fixed overhead independent of data size, so many small transfers waste a disproportionate amount of time on overhead rather than useful data movement. Memory pooling techniques — pre-allocating and reusing pinned (page-locked) host memory buffers rather than repeatedly allocating and freeing memory for each transfer — reduce this overhead and enable faster, more predictable DMA transfers between host and device. Related software-level techniques include using CUDA streams to overlap data transfer with computation (so the GPU keeps computing while the next batch transfers in the background), and batching transfers to amortize fixed per-transfer overhead across more data. Options A, B, and D each propose hardware upgrades that address a different bottleneck than the one described: increasing CPU clock speed (A) or core count (B) improves CPU-side compute throughput, not the data-transfer bandwidth or latency between CPU and GPU specifically. Upgrading the GPU (D) increases GPU compute capability but does nothing to address a PCIe/interconnect bandwidth limitation — a faster GPU sitting idle waiting for data across the same bottlenecked bus would not see meaningfully improved end-to-end throughput. The question specifically asks about *throughput between* CPU and GPU, which points to interconnect/transfer-management optimization rather than raw compute upgrades on either side.
questions.eZh: 在 ML 管线中，CPU 与 GPU 之间通过 PCIe（或 NVLink）总线进行数据传输经常成为吞吐瓶颈，尤其是在小而频繁的传输占主导、而非大批量传输的情况下——每次传输都会产生与数据大小无关的固定开销，因此许多小传输会把不成比例的时间浪费在开销上而非有效的数据搬运上。内存池技术——预先分配并复用 pinned（page-locked）主机内存缓冲区，而不是为每次传输反复分配和释放内存——可以降低这类开销，并实现更快、更可预测的 host 与 device 之间的 DMA 传输。相关的软件层技术还包括使用 CUDA streams 将数据传输与计算重叠（使 GPU 在下一批数据于后台传输时继续计算），以及批量传输以将固定的单次传输开销摊薄到更多数据上。选项 A、B 和 D 都提出了针对不同瓶颈的硬件升级：提高 CPU 时钟频率（A）或核心数（B）提升的是 CPU 侧的计算吞吐，而非 CPU 与 GPU 之间的数据传输带宽或延迟。升级 GPU（D）会增强 GPU 计算能力，但无助于解决 PCIe/互连的带宽限制——一块更快的 GPU 若在同一受限总线前空等数据，端到端吞吐并不会显著改善。题目明确问的是 CPU 与 GPU *之间*的吞吐，这指向互连/传输管理优化，而不是任一侧的原始算力升级。

questions.q: Which visualization technique is suitable for representing the distribution of performance scores for different multimodal ML models over different modalities?
questions.qZh: 哪种可视化技术适合表示不同多模态 ML 模型在不同模态上的性能分数分布？
o: Heatmap
Histogram
Box plot
Pie chart
oZh: 热力图
直方图
箱线图
饼图
questions.e: A box plot (box-and-whisker plot) summarizes the distribution of a numeric variable — median, interquartile range, and outliers — as a single compact glyph, and critically, multiple box plots can be placed side by side to compare distributions across categorical groupings. This makes it well suited to the scenario described: comparing the spread and central tendency of performance scores across several models, further faceted by modality, in one readable figure. Box plots make skew, variance, and outlier prevalence immediately comparable across groups in a way a single summary statistic (like mean accuracy) cannot. A histogram (B) shows the distribution of a single variable well but does not scale cleanly to side-by-side comparison across many model/modality combinations without becoming visually cluttered. A heatmap (A) is excellent for showing a matrix of values (e.g., mean score per model × modality pair) but represents point estimates, not distributions — it cannot convey variance or spread. A pie chart (D) is inappropriate for any continuous performance metric. In practice, a violin plot — which overlays a kernel density estimate on the box plot's summary statistics — is often preferred when the underlying distribution's shape (e.g., bimodality) matters, but among the given options, the box plot is the correct choice for distributional comparison across groups.
questions.eZh: 箱线图（box-and-whisker plot）用一个紧凑的图形元素概括数值变量的分布——中位数、四分位距和离群值——关键在于多个箱线图可以并排放置，以比较不同分类分组下的分布。这使它非常适合题目所描述的场景：在一张易读的图中比较多个模型（并进一步按模态分面）的性能分数的离散程度与集中趋势。箱线图使偏度、方差和离群值的普遍程度在组间变得直观可比，这是单一汇总统计量（如平均准确率）无法做到的。直方图（B）能很好地展示单个变量的分布，但面对大量模型/模态组合的并排比较时难以扩展，容易显得杂乱。热力图（A）非常适合展示数值矩阵（例如每个模型 × 模态对的平均分数），但它表示的是点估计而非分布——无法体现方差或离散程度。饼图（D）不适用于任何连续性能指标。在实践中，当底层分布的形状（例如双峰性）很重要时，通常更倾向于小提琴图——它在箱线图的汇总统计之上叠加核密度估计——但在给出的选项中，箱线图是跨组分布比较的正确选择。

questions.q: You have been given a dataset with missing values. What is the first step you should take with the data?
questions.qZh: 你收到一个包含缺失值的数据集。首先应该对这些数据做什么？
o: Analyze the patterns and distribution of missing values.
Remove the rows with missing values.
Fill in the missing values with a default value.
Remove the columns with missing values.
oZh: 分析缺失值的模式和分布。
删除包含缺失值的行。
用默认值填补缺失值。
删除包含缺失值的列。
questions.e: Before deciding *how* to handle missing data, best practice requires understanding *why* it's missing — analyzing whether missingness is Missing Completely at Random (MCAR, no systematic pattern), Missing at Random (MAR, related to other observed variables but not the missing value itself), or Missing Not at Random (MNAR, related to the missing value itself, e.g., patients with severe symptoms being less likely to complete a survey field). This diagnostic step determines which downstream handling strategy is statistically appropriate: naive row deletion under MNAR conditions can introduce systematic bias into the remaining dataset, while mean/median imputation applied blindly can distort variance and correlational structure if missingness isn't actually random. Options B, C, and D each jump directly to a specific remedial action without first establishing whether that action is appropriate for the missingness pattern present. Removing rows (B) sacrifices sample size and can bias results if missingness correlates with the outcome of interest. Filling with a default value (C) without understanding the pattern risks introducing artificial structure that doesn't reflect the true underlying data. Removing entire columns (D) may discard genuinely informative features if missingness in that column is low or non-systematic. Only after this initial pattern analysis should you select an appropriate strategy: listwise deletion, mean/median/mode imputation, model-based imputation (e.g., MICE, k-NN imputation), or explicit missingness indicators as additional features.
questions.eZh: 在决定*如何*处理缺失数据之前，最佳实践要求先理解缺失的*原因*——分析缺失属于完全随机缺失（MCAR，无系统性模式）、随机缺失（MAR，与其他观测变量相关但与缺失值本身无关），还是非随机缺失（MNAR，与缺失值本身相关，例如症状严重的患者更可能不填写某个调查字段）。这一诊断步骤决定了哪种下游处理策略在统计上是合适的：在 MNAR 条件下天真地删除行会给剩余数据集引入系统性偏差，而盲目地做均值/中位数插补则可能扭曲方差和相关结构。选项 B、C 和 D 都直接跳到某种补救措施，而没有先确定该措施是否适合当前存在的缺失模式。删除行（B）会牺牲样本量，且当缺失与关注的结果相关时可能引入偏差。在不了解模式的情况下用默认值填补（C）会引入人为结构，无法反映真实的底层数据。删除整列（D）则可能丢弃真正有信息量的特征，如果该列的缺失率较低或不具备系统性。只有在完成这一初步的模式分析之后，才应选择合适的策略：成列删除、均值/中位数/众数插补、基于模型的插补（例如 MICE、k-NN imputation），或添加显式缺失指示变量作为额外特征。

questions.q: Which metric is commonly used to evaluate machine-translation models?
questions.qZh: 通常用于评估机器翻译模型的指标是哪一个？
o: F1 score
Accuracy
Mean Absolute Error (MAE)

BLEU score D BLEU (Bilingual Evaluation Understudy) is the standard automatic metric for evaluating machine translation quality. It measures n-gram precision — the overlap of contiguous word sequences (unigrams through typically 4-grams) between the model's translated output and one or more human reference translations — combined with a brevity penalty to discourage overly short translations that could otherwise achieve artificially high precision. BLEU scores range from 0 to 1 (or 0-100 as a percentage), with higher scores indicating closer alignment to reference translations. The distractors represent metrics standard to other task families: F1 score (A) evaluates classification tasks by balancing precision and recall over discrete positive/negative predictions, ill-suited to open-ended text generation where there is no fixed set of "correct" tokens. Accuracy (B) similarly assumes a discrete correct/incorrect judgment, inappropriate for translation where multiple valid phrasings can convey the same meaning. Mean Absolute Error (C) is a regression metric measuring average magnitude of numeric prediction error, irrelevant to text output evaluation entirely. It's worth noting BLEU has known limitations — it correlates imperfectly with human judgments of fluency and can penalize valid paraphrases — which has motivated complementary metrics like METEOR, ROUGE (more common for summarization), and learned metrics like BERTScore, though BLEU remains the benchmark most commonly referenced for translation specifically. [Reference: Core Machine Learning and AI Knowledge / Multimodal Data domains — task-specific evaluation metrics (BLEU for translation, WER for ASR, MOS for TTS)., ]
oZh: F1 分数
准确率
平均绝对误差（MAE）

BLEU 分数 D BLEU（Bilingual Evaluation Understudy）是评估机器翻译质量的标准自动指标。它衡量 n-gram 精度——模型翻译输出与一个或多个人工参考译文之间连续词序列（一元到通常的四元）的重合度——并结合 brevity penalty 来抑制过短的翻译，否则过短的翻译可能获得人为偏高的精度。BLEU 分数范围为 0 到 1（或以百分比表示为 0-100），分数越高表示与参考译文越吻合。干扰项都是其他任务族中的标准指标：F1 分数 (A) 通过在离散的正/负预测上平衡精确率与召回率来评估分类任务，不适用于开放式文本生成，因为其中并不存在固定的“正确”token 集合。准确率 (B) 同样假设存在离散的对/错判断，对于翻译并不合适，因为多种有效表述可以表达相同含义。平均绝对误差 (C) 是衡量预测数值误差平均幅度的回归指标，与文本输出的评估完全无关。值得一提的是，BLEU 存在已知局限——它与人工对流畅度的判断相关性并不完美，并且可能惩罚有效的改写——这促使人们采用 METEOR、ROUGE（在摘要任务中更常用）以及 BERTScore 这类学习式指标作为补充，但 BLEU 仍是翻译任务中最常被引用的基准。[参考：Core Machine Learning and AI Knowledge / Multimodal Data 领域——特定任务的评估指标（翻译用 BLEU，ASR 用 WER，TTS 用 MOS）。, ]

questions.q: In the context of multimodal machine learning, what does 'data fusion' refer to?
questions.qZh: 在多模态机器学习的语境下，“data fusion”（数据融合）指的是什么？
o: Separating different modalities of data into distinct representations.
Combining different modalities of data into a single representation.
Removing missing or incomplete information from different modalities.

Evaluating the quality of diverse data types in multimodal machine learning. B Data fusion is the process of combining information from multiple modalities into a single, unified representation that a downstream model can act on. As covered in the early-fusion and late-fusion questions elsewhere in this set, fusion can occur at different pipeline stages — raw/feature-level (early), intermediate representation level (hybrid), or decision level (late) — but in every case the defining operation is combination, not separation. Option A describes the inverse operation and does not correspond to any standard multimodal technique under the name "fusion." Option C describes missing-data handling or imputation, a data-quality concern that is often addressed *before* fusion (a model needs some representation for each modality, even an imputed or masked one, before combining them) but is not fusion itself. Option D describes evaluation or quality assessment, a distinct concern from the mechanical act of combining modalities into one representation. Fusion technique choice has real architectural consequences: early fusion assumes tight temporal/spatial correspondence between modalities and is sensitive to missing streams; late fusion is more robust to missing or noisy modalities since each unimodal branch can still contribute independently; hybrid/intermediate fusion, common in modern transformer-based multimodal architectures via cross-attention, aims to capture the benefits of both while mitigating each one's weaknesses. [Reference: Multimodal Data domain — data fusion as the combination operation across early/late/hybrid strategies., ]
oZh: 将不同模态的数据分离为各自独立的表示。
将不同模态的数据合并为单一表示。
从不同模态中移除缺失或不完整的信息。

评估多模态机器学习中多种数据类型的质量。 B 数据融合是将来自多个模态的信息合并为单一统一表示的过程，供下游模型使用。正如本套题中其他关于早期融合和后期融合的题目所涵盖的，融合可以发生在管线的不同阶段——原始/特征级（早期）、中间表示层（混合）或决策级（后期）——但在任何情况下，其定义性操作都是合并，而不是分离。选项 A 描述的是相反的操作，在“融合”这一名称下不对应任何标准的多模态技术。选项 C 描述的是缺失数据处理或插补，这是一个数据质量方面的关注点，通常在融合*之前*处理（模型需要为每种模态准备某种表示，即使是插补后的或被掩码的，然后才能进行合并），但它本身并不是融合。选项 D 描述的是评估或质量评估，与把多个模态机械地合并为单一表示是完全不同的关注点。融合技术的选择会带来实际的架构后果：早期融合假设各模态之间存在紧密的时间/空间对应关系，并且对缺失的数据流敏感；后期融合对模态缺失或噪声更鲁棒，因为每个单模态分支仍可独立贡献；混合/中间融合在现代基于 transformer 的多模态架构中通过 cross-attention 广泛使用，旨在同时获得两者的优势并缓解各自的弱点。[参考：Multimodal Data 领域——data fusion 作为 early/late/hybrid 各策略中的合并操作。, ]
questions.e: Data fusion is the process of combining information from multiple modalities into a single, unified representation that a downstream model can act on. As covered in the early-fusion and late-fusion questions elsewhere in this set, fusion can occur at different pipeline stages — raw/feature-level (early), intermediate representation level (hybrid), or decision level (late) — but in every case the defining operation is combination, not separation. Option A describes the inverse operation and does not correspond to any standard multimodal technique under the name "fusion." questions.eZh: 数据融合是将来自多个模态的信息合并为单一统一表示的过程，供下游模型使用。正如本套题中其他关于早期融合和后期融合的题目所涵盖的，融合可以发生在管线的不同阶段——原始/特征级（早期）、中间表示层（混合）或决策级（后期）——但在任何情况下，其定义性操作都是合并，而不是分离。选项 A 描述的是相反的操作，在“融合”这一名称下不对应任何标准的多模态技术。选项 C 描述的是缺失数据处理或插补，这是一个数据质量方面的关注点，通常在融合*之前*处理（模型需要为每种模态准备某种表示，即使是插补后的或被掩码的，然后才能进行合并），但它本身并不是融合。选项 D 描述的是评估或质量评估，与把多个模态机械地合并为单一表示是完全不同的关注点。融合技术的选择会带来实际的架构后果：早期融合假设各模态之间存在紧密的时间/空间对应关系，并且对缺失的数据流敏感；后期融合对模态缺失或噪声更鲁棒，因为每个单模态分支仍可独立贡献；混合/中间融合在现代基于 transformer 的多模态架构中通过 cross-attention 广泛使用，旨在同时获得两者的优势并缓解各自的弱点。[参考：Multimodal Data 领域——data fusion 作为 early/late/hybrid 各策略中的合并操作。, ]

questions.q: What is a main application of Triton Inference Server?
questions.qZh: Triton Inference Server 的一项主要应用是什么？
o: Triton Server can be used to generate images from pure noise.
Triton Server can be used to deploy AI models on the GPU only.
Triton Server can be used to execute GPU-accelerated graph analysis with cuGraph.

Triton Server can be used to deploy neural networks from various frameworks. D NVIDIA Triton Inference Server is an open-source model-serving platform designed to standardize production deployment across heterogeneous model formats and hardware backends. Its defining capability is multi-framework support: a single Triton instance can concurrently serve models trained in TensorFlow, PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, OpenVINO, and custom Python/C++ backends, exposing them through unified HTTP/REST and gRPC inference APIs. This eliminates the need for framework-specific serving stacks and lets teams standardize deployment infrastructure independent of how a given model was trained. Option B is a common but incorrect assumption — Triton explicitly supports both GPU and CPU inference, which matters for cost-sensitive or edge deployments where GPU availability is limited. Option C confuses Triton with cuGraph, a separate RAPIDS library for GPU-accelerated graph analytics (unrelated to model serving), and option A describes a generative task (denoising diffusion), which is a *model capability*, not a Triton *server* function — Triton can host such a model, but "generating images from noise" is not what the server itself does. Triton also provides dynamic batching, concurrent model execution, model ensembling (chaining pre/post-processing with inference), and metrics export — features tested elsewhere in the Software Development and Engineering and Performance Optimization domains. [Reference: Software Development and Engineering domain — Triton Inference Server, multi-framework model deployment., ]

questions.q: What is a common method to reduce the computational cost of deep learning models during inference?
questions.qZh: 在推理过程中降低深度学习模型计算开销的常见方法是什么？
o: Pruning weights or neurons.
Adding more convolutional filters.
By replacing activation functions in some neurons with simpler ones.

Increasing the batch size. A Pruning removes weights, neurons, or entire filters/channels that contribute minimally to model output — identified via magnitude-based criteria (removing near-zero weights), sensitivity analysis, or more sophisticated importance scoring — producing a smaller, sparser model that requires fewer computations and less memory at inference time while aiming to preserve accuracy through careful selection and, often, a fine-tuning step after pruning to recover any lost performance. Structured pruning (removing entire filters/channels) yields hardware-friendly speedups on standard accelerators, while unstructured pruning (removing individual weights) achieves higher sparsity ratios but requires specialized sparse-computation hardware or libraries to realize actual speed gains. The remaining options move in the wrong direction or address a different concern: adding more convolutional filters (B) increases model capacity and parameter count, which increases computational cost, the opposite of the stated goal. Increasing batch size (D) affects training throughput and memory usage per step but does not reduce the per-sample computational cost of inference — a larger batch does more total work, not less per inference call, and batch size at inference is often constrained by latency requirements rather than optimization goals. Option C's premise — selectively replacing activation functions with simpler ones in "some neurons" — is not a standard or well-defined optimization technique; activation function choice is typically uniform within a layer and driven by training dynamics, not a piecemeal inference-cost lever. [Reference: Performance Optimization domain — pruning, alongside quantization and kernel fusion, as core inference-cost reduction techniques., ]
oZh: 对权重或神经元进行剪枝。
增加更多的卷积滤波器。
将某些神经元的激活函数替换为更简单的函数。

增大批大小。 A 剪枝会移除对模型输出贡献极小的权重、神经元或整个滤波器/通道——这些通过基于幅值的标准（移除接近零的权重）、敏感性分析或更精细的重要性评分来识别——从而得到更小、更稀疏的模型，在推理时需要更少的计算和更少的内存，同时通过谨慎选择、并通常在剪枝后进行一次微调以恢复损失的性能，力求保持准确率。结构化剪枝（移除整个滤波器/通道）可在标准加速器上带来对硬件友好的加速；而非结构化剪枝（移除单个权重）能达到更高的稀疏率，但需要专用的稀疏计算硬件或库才能真正获得速度收益。其余选项方向错误或针对的是不同的关注点：增加更多卷积滤波器 (B) 会提升模型容量和参数量，从而增加计算开销，与既定目标相反。增大批大小 (D) 影响的是训练吞吐和每步的内存占用，但不会降低推理的单样本计算成本——更大的批次做的是更多总工作量，而不是每次推理调用更少；推理时的批大小往往受延迟要求约束，而非优化目标。选项 C 的前提——在“某些神经元”中选择性地把激活函数替换为更简单的函数——并不是标准或定义明确的优化技术；激活函数的选择通常在同一层内是统一的，并由训练动态决定，而不是一种零敲碎打的推理成本调节手段。[参考：Performance Optimization 领域——剪枝与量化、kernel fusion 并列，是降低推理成本的核心技术。, ]
