Score each pair with a pretrained CLIP model and filter out pairs below a similarity threshold
Increase the training batch size so noisy pairs average out
oZh: 丢弃所有图文对，改用非配对的对比学习训练
为数据集中的每张图片人工重新撰写描述
用预训练的 CLIP 模型为每个图文对打分，滤除低于相似度阈值的样本对
增大训练 batch size，让噪声样本对相互抵消
questions.e: CLIP-score filtering (used to curate datasets like LAION) removes low-similarity, noisy pairs before training, directly improving alignment signal quality. Why the others are wrong: - The data IS paired (image+caption); switching to unpaired training discards useful signal unnecessarily. - Manual re-captioning is not scalable for web-scale datasets and is not the standard curation approach. - Larger batch size improves negative sampling in contrastive loss but does not fix mismatched/noisy pairs. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: CLIP-score 过滤（用于整理 LAION 等数据集）会在训练前移除低相似度的噪声样本对，从而直接提升对齐信号的质量。其他选项为何错误：- 这些数据本身就是配对的（图片+描述）；改用非配对训练等于不必要地丢弃有用信号。- 人工重新撰写描述对于网络规模的数据集不可行，也不是标准的整理方式。- 更大的 batch size 能改善对比损失中的负样本采样，但无法修正图文不匹配/含噪的问题。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A vision-language model was trained using early fusion, concatenating raw image and text embeddings before any downstream layers. At deployment, some requests arrive with only an image and no text. What is the BEST fix?
questions.qZh: 某视觉语言模型采用早期融合（early fusion）训练，在任何下游层之前将原始图像嵌入与文本嵌入拼接在一起。部署时，有些请求只有图片而没有文本。最好的修复方式是什么？
o: No fix is needed; early-fused models degrade gracefully when a modality is missing
Switch to a late-fusion or gated-fusion architecture, or retrain with modality-dropout so the model learns to handle missing inputs
Retrain using only unimodal image data going forward
Pad the missing text input with random noise at inference only, without retraining
oZh: 无需修复；当某个模态缺失时，早期融合模型会优雅降级
改用后期融合（late-fusion）或门控融合（gated-fusion）架构，或使用 modality-dropout 重新训练，使模型学会处理缺失的输入
今后仅使用单模态图像数据重新训练
不做重训练，仅在推理阶段用随机噪声填充缺失的文本输入
questions.e: Early fusion is rigid to input structure; the correct fix is architectural (late/gated fusion) or training-based (modality dropout during training) so the model has learned robustness to missing modalities. Why the others are wrong: - Early fusion architectures typically break or produce degraded output when an expected input is absent — no fix means broken inference. - Dropping the other modality entirely discards useful multimodal capability rather than fixing the missing-modality problem. - Random noise padding at inference without training adaptation does not teach the model to handle the missing case and yields unreliable output. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 早期融合对输入结构非常僵硬；正确的修复方式是架构层面的（后期融合/门控融合）或训练层面的（训练时使用 modality dropout），让模型学会对模态缺失的鲁棒性。其他选项为何错误：- 当预期输入缺失时，早期融合架构通常会直接失败或输出严重退化——不做修复就意味着推理不可用。- 完全丢弃另一种模态会浪费有用的多模态能力，而不是解决模态缺失问题。- 推理时用随机噪声填充而不做训练适配，无法教会模型处理缺失情况，且输出不可靠。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A team has a small set of paired image-caption examples plus a large corpus of unpaired images and unpaired text. What is the BEST approach to build an image captioning model?
questions.qZh: 一个团队拥有一小部分配对的图文示例，以及大量非配对图像和非配对文本。构建图像描述模型的最佳方案是什么？
o: Discard the unpaired data since it cannot be directly used
Randomly match unpaired images with unpaired text to create synthetic pairs
Leverage a large pretrained vision-language model and fine-tune it on the small paired dataset
Train a captioning model from scratch using only the paired subset
oZh: 丢弃非配对数据，因为它无法直接使用
随机将非配对图像与非配对文本匹配，构造合成样本对
利用大型预训练视觉语言模型，并在这份小规模配对数据集上进行微调
仅使用配对子集从零开始训练描述模型
questions.e: Fine-tuning a pretrained multimodal model (which already learned alignment from large-scale paired/web data) on the limited paired set is the standard, data-efficient approach. Why the others are wrong: - Unpaired data can still be useful for unimodal pretraining or contrastive setups; discarding it wastes available signal. - Random matching creates false alignment signal and actively harms training. - Training from scratch on a small paired dataset is data-inefficient and will underperform fine-tuning a pretrained model.
questions.eZh: 在有限的配对数据上微调预训练多模态模型（该模型已从大规模配对/网络数据中学到了对齐关系），是标准且数据高效的做法。其他选项为何错误：- 非配对数据仍可用于单模态预训练或对比式训练，丢弃它是在浪费可用信号。- 随机匹配会制造错误的对齐信号，反而损害训练。- 在小规模配对数据集上从零训练数据效率低，效果会不及微调预训练模型。

questions.q: Which pipeline type is required to generate a photorealistic image from a text description such as 'a red bicycle on a beach'?
questions.qZh: 要从诸如“一辆红色自行车停在海滩上”这样的文本描述生成照片级逼真的图像，需要哪种类型的流水线？
o: Image-to-text
Speech-to-text
Text-to-text
Text-to-image
oZh: 图像到文本（Image-to-text）
语音到文本（Speech-to-text）
文本到文本（Text-to-text）
文本到图像（Text-to-image）
questions.e: Text-to-image pipelines (e.g., diffusion-based generators) take a text prompt as input and produce an image as output. Why the others are wrong: - Image-to-text is the reverse pipeline, producing captions/descriptions from images, not images from text. - Speech-to-text converts audio to text and has no image generation capability. - Text-to-text pipelines transform text into text (e.g., translation, summarization), not images.
questions.eZh: Text-to-image 流水线（例如基于扩散模型的生成器）以文本提示词为输入，输出图像。其他选项为何错误：- Image-to-text 是方向相反的流水线，它从图像生成标题/描述，而不是从文本生成图像。- Speech-to-text 将音频转换为文本，不具备图像生成能力。- Text-to-text 流水线把文本转换为文本（如翻译、摘要），而不是图像。

questions.q: Which task is a BLIP/BLIP-2-style model PRIMARILY designed for?
questions.qZh: BLIP/BLIP-2 风格的模型主要针对哪项任务设计？
o: Generating images from text prompts
Unpaired image-to-image domain translation
Audio classification
Image captioning and visual question answering (image-to-text)
oZh: 根据文本提示词生成图像
非配对的图像到图像域转换
音频分类
图像描述生成与视觉问答（image-to-text）
questions.e: BLIP/BLIP-2 architectures are vision-language models optimized for image-to-text tasks such as captioning and VQA. Why the others are wrong: - Text-to-image generation is handled by diffusion models (e.g., Stable Diffusion), not BLIP. - Unpaired image-to-image translation is the domain of GAN-based methods like CycleGAN, not BLIP. - BLIP is not designed for audio tasks; it operates on vision and text modalities.
questions.eZh: BLIP/BLIP-2 架构是针对图像描述、VQA 等 image-to-text 任务优化的视觉语言模型。其他选项为何错误：- 文生图由扩散模型（如 Stable Diffusion）完成，而不是 BLIP。- 非配对的图像到图像转换属于 CycleGAN 这类基于 GAN 的方法，而非 BLIP。- BLIP 并非为音频任务设计；它处理的是视觉和文本模态。

questions.q: In CLIP-style contrastive training, which hyperparameter directly controls the sharpness of the softmax distribution over image-text similarity scores, affecting how strongly negatives are penalized?
questions.qZh: 在 CLIP 风格的对比训练中，哪个超参数直接控制图像-文本相似度得分上 softmax 分布的锐度，从而影响负样本被惩罚的强度？
o: Learning rate
Number of training epochs
Temperature parameter
Dropout rate
oZh: 学习率
训练轮数
温度参数
Dropout 比率
questions.e: The temperature parameter scales the logits before the softmax in the InfoNCE loss, directly controlling how peaked or flat the similarity distribution is. Why the others are wrong: - Learning rate controls optimization step size, not the shape of the similarity distribution. - Epoch count affects how long training runs, not the softmax sharpness for a given batch. - Dropout rate affects regularization of network weights, unrelated to the contrastive similarity scaling. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 温度参数在 InfoNCE 损失中于 softmax 之前缩放 logits，直接控制相似度分布是尖锐还是平坦。其他选项为何错误：- 学习率控制优化步长，而不是相似度分布的形状。- 训练轮数影响训练时长，并不影响给定 batch 的 softmax 锐度。- Dropout 比率影响网络权重的正则化，与对比相似度的缩放无关。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A paired image-caption dataset includes captions like 'the cat is on the left side of the frame.' Which augmentation strategy risks breaking cross-modal alignment if applied without adjusting the caption?
questions.qZh: 某配对图文数据集中的描述形如“猫位于画面的左侧”。如果在不调整描述的情况下应用，哪种数据增强策略有破坏跨模态对齐的风险？
o: Synonym replacement in the caption text unrelated to spatial or visual content
Horizontal flip of the image without updating spatial references in the caption
Color jitter on the image for a caption that never references color
Adding light Gaussian noise to an unrelated audio channel
oZh: 在描述文本中做同义词替换，且替换内容与空间或视觉内容无关
对图像做水平翻转，但不更新描述中的空间方位表述
对图像做颜色抖动，而描述中从未提及颜色
向无关的音频通道加入轻微高斯噪声
questions.e: Horizontal flipping changes left/right spatial relationships in the image, but if the caption text is left unchanged, the caption becomes factually wrong for the flipped image, breaking the paired alignment. Why the others are wrong: - Synonym replacement not tied to spatial/visual specifics generally preserves meaning and alignment. - Color jitter is safe when the caption makes no color claims, since it doesn't contradict the text. - Noise on an unrelated audio channel has no bearing on image-caption alignment. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 水平翻转会改变图像中的左右空间关系，但若描述文本保持不变，该描述对翻转后的图像就变成了事实错误，从而破坏配对对齐关系。其他选项为何错误：- 与空间/视觉细节无关的同义词替换通常保留语义与对齐关系。- 当描述未做出颜色断言时，颜色抖动是安全的，因为它不与文本相矛盾。- 无关音频通道上的噪声与图文对齐无关。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which statement BEST describes the difference between paired and unpaired multimodal datasets?
questions.qZh: 哪项陈述最准确地描述了配对与非配对多模态数据集之间的区别？
o: Paired datasets contain explicit sample-level correspondence across modalities (e.g., an image with its matching caption); unpaired datasets contain samples from each modality with no such explicit correspondence
Paired datasets always come from different data distributions; unpaired datasets always share one distribution
Paired datasets are always synthetic while unpaired datasets are always collected from the real world
Paired datasets can only be used with GAN architectures, while unpaired datasets can only be used with diffusion models
oZh: 配对数据集在模态之间包含显式的样本级对应关系（例如一张图片及其匹配的描述）；非配对数据集包含各模态的样本，但不存在这种显式对应关系
配对数据集总是来自不同的数据分布；非配对数据集总是共享同一个分布
配对数据集总是合成的，而非配对数据集总是从真实世界采集的
配对数据集只能与 GAN 架构配合使用，而非配对数据集只能与扩散模型配合使用
questions.e: The defining distinction is sample-level correspondence: paired data has a known matching relationship between modality instances, unpaired data does not. Why the others are wrong: - Distribution source is unrelated to the pairing concept; both paired and unpaired sets can come from same or different distributions. - Neither pairing status determines whether data is synthetic or real-world. - Architecture choice (GAN vs diffusion) is independent of whether the underlying data is paired or unpaired; e.g., CycleGAN is specifically designed for unpaired data.
questions.eZh: 本质区别在于样本级对应关系：配对数据具有已知的模态实例匹配关系，非配对数据则没有。其他选项为何错误：- 数据来源的分布与配对概念无关；配对和非配对数据集都可能来自相同或不同的分布。- 配对状态既不决定数据是合成的还是真实采集的。- 架构选择（GAN 与扩散模型）与底层数据是否配对无关；例如 CycleGAN 正是为非配对数据设计的。

questions.q: A team deploys a multimodal (image+text) model behind Triton Inference Server. Clients send single-image requests at unpredictable rates, and the SLA requires 95th-percentile latency under 100ms while maximizing GPU throughput. Which configuration change BEST achieves this?
questions.qZh: 一个团队在 Triton Inference Server 后面部署了一个多模态（图像+文本）模型。客户端以不可预测的速率发送单图像请求，SLA 要求 95 分位延迟低于 100ms，同时最大化 GPU 吞吐。哪种配置改动最能达成这一目标？
o: Set max batch size to 1 and disable batching entirely
Set instance group count to 1 and remove GPU allocation
Enable dynamic batching with a small max queue delay microseconds value (e.g., 2000-5000)
Increase max batch size to 512 with no queue delay limit
oZh: 将 max batch size 设为 1 并完全禁用批处理
将 instance group 数量设为 1 并移除 GPU 分配
启用动态批处理，并设置较小的 max queue delay microseconds 值（如 2000-5000）
将 max batch size 增大到 512，且不限制队列延迟
questions.e: Dynamic batching with a small queue delay lets Triton opportunistically combine incoming single requests into small batches, improving GPU utilization while the short delay keeps latency near the SLA target. Why the others are wrong: - Disabling batching wastes GPU throughput since each request runs alone - Reducing instance group to 1 and removing GPU allocation reduces concurrency and hurts both latency and throughput - A very large batch size with no delay cap can cause requests to wait too long or run oversized batches, blowing the latency SLA ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 动态批处理配合较小的队列延迟，可让 Triton 机会性地把陆续到达的单请求合并成小批次，在提升 GPU 利用率的同时把延迟保持在接近 SLA 目标水平。其他选项为何错误：- 禁用批处理会让每个请求单独执行，浪费 GPU 吞吐。- 将 instance group 减至 1 并移除 GPU 分配会降低并发能力，延迟和吞吐都会受损。- 极大的 batch size 且不设延迟上限，可能导致请求等待过久或批次过大，从而突破延迟 SLA。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which NVIDIA product is purpose-built to serve trained models from multiple frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, TensorRT) through a single standardized inference API?
questions.qZh: 哪款 NVIDIA 产品是专门打造，用于通过单一标准化的推理 API 提供来自多种框架（PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX、TensorRT）的已训练模型服务？
o: NVIDIA NGC Catalog
NVIDIA cuDNN
NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
NVIDIA DALI
oZh: NVIDIA NGC Catalog
NVIDIA cuDNN
NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
NVIDIA DALI
questions.e: Triton Inference Server is the multi-framework model serving platform providing HTTP/gRPC APIs, dynamic batching, and concurrent model execution. Why the others are wrong: - NGC Catalog is the repository of container images and models, not a serving runtime itself - cuDNN is a low-level deep learning primitives library, not an inference server - DALI is a data loading/augmentation library, not a model server
questions.eZh: Triton Inference Server 是多框架模型服务平台，提供 HTTP/gRPC API、动态批处理以及模型并发执行。其他选项为何错误：- NGC Catalog 是容器镜像和模型的仓库，本身不是服务运行时。- cuDNN 是底层深度学习算子库，不是推理服务器。- DALI 是数据加载/增强库，不是模型服务器。

questions.q: An engineering team wants deployments to behave identically across dev, staging, and production, avoiding dependency drift caused by 'works on my machine' issues. Which approach BEST ensures this?
questions.qZh: 某工程团队希望各环境的部署表现完全一致，避免因“在我机器上能跑（works on my machine）”类问题导致的依赖漂移。哪种做法最能保证这一点？
o: Pull the ':latest' tag of any NGC container each time and install packages ad hoc on each host
Pin an exact NGC container tag, freeze dependency versions in requirements.txt/environment.yml, and version the Dockerfile in Git
Manually document the setup steps in a wiki page for each environment
Install frameworks directly on bare-metal hosts without containers to reduce overhead
oZh: 每次拉取任意 NGC 容器的 ':latest' 标签，并在每台主机上临时安装软件包
锁定精确的 NGC 容器标签，在 requirements.txt/environment.yml 中冻结依赖版本，并在 Git 中对 Dockerfile 进行版本管理
为每个环境在 wiki 页面上手动记录安装步骤
不使用容器，直接在裸机主机上安装框架以减少开销
questions.e: Pinning exact container tags and dependency versions, combined with version-controlled Dockerfiles, guarantees reproducible builds across environments. Why the others are wrong: - ':latest' tags change over time and break reproducibility - Wiki documentation is not enforced by tooling and drifts from actual system state - Bare-metal installs without containers reintroduce environment inconsistency across machines ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 锁定精确的容器标签与依赖版本，并结合版本控制下的 Dockerfile，可保证跨环境可复现的构建。其他选项为何错误：- ':latest' 标签会随时间变化，破坏可复现性。- wiki 文档不由工具强制执行，会与系统实际状态发生偏离。- 不使用容器的裸机安装会让不同机器之间重新出现环境不一致。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: In a Triton model's config.pbtxt file, which field defines the maximum number of inference requests that can be combined into a single batch for that model?
questions.qZh: 在 Triton 模型的 config.pbtxt 文件中，哪个字段定义了该模型可合并到单个批次中的最大推理请求数？
o: max batch size
instance group
max queue delay microseconds
preferred batch size
oZh: max batch size
instance group
max queue delay microseconds
preferred batch size
questions.e: max batch size sets the upper limit on how many requests Triton can combine into one batch for that model. Why the others are wrong: - instance group controls how many concurrent model instances run, not batch size limits - max queue delay microseconds controls how long Triton waits to fill a batch, not the size cap - preferred batch size is a hint for target batch sizes within dynamic batching, not the hard maximum ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: max batch size 限定了 Triton 为该模型合并到同一批次中的请求数量上限。其他选项为何错误：- instance group 控制并发运行的模型实例数量，而不是批大小上限。- max queue delay microseconds 控制 Triton 等待凑满批次的时间，而不是大小上限。- preferred batch size 是动态批处理中目标批大小的提示值，而非硬性上限。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: What is the primary reason to use a container from the NGC catalog instead of building a custom container from scratch for GPU-based multimodal model deployment?
questions.qZh: 在面向 GPU 的多模态模型部署中，使用 NGC 目录中的容器而不是从零开始构建自定义容器的主要原因是什么？
o: NGC containers automatically retrain models for you
NGC containers eliminate the need for a model repository
NGC containers are pre-built and validated with matched CUDA, cuDNN, and framework versions optimized for NVIDIA GPUs
NGC containers require no Docker runtime to execute
oZh: NGC 容器会自动为你重新训练模型
NGC 容器消除了对模型仓库的需求
NGC 容器是预先构建并经过验证的，CUDA、cuDNN 与框架版本相互匹配，并针对 NVIDIA GPU 做了优化
NGC 容器运行时不需要 Docker 运行时
questions.e: NGC containers ship pre-tested, version-aligned GPU driver/library stacks (CUDA, cuDNN, frameworks) so teams avoid manual dependency compatibility work. Why the others are wrong: - NGC containers only provide runtime environments; they do not perform training automatically - A model repository is still required by Triton regardless of container source - NGC containers are still Docker images and require a container runtime to run
questions.eZh: NGC 容器随附经过预测试、版本对齐的 GPU 驱动/库栈（CUDA、cuDNN、各框架），因此团队无需手工处理依赖兼容性问题。其他选项为何错误：- NGC 容器只提供运行时环境，并不会自动执行训练 - 无论容器来自何处，Triton 仍然需要模型仓库 - NGC 容器仍然是 Docker 镜像，运行时需要容器运行时

questions.q: A generative text service needs to serve variable-length outputs to many concurrent users while keeping streaming latency low. Which Triton configuration combination BEST supports this scenario?
questions.qZh: 一个生成式文本服务需要为大量并发用户提供长度不定的输出，同时保持流式传输的低延迟。哪一种 Triton 配置组合最契合这一场景？
o: A single instance group with max batch size 1 and dynamic batching disabled
Only increasing max batch size without adjusting instance group or queue delay
Running the model directly in a Python script without Triton
dynamic batching with a short max queue delay microseconds plus multiple instance group entries for concurrency
oZh: 单个实例组，max batch size 为 1，并禁用动态批处理
仅增大 max batch size，而不调整实例组或队列延迟
不使用 Triton，直接在 Python 脚本中运行模型
采用动态批处理并设置较短的 max queue delay（微秒级），同时配置多个实例组条目以提升并发
questions.e: Combining short-delay dynamic batching with multiple model instances lets Triton batch efficiently while running concurrent instances to keep per-request latency low under load. Why the others are wrong: - Disabling batching with a single instance forces one request at a time, hurting throughput under concurrent load - Raising max batch size alone without instance concurrency can increase queueing latency - Bypassing Triton loses batching, concurrency management, and standardized serving APIs ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 将短延迟动态批处理与多个模型实例结合，可以让 Triton 高效地组批，同时通过并发运行的实例在负载下保持较低的单请求延迟。其他选项为何错误：- 禁用批处理并只使用单个实例，会强制逐个处理请求，在并发负载下损害吞吐 - 只增大 max batch size 而没有实例并发，反而可能增加排队延迟 - 绕过 Triton 会失去批处理、并发管理以及标准化的服务 API ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A data scientist wants to quickly prototype a pretrained multimodal captioning model with minimal code before considering production deployment. Which tool is BEST suited for this initial step?
questions.qZh: 一位数据科学家希望在考虑生产部署之前，用尽量少的代码快速原型验证一个预训练的多模态图像描述模型。哪个工具最适合这一初始步骤？
o: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server with a custom Python backend
A hand-written CUDA kernel
Hugging Face pipeline() API
NGC container orchestration via Kubernetes
oZh: 搭配自定义 Python backend 的 NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
手写的 CUDA kernel
Hugging Face pipeline() API
通过 Kubernetes 进行 NGC 容器编排
questions.e: Hugging Face's pipeline() API wraps tokenizer, model, and post-processing in a few lines of code, ideal for rapid prototyping before production hardening. Why the others are wrong: - Triton is a production serving platform, overkill and more complex for a quick prototype - Writing raw CUDA kernels is unnecessary and far too low-level for prototyping a pretrained model - Kubernetes orchestration addresses deployment scale, not rapid experimentation
questions.eZh: Hugging Face 的 pipeline() API 用几行代码就把 tokenizer、模型和后处理封装起来，非常适合在面向生产加固之前快速做原型验证。其他选项为何错误：- Triton 是生产级服务平台，对快速原型而言过于复杂且大材小用 - 为预训练模型编写原始 CUDA kernel 并无必要，层次也过低 - Kubernetes 编排解决的是部署规模问题，而非快速实验

questions.q: Which Triton Inference Server feature allows multiple copies of the same model to execute concurrently, either on the same GPU or across multiple GPUs?
questions.qZh: Triton Inference Server 的哪项特性允许同一模型的多个副本并发执行，既可以在同一块 GPU 上，也可以在多块 GPU 上？
o: dynamic batching
instance group
ensemble scheduling
model warmup
oZh: 动态批处理（dynamic batching）
实例组（instance group）
集调度（ensemble scheduling）
模型预热（model warmup）
questions.e: instance group defines how many concurrent instances of a model run and on which devices (KIND GPU/KIND CPU), enabling parallel execution beyond batching. Why the others are wrong: - dynamic batching groups requests into batches but does not create multiple concurrent model copies - Ensemble scheduling chains multiple different models/steps into a pipeline, not concurrency of one model - Model warmup pre-loads sample requests at startup to avoid cold-start latency, unrelated to concurrency count ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 实例组定义一个模型要运行多少个并发实例以及运行在哪些设备上（KIND GPU/KIND CPU），从而实现超越批处理的并行执行。其他选项为何错误：- 动态批处理把请求组成批次，但不会创建多个并发的模型副本 - 集调度把多个不同的模型/步骤串联成流水线，而非同一模型的并发 - 模型预热在启动时预先加载样本请求以避免冷启动延迟，与并发数量无关 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A team plots training loss and validation loss over 50 epochs. Training loss steadily decreases to near zero, while validation loss decreases until epoch 15, then steadily increases for the remaining epochs. What does this pattern indicate?
questions.qZh: 某团队绘制了 50 个 epoch 的训练损失与验证损失曲线。训练损失持续下降至接近 0，而验证损失下降到第 15 个 epoch 后，在其余 epoch 中持续上升。这一模式说明什么？
o: The model is underfitting and needs more capacity
The learning rate is too low and training should continue longer
The validation set is mislabeled and should be discarded
The model is overfitting after epoch 15 and should use early stopping around that point
oZh: 模型欠拟合，需要更大的模型容量
学习率太低，训练应继续更长时间
验证集标注有误，应当丢弃
模型在第 15 个 epoch 之后出现过拟合，应在该位置附近使用早停
questions.e: A diverging gap where training loss keeps dropping but validation loss rises is the textbook overfitting signature — the model is memorizing training data rather than generalizing. Early stopping at the validation loss minimum (epoch 15) is the standard remedy. Why the others are wrong: - Underfitting shows both training and validation loss staying high/flat, not a diverging gap - Increasing epochs would worsen overfitting further, not fix it — the curve already shows the model has converged on training data - A rising validation loss with falling training loss is a training dynamic issue, not evidence of label corruption
questions.eZh: 训练损失持续下降而验证损失上升、两者差距不断拉大，是典型的过拟合特征——模型在记忆训练数据而非泛化。在验证损失最小处（第 15 个 epoch）做早停是标准的补救手段。其他选项为何错误：- 欠拟合表现为训练和验证损失都高且平坦，而不是差距扩大 - 增加 epoch 数只会让过拟合更严重，无法解决问题——曲线已经表明模型在训练数据上已收敛 - 验证损失上升而训练损失下降属于训练动态问题，并不能说明标签被污染

questions.q: You generate a t-SNE plot of sentence embeddings from a multimodal foundation model and see several well-separated, tight clusters with large empty gaps between them, plus some points scattered far from any cluster. Which conclusion is MOST justified from this plot alone?
questions.qZh: 你为一个多模态基础模型的句子嵌入生成了 t-SNE 图，看到若干分离良好且紧凑的簇，簇之间存在大片空白间隙，另外还有一些点散布在远离任何簇的位置。仅凭这张图，最有依据的结论是什么？
o: The absolute distances between clusters represent true semantic distance between concepts
The scattered points are certainly mislabeled data and should be removed from the dataset
t-SNE has failed because clusters should always be evenly spaced in a valid embedding space
The clusters likely correspond to semantically distinct groups, but exact inter-cluster distances and gap sizes should not be interpreted literally
oZh: 簇之间的绝对距离代表概念之间真实的语义距离
那些离群的点一定是标注错误的数据，应当从数据集中剔除
t-SNE 已经失败，因为在有效的嵌入空间中簇应当总是均匀分布
这些簇很可能对应语义上不同的分组，但簇间距离和间隙大小的确切数值不应被字面解读
questions.e: t-SNE preserves local neighborhood structure well but distorts global distances and cluster sizes/gaps — this is a core exam gotcha. Clusters are meaningful for grouping, but you cannot read quantitative distance or density from the plot. Why the others are wrong: - t-SNE explicitly does NOT preserve global distances — reading literal distance between clusters is the classic misinterpretation the exam tests - Outlying points may just be low-density regions of the true manifold or rare-but-valid examples; the plot alone can't confirm mislabeling - Uneven spacing is expected behavior of t-SNE (it exaggerates cluster separation), not a sign of failure ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: t-SNE 能很好地保持局部邻域结构，但会扭曲全局距离以及簇的大小/间距——这是考试中的核心陷阱。簇在分组层面是有意义的，但你无法从图上读出定量的距离或密度。其他选项为何错误：- t-SNE 明确不保持全局距离——把簇间距离字面化正是考试要考的经典误读 - 离群点可能只是真实流形上的低密度区域，或是少见但有效的样本；仅凭该图无法确认标注错误 - 间距不均是 t-SNE 的预期行为（它会夸大簇的分离度），并非失败的迹象 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An engineer inspects a bar chart of class counts in a multimodal dataset and finds 92% of image-text pairs belong to one category, with the remaining 8% spread across nine other categories. During model evaluation, accuracy is 91% but per-class recall for minority categories is near 0%. What is the correct diagnosis?
questions.qZh: 一位工程师查看了某多模态数据集中各类别样本数量的柱状图，发现 92% 的图文对属于单一类别，其余 8% 分散在另外九个类别中。模型评估时准确率为 91%，但少数类别的按类召回率接近 0。正确的诊断是什么？
o: The dataset exhibits severe class imbalance, and accuracy is a misleading metric here — per-class metrics like recall/F1 or a confusion matrix should be used instead
The model is performing well since overall accuracy is high
The evaluation metric plot must contain a bug because accuracy and recall should always match
The model needs a larger batch size to fix the recall problem
oZh: 数据集存在严重的类别不平衡，此处准确率是具有误导性的指标——应改用召回率/F1 等按类指标或混淆矩阵
由于整体准确率高，模型表现良好
评估指标图一定存在 bug，因为准确率与召回率应当始终一致
模型需要更大的 batch size 来解决召回率问题
questions.e: When one class dominates, a model predicting the majority class every time achieves high accuracy while completely failing minority classes — this is the classic imbalance trap the exam tests, requiring recall/F1/confusion-matrix analysis instead of raw accuracy. Why the others are wrong: - High accuracy under severe imbalance is precisely the deceptive scenario the exam wants you to catch, not a sign of good performance - Accuracy and recall diverging under imbalance is expected mathematics, not a bug - Batch size is a training hyperparameter unrelated to a metric-choice/imbalance diagnostic issue ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 当某一类别占主导时，一个始终预测多数类的模型就能取得高准确率，同时在少数类上完全失败——这正是考试要考的经典不平衡陷阱，需要用召回率/F1/混淆矩阵来分析，而非原始准确率。其他选项为何错误：- 严重不平衡下高准确率恰恰是考试想让你识破的迷惑性场景，并非表现良好的标志 - 不平衡下准确率与召回率出现分歧属于预期的数学结果，不是 bug - batch size 是训练超参数，与指标选择/不平衡诊断问题无关 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: You need to diagnose whether a multimodal generative model's outputs are converging to good quality DURING training, epoch by epoch, using a single continuous visualization. Which plot is BEST suited for this task?
questions.qZh: 你需要用单一的连续可视化图表，逐 epoch 判断多模态生成模型的输出在训练过程中是否正在收敛到良好质量。哪种图表最适合这一任务？
o: A training and validation loss curve plotted across epochs
A t-SNE scatter plot of final embeddings
A confusion matrix from the final checkpoint
A bar chart of class distribution in the training set
oZh: 按 epoch 绘制的训练损失与验证损失曲线
最终嵌入的 t-SNE 散点图
来自最终 checkpoint 的混淆矩阵
训练集类别分布柱状图
questions.e: Loss curves across epochs are the standard plot for tracking convergence and generalization behavior over the course of training — exactly what's needed to monitor epoch-by-epoch progress. Why the others are wrong: - t-SNE plots a static embedding snapshot, not training progression over time - A confusion matrix evaluates classification performance at one point in time, not convergence dynamics - A class distribution bar chart describes the dataset, not training dynamics
questions.eZh: 按 epoch 绘制的损失曲线是追踪训练过程中收敛与泛化行为的标准图表——正好满足逐 epoch 监控训练进展的需要。其他选项为何错误：- t-SNE 图呈现的是静态的嵌入快照，而非随时间推进的训练过程 - 混淆矩阵评估的是某一时间点的分类性能，而非收敛动态 - 类别分布柱状图描述的是数据集，而非训练动态

questions.q: A practitioner must visualize 50,000 high-dimensional embeddings and needs the visualization to better preserve both local neighborhood relationships AND some global structure, while also running significantly faster than pairwise-similarity-based methods on large datasets. Which technique is the BEST choice?
questions.qZh: 某从业者需要可视化 50,000 个高维嵌入，希望可视化结果既能更好地保留局部邻域关系、又能保留部分全局结构，同时在大数据集上的运行速度显著快于基于成对相似度的方法。哪种技术是最佳选择？
o: t-SNE with default perplexity of 30
PCA reduced to 2 components only
UMAP
A raw scatter plot of the first two feature dimensions
oZh: 使用默认 perplexity 为 30 的 t-SNE
仅降维到 2 个主成分的 PCA
UMAP
直接绘制前两个特征维度的原始散点图
questions.e: UMAP is built on a graph-based approach that scales better computationally than t-SNE on large datasets and generally preserves more of the global structure alongside local structure — a key exam differentiator between the two techniques. Why the others are wrong: - t-SNE preserves local structure well but is computationally heavier at scale and preserves less global structure than UMAP - PCA is linear and preserves global variance but often fails to reveal nonlinear local cluster structure in embeddings - Raw first-two-dimension scatter plots discard almost all information in high-dimensional embeddings and are not a valid dimensionality-reduction technique
questions.eZh: UMAP 基于图方法，在大数据集上的计算扩展性优于 t-SNE，且通常在保留局部结构的同时保留更多全局结构——这是两者之间关键的考试区分点。其他选项为何错误：- t-SNE 能很好地保留局部结构，但在大规模下计算负担更重，且保留的全局结构少于 UMAP - PCA 是线性的，能保留全局方差，但往往无法揭示嵌入中的非线性局部簇结构 - 直接绘制前两维的散点图会丢弃高维嵌入中几乎全部信息，并不是有效的降维技术

questions.q: In a t-SNE visualization, what does the 'perplexity' hyperparameter primarily control?
questions.qZh: 在 t-SNE 可视化中，'perplexity' 这个超参数主要控制什么？
o: The final number of dimensions in the output plot
The effective number of nearest neighbors considered when balancing local vs. broader structure
The learning rate used during model training
The total runtime of the training job, independent of dataset size
oZh: 输出图中最终的维度数量
在平衡局部结构与更宏观结构时所考虑的有效最近邻数量
模型训练过程中使用的学习率
训练作业的总运行时间，与数据集大小无关
questions.e: Perplexity controls the effective neighborhood size t-SNE considers for each point; low values emphasize very local structure, high values emphasize broader structure. Typical exam-tested range is roughly 5–50. Why the others are wrong: - Output dimensionality is a separate parameter (n components), not perplexity - Perplexity is a t-SNE visualization parameter, not a model training learning rate - Perplexity affects computation but is not a direct measure of total runtime independent of other factors ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: perplexity 控制 t-SNE 为每个点考虑的有效邻域规模；取值偏小会强调非常局部的结构，取值偏大会强调更宏观的结构。考试常考范围大致为 5–50。其他选项为何错误：- 输出维度是另一个独立参数（n components），而不是 perplexity - perplexity 是 t-SNE 可视化参数，并非模型训练的学习率 - perplexity 会影响计算量，但它并不是独立于其他因素的总运行时间的直接度量 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: When configuring UMAP for embedding visualization, increasing the 'n neighbors' parameter to a much larger value will MOST likely have which effect?
questions.qZh: 在配置 UMAP 进行嵌入可视化时，将 'n_neighbors' 参数大幅增大，最可能产生什么效果？
o: The plot will emphasize more global structure, producing smoother, more continuous layouts with fewer sharply separated small clusters
The plot will emphasize very fine local structure and produce many small tight clusters
The embedding dimensionality will increase automatically
It has no effect on the resulting visualization
oZh: 图形会更强调全局结构，布局更平滑、更连续，明显分离的小簇更少
图形会更强调非常精细的局部结构，产生许多紧密的小簇
嵌入维度会自动增加
对最终的可视化结果没有影响
questions.e: n neighbors in UMAP is directly analogous to perplexity in t-SNE: larger values make UMAP consider a wider neighborhood, favoring global structure preservation over fine local detail — a frequently tested configuration behavior. Why the others are wrong: - Small n neighbors values, not large ones, produce fine-grained fragmented local clusters - n neighbors controls neighborhood graph construction, not output dimensionality (that's n components) - n neighbors is one of UMAP's most influential hyperparameters and clearly changes the resulting layout ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: UMAP 中的 n_neighbors 与 t-SNE 中的 perplexity 直接对应：取值越大，UMAP 考虑的邻域越宽，越倾向于保留全局结构而非精细的局部细节——这是常考的配置行为。其他选项为何错误：- 产生细粒度碎片化局部簇的是较小的 n_neighbors 取值，而不是较大的取值 - n_neighbors 控制的是邻域图的构建，而非输出维度（后者是 n components） - n_neighbors 是 UMAP 中影响最大的超参数之一，显然会改变最终布局 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which statement correctly differentiates t-SNE from UMAP for the exam's purposes?
questions.qZh: 就考试目的而言，哪一陈述正确区分了 t-SNE 与 UMAP？
o: t-SNE and UMAP are mathematically identical algorithms with only different default color schemes
UMAP can only be used for text embeddings, while t-SNE is exclusive to image embeddings
t-SNE always produces deterministic, reproducible plots while UMAP is always non-deterministic

t-SNE preserves local structure well but distorts global relative distances/cluster sizes; UMAP tends to preserve local structure while retaining more global structure and scaling better to large datasets
oZh: t-SNE 与 UMAP 在数学上是完全相同的算法，只是默认配色方案不同
UMAP 只能用于文本嵌入，而 t-SNE 专用于图像嵌入
t-SNE 总是产生确定性的、可复现的图形，而 UMAP 总是非确定性的
t-SNE 能很好地保留局部结构，但会扭曲全局相对距离/簇的大小；UMAP 在保留局部结构的同时通常还能保留更多全局结构，且在大型数据集上扩展性更好
questions.e: This is the core conceptual comparison tested: both are nonlinear dimensionality reduction techniques for visualization, but UMAP generally preserves more global structure and scales more efficiently, while t-SNE is stronger only on strictly local neighborhood preservation. Why the others are wrong: - The two algorithms use different underlying mathematical foundations (SNE/KL-divergence vs. fuzzy topological/graph-based methods) - Both techniques are modality-agnostic and work on any high-dimensional embedding vectors regardless of source modality - Both algorithms involve stochastic elements (random initialization, optimization) and are not guaranteed deterministic by default without fixed seeds
questions.eZh: 这是考试所考的核心概念对比：两者都是用于可视化的非线性降维技术，但 UMAP 通常保留更多全局结构、扩展效率更高，而 t-SNE 只在严格保持局部邻域结构方面更强。其他选项为何错误：- 两种算法采用的底层数学基础不同（SNE/KL 散度 vs. 模糊拓扑/图方法） - 两种技术与模态无关，可用于任意来源模态的高维嵌入向量 - 两种算法都包含随机性要素（随机初始化、优化过程），在不固定随机种子的情况下默认都不保证确定性

questions.q: A team has a fully trained FP32 LLM and needs to deploy it on NVIDIA GPUs with minimal latency and memory footprint, leveraging layer fusion and kernel auto-tuning. Which approach BEST meets these requirements?
questions.qZh: 某团队拥有一个训练完成的 FP32 大语言模型，需要将其部署到 NVIDIA GPU 上，在利用层融合和 kernel 自动调优的同时实现最低的延迟和内存占用。哪种方案最符合这些要求？
o: Convert the model to BF16 only and deploy with standard PyTorch eager mode
Retrain the model from scratch in FP16 and deploy with a generic unoptimized ONNX runtime
Apply knowledge distillation only and keep FP32 precision for inference
Quantize the model to INT8 with a calibration dataset and deploy using TensorRT
oZh: 仅将模型转换为 BF16，并使用标准 PyTorch eager 模式部署
用 FP16 从零重新训练模型，并使用通用且未优化的 ONNX runtime 部署
仅应用知识蒸馏，并保持 FP32 精度进行推理
使用校准数据集将模型量化为 INT8，并使用 TensorRT 部署
questions.e: TensorRT performs layer fusion, kernel auto-tuning, and precision calibration; combined with INT8 quantization (using a calibration dataset to preserve accuracy), this gives the lowest latency and memory footprint. Why the others are wrong: - BF16 in eager mode skips TensorRT's graph-level optimizations (fusion, kernel tuning), leaving significant performance on the table. - Retraining from scratch is unnecessary and wasteful when the model is already trained; a generic ONNX runtime also lacks TensorRT's fusion/tuning. - Distillation changes model size/architecture but does nothing for inference-time kernel optimization, and FP32 has the largest memory footprint of the options.
questions.eZh: TensorRT 会执行层融合、kernel 自动调优和精度校准；结合 INT8 量化（用校准数据集保持精度），可获得最低的延迟和内存占用。其他选项为何错误：- BF16 配合 eager 模式会跳过 TensorRT 的图级优化（融合、kernel 调优），性能上损失明显 - 在模型已训练好的情况下从零重新训练既无必要又浪费资源；通用 ONNX runtime 也缺乏 TensorRT 的融合/调优能力 - 蒸馏改变的是模型规模/架构，对推理时的 kernel 优化毫无帮助，而 FP32 在这些选项中内存占用最大

questions.q: Which NVIDIA tool is purpose-built to optimize a trained deep learning model for GPU inference through layer fusion, kernel auto-tuning, and precision calibration?
questions.qZh: 哪款 NVIDIA 工具专门用于通过层融合、kernel 自动调优和精度校准，来优化已训练好的深度学习模型以进行 GPU 推理？
o: cuDNN
NCCL
cuBLAS
TensorRT
oZh: cuDNN
NCCL
cuBLAS
TensorRT
questions.e: TensorRT is NVIDIA's inference optimization SDK that builds an optimized runtime engine via layer fusion, kernel auto-tuning, and precision calibration (FP16/INT8/FP8). Why the others are wrong: - cuDNN is a lower-level primitive library for deep learning operations (convolutions, etc.), not a model-level inference optimizer. - NCCL handles multi-GPU/multi-node communication for distributed training, unrelated to inference graph optimization. - cuBLAS provides GPU-accelerated linear algebra routines, not model-level fusion or calibration.
questions.eZh: TensorRT 是 NVIDIA 的推理优化 SDK，通过层融合、kernel 自动调优和精度校准（FP16/INT8/FP8）构建优化后的运行时引擎。其他选项为何错误：- cuDNN 是面向深度学习运算（卷积等）的底层算子库，不是模型级推理优化器 - NCCL 负责分布式训练中的多 GPU/多节点通信，与推理图优化无关 - cuBLAS 提供 GPU 加速的线性代数例程，不提供模型级融合或校准

questions.q: During mixed precision training on an A100 GPU using FP16, the training loss becomes NaN due to gradient underflow. Which configuration change most directly addresses this while still using FP16?
questions.qZh: 在 A100 GPU 上使用 FP16 进行混合精度训练时，由于梯度下溢，训练损失变为 NaN。在仍然使用 FP16 的前提下，哪项配置调整最直接地解决了这一问题？
o: Switch to BF16 without any loss scaling
Enable dynamic loss scaling while continuing to train in FP16
Reduce the batch size to 1
Switch all weights and activations to INT8
oZh: 切换到 BF16，不使用任何 loss scaling
启用动态 loss scaling，同时继续以 FP16 训练
将 batch size 减小到 1
将所有权重和激活值切换为 INT8
questions.e: Loss scaling multiplies the loss before backpropagation so small gradients don't underflow to zero in FP16's narrow dynamic range, then unscales before the optimizer step — this is the standard FP16 fix. Why the others are wrong: - Switching to BF16 also solves the dynamic-range problem, but the question specifies continuing to use FP16, so this doesn't answer the constraint. - Reducing batch size affects statistical gradient estimates and memory usage but does not fix numerical underflow caused by FP16's limited exponent range. - INT8 is used for inference quantization, not training, and would make gradient-based training far less stable, not more. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: loss scaling 会在反向传播前放大损失，使很小的梯度不会在 FP16 较窄的动态范围内下溢为 0，并在优化器更新前再缩放回来——这是 FP16 的标准修复方案。其他选项为何错误：- 切换到 BF16 同样能解决动态范围问题，但题目要求继续使用 FP16，因此不满足该约束 - 减小 batch size 会影响梯度估计的统计性和内存占用，但无法修复 FP16 指数范围有限导致的数值下溢 - INT8 用于推理量化而非训练，而且会让基于梯度的训练远不如原来稳定 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: What is the key conceptual difference between model quantization and knowledge distillation as memory-optimization techniques?
questions.qZh: 作为内存优化技术，模型量化与知识蒸馏之间的关键概念差异是什么？
o: Quantization always requires full retraining while distillation never requires any training
Distillation reduces numerical precision while quantization changes the model's architecture
Quantization reduces the numerical precision of weights/activations; distillation trains a smaller student model to mimic a larger teacher model's outputs
They are interchangeable terms for the same optimization technique
oZh: 量化总是需要完全重新训练，而蒸馏从不需要任何训练
蒸馏降低数值精度，而量化改变模型的架构
量化降低权重/激活值的数值精度；蒸馏则训练一个更小的学生模型去模仿更大教师模型的输出
二者是同一优化技术的可互换术语
questions.e: Quantization (e.g., FP32→INT8) lowers the bit-width representing weights/activations without changing model structure, while distillation transfers knowledge from a large teacher model into a smaller student architecture. Why the others are wrong: - Quantization can be post-training (no retraining) or quantization-aware (with fine-tuning); distillation always requires training the student model, so this reverses the facts. - This swaps the definitions — distillation affects architecture/size, quantization affects numeric precision, not the other way around. - They address memory constraints via fundamentally different mechanisms (precision vs. model size) and are not interchangeable.
questions.eZh: 量化（例如 FP32→INT8）在不改变模型结构的前提下降低表示权重/激活值所需的位宽，而蒸馏则把知识从大型教师模型迁移到更小的学生架构中。其他选项为何错误：- 量化可以是训练后量化（无需重新训练）或量化感知训练（配合微调）；而蒸馏总是需要训练学生模型，因此该选项颠倒了事实 - 这把定义调换了——蒸馏影响架构/规模，量化影响数值精度，而非相反 - 二者通过根本不同的机制（精度 vs. 模型规模）来应对内存约束，不能互换

questions.q: A team training a multimodal generative model on H100 GPUs wants FP32-equivalent dynamic range with reduced memory usage, and wants to avoid implementing custom loss scaling logic. Which precision format best fits this requirement?
questions.qZh: 某团队在 H100 GPU 上训练多模态生成模型，希望获得与 FP32 相当的动态范围、同时降低内存占用，并且不必实现自定义的 loss scaling 逻辑。哪种精度格式最符合该需求？
o: FP16
INT8
FP64
BF16
oZh: FP16
INT8
FP64
BF16
questions.e: BF16 uses the same 8-bit exponent as FP32 (matching its dynamic range) while halving memory versus FP32, and its wide range makes loss scaling unnecessary, unlike FP16. Why the others are wrong: - FP16 has a narrower dynamic range than FP32 and typically requires loss scaling to avoid underflow, violating the stated constraint. - INT8 is an inference-time quantization format, not typically used for stable full-precision-range training. - FP64 increases memory usage and compute cost significantly and offers no meaningful benefit for this use case.
questions.eZh: BF16 使用与 FP32 相同的 8 位指数（动态范围与 FP32 相当），同时内存占用相比 FP32 减半；其宽广的范围使 loss scaling 变得不必要，这是 FP16 所不具备的。其他选项为何错误：- FP16 的动态范围比 FP32 窄，通常需要 loss scaling 才能避免下溢，违反了题述约束 - INT8 是推理期的量化格式，通常不用于需要稳定全精度动态范围的训练 - FP64 会显著增加内存占用和计算成本，对该用例没有实质收益

questions.q: A production inference service receives many small, concurrent requests and needs to maximize overall GPU throughput by grouping requests together at runtime. Which technique addresses this?
questions.qZh: 某生产推理服务收到大量小规模并发请求，需要在运行时将请求组合起来，以最大化 GPU 的整体吞吐。哪种技术可以做到这一点？
o: Gradient accumulation
Weight pruning
Loss scaling
Dynamic batching
oZh: 梯度累积（gradient accumulation）
权重剪枝（weight pruning）
Loss scaling
动态批处理（dynamic batching）
questions.e: Dynamic batching groups incoming inference requests at runtime into larger batches, improving GPU utilization and throughput at the cost of some added per-request latency. Why the others are wrong: - Gradient accumulation is a training-time technique to simulate larger batch sizes with limited memory, not an inference-serving technique. - Weight pruning removes redundant parameters to shrink model size; it doesn't address runtime request grouping. - Loss scaling is a training-time numerical stability technique for mixed precision, irrelevant to inference throughput.
questions.eZh: 动态批处理在运行时把到达的推理请求组合成更大的批次，从而提升 GPU 利用率和吞吐，代价是增加了单请求延迟。其他选项为何错误：- 梯度累积是训练期技术，用于在内存有限时模拟更大的 batch size，并非推理服务技术 - 权重剪枝移除冗余参数以缩小模型规模，并不解决运行时的请求组合问题 - loss scaling 是混合精度的训练期数值稳定性技术，与推理吞吐无关

questions.q: A team quantizes a trained FP32 model directly to INT8 without using any calibration dataset and observes significant accuracy degradation. What is the most likely cause?
questions.qZh: 某团队在未使用任何校准数据集的情况下，将一个训练好的 FP32 模型直接量化为 INT8，并观察到明显的精度下降。最可能的原因是什么？
o: INT8 quantization always reduces accuracy regardless of calibration
The absence of a calibration step led to poor dynamic-range mapping for weights and activations
TensorRT does not support INT8 precision
The model must first be retrained in FP16 before any quantization is possible
oZh: 无论是否校准，INT8 量化总会降低精度
缺少校准步骤导致权重和激活值的动态范围映射不佳
TensorRT 不支持 INT8 精度
必须先用 FP16 重新训练模型才能进行任何量化
questions.e: Post-training INT8 quantization requires a representative calibration dataset to determine accurate scale/zero-point mappings for activations; skipping this step causes poor range mapping and accuracy loss. Why the others are wrong: - INT8 quantization, when properly calibrated (or done via quantization-aware training), can achieve accuracy very close to FP32/FP16 baselines. - TensorRT explicitly supports INT8 precision as one of its core optimization modes. - FP16 retraining is not a prerequisite for INT8 quantization; calibration or QAT directly from FP32 is a standard, supported path. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 训练后 INT8 量化需要具备代表性的校准数据集，以确定激活值准确的 scale/zero-point 映射；跳过该步骤会导致范围映射不佳并造成精度损失。其他选项为何错误：- 只要校准得当（或采用量化感知训练），INT8 量化可以达到非常接近 FP32/FP16 基线的精度 - TensorRT 明确支持 INT8 精度，这是其核心优化模式之一 - FP16 重训练并非 INT8 量化的前置条件；直接从 FP32 做校准或 QAT 是标准且受支持的路径 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which technique does TensorRT typically use to determine INT8 quantization scale factors, requiring a representative sample dataset rather than full retraining?
questions.qZh: TensorRT 通常采用哪种技术来确定 INT8 量化的 scale factor，该技术需要具备代表性的样本数据集而非完全重新训练？
o: Quantization-aware training only
Post-training calibration using a representative dataset
BF16 automatic mixed precision casting
Native FP8 inference without any calibration step
oZh: 仅使用量化感知训练
使用具备代表性数据集的训练后校准
BF16 自动混合精度转换
不做任何校准步骤的原生 FP8 推理
questions.e: TensorRT's standard INT8 workflow uses post-training calibration: running a representative dataset through the model to compute per-tensor/per-channel dynamic ranges for quantization scale factors, without full retraining. Why the others are wrong: - Quantization-aware training is an alternative approach requiring model fine-tuning with simulated quantization, not the typical lightweight TensorRT calibration flow. - BF16 autocasting is a mixed-precision technique unrelated to INT8 scale-factor determination. - FP8 inference on supported architectures still benefits from calibration for best accuracy; claiming no calibration step is needed is inaccurate as a general rule.
questions.eZh: TensorRT 标准的 INT8 工作流使用训练后校准：让具备代表性的数据集跑过模型，计算用于量化 scale factor 的 per-tensor/per-channel 动态范围，无需完全重新训练。其他选项为何错误：- 量化感知训练是另一种方法，需要用模拟量化对模型进行微调，并非 TensorRT 典型的轻量级校准流程 - BF16 自动转换是混合精度技术，与 INT8 scale factor 的确定无关 - 在受支持的架构上做 FP8 推理，为获得最佳精度同样受益于校准；声称无需任何校准步骤，作为通用结论并不准确

questions.q: A media company generates AI images for a news site and must let downstream viewers verify the image was AI-generated even after it is re-compressed and re-uploaded to social platforms. Which approach BEST meets this requirement?
questions.qZh: 某媒体公司为新闻网站生成 AI 图像，必须让下游观看者即使在图像被重新压缩并重新上传到社交平台之后，仍能验证该图像是 AI 生成的。哪种方法最能满足此要求？
o: Embed a cryptographically signed C2PA Content Credentials manifest plus an imperceptible robust watermark
Attach a text disclaimer in the image caption only
Increase the sampling temperature during generation
Store the generation prompt in the image filename
oZh: 嵌入经密码学签名的 C2PA Content Credentials 清单，并加上肉眼不可察的鲁棒水印
仅在图片说明中附加文字免责声明
在生成过程中提高采样温度
将生成提示词存储在图像文件名中
questions.e: C2PA manifests provide a signed, tamper-evident provenance chain, and pairing them with an imperceptible watermark preserves a verifiable signal even if metadata is stripped or the file is recompressed. Why the others are wrong: - Captions are easily removed and carry no cryptographic guarantee - Temperature affects generation randomness, not provenance or safety - Filenames are trivially edited and lost on re-upload
questions.eZh: C2PA 清单提供了经过签名、防篡改的来源链，将其与肉眼不可察的水印配合使用，即使元数据被剥离或文件被重新压缩，也能保留可验证的信号。其它选项错误的原因：- 说明文字很容易被移除，也不提供任何密码学保证 - 温度影响的是生成的随机性，而非来源信息或安全性 - 文件名很容易被编辑，重新上传时也会丢失

questions.q: A medical Q&A multimodal assistant confidently states a drug dosage that does not appear in any of its training or retrieved sources, and the dosage is factually wrong. What is this failure mode called?
questions.qZh: 某医疗问答多模态助手自信地陈述了一个在其训练数据或检索到的来源中都不存在的药物剂量，而且该剂量在事实上是错误的。这种失效模式称为什么？
o: Bias amplification
Hallucination
Model drift
Overfitting
oZh: 偏见放大
幻觉
模型漂移
过拟合
questions.e: Hallucination is the generation of fluent, plausible-sounding content that is not grounded in any source and is unverifiable or false — exactly this case. Why the others are wrong: - Bias amplification concerns skewed representation of groups, not fabricated facts - Drift refers to performance degradation over time due to data shift, not a single ungrounded claim - Overfitting is a training-time generalization failure, not an inference-time factual error ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 幻觉是指生成流畅、看似合理但没有任何来源依据、无法验证或纯属虚假的内容——正是本例的情况。其它选项错误的原因：- 偏见放大关注的是对群体的偏颇表达，而非捏造事实 - 漂移指数据分布变化导致性能随时间下降，而非单条无依据的陈述 - 过拟合是训练期的泛化失败，而非推理期的事实性错误 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An image generator, when prompted with 'CEO', overwhelmingly produces images of one demographic group, reflecting skewed training data. Which mitigation BEST addresses the root cause?
questions.qZh: 某图像生成器在提示为 'CEO' 时，压倒性地生成某一人口群体的图像，反映出训练数据存在偏斜。哪种缓解措施最能解决根本原因？
o: Lower the classifier-free guidance scale
Add an invisible watermark to all outputs
Increase the output image resolution
Rebalance the training/fine-tuning dataset and apply fairness-aware fine-tuning or prompt-conditioning debiasing
oZh: 降低 classifier-free guidance 的 scale 值
为所有输出添加不可见水印
提高输出图像的分辨率
重新平衡训练/微调数据集，并采用公平性感知微调或基于提示词条件化的去偏
questions.e: Representation bias originates in training data distribution; the correct fix targets data rebalancing or fairness-aware fine-tuning/debiasing techniques, not generation-time cosmetic settings. Why the others are wrong: - Guidance scale controls prompt adherence/fidelity, not demographic distribution - Watermarking addresses provenance, not fairness - Resolution is unrelated to representational bias
questions.eZh: 表征偏差源自训练数据的分布；正确的修复手段是数据再平衡或公平性感知微调/去偏技术，而不是生成阶段的外在设置。其它选项错误的原因：- 引导 scale 控制的是对提示词的贴合度/保真度，而非人口群体分布 - 水印解决的是来源溯源问题，而非公平性问题 - 分辨率与表征偏差无关

questions.q: Which watermarking technique is designed to remain detectable after an image undergoes JPEG compression, resizing, and social-media re-upload, while remaining invisible to the human eye?
questions.qZh: 哪种水印技术被设计为在图像经过 JPEG 压缩、缩放和社交媒体重新上传之后仍可被检测到，同时对人眼不可见？
o: An imperceptible statistical watermark embedded into pixel values during generation (e.g., SynthID-style)
A visible logo overlay in the corner of the image
EXIF metadata field only
A checksum hash stored in a separate text file
oZh: 在生成过程中嵌入像素值的肉眼不可察统计水印（例如 SynthID 风格）
在图像角落叠加的可见 logo
仅使用 EXIF 元数据字段
存储在独立文本文件中的校验和哈希值
questions.e: Imperceptible statistical watermarks are embedded directly into the generation process at the pixel/token level, making them robust to common transformations like compression and resizing, unlike metadata or overlays which are easily stripped. Why the others are wrong: - Visible overlays can be cropped or edited out and degrade image quality - EXIF metadata is routinely stripped by social platforms on re-upload - A separate checksum file is not carried with the image once shared ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 肉眼不可察的统计水印直接嵌入生成过程的像素/token 层面，因此能抵抗压缩和缩放等常见变换，而元数据或叠加层很容易被剥离。其它选项错误的原因：- 可见叠加层可以被裁剪或编辑掉，还会降低图像质量 - EXIF 元数据在重新上传时通常会被社交平台剥离 - 独立的校验和文件在图片被分享后不会随图片一起携带 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A publisher needs to track a full edit history — original camera capture, photo editing, and AI enhancement — in a single verifiable chain attached to the media file. Which standard is purpose-built for this?
questions.qZh: 某出版商需要跟踪完整的编辑历史——原始相机拍摄、照片编辑以及 AI 增强——并使其作为一条可验证的链附加在媒体文件上。哪个标准是为此专门设计的？
o: SSL/TLS certificate on the hosting server
C2PA Content Credentials
A plain EXIF timestamp
A custom filename versioning convention
oZh: 托管服务器上的 SSL/TLS 证书
C2PA Content Credentials
普通的 EXIF 时间戳
自定义的文件名版本命名约定
questions.e: C2PA (Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity) defines a cryptographically signed, chained manifest format that records each edit/generation step across the media's lifecycle. Why the others are wrong: - TLS certificates secure transport, not content history - EXIF timestamps are unsigned, easily edited, and don't capture edit chains - Filename conventions are not verifiable or tamper-evident
questions.eZh: C2PA（Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity，内容来源与真实性联盟）定义了一种经密码学签名、链式相连的清单格式，用于记录媒体生命周期中的每一次编辑/生成步骤。其它选项错误的原因：- TLS 证书保护的是传输，而非内容历史 - EXIF 时间戳未经签名、容易编辑，且无法记录编辑链 - 文件名约定不可验证，也不具备防篡改特性

questions.q: In an NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails deployment, which rail type intercepts and filters the raw user message BEFORE it is passed to the LLM, blocking disallowed topics regardless of phrasing?
questions.qZh: 在 NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails 部署中，哪种 rail 类型会在原始用户消息被传给 LLM 之前拦截并过滤它，无论措辞如何都拦截不允许的话题？
o: Input rails
Output rails
Execution rails
Retrieval rails
oZh: 输入 rails（Input rails）
输出 rails（Output rails）
执行 rails（Execution rails）
检索 rails（Retrieval rails）
questions.e: Input rails process and can block or rewrite the user's message before it reaches the LLM, enforcing topical/safety restrictions upstream of generation. Why the others are wrong: - Output rails filter/validate the LLM's generated response, not the incoming query - Execution rails govern tool/function-calling actions, not raw text filtering - Retrieval rails govern what content is fetched from a knowledge base, not the initial user message ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 输入 rails 在用户消息到达 LLM 之前对其进行处理，可以拦截或改写，从而在生成之前的上游施加话题/安全限制。其它选项错误的原因：- 输出 rails 过滤/校验 LLM 生成的响应，而非传入的查询 - 执行 rails 管理工具/函数调用的动作，而非原始文本过滤 - 检索 rails 管理从知识库中获取哪些内容，而非初始的用户消息 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A multimodal RAG assistant frequently generates confident answers unsupported by its retrieved documents. Which change BEST reduces hallucination while preserving factuality?
questions.qZh: 某多模态 RAG 助手经常生成其检索文档无法支持的自信答案。哪项改动最能降低幻觉，同时保持事实性？
o: Increase the generation temperature to add diversity
Ground responses in retrieved citations and add a confidence/attribution check before returning the answer
Remove the retrieval step to simplify the pipeline
Increase max tokens to give the model more room to elaborate
oZh: 提高生成温度以增加多样性
将回答锚定在检索到的引用上，并在返回答案前加入置信度/归因检查
移除检索步骤以简化流水线
增加 max tokens，让模型有更多空间展开阐述
questions.e: Grounding outputs in retrieved evidence with explicit citation/attribution scoring directly constrains generation to verifiable sources, the standard mitigation for hallucination in RAG systems. Why the others are wrong: - Higher temperature increases randomness, worsening hallucination risk - Removing retrieval eliminates the only grounding signal, increasing hallucination - More tokens gives more room for unsupported elaboration, not less
questions.eZh: 将输出锚定在检索到的证据上，并配合显式的引用/归因评分，可以直接把生成约束到可验证的来源，这是 RAG 系统中降低幻觉的标准手段。其它选项错误的原因：- 更高的温度会增加随机性，使幻觉风险更严重 - 移除检索就消除了唯一的锚定信号，反而增加幻觉 - 更多 token 给了无依据的阐述更多空间，而非更少

questions.q: Which statement BEST distinguishes 'factuality' from 'hallucination' in generative AI evaluation?
questions.qZh: 在生成式 AI 评测中，哪个陈述最能区分 'factuality'（事实性）与 'hallucination'（幻觉）？
o: Factuality measures fluency of text; hallucination measures grammatical correctness
They are interchangeable terms for the same evaluation metric

Factuality measures how well output matches verifiable real-world/ground-truth information; hallucination is the generation of unsupported or fabricated content regardless of whether it happens to be true
Factuality only applies to images; hallucination only applies to text
oZh: 事实性衡量文本的流畅度；幻觉衡量语法正确性
二者是可互换的术语，指同一个评测指标
事实性衡量输出与可验证的真实世界/真值信息的匹配程度；幻觉则是生成无依据或捏造的内容，无论其是否碰巧为真
事实性只适用于图像；幻觉只适用于文本
questions.e: Factuality is a correctness metric against ground truth; hallucination describes the generative behavior of producing ungrounded content, which may or may not coincidentally be factual — the two are related but distinct axes. Why the others are wrong: - Fluency/grammar are unrelated evaluation dimensions - Treating them as identical misses that hallucinated content can occasionally be accidentally true - Both concepts apply across modalities, not restricted to one ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 事实性是针对真值的正确性指标；幻觉描述的是生成无依据内容的生成行为，这些内容可能偶然是正确的——两者相关但属于不同维度。其它选项错误的原因：- 流畅度/语法与这两个评测维度无关 - 把二者等同，会忽略幻觉内容偶尔可能碰巧为真的情况 - 两个概念都适用于多种模态，并非局限于某一种 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: The NCA-GENM exam gives 60 minutes for approximately 55 questions. You are on question 3 and have already spent 3 minutes trying to recall the exact difference between two NVIDIA SDKs. What is the BEST action right now?
questions.qZh: NCA-GENM 考试给出 60 分钟约 55 道题。你目前做到第 3 题，并且已经花了 3 分钟试图回忆两个 NVIDIA SDK 之间的确切区别。此刻最好的做法是什么？
o: Keep working the question until you are fully certain of the answer
Flag the question, select your best current guess, and move on immediately
Skip the question entirely and leave it blank to come back later
Restart the exam timer mentally and recalculate your pace for the remaining questions
oZh: 继续做这道题，直到完全确定答案
标记该题，选择当前最佳猜测，然后立即继续下一题
完全跳过该题，留空稍后再回来
在心里重新开始计时，重新计算剩余题目的答题节奏
questions.e: At ~65 seconds/question budget, 3 minutes on question 3 already exceeds pace. Flagging with a best guess protects your score (no penalty for wrong answers) while preserving time for the rest of the exam. Why the others are wrong: - Continuing to work it burns time you cannot recover, risking a pacing collapse later in the exam - Leaving it blank forfeits a free chance at partial credit-by-guess since there is no penalty for incorrect answers - Recalculating pace is not an action that resolves the immediate time loss — you still need to move on ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 按每题约 65 秒的时间预算，在第 3 题上花 3 分钟已经超出节奏。标记并给出最佳猜测可以保住分数（答错不扣分），同时为考试其余部分保留时间。其它选项错误的原因：- 继续纠结会消耗无法找回的时间，导致后续答题节奏崩溃 - 留空等于放弃一次免费的机会，因为答错不扣分 - 重新计算节奏并不能解决当前已损失的时间——你仍然需要往下走 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: At the 30-minute mark you have only completed 18 of ~55 questions. Which strategy adjustment BEST gets you back on pace without abandoning accuracy entirely?
questions.qZh: 到 30 分钟时，你只完成了约 55 题中的 18 题。哪种策略调整最能让你回到正轨，又不至于完全放弃准确率？
o: Speed up by selecting the first plausible-looking answer on every remaining question without reading distractors
Switch to a two-pass approach: quickly eliminate obviously wrong options using exact terminology, flag anything still ambiguous, and answer easy questions in full
Stop and review your first 18 answers to make sure none need changing before continuing
Use all remaining time on the hardest-looking questions since they carry more weight

停下来复查前 18 题的答案，确保没有需要修改的，然后再继续
把剩余时间全部用在看起来最难的题目上，因为它们权重更高
questions.e: Terminology-based elimination is fast and reliable; flagging ambiguous items instead of stalling on them recovers time while still answering confident questions properly. Why the others are wrong: - Guessing without reading distractors sacrifices accuracy on questions you could actually get right with light elimination - Reviewing early answers mid-exam wastes time and does not address being behind pace on new questions - All questions carry equal weight on the NCA-GENM; there is no scoring benefit to prioritizing 'hard-looking' items ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 基于术语的排除既快又可靠；标记有歧义的题目而不是在原地纠缠，能收回时间，同时把有把握的题目认真作答。其它选项错误的原因：- 不读干扰项直接猜，会牺牲那些稍作排除本可答对的题目的准确率 - 考试中途复查早期答案浪费时间，也不能解决新题上进度落后的问题 - NCA-GENM 中所有题目权重相同，优先做“看起来难”的题没有得分收益 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A team needs to serve three different fine-tuned models (one PyTorch, one ONNX, one TensorRT-optimized) behind a single inference endpoint with dynamic batching and concurrent model execution. Which NVIDIA tool BEST fits this requirement?
questions.qZh: 某团队需要在单一推理端点后面提供三个不同的微调模型（一个 PyTorch、一个 ONNX、一个经 TensorRT 优化），并具备动态批处理和并发模型执行能力。哪个 NVIDIA 工具最符合此要求？

NeMo Curator
NGC CLI
TensorRT builder API alone

Triton Model Repository 配置文件
TensorRT 引擎缓存
NeMo Aligner 检查点存储
questions.e: NGC is NVIDIA's catalog of pretrained models, containers, and Helm charts, designed exactly for this pull-before-you-build workflow. Why the others are wrong: - A Triton model repository is a local directory structure for serving models, not a hosted catalog for downloading them - A TensorRT engine cache stores already-built, hardware-specific inference engines, not source models/containers - NeMo Aligner checkpoints are outputs of alignment training runs, not a general catalog for discovery/download
questions.eZh: NGC 是 NVIDIA 的预训练模型、容器和 Helm charts 目录，正是为这种“先拉取再构建”的工作流而设计的。其它选项错误的原因：- Triton model repository 是用于提供模型服务的本地目录结构，而不是用于下载模型的托管目录 - TensorRT 引擎缓存存放的是已构建的、硬件专属的推理引擎，而不是源模型/容器 - NeMo Aligner 检查点是训练对齐任务的产物，而不是通用的发现/下载目录

questions.q: You are optimizing a trained model for deployment with TensorRT and need to reduce latency while accepting a small, controlled accuracy trade-off. Which configuration change BEST achieves this?
questions.qZh: 你正在用 TensorRT 优化一个训练好的模型以便部署，需要在可接受小幅度、可控精度权衡的前提下降低延迟。哪项配置变更最能实现这一点？
o: Increase the maximum workspace size only
Disable layer fusion during engine build
Convert the engine to run in INT8 or FP16 precision instead of FP32
Increase the batch size to the maximum supported value
oZh: 仅增大最大 workspace 大小
在构建引擎时禁用层融合
将引擎转换为以 INT8 或 FP16 精度而非 FP32 运行
将批大小增至支持的最大值
questions.e: Reducing precision (FP32 → FP16/INT8) is the standard TensorRT technique to cut latency and memory footprint, trading a small, calibratable accuracy loss for speed. Why the others are wrong: - Increasing workspace size only affects available memory for kernel selection during build, not runtime precision or latency directly - Disabling layer fusion removes a key TensorRT optimization and would increase latency, not reduce it - Increasing batch size improves throughput but typically increases per-request latency, the opposite of the stated goal ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 降低精度（FP32 → FP16/INT8）是 TensorRT 降低延迟和显存占用的标准技术，用可控、可校准的少量精度损失换取速度。其它选项错误的原因：- 增大 workspace 大小只影响构建时可用于 kernel 选择的显存，并不直接改变运行时精度或延迟 - 禁用层融合会移除 TensorRT 的关键优化，反而增加延迟 - 增大批大小能提升吞吐，但通常会增加单请求延迟，与所述目标相反 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A generated-image dataset is evaluated against a real-image dataset, and the resulting score is reported as a single distance value where lower values indicate the generated images are more realistic and diverse. Which metric produces this score?
questions.qZh: 一个生成图像数据集与真实图像数据集进行评估，所得分数以单个距离值报告，数值越低表示生成图像越真实、越多样。哪个指标产生该分数？
o: CLIP score
BLEU score
Fréchet Inception Distance (FID)
Perplexity
oZh: CLIP score
BLEU score
Fréchet Inception Distance (FID)
Perplexity
questions.e: FID compares feature distributions of real vs. generated images using an Inception network; lower FID means closer match in quality and diversity. Why the others are wrong: - CLIP score measures image-text alignment via joint embeddings, not real-vs-generated image distribution distance - BLEU is a text n-gram overlap metric used for translation/captioning, not image realism - Perplexity measures language model prediction confidence on text, unrelated to image generation quality ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: FID 使用 Inception 网络比较真实图像与生成图像的特征分布；FID 越低表示在质量和多样性上越接近。其它选项错误的原因：- CLIP score 通过联合嵌入衡量图文对齐，而非真实与生成图像之间的分布距离 - BLEU 是用于翻译/图像描述的文本 n-gram 重叠指标，与图像真实性无关 - Perplexity 衡量语言模型在文本上的预测置信度，与图像生成质量无关 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A question describes a system that embeds images and text captions into a shared vector space so that matching pairs have high cosine similarity, and asks which component enables this. Two distractor options mention 'FID-based alignment' and 'Triton embedding server.' Using exact terminology elimination, which option is correct?
questions.qZh: 某题描述了一个系统，它将图像和文本描述嵌入到共享向量空间中，使匹配的配对具有高余弦相似度，并询问是哪个组件实现了这一点。两个干扰项提到 'FID-based alignment' 和 'Triton embedding server'。用精确术语排除法，哪个选项是正确的？
o: FID-based alignment module
Triton embedding server
CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) encoder
TensorRT quantization layer
oZh: FID-based alignment module
Triton embedding server
CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) encoder
TensorRT quantization layer
questions.e: CLIP is specifically trained via contrastive learning to place matching image-text pairs close together in a shared embedding space — exactly the described mechanism. Why the others are wrong: - FID is an evaluation metric for image generation quality, not a mechanism for creating a shared embedding space — this is a fabricated distractor combining two unrelated terms - Triton is an inference server, not an embedding technique; 'embedding server' is not a real NVIDIA product feature tied to this behavior - TensorRT quantization reduces numeric precision for inference speed; it has no role in creating cross-modal embedding spaces ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: CLIP 专门通过对比学习训练，使匹配的图文对在共享嵌入空间中彼此靠近——正是所描述的机制。其它选项错误的原因：- FID 是图像生成质量的评测指标，而不是构建共享嵌入空间的机制——这是把两个无关术语拼在一起的臆造干扰项 - Triton 是推理服务器，而非嵌入技术；“embedding server” 并不是与该行为相关的真实 NVIDIA 产品特性 - TensorRT 量化通过降低数值精度来提升推理速度，在构建跨模态嵌入空间中不起作用 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: On exam day, the remote proctoring system requires you to complete an environment check before the timer starts. Which action is REQUIRED as part of standard remote-proctored exam-day logistics?
questions.qZh: 考试当天，远程监考系统要求你在计时开始前完成环境检查。哪项操作是标准远程监考考试日流程中必须完成的？
o: Sharing your screen with a second monitor left fully visible and unchecked
Providing a valid government-issued photo ID and completing a room scan with your webcam
Disabling your webcam once identity is confirmed to save bandwidth
Keeping notes or reference material visible but untouched on your desk
oZh: 共享你的屏幕，且第二块显示器完全可见、未做检查
提供有效的政府签发的带照片身份证件，并使用摄像头完成房间扫描
身份确认后关闭摄像头以节省带宽
将笔记或参考资料放在桌上保持可见但不去触碰
questions.e: Standard remote proctoring requires photo ID verification and a 360-degree room scan to confirm a clear, single-monitor, resource-free testing environment before the exam begins. Why the others are wrong: - A second monitor must typically be disconnected or removed, not just left visible, as it is a common integrity violation - The webcam must remain on and monitoring you for the entire exam duration, not just at identity check - Any notes or reference material on the desk, even untouched, is generally prohibited and can trigger a flag or termination
questions.eZh: 标准远程监考要求核验带照片的身份证件并进行 360 度房间扫描，以确认考试环境为单显示器、无资料的清洁环境，然后才能开始考试。其它选项错误的原因：- 第二块显示器通常必须断开或移除，而非仅仅保持可见，因为这是常见的违规行为 - 摄像头必须在整个考试期间保持开启并持续监控，而非仅在身份核验时开启 - 桌上的任何笔记或参考资料，即使不去触碰，通常也被禁止，可能触发标记或终止考试

questions.e: When designing complex agentic workflows, linear pipelines (or prompt chains) are considered insufficient because they struggle to handle ambiguity and errors effectively . Instead, graph-based workflow orchestration offers the greatest flexibility by modeling the workflow as a directed graph where nodes represent functions—like agents or tools—and edges dictate the flow of logic . This paradigm, popularized by frameworks like LangGraph, supports stateful graph execution, continuous loops, and conditional branching . By utilizing conditional edges, the system can dynamically evaluate its shared state to decide the next best action, such as executing a tool, pausing for human-in-the-loop approval, or finishing the task entirely
