让每个专家智能体独立作答，再由运维人员选择使用哪个答案。
questions.e: A central coordinator is correct because it can assign the three specialist roles and present one consolidated response, meeting the requirement for a single accountable result. Option B is not correct because peer voting does not ensure one owner for the final response. Option C is not correct because it removes the required specialist boundaries. Option D is not correct because it leaves response selection to the operator.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为中央协调器可以分派三个专家角色，并呈现一份整合后的响应，满足需要有单一责任主体的结果这一要求。选项 B 不正确，因为同级投票无法为最终响应确立唯一的责任方。选项 C 不正确，因为它取消了必需的专家角色边界。选项 D 不正确，因为它把响应选择权留给了运维人员。

questions.q: Choose two. Which communication design choices best satisfy the integration requirements?
questions.qZh: 选择两项。哪些通信设计选择最能满足集成要求？
o: Require every agent to publish all intermediate messages to every other agent.
Give each agent a defined role and route requests through the coordinator using a shared message envelope with sender, recipient, and correlation identifier.
Define a response contract with a completion status and structured result so the coordinator can distinguish success, failure, and a request for another specialist.
Have specialist agents call one another through hard-coded pairwise connections without using the coordinator.
Put the full workflow in every specialist agent and allow any specialist to return a final answer.
oZh: 要求每个智能体将其所有中间消息发布给所有其他智能体。
为每个智能体定义明确的角色，并使用包含发送方、接收方与关联标识符（correlation identifier）的共享消息封装（message envelope），将请求经由协调器路由。
定义带有完成状态和结构化结果的响应契约，使协调器能够区分成功、失败以及请求其他专家智能体。
让专家智能体通过硬编码的两两连接相互调用，而不使用协调器。
将完整工作流放入每个专家智能体中，并允许任一专家智能体返回最终答案。
questions.e: The shared message envelope and response contract are correct because they let independently maintained agents exchange identifiable requests and consistently report outcomes to the coordinator. Option A is not correct because broadcasting all intermediate messages creates unnecessary traffic. Option D is not correct because pairwise links tightly couple specialists. Option E is not correct because duplicated workflow ownership can produce inconsistent responses.
questions.eZh: 共享消息封装与响应契约是正确的，因为它们让各自独立维护的智能体能够交换可标识的请求，并以一致的方式向协调器报告结果。选项 A 不正确，因为广播所有中间消息会产生不必要的通信流量。选项 D 不正确，因为两两连接会让专家智能体紧密耦合。选项 E 不正确，因为工作流归属重复会导致响应不一致。

questions.q: Which implementation will allow the agent to execute the function and use its result in a response?
questions.qZh: 哪种实现方式能让智能体执行该函数并在响应中使用其结果？
o: Create a LangChain agent with the ChatNVIDIA model and the registered Python tool so the agent runtime can dispatch the call and return the result to the model.
Call bind_tools on the model and return its first response without checking for or executing tool calls.
Place the function source code in the system prompt and ask the model to run it.
Convert the model's tool call arguments directly into a final answer without invoking the function.
oZh: 创建一个 LangChain 智能体，配置 ChatNVIDIA 模型和已注册的 Python 工具，使智能体运行时能够分发该调用并把结果返回给模型。
在模型上调用 bind_tools 并直接返回其首个响应，不检查也不执行工具调用。
把函数源代码放进系统提示词，并要求模型运行它。
不调用该函数，直接把模型的工具调用参数转换为最终答案。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the scenario requires the agent to run lookup_order and use its returned status, which the agent runtime does when the tool is registered with the agent. Option B only makes tool information available to the model and does not execute the function. Option C asks the model to imitate code execution, and Option D skips the lookup entirely.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为该场景要求智能体运行 lookup_order 并使用其返回的状态，而智能体运行时在工具注册到智能体后即可完成这一过程。选项 B 只是让模型获得工具信息，并未执行该函数。选项 C 只是要求模型模仿代码执行，选项 D 则完全跳过了查询。

questions.q: Choose two steps that will make the live quote operation usable by the agent.
questions.qZh: 选择两项可以使实时报价操作被智能体使用的步骤。
o: Wrap the quote operation as a tool with a defined input schema and a description that identifies the required account identifier.
Add the quote service documentation to the system prompt and rely on the model to retrieve the current quote from that text.
Ask the model to write a raw HTTP request in its response, then treat that text as the service result.
Register the wrapped quote tool in the LangChain agent's tool list so the agent runtime can invoke it.
Include a sample quote in the prompt and use it whenever the agent needs a quote.
oZh: 将报价操作封装为工具，定义输入 schema，并给出说明以标明所需的账户标识符。
将报价服务的文档加入 system prompt，并依赖模型从该文本中提取当前报价。
要求模型在响应中写出原始 HTTP 请求，然后把该文本当作服务结果。
在 LangChain 智能体的工具列表中注册封装后的报价工具，使智能体运行时能够调用它。
在 prompt 中包含一份示例报价，并在智能体需要报价时使用它。
questions.e: Options A and D are correct because the agent needs a defined input for the account identifier and access to the callable wrapper to retrieve a live quote. Options B and E provide prompt text rather than invoking the current service. Option C produces request text but does not call the quote operation or return its actual result.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 D 正确，因为智能体需要为账户标识符定义明确的输入，并需要访问可调用的封装工具才能获取实时报价。选项 B 和 E 只是提供了 prompt 文本，并未调用当前的服务。选项 C 生成的是请求文本，既未调用报价操作，也未返回其实际结果。

questions.q: Which conclusion should the team draw from these results?
questions.qZh: 团队应当从这些结果中得出什么结论？
o: Adopt Variant B because it has the highest completion rate, even though its latency exceeds the limit.
Adopt Variant A because it meets the latency limit and has a higher completion rate than the baseline.
Keep the baseline because it has the lowest latency, regardless of its lower completion rate.
Adopt Variant B because a larger benchmark set makes the latency limit less relevant.
oZh: 采用变体 B，因为它完成率最高，尽管其延迟超出了限制。
采用变体 A，因为它满足延迟限制，且完成率高于基线。
保留基线版本，因为它延迟最低，无论其完成率较低。
采用变体 B，因为更大的基准测试集会让延迟限制变得不那么重要。
questions.e: Option B is correct because Variant A raises completion from 84 percent to 91 percent while remaining under the 1.8-second latency limit. Option A is not correct because Variant B exceeds that limit. Option C ignores the improvement that Variant A achieves within the constraint. Option D is not correct because a larger test set does not change the stated latency requirement.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为变体 A 在保持低于 1.8 秒延迟限制的同时，将完成率从 84% 提升到 91%。选项 A 不正确，因为变体 B 超出了该限制。选项 C 忽略了变体 A 在约束条件内所取得的改进。选项 D 不正确，因为更大的测试集并不会改变既定的延迟要求。

questions.q: Choose two. Which actions provide the strongest basis for tuning the agent and deciding if the change should be accepted?
questions.qZh: 选两项。哪些做法为调优智能体以及判断某项改动是否应被接受提供了最有力的依据？
o: Group failed cases by failure type and prioritize the category that accounts for the most missed tasks.
Increase the response length limit for every request, then use a small sample of successful cases to judge the result.
Replace the evaluation set with newly collected cases after each change so the agent is not tested on familiar inputs.
Compare each candidate change with the current version on the same representative evaluation set, tracking task completion and p95 latency against the service limits.
Select the change with the best average completion score, even if it violates the service latency limit.
oZh: 按失败类型对失败用例分组，并优先处理导致遗漏任务最多的那一类。
提高每个请求的响应长度上限，然后用少量成功用例来判断结果。
每次改动后都用新收集的用例替换评估集，以免智能体在熟悉输入上被测试。
在同一个有代表性的评估集上，将每个候选改动与当前版本进行对比，并依据服务限制跟踪任务完成情况和 p95 延迟。
选择平均完成得分最好的改动，即使它违反了服务延迟限制。
questions.e: Options A and D are correct because failure categories help target tuning, while a consistent evaluation set supports a fair comparison against both task and latency limits. Option B changes a broad setting and judges it on a biased sample. Option C prevents direct comparison across versions. Option E disregards the stated latency constraint.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 D 正确，因为失败分类有助于确定调优重点，而一致的评估集能支撑针对任务指标和延迟限制的公平比较。选项 B 改动了全局设置，并用有偏的样本来评判结果。选项 C 阻碍了跨版本的直接比较。选项 E 无视了既定的延迟约束。

questions.q: Which deployment change best enables the service to scale horizontally while preserving active conversations?
questions.qZh: 哪种部署改动最能让该服务在横向扩展的同时保留正在进行的会话？
o: Keep session affinity and add replicas, relying on each conversation to remain on its original pod.
Move conversation state to the approved shared Redis service and run interchangeable agent replicas behind the service.
Increase the CPU and memory limits on the existing pod while keeping a single replica.
Periodically copy each pod's in-memory conversation dictionary to the other replicas with init containers.
oZh: 保持会话亲和性并增加副本，依赖每个会话始终留在其原始 pod 上。
把会话状态迁移到已获批的共享 Redis 服务，并在该服务之后运行可互换的智能体副本。
在保持单副本的前提下，提高现有 pod 的 CPU 和内存限制。
用 init containers 定期把每个 pod 的内存会话字典复制到其他副本。
questions.e: Option B is correct because shared Redis lets any replica access the conversation state when requests reach a different pod. Option A still depends on a particular pod and can fail when it is replaced. Option C does not add horizontal capacity. Option D uses init containers, which do not continuously synchronize changing session data.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为共享 Redis 使任何副本在请求落到其他 pod 时也能访问会话状态。选项 A 仍然依赖特定 pod，一旦该 pod 被替换就可能失效。选项 C 并未增加横向容量。选项 D 使用 init containers，而它们无法持续同步不断变化的会话数据。

questions.q: Choose two deployment actions that best address the expected increase in concurrent sessions.
questions.qZh: 选两项最能应对并发会话预期增长的部署操作。
o: Add CPU-backed replicas of the agent API behind its existing Kubernetes Service.
Deploy additional NVIDIA NIM replicas on CPU-only nodes to increase model capacity.
Increase the agent API replica count and the NIM replica count by the same percentage.
Configure the agent API to scale independently while continuing to use the existing NIM service endpoint.
Direct client requests to individual agent pods so the Kubernetes Service does not add routing overhead.
oZh: 在其现有的 Kubernetes Service 后增加以 CPU 为支撑的 agent API 副本。
在仅有 CPU 的节点上部署额外的 NVIDIA NIM 副本，以提升模型容量。
按相同百分比同时增加 agent API 副本数和 NIM 副本数。
将 agent API 配置为独立扩缩容，同时继续使用现有的 NIM 服务端点。
把客户端请求直接指向各个 agent pod，以免 Kubernetes Service 增加路由开销。
questions.e: Options A and D are correct because the load test identifies agent API CPU as the constraint, while the existing NIM replicas have sufficient measured GPU capacity. Option B places NIM on nodes without GPUs. Option C scales the model tier without evidence that it needs more capacity. Option E bypasses the service and makes traffic distribution less reliable.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 D 正确，因为压测表明瓶颈在于 agent API 的 CPU，而现有 NIM 副本经实测具备足够的 GPU 容量。选项 B 把 NIM 部署在没有 GPU 的节点上。选项 C 在没有证据表明需要更多容量的情况下扩充了模型层。选项 E 绕过了服务，使流量分配更不可靠。

questions.q: Which decision policy minimizes expected total cost?
questions.qZh: 哪种决策策略能最小化期望总成本？
o: Replace the pump immediately without testing.
Run the diagnostic, replace the pump after a positive result, and continue operating after a negative result.
Continue operating without testing or replacing the pump.
Run the diagnostic and replace the pump regardless of its result.
oZh: 不做测试，直接立即更换水泵。
运行诊断检测，结果为阳性时更换水泵，结果为阴性时继续运行。
既不测试也不更换水泵，继续运行。
运行诊断检测，无论结果如何都更换水泵。
questions.e: Option B is correct because the diagnostic policy has an expected total cost of $1,100, including the test, repairs after positive results, and expected failure costs after negative results. Option A costs $1,600. Option C has an expected failure cost of $2,000. Option D adds the test cost to an unconditional replacement, for $1,900.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为该诊断策略的期望总成本为 1,100 美元，包含测试成本、阳性结果后的维修成本以及阴性结果下的期望故障成本。选项 A 的成本为 1,600 美元。选项 C 的期望故障成本为 2,000 美元。选项 D 在无条件更换的基础上再加上测试成本，总计 1,900 美元。

questions.q: Choose two. Which actions should the agent take when revising its diagnostic plan?
questions.qZh: 选择两项。智能体在修订其诊断计划时应采取哪些行动？
o: Keep the pump-failure assumption and test the pump motor first because it was the basis of the original plan.
Revise the plan to focus on causes downstream of the pump, given the reported observations.
Use the two available checks to examine the downstream valve and verify the pressure reading, which can distinguish likely causes.
Spend the first check recalibrating the inlet gauge, even though its reading is normal.
Present every possible diagnostic check without ordering them, so the desk can select a sequence later.
oZh: 保留泵故障的假设并优先测试泵电机，因为这是原计划的基础。
根据报告的观测结果，修订计划以聚焦于泵下游的原因。
利用可用的两项检查来检查下游阀门并验证压力读数，从而区分可能的原因。
将第一项检查用于重新校准入口压力表，尽管其读数正常。
列出所有可能的诊断检查但不做排序，以便服务台稍后选择执行顺序。
questions.e: Options B and C are correct because the reported observations weaken the pump-failure assumption, and the two checks can distinguish likely downstream causes within the stated limit. Option A retains an assumption contradicted by the observations. Option D spends a check on a gauge reported as normal. Option E provides no sequence for the constrained diagnostic plan.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 和 C 正确，因为报告的观测结果削弱了泵故障的假设，且这两项检查能在既定限制内区分可能的下游原因。选项 A 保留了一个与观测结果相矛盾的假设。选项 D 把一次检查用在了被报告为正常的压力表上。选项 E 未为受限的诊断计划提供执行顺序。

questions.q: Which ingestion approach best supports answers that combine equipment procedures with current asset values?
questions.qZh: 哪种摄取（ingestion）方式最有利于回答需要结合设备操作规程与当前资产价值的问题？
o: Convert every source into plain text, discard table structure, and create one embedding for each complete file.
Extract document text and tables, store asset values as structured records, and preserve shared identifiers and source metadata for retrieval.
Convert the manuals and inventory files into training examples so the model can recall their contents without retrieval.
Index the inventory file as a single passage and rely on the model to infer which row applies to each asset.
Create separate indexes for manuals and inventory records without retaining any keys that link an asset to its procedure.
oZh: 将每个来源转换为纯文本，丢弃表格结构，并为每个完整文件创建一个 embedding。
提取文档文本与表格，将资产值存储为结构化记录，并保留共享标识符和来源元数据以供检索。
将手册和库存文件转换为训练样本，使模型无需检索即可回忆其内容。
将库存文件索引为单一段落，并依赖模型推断哪一行适用于每个资产。
为手册和库存记录分别建立索引，但不保留将资产与其操作规程关联的任何键。
questions.e: Option B is correct because extracting tables as structured records and retaining shared asset identifiers lets retrieval connect each value to its procedure and source. Option A loses table relationships and makes whole files difficult to retrieve precisely. Option C relies on model recall rather than current source data. Option D obscures row-level values. Option E removes the link needed to join related information.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为将表格提取为结构化记录并保留共享的资产标识符，可以让检索把每个数值与其操作规程和来源关联起来。选项 A 丢失了表格关系，使整个文件难以精确检索。选项 C 依赖模型记忆而非当前的源数据。选项 D 掩盖了行级数值。选项 E 移除了关联相关信息所必需的连接。

questions.q: Choose two. Which data-handling changes best ensure that the agent interprets supplier measurements and dates correctly?
questions.qZh: 选择两项。哪些数据处理改动最能确保智能体正确解读供应商的度量值与日期？
o: Parse each feed using its documented locale and schema, then convert measurements and dates into typed canonical fields.
Treat all numeric-looking values as strings and compare them lexically to avoid conversion errors.
Retain each original value and unit alongside its normalized value and source identifier.
Assume every supplier uses the same decimal separator, date order, and measurement units.
Convert all measurements to a single unit but discard the original values and supplier details.
Infer date formats and units from nearby text whenever a feed does not match the expected format.
oZh: 按照各数据源文档说明中的 locale 和 schema 进行解析，然后将度量值和日期转换为带类型的规范化字段。
把所有看起来像数值的值都视为字符串，并按字典序比较，以避免转换错误。
在保留原始值和单位的同时，一并保留其规范化值与来源标识符。
假定所有供应商使用相同的小数分隔符、日期顺序和度量单位。
将所有度量值转换为单一单位，但丢弃原始值和供应商详情。
当数据源格式与预期不符时，从邻近文本中推断日期格式和单位。
questions.e: Options A and C are correct because explicit locale-aware parsing and typed normalization support accurate comparisons, while retaining original values, units, and source identifiers supports verification. Option B makes numeric comparisons unreliable. Option D assumes formats are uniform. Option E loses traceability. Option F can silently misinterpret ambiguous data.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 C 正确，因为显式的、感知 locale 的解析与带类型的规范化有助于准确比较，而保留原始值、单位和来源标识符则便于校验。选项 B 使数值比较不可靠。选项 D 假定格式统一。选项 E 丢失了可追溯性。选项 F 可能悄无声息地误解含义不明确的数据。

questions.q: Which NVIDIA platform best fits these requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪款 NVIDIA 平台最符合这些要求？
o: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin
NVIDIA IGX Orin
NVIDIA DGX H100
NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU
oZh: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin
NVIDIA IGX Orin
NVIDIA DGX H100
NVIDIA BlueField-3 DPU
questions.e: Option A is correct because Jetson AGX Orin is designed for embedded robotics and edge computing, matching the cart’s limited space and battery budget. Option B is aimed at industrial edge systems, not this compact mobile use. Option C is a rack-scale system, and Option D is a data processing unit, not the cart’s primary AI compute platform.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为 Jetson AGX Orin 专为嵌入式机器人和边缘计算而设计，符合该小车受限的空间和电池预算。选项 B 面向工业边缘系统，而非这种紧凑型移动场景。选项 C 是机架级系统，选项 D 是数据处理单元，两者都不是该小车的主要 AI 计算平台。

questions.q: Which two NVIDIA platform components best meet these requirements? Choose two.
questions.qZh: 哪两个 NVIDIA 平台组件最符合这些要求？选择两项。
o: NVIDIA NIM microservice for the selected foundation model, providing an optimized inference endpoint.
NVIDIA AI Enterprise software, providing an enterprise-supported platform for the AI workload.
NVIDIA NeMo framework, used to build or customize models before inference.
NVIDIA Isaac Sim, used to simulate robotics environments.
CUDA Toolkit, used to develop software that directly programs NVIDIA GPUs.
oZh: 用于所选基础模型的 NVIDIA NIM 微服务，提供优化的推理端点。
NVIDIA AI Enterprise 软件，为 AI 工作负载提供具备企业级支持的平台。
NVIDIA NeMo 框架，用于在推理之前构建或定制模型。
NVIDIA Isaac Sim，用于仿真机器人环境。
CUDA Toolkit，用于开发直接对 NVIDIA GPU 编程的软件。
questions.e: Options A and B are correct because the team needs a model inference endpoint and an enterprise-supported NVIDIA AI software platform. Option C is not needed because the team is not building or customizing a model. Option D supports robotics simulation, not this workload. Option E is aimed at GPU software development and is not required to use a NIM inference endpoint.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 B 正确，因为团队需要一个模型推理端点和一个具备企业级支持的 NVIDIA AI 软件平台。选项 C 并非必需，因为该团队并不构建或定制模型。选项 D 支持机器人仿真，而非本工作负载。选项 E 面向 GPU 软件开发，并非使用 NIM 推理端点所必需。

questions.q: Choose two operational actions that will best help the on-call engineer isolate the cause.
questions.qZh: 选择两项运维操作，最有助于值班工程师定位根本原因。
o: Filter OpenTelemetry traces for failed order-history tool spans and group them by endpoint and time.
Review model token counts to determine whether longer prompts caused the timeouts.
Compare order-history tool-span errors and latency with the service metrics for the same time period.
Restart all agent workers to clear any accumulated conversation state.
Increase the model context limit so the agent can retry tool calls more effectively.
Disable the order-history tool permanently and leave the agent running without it.
oZh: 筛选 OpenTelemetry trace 中失败的 order-history 工具 span，并按端点和时间对其分组。
查看模型的 token 计数，以判断是否是更长的提示词导致了超时。
将 order-history 工具 span 的错误与延迟，同一时间段内的服务指标进行对比。
重启所有智能体 worker，以清除累积的对话状态。
提高模型的上下文上限，使智能体能够更有效地重试工具调用。
永久禁用 order-history 工具，并在其缺失的情况下继续运行智能体。
questions.e: Options A and C are correct because trace details and matching service metrics can show whether failures cluster around the order-history call. Option B is not correct because stable model latency and token usage do not explain tool timeouts. Option D may disrupt service without locating the fault. Option E does not address the failing service. Option F removes required functionality.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 C 正确，因为 trace 详情与相应的服务指标能够显示故障是否集中在 order-history 调用附近。选项 B 不正确，因为稳定的模型延迟和 token 用量无法解释工具超时。选项 D 可能会干扰服务而无法定位故障。选项 E 未针对失败的服务采取行动。选项 F 移除了必需的功能。

questions.q: Which maintenance approach best limits disruption while meeting the audit requirement?
questions.qZh: 哪种维护方式在满足审计要求的同时能将干扰降到最低？
o: Create a replacement credential, update the managed secret, verify successful API calls, and then revoke the old credential.
Revoke the current credential first, then create a replacement and update the managed secret after the agent reports errors.
Create a replacement credential and leave both credentials active so the agent can continue using either one.
Copy the replacement credential into the agent configuration file and restart the service during the busiest period.
oZh: 创建替代凭据，更新托管的密钥，验证 API 调用成功，然后吊销旧凭据。
先吊销当前凭据，然后创建替代凭据，并在智能体报错后再更新托管的密钥。
创建替代凭据并让两个凭据同时保持有效，使智能体可以继续使用其中任意一个。
将替代凭据复制到智能体配置文件中，并在业务最繁忙的时段重启服务。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the service permits overlapping credentials, so the managed secret can be updated and verified before the old credential is revoked. Option B creates avoidable failures during the gap. Option C does not satisfy the requirement to revoke the old credential. Option D exposes the secret in configuration and adds an unnecessary restart during peak use.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为该服务允许凭据重叠使用，因此可以在吊销旧凭据之前更新并验证托管的密钥。选项 B 会在空档期内造成可避免的故障。选项 C 不满足吊销旧凭据的要求。选项 D 将密钥暴露在配置中，并在使用高峰期增加了不必要的重启。

questions.q: Which action should the company take before launch?
questions.qZh: 公司在上线前应采取哪项措施？
o: Establish a lawful basis and clear notice for the processing, minimize the personal data sent to the model, and confirm that processor and retention terms meet the company’s requirements.
Treat the model provider’s data-processing agreement as the lawful basis for using customer account histories.
Send the full account histories to the model, then remove identifying details from the generated responses.
Obtain consent from company employees because they operate the support agent.
oZh: 为数据处理确立合法依据并提供明确告知，最小化发送给模型的个人数据，并确认处理者条款和留存条款符合公司的要求。
将模型提供商的数据处理协议视为使用客户账户历史的合法依据。
将完整的账户历史发送给模型，然后从生成的回复中移除可识别身份的信息。
因为公司员工操作该客服智能体，就从公司员工处获取同意。
questions.e: Option A is correct because the company has no documented lawful basis, sends more account data than necessary, and has not confirmed suitable retention terms. Option B is not correct because a processor agreement does not establish the controller’s lawful basis. Option C is not correct because removing details after processing does not protect the data already sent. Option D is not correct because employees cannot consent on behalf of customers.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为该公司没有记录在案的合法依据，发送了超出必要范围的账户数据，也未确认合适的留存条款。选项 B 不正确，因为处理者协议并不能确立控制者的合法依据。选项 C 不正确，因为处理之后再删除信息无法保护已经发送出去的数据。选项 D 不正确，因为员工无法代表客户作出同意。

questions.q: Choose two steps that best address the ethical and legal risk before approval.
questions.qZh: 选择两项在批准前最能应对伦理与法律风险的措施。
o: Compare recommendation outcomes across protected groups using appropriately governed audit data, and investigate any disparities.
Remove fields explicitly naming protected characteristics and treat that change alone as proof that the recommendations are fair.
Document the legitimate reasons for the pricing factors and assess whether address-derived or other proxy features create unjustified disparities.
Use aggregate prediction accuracy as the sole evidence that the pricing recommendations do not discriminate.
Delete recommendation records immediately after generation so that the company does not retain evidence of possible disparities.
oZh: 使用管理得当的审计数据比较各受保护群体之间的推荐结果差异，并调查任何不平等现象。
删除明确标注受保护特征的字段，并仅凭这一改动就认定推荐是公平的。
记录定价因素的正当理由，并评估源自地址或其他代理特征是否会造成不合理的不平等。
以整体预测准确率作为定价推荐不存在歧视的唯一证据。
在生成后立即删除推荐记录，使公司不保留可能存在不平等的证据。
questions.e: Options A and C are correct because group-level review can reveal unequal outcomes, while examining proxy features and documenting their rationale addresses a specific source of unfair pricing. Option B is not correct because other features can act as proxies. Option D is not correct because aggregate accuracy does not establish nondiscrimination. Option E is not correct because deleting records prevents a meaningful compliance review.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 C 正确，因为群体层面的审查可以揭示结果不均，而检查代理特征并记录其理由则针对不公平定价的一个具体来源。选项 B 不正确，因为其他特征也可能充当代理变量。选项 D 不正确，因为整体准确率不能证明不存在歧视。选项 E 不正确，因为删除记录会使合规审查失去意义。

questions.q: Which interaction design best meets these requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪种交互设计最符合这些要求？
o: Keep refunds above $250 pending, show the proposed amount and case details, and let the adjuster approve, edit, or reject the proposal before payment.
Issue every proposed refund immediately and provide the adjuster with an audit log afterward.
Show the adjuster a complete transcript of the agent's internal reasoning and let the payment proceed automatically.
Send every refund to the adjuster for approval, regardless of amount.
oZh: 对超过 $250 的退款保持待处理状态，显示建议金额和案件详情，并让理赔员在付款前批准、修改或驳回该建议。
立即执行每笔建议退款，之后再向理赔员提供审计日志。
向理赔员展示智能体内部推理的完整记录，并让付款自动进行。
无论金额大小，将每笔退款都提交给理赔员审批。
questions.e: Option A is correct because refunds above $250 remain pending while the adjuster reviews the amount and case details, then approves, edits, or rejects the proposal. Option B is not correct because a post-action log cannot provide pre-action review. Option C is not correct because raw internal reasoning is not a reliable decision aid. Option D is not correct because routing routine refunds for approval violates the stated threshold and burdens the limited review queue.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为超过 $250 的退款在理赔员审阅金额和案件详情之前保持待处理状态，随后由理赔员批准、修改或驳回该建议。选项 B 不正确，因为事后日志无法提供事前审查。选项 C 不正确，因为原始的内部推理不是可靠的决策依据。选项 D 不正确，因为将常规退款也送审违反了既定阈值，并加重了有限的审核队列负担。

questions.q: Choose two interface features that best support technician oversight.
questions.qZh: 选择两项最能支持技术人员监督的界面功能。
o: Mark uncertain observations and show the equipment-record details that support each proposed check.
Show only the assistant's final diagnosis to keep the tablet display brief.
Run the proposed checks automatically unless a technician cancels them.
Let the technician edit, skip, or stop a proposed check before the assistant continues.
Send a notification for each new observation, but do not provide controls to change the proposed checks.
Require the technician to re-enter the equipment history before viewing each recommendation.
oZh: 标记不确定的观察结果，并显示支撑每项建议检查的设备记录详情。
仅显示助手的最终诊断，以保持平板显示简洁。
自动执行建议的检查，除非技术人员取消它们。
允许技术人员在助手继续之前编辑、跳过或终止某项建议检查。
针对每项新的观察结果发送通知，但不提供修改建议检查的控制手段。
要求技术人员在查看每条建议之前重新录入设备历史。
questions.e: Options A and D are correct because they expose uncertain observations and let technicians change or stop a proposed check before the agent continues. Option B is not correct because hiding evidence blocks informed review. Option C is not correct because automatic execution removes intervention. Option E sends alerts without decision control, and Option F forces technicians to re-enter history instead of reviewing the proposal.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 D 正确，因为它们会呈现不确定的观察结果，并允许技术人员在智能体继续之前修改或终止某项建议检查。选项 B 不正确，因为隐藏证据会阻碍知情审查。选项 C 不正确，因为自动执行剥夺了干预手段。选项 E 只发送告警而没有决策控制，选项 F 则强制技术人员重新录入历史，而不是审查建议。

questions.q: When evaluating an agent’s degrading response times under increasing load, which analysis approach most effectively identifies scalability bottlenecks and optimization opportunities?
questions.qZh: 在评估智能体在负载增加时响应时间的退化时，哪种分析方法最能有效识别可扩展性瓶颈和优化机会？
o: Track average response time while examining stage-by-stage processing metrics, resource usage trends, and potential components impacting scalability.
Test at fixed, low load levels while using controlled stress scenarios to compare with performance under production-like traffic patterns.
Profile each major system stage using distributed tracing, analyze GPU utilization with NVIDIA performance tools, and map queuing delays against varying workload patterns.
Focus on model inference duration while also measuring preprocessing time, tool-calling latency, and response formatting in the end-to-end pipeline.
oZh: 跟踪平均响应时间，同时考察各阶段的处理指标、资源使用趋势以及可能影响可扩展性的组件。
在固定的低负载水平下进行测试，同时使用受控的压力场景与类生产流量模式下的性能进行对比。
使用分布式追踪对每个主要系统阶段进行性能分析，使用 NVIDIA 性能工具分析 GPU 利用率，并将排队延迟与不同的工作负载模式进行映射分析。
关注模型推理时长，同时测量端到端流水线中的预处理时间、工具调用延迟和响应格式化开销。
questions.e: Distributed tracing plus GPU profiling shows where load creates queueing, memory pressure, or blocked tool calls. Average response time alone hides the bottleneck. From an NVIDIA systems-engineering lens, Option C aligns with the way agentic services should be decomposed and measured. The selected option specifically C states “Profile each major system stage using distributed tracing, analyze GPU utilization with NVIDIA performance tools, and map queuing delays against varying workload patterns.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. The practical pattern is trajectory-level evaluation, distributed tracing, task-completion metrics, latency breakdowns, and regression gates. The NVIDIA implementation angle is not cosmetic here: NeMo Evaluator and agentic metrics focus on trajectories and goal completion, not only the fluency of the last response. The distractors fail because manual spot checks are useful but cannot replace regression tests across query classes, temporal drift, and tool failure modes. This is exactly where NVIDIA’s stack is strongest: separating acceleration, orchestration, policy, and observability.
questions.eZh: 分布式追踪加上 GPU 性能分析可以显示负载在何处造成排队、内存压力或被阻塞的工具调用。仅看平均响应时间会掩盖瓶颈。从 NVIDIA 系统工程的视角看，选项 C 与智能体化服务应当被拆分和度量的方式相符。所选选项具体为 C，其表述是“使用分布式追踪对每个主要系统阶段进行性能分析，使用 NVIDIA 性能工具分析 GPU 利用率，并将排队延迟与不同的工作负载模式进行映射分析。”，这与运维需求本身相符，而不仅仅是表面措辞的匹配。实际采用的模式是轨迹级评估、分布式追踪、任务完成指标、延迟分解以及回归门禁。NVIDIA 的实现视角在这里并非表面功夫：NeMo Evaluator 和智能体化指标关注的是轨迹与目标完成情况，而不只是最后一条回复的流畅度。干扰项之所以不合格，是因为人工抽查虽有用，但无法替代跨查询类别、时间漂移和工具失效模式的回归测试。这正是 NVIDIA 技术栈最擅长的领域：把加速、编排、策略与可观测性分离开来。

questions.q: You are building a customer-support chatbot that fetches user account data from an external billing API. During testing, the API sometimes returns timeouts or 500 errors. You want the agent to be resilient-retrying when appropriate but failing gracefully if the service is down. Which strategy best handles intermittent failures in API calls while still ensuring a good user experience?
questions.qZh: 你正在构建一个客服聊天机器人，它需要从外部计费 API 获取用户账户数据。测试期间，该 API 偶尔返回超时或 500 错误。你希望智能体在适当时能够弹性重试，但在服务宕机时能够优雅失败。哪种策略在处理 API 调用的间歇性故障的同时还能保证良好的用户体验？
o: Retry requests with a consistent short delay after each failure and notify the user as each retry takes place.
Implement exponential-backoff retries with a circuit breaker, and return a clear message to the user if all retries fail.
Return a standard fallback message on failures to maintain conversation flow and reduce the risk of service interruptions for the user.
Schedule retries using a fixed delay for all failure types, maintaining predictable timing and user notifications after each attempt.
oZh: 每次失败后以固定的短延迟重试请求，并在每次重试发生时通知用户。
实现带熔断器的指数退避重试，并在所有重试都失败时向用户返回明确的消息。
失败时返回标准的兜底消息，以维持对话流程并降低用户遭遇服务中断的风险。
对所有故障类型都使用固定延迟调度重试，保持可预测的时间安排，并在每次尝试后通知用户。
questions.e: The high-value engineering move is wrappers that convert messy external services into stable functions with bounded latency and predictable failure semantics. The best answer is Option B when the design is judged by reliability, latency budget, auditability, and maintainability rather than demo simplicity. Exponential backoff plus a circuit breaker prevents retry storms and gives users a graceful failure path. Fixed retries can amplify downstream outages. The stack-level anchor is clear: tool execution should sit behind adapters that can be profiled and regression-tested just like retrieval and inference services. The selected option specifically B states “Implement exponential-backoff retries with a circuit breaker, and return a clear message to the user if all retries fail.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. The rejected options are weaker because hardcoded endpoints, loose parsers, or monolithic handlers turn every API change into an application release and hide failures from observability. Anything less would make the agent fragile when traffic, schemas, policies, or user behavior shift.
questions.eZh: 高价值的工程做法是用包装器把杂乱的外部服务转换成延迟有界、失败语义可预测的稳定函数。当以可靠性、延迟预算、可审计性和可维护性而非演示简洁性来评判设计时，最佳答案是选项 B。指数退避加熔断器可以防止重试风暴，并为用户提供优雅的失败路径。固定的重试可能放大下游故障。技术栈层面的要点很明确：工具执行应当位于适配器之后，这些适配器可以像检索服务和推理服务一样被性能剖析和回归测试。所选选项具体为 B，其表述是“实现带熔断器的指数退避重试，并在所有重试都失败时向用户返回明确的消息。”，这与运维需求本身相符，而不仅仅是表面措辞的匹配。被否决的选项更弱，因为硬编码的端点、宽松的解析器或单体式的处理逻辑会让每次 API 变更都变成一次应用发布，并把故障从可观测性中隐藏起来。任何次优选择都会在流量、schema、策略或用户行为发生变化时使智能体变得脆弱。

questions.q: In a global financial firm, an AI Architect is building a multi-agent compliance assistant using an agentic AI framework. The system must manage short-term memory for multi-turn interactions and long-term memory for persistent user and policy context. It should enable contextual recall and adaptation across sessions using NVIDIA’s tool stack. Which architectural approach best supports these requirements?
questions.qZh: 在一家全球性金融机构中，AI 架构师正在使用智能体化 AI 框架构建一个多智能体合规助手。该系统必须为多轮交互管理短期记忆，并为持久的用户与策略上下文管理长期记忆。它应能够借助 NVIDIA 的工具栈实现跨会话的上下文召回与适配。哪种架构方案最能支撑这些需求？
o: Leverage NVIDIA NeMo Framework with modular memory management, integrating conversational state tracking, knowledge graphs, and vector store retrieval, while using LoRA-tuned models to adapt responses overtime.

Leverage RAPIDS cuDF for memory tracking by streaming multi-turn conversation logs as GPU-resident data frames, assuming transactional history can be recalled and reasoned over using dataframe operations.
Rely exclusively on TensorRT to encode all prior knowledge into compiled model weights, allowing inference-only execution with no external memory dependencies across sessions.
Leverage NVIDIA Triton Inference Server with dynamic batching to cache session-level inputs between inference calls, and use an external Redis store for long-term memory.
oZh: 采用 NVIDIA NeMo Framework 并结合模块化的记忆管理，集成对话状态跟踪、知识图谱和向量存储检索，同时使用 LoRA 微调的模型随时间适配响应。
采用 RAPIDS cuDF 进行记忆跟踪，将多轮对话日志以驻留 GPU 的 dataframe 形式流式处理，并假定可以通过 dataframe 操作来召回和推理事务历史。
完全依赖 TensorRT 将所有先验知识编码进已编译的模型权重，从而以纯推理方式执行，跨会话不依赖任何外部记忆。
采用 NVIDIA Triton Inference Server 的动态批处理在推理调用之间缓存会话级输入，并使用外部 Redis 存储作为长期记忆。
questions.e: Compliance assistants need both ephemeral turn state and durable policy/user context. NeMo plus vector/graph memory is a better fit than pretending TensorRT stores historical knowledge. That matters because separate short-term context for the current task and long-term memory for preferences, history, and durable domain facts. The selected option specifically A states “Leverage NVIDIA NeMo Framework with modular memory management, integrating conversational state tracking, knowledge graphs, and vector store retrieval, while using LoRA-tuned models to adapt responses overtime.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. Option A wins because it optimizes the system boundary around the risky component rather than hoping the base model behaves consistently. The alternatives would look simpler in a prototype, but fine-tuning alone cannot store frequently changing facts, and RAG alone does not train better habitual behavior. The NVIDIA implementation angle is not cosmetic here: NeMo-style training and retrieval workflows distinguish learned behavior from recallable enterprise knowledge. The result is a system that can be benchmarked, traced, and revised without destabilizing the whole agent fabric.
questions.eZh: 合规助手既需要短暂易逝的轮次状态，也需要持久的策略/用户上下文。相比假装 TensorRT 能存储历史知识，NeMo 加上向量/图记忆是更合适的方案。这一点很重要：要为当前任务区分短期上下文，为偏好、历史和持久领域事实区分长期记忆。所选选项具体为 A，其表述是“采用 NVIDIA NeMo Framework 并结合模块化的记忆管理，集成对话状态跟踪、知识图谱和向量存储检索，同时使用 LoRA 微调的模型随时间适配响应。”，这与运维需求本身相符，而不仅仅是表面措辞的匹配。选项 A 胜出，是因为它围绕风险组件来优化系统边界，而不是寄希望于基座模型表现稳定。替代方案在原型中看起来更简单，但仅靠微调无法存储频繁变化的事实，仅靠 RAG 也无法训练出更好的习惯性行为。NVIDIA 的实现视角在这里并非表面功夫：NeMo 式的训练与检索工作流把学到的行为与可召回的企业知识区分开来。最终得到的是一个可以基准测试、追踪和修订，而不会动摇整个智能体网络（agent fabric）的系统。

questions.q: Your support agent frequently fails to complete tasks when third-party tools return unexpected formats. Which solution improves resilience against these failures?
questions.qZh: 当第三方工具返回意外格式时，你的支持智能体经常无法完成任务。哪种方案能提升对这些故障的韧性？
o: Add robust schema validation and exception handling for all tool outputs
Use deterministic temperature settings for all generations
Reduce the number of tools available to avoid bad integrations
Re-train the model to avoid the use of third-party tools entirely
oZh: 为所有工具输出添加健壮的 schema 校验和异常处理
对所有生成使用确定性的 temperature 设置
减少可用工具数量以避免不良集成
重新训练模型以完全避免使用第三方工具
questions.e: At production scale, Option A preserves separability between reasoning, state, tools, and runtime operations. The selected option specifically A states “Add robust schema validation and exception handling for all tool outputs”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. Schema validation and exception handling make unexpected tool outputs explicit. Reducing tools or retraining does not fix bad payload handling. Operationally, the design depends on a plugin-style execution layer that keeps external systems outside the model while still letting the agent invoke them deterministically. For a production build, a production NVIDIA deployment can put tool latency, errors, and schema validation into traces, then tune the workflow without changing the foundation model. The losing choices mostly optimize for short-term convenience; static or unvalidated integration choices cannot withstand transient outages, rate limits, malformed responses, or schema drift. It also creates clean evidence for audits, incident review, and root-cause analysis when behavior drifts. questions.q: What benefits does a Kubernetes deployment offer over Slurm?

o: Clear memory after each interaction and reset session state, removing historical context needed for personalized tasks to identify optimization opportunities.
Profile memory access patterns by measuring retrieval latency, relevance scoring accuracy, and storage efficiency while monitoring context window utilization to identify optimization opportunities.
Use fixed memory allocation including all conversation types, topic changes, and user needs, allowing adaptive-free observation of interaction patterns to identify optimization opportunities.

Implement sliding window analysis comparing context compression strategies, summarization quality, and information preservation rates across varying conversation lengths to identify optimization opportunities.

Store all conversation history including all interactions, allowing adaptive-free observation of data to identify optimization opportunities. B, D At production scale, the combination of Options B and D preserves separability between reasoning, state, tools, and runtime operations. Memory degradation is measured through retrieval latency, relevance, compression quality, and preserved facts over long sessions. Clearing memory only destroys the signal. The high-value engineering move is separate short-term context for the current task and long-term memory for preferences, history, and durable domain facts. Together, B states “Profile memory access patterns by measuring retrieval latency, relevance scoring accuracy, and storage efficiency while monitoring context window utilization to identify optimization opportunities.”; D states “Implement sliding window analysis comparing context compression strategies, summarization quality, and information preservation rates across varying conversation lengths to identify optimization opportunities.”, so the answer covers both sides of the requirement instead of solving only the model or only the infrastructure layer. Kubernetes orchestration with Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) D, E Together, D states “Containerized deployment with NIM (NVIDIA Inference Microservices)”; E states “Kubernetes orchestration with Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA)”, so the answer covers both sides of the requirement instead of solving only the model or only the infrastructure layer. questions.q: Which two validation approaches are MOST critical for ensuring agent reliability in production deployments? (Choose two.)
questions.qZh: 在生产部署中确保智能体可靠运行时，哪两种验证方式最为关键？（选择两项）
o: User satisfaction surveys as the primary quality metric
Performance testing during development phases
Structured output validation with Pydantic schemas
Random sampling of agent interactions for manual review

Automated consistency checking across multiple agent runs C, E Together, C states “Structured output validation with Pydantic schemas”; E states “Automated consistency checking across multiple agent runs”, so the answer covers both sides of the requirement instead of solving only the model or only the infrastructure layer. Pydantic-style structured validation catches malformed outputs; consistency checks detect nondeterministic behavior across runs. Surveys are secondary quality signals. the combination of Options C and E wins because it optimizes the system boundary around the risky component rather than hoping the base model behaves consistently. The NVIDIA implementation angle is not cosmetic here: NVIDIA evaluation tooling emphasizes whole-agent behavior, including tool selection order, final outcome quality, throughput, latency, and traceability. That matters because closed-loop evaluation where benchmark results, user feedback, and parameter changes are versioned together. That is why the other options are traps: looking only at speed can reward broken behavior, while looking only at accuracy can ignore cost and reliability failures. The result is a system that can be benchmarked, traced, and revised without destabilizing the whole agent fabric.

在开发阶段进行性能测试

Analyze logs of tool usage frequency and error rates during inference
Compare average prompt length over time to analyze common input patterns

The losing choices mostly optimize for short-term convenience; offline benchmarks alone cannot expose live API failures, schema drift, queue saturation, or feedback-driven dissatisfaction. This choice gives engineering teams the knobs they need for continuous tuning after deployment.

The company wants to optimize costs while maintaining service quality across all query types. Which approach would provide the MOST cost-optimized scaling strategy for this variable-workload, mixed-complexity environment?

o: Deploy specialized NVIDIA NIM microservices using a single large model configuration that handles all agent functions on high-capacity GPUs, with auto-scaling infrastructure that maintains constant resource allocation across all traffic patterns.

Deploy specialized NVIDIA NIM microservices on CPU-optimized infrastructure with auto-scaling capabilities to minimize hardware costs, while accepting longer inference times for cost optimization benefits.

Deploy specialized NVIDIA NIM microservices with an LLM router to dynamically route requests to appropriate models based on complexity, combined with auto-scaling infrastructure that scales different model types independently.

Deploy multiple specialized NVIDIA NIM microservices with identical high-capacity models across all available GPUs, implementing auto-scaling infrastructure without request complexity differentiation or dynamic model selection capabilities. C The selected option specifically C states “Deploy specialized NVIDIA NIM microservices with an LLM router to dynamically route requests to appropriate models based on complexity, combined with auto-scaling infrastructure that scales different model types independently.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. The decisive point is failure isolation: Option C keeps the agent’s decision path observable instead of burying behavior inside one prompt or one service. The runtime should therefore be built around independent scaling of agent components so embeddings, reranking, reasoning, and guardrails do not share one rigid capacity pool. Routing simple FAQs to cheaper models and complex reasoning to stronger models is the cost/performance sweet spot. Independent scaling avoids overprovisioning every agent tier. That is why the other options are traps: CPU-only or memory-only scaling signals rarely capture the saturation profile of GPU-backed LLM inference. The stack-level anchor is clear: NIM microservices and the NIM Operator fit Kubernetes production operations; Triton provides serving primitives and Prometheus-exportable inference metrics for GPUs and models. The answer is therefore about engineered control planes, not simply model capability.

questions.q: An AI Engineer at an automotive company is developing an inventory restocking assistant for parts that must plan reordering of parts over multiple days, factoring in stock levels, predicted demand, and supplier lead time. o: Reinforcement learning sequence model using only a custom PyTorch Decision Transformer
Rule-based reorder strategy with fixed thresholds implemented via NVIDIA Triton Inference Server
Hybrid supervised/RL-trained model using NeMo-Aligner for policy alignment

Reinforcement learning sequence model such as NVIDIA’S NeMo-RL framework D The high-value engineering move is measuring queue time, compute time, execution count, and memory pressure instead of guessing from average response time. For this scenario, Option D is defensible because it exposes the control plane that a senior engineer can test, scale, and harden. Restocking is sequential decision-making with delayed rewards. NeMo-RL-style training can optimize policies over multi-day consequences rather than fixed thresholds. Within the NVIDIA stack, Triton’s metrics make GPU and model behavior visible enough to correlate batching efficiency with user-facing latency. The selected option specifically D states “Reinforcement learning sequence model such as NVIDIA’S NeMo-RL framework”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. The rejected options are weaker because tuning one component in isolation or relying on FP32/default settings leaves GPU memory bandwidth, batching windows, and queuing delay unmanaged. Anything less would make the agent fragile when traffic, schemas, policies, or user behavior shift. Which approach is most effective for achieving robust and scalable deployment of an agentic AI system in production?
questions.qZh: 某公司计划上线一个需要同时服务数千名用户的多智能体系统。团队需要确保系统在需求增长时保持可靠、高效扩展，并以具成本效益的方式运行。对于在生产环境中实现智能体化 AI 系统稳健且可扩展的部署，哪种方案最为有效？
o: Running agents without load balancing to reduce infrastructure complexity and achieve robust and scalable deployment of an agentic system
Establishing a continuous monitoring framework to track system performance and adapt resources as usage patterns evolve
Deploying all agents on a single server with ongoing performance monitoring to maximize hardware utilization

Orchestrating agents using containerization platforms, combined with load balancing and ongoing performance monitoring D The best answer is Option D when the design is judged by reliability, latency budget, auditability, and maintainability rather than demo simplicity. The stack-level anchor is clear: NVIDIA AI Enterprise deployments typically combine optimized containers, GPU Operator/DCGM visibility, and Kubernetes-native lifecycle management. The selected option specifically D states “Orchestrating agents using containerization platforms, combined with load balancing and ongoing performance monitoring”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. Container orchestration plus load balancing and monitoring creates a resilient serving plane. A single server may maximize utilization until it becomes the outage domain. The high-value engineering move is containerized services, HPA/cluster autoscaling, GPU-aware scheduling, health probes, rolling updates, and metric-driven capacity control. The distractors fail because bare-metal scripts can benchmark well once but are weak for failover, rollback, capacity changes, and fleet observability. Anything less would make the agent fragile when traffic, schemas, policies, or user behavior shift. GPU-aware scheduling and service-level metrics are essential because CPU utilization rarely predicts LLM inference saturation.

o: Integrating MLOps practices for continuous deployment and rapid model updates in production environments
Designing a distributed system architecture with multi-region deployment, automated failover, and dynamic resource allocation
Implementing containerization with Docker to simplify deployment and streamline updates

Using hardware profiling to optimize agent workloads for efficient GPU utilization across all deployed instances B A global user base requires regional placement, failover, and dynamic allocation. Docker alone packages the app; it does not solve cross-region availability. The correct implementation surface is separate scalable inference services with load balancing, readiness checks, and resource policies tied to latency and GPU metrics. The selected option specifically B states “Designing a distributed system architecture with multi-region deployment, automated failover, and dynamic resource allocation”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. In a GPU-backed agent deployment, Option B maps closest to how the NVIDIA stack expects orchestration, inference, and control policies to be separated. The alternatives would look simpler in a prototype, but placing all roles on the same large model wastes GPU budget and makes simple requests pay the cost of complex reasoning. This lines up with NVIDIA guidance because Triton can expose request and GPU metrics while Kubernetes policies translate those signals into scheduling and autoscaling decisions. This choice gives engineering teams the knobs they need for continuous tuning after deployment.

questions.q: You are designing the architecture for a RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) system, and you are concerned about ensuring data freshness and minimizing latency. Which of the following is the most important consideration when designing the architecture?
questions.qZh: 你正在为一个 RAG（检索增强生成）系统设计架构，并关注如何保证数据新鲜度和尽量降低延迟。在设计该架构时，以下哪一项是最重要的考量因素？
o: Employing a consolidated architecture with a large service handling all data retrieval and LLM interaction. This ensures consistent performance and simplifies debugging.
Using a synchronous, block-level approach, where the LLM continuously monitors the database for updates and retrieves the entire dataset with each prompt.
Implementing a single, centralized database for all data, updated with a synchronous polling mechanism for the LLM to retrieve the latest information.

Use a loosely coupled, event-driven micro-service architecture where separate services handle data indexing, retrieval, and LLM prompting. D The rejected options are weaker because stuffing raw chunks into prompts or relying on model priors makes answers stale, irreproducible, and difficult to debug. Event-driven microservices separate ingestion, indexing, retrieval, and generation. That is the path to fresh data with low latency and maintainable updates. The architecture implied by Option D is the one that survives real workloads: separate responsibilities, explicit contracts, and measurable runtime behavior. The selected option specifically D states “Use a loosely coupled, event-driven micro-service architecture where separate services handle data indexing, retrieval, and LLM prompting.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. In NVIDIA terms, RAG quality depends on data handling as much as generation; vector retrieval and reranking must be validated with their own metrics. The correct implementation surface is query transformation and fusion before generation so the model receives evidence-rich context rather than one brittle keyword match. This choice gives engineering teams the knobs they need for continuous tuning after deployment.
oZh: 采用整合式架构，由一个大型服务处理所有数据检索与大语言模型交互。这可确保性能一致并简化调试。

questions.q: When implementing security measures for enterprise agentic systems using NVIDIA’S NeMo Guardrails, which approach provides the most comprehensive protection?
questions.qZh: 在使用 NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails 为企业级智能体化系统实施安全措施时，哪种方案能够提供最全面的保护？
o: Input sanitization at the user interface level
Multi-layered guardrails with content moderation, output filtering, and behavioral monitoring
Rule-based content filtering with predefined patterns

User authentication and authorization controls B Enterprise protection needs layered rails: content moderation, output filtering, behavior monitoring, and policy enforcement. Authentication alone controls users, not generated behavior. The practical pattern is interfaces that show recommendations, evidence, risk drivers, and immediate accept/modify/reject actions. The selected option specifically B states “Multi-layered guardrails with content moderation, output filtering, and behavioral monitoring”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. In a GPU-backed agent deployment, Option B maps closest to how the NVIDIA stack expects orchestration, inference, and control policies to be separated. The alternatives would look simpler in a prototype, but high-level summaries without drill-down prevent experts from verifying whether the recommendation is grounded. This lines up with NVIDIA guidance because NVIDIA-style production governance pairs guardrails and observability with user-facing controls so interventions are traceable. This is exactly where NVIDIA’s stack is strongest: separating acceleration, orchestration, policy, and observability. Human review must be designed into the workflow rather than added as an after-the-fact manual workaround.
oZh: 在用户界面层面进行输入净化
多层护栏，涵盖内容审核、输出过滤和行为监控
基于规则的、配合预定义模式的内容过滤

用户身份认证与授权控制 B 企业级保护需要分层的护栏：内容审核、输出过滤、行为监控和策略执行。仅靠身份认证管控的是用户，而不是生成的行为。实用的模式是提供这样的界面：展示建议、证据、风险因素，并提供即时的接受/修改/拒绝操作。具体来说，所选项 B 为“多层护栏，涵盖内容审核、输出过滤和行为监控”，它契合的是运维需求而非字面上的措辞匹配。在 GPU 支撑的智能体部署中，选项 B 最贴近 NVIDIA 技术栈对编排、推理与控制策略相分离的预期。其他选项在原型阶段看起来更简单，但只有高层摘要而无法下钻，会让专家无法核实建议是否有据可依。这与 NVIDIA 的指导一致，因为 NVIDIA 风格的生产治理会把护栏与可观测性同面向用户的控制手段结合起来，使干预措施可追溯。这正是 NVIDIA 技术栈的强项所在：把加速、编排、策略和可观测性分离开来。人工复核必须被设计进工作流，而不是事后添加的手工变通方案。

questions.q: When evaluating GPU utilization inefficiencies in deploying Llama Nemotron models across A100 and H100 clusters, which approaches help identify optimal resource allocation strategies? (Choose two.)
questions.qZh: 在评估 Llama Nemotron 模型跨 A100 与 H100 集群部署时的 GPU 利用率低效问题时，哪些方法有助于确定最优的资源分配策略？（选择两项）
o: Allow Nemotron variants to profile actual workload characteristics and allocate resources based on observed demands.
Profile resource utilization for each Nemotron variant and match models to appropriate GPU tiers.
Allocate all agents to Hl00 GPUs, allowing resource profiles to automatically adjust for model size and computational requirements.

Assess concurrent execution capabilities by employing multi-instance GPU partitioning for varying workload types. B, D The decisive point is failure isolation: the combination of Options B and D keeps the agent’s decision path observable instead of burying behavior inside one prompt or one service. Together, B states “Profile resource utilization for each Nemotron variant and match models to appropriate GPU tiers.”; D states “Assess concurrent execution capabilities by employing multi-instance GPU partitioning for varying workload types.”, so the answer covers both sides of the requirement instead of solving only the model or only the infrastructure layer. Profiling each Nemotron variant and using MIG/concurrent execution where appropriate gives resource fit. Sending every workload to H100s wastes premium capacity. The runtime should therefore be built around matching model precision, batch windows, model instances, and GPU memory behavior to the latency service-level objective. The stack-level anchor is clear: TensorRT-LLM and NIM reduce inference overhead, but they still need serving-level tuning to avoid queue buildup under concurrency. The losing choices mostly optimize for short-term convenience; hardware upgrades alone do not fix poor batching, serial ensembles, guardrail overhead, or KV-cache pressure. The answer is therefore about engineered control planes, not simply model capability.
oZh: 让 Nemotron 各变体对真实工作负载特性进行性能剖析，并依据观测到的需求分配资源。
对每个 Nemotron 变体进行资源利用率剖析，并将模型与合适的 GPU 层级相匹配。
将所有智能体都分配到 H100 GPU 上，让资源画像能根据模型规模和计算需求自动调整。

通过采用多实例 GPU 分区来评估并发执行能力，以应对不同的工作负载类型。 B、D 决定性的一点在于故障隔离：选项 B 与 D 的组合让智能体的决策路径保持可观测，而不是把行为埋进一个 prompt 或一个服务之中。合起来看，B 项为“对每个 Nemotron 变体进行资源利用率剖析，并将模型与合适的 GPU 层级相匹配。”；D 项为“通过采用多实例 GPU 分区来评估并发执行能力，以应对不同的工作负载类型。”，因此该答案同时覆盖了需求的两方面，而不是只解决模型层或只解决基础设施层。对每个 Nemotron 变体做剖析，并在合适之处使用 MIG/并发执行，才能实现资源与负载的匹配。把所有工作负载都发往 H100 会浪费高端容量。因此，运行时应当围绕模型精度、批处理窗口、模型实例数以及 GPU 内存行为与延迟服务级别目标的匹配来构建。技术栈层面的锚点很清晰：TensorRT-LLM 和 NIM 能降低推理开销，但仍需在服务层做调优，以避免高并发下的队列积压。落选的选项大多是在优化短期便利性；仅靠硬件升级无法解决糟糕的批处理、串行集成、护栏开销或 KV cache 压力。因此，答案关乎经过工程化设计的控制平面，而不仅仅是模型能力。

questions.q: You are building an agent that performs financial analysis by retrieving and processing structured data from a client’s internal SQL database. The agent must handle occasional connection errors and retry the query up to a few times before failing gracefully. Which approach best meets these requirements?
questions.qZh: 你正在构建一个通过从客户内部 SQL 数据库检索并处理结构化数据来执行金融分析的智能体。该智能体必须处理偶发的连接错误，并在优雅失败之前最多重试几次查询。哪种方案最符合这些要求？
o: Use structured tool calls with built-in retry handling and timed delays inside the tool wrapper
Use few-shot prompting to guide the agent’s conversation flow and manually retry failed API responses
Use a reactive agent pattern that retries the query after a user confirms a retry attempt

Use memory to track the number of failed attempts and apply it in later retries A A tool wrapper is the right place for retry count, delays, and graceful failure. Prompting the model to retry manually is unreliable engineering. Option A fits the operating model because the problem describes an agent that must remain adaptive under changing inputs and infrastructure conditions. The selected option specifically A states “Use structured tool calls with built-in retry handling and timed delays inside the tool wrapper”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. The durable control mechanism is schema-bound tool invocation, typed parameters, timeout envelopes, retry policy, and traceable function execution. This lines up with NVIDIA guidance because the Agent Toolkit model is to expose tools as reusable workflow components; that is what makes multi-tool agents testable under schema changes. The distractors fail because embedding tools inside the agent loop makes security review, timeout handling, and version control unnecessarily difficult. For certification purposes, read the question as asking for controlled autonomy, not raw LLM creativity.
oZh: 使用带内置重试处理和定时延迟的结构化工具调用，并把这些逻辑放在工具封装层内
使用少样本提示引导智能体的对话流程，并手动重试失败的 API 响应
使用反应式智能体模式，在用户确认重试尝试后再重试查询

使用记忆来跟踪失败尝试的次数，并在后续重试中应用 A 工具封装层是放置重试次数、延迟和优雅失败的正确位置。让模型自行提示重试并不是可靠的工程做法。选项 A 契合这种运作模式，因为问题描述的是一个必须在输入和基础设施条件变化时保持适应性的智能体。具体来说，所选项 A 为“使用带内置重试处理和定时延迟的结构化工具调用，并把这些逻辑放在工具封装层内”，它契合的是运维需求而非字面上的措辞匹配。持久有效的控制机制是 schema 约束的工具调用、类型化的参数、超时边界、重试策略以及可追溯的函数执行。这与 NVIDIA 的指导一致，因为 Agent Toolkit 的理念就是把工具暴露为可复用的工作流组件；正是这一点让多工具智能体在 schema 变更时仍可测试。干扰项之所以失败，是因为把工具嵌入智能体循环会让安全审查、超时处理和版本控制变得不必要地困难。就认证目的而言，应把本题理解为在考察受控的自主性，而非天生的 LLM 创造力。

questions.q: An AI Engineer is analyzing a production agentic AI system’s compliance with responsible AI standards. Which evaluation approaches effectively identify potential safety vulnerabilities and ethical risks in multi-agent workflows? (Choose two.)
questions.qZh: 某 AI 工程师正在分析一个生产环境中的智能体化 AI 系统对负责任 AI 标准的符合情况。哪些评估方法能够有效识别多智能体工作流中潜在的安全漏洞和伦理风险？（选择两项）
o: Emphasize latency metrics and throughput performance as key evaluation factors for safety vulnerabilities, providing a baseline for operational measures and resource allocation.

Implement comprehensive audit trails using NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails with semantic similarity checks, tracking agent decisions across conversation flows and evaluating policy violations through automated compliance scoring.
Use user feedback as a primary signal for risk identification, emphasizing post-deployment observations and qualitative experience reports alongside operational monitoring.

Deploy multi-layered evaluation combining bias detection metrics (demographic parity, equalized odds) with adversarial testing to probe agent responses for harmful outputs across diverse user populations B, D Operationally, the design depends on guardrail coverage that is tested against observed failures and adversarial prompts rather than assumed from policy text. For this scenario, the combination of Options B and D is defensible because it exposes the control plane that a senior engineer can test, scale, and harden. Audit trails, semantic policy checks, bias metrics, and adversarial tests expose ethical and safety risk. Latency is operational, not sufficient for responsible AI evaluation. Within the NVIDIA stack, Guardrails are most effective when paired with evaluation, red-team prompts, and audit metadata so coverage gaps become visible. Together, B states “Implement comprehensive audit trails using NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails with semantic similarity checks, tracking agent decisions across conversation flows and evaluating policy violations through automated compliance scoring.”; D states “Deploy multi-layered evaluation combining bias detection metrics (demographic parity, equalized odds) with adversarial testing to probe agent responses for harmful outputs across diverse user populations”, so the answer covers both sides of the requirement instead of solving only the model or only the infrastructure layer. The rejected options are weaker because keyword filters and one-time prompt disclaimers do not enforce policy under prompt injection, ambiguous requests, or regulated-domain escalation paths. It also creates clean evidence for audits, incident review, and root-cause analysis when behavior drifts.
oZh: 把延迟指标和吞吐性能作为识别安全漏洞的关键评估因素，为运营度量和资源分配提供基线。

questions.q: A healthcare AI company is deploying diagnostic agents that process medical imaging and patient data. The system must deliver consistent sub-100ms inference times for critical diagnoses while supporting deployment across multiple hospital sites with different NVIDIA GPU configurations (from RTX 6000 workstations to DGX systems). The agents need to maintain high accuracy while being portable across different hardware environments and capable of running efficiently on various GPU memory configurations. Which optimization strategy would deliver the BEST performance improvements while maintaining deployment flexibility across diverse NVIDIA hardware configurations?

o: Deploy agents with NVIDIA CUDA-optimized Docker containers using a sequential inference architecture that processes each layer individually with GPU-to-CPU memory transfers between operations to avoid memory issues.
Deploy agents using NVIDIA NIM containers with CPU-optimized inference to avoid GPU memory constraints and ensure consistent performance across different hospital infrastructure configurations.
Deploy models using NVIDIA TensorRT optimization in their original FP32 precision format without any quantization or memory optimization, requiring 32GB+ GPU memory across all deployment sites.

Deploy agents using model optimizations with post-training quantization with Nvidia NIM deployment for portable performance across different GPU platforms and memory configurations. D The implementation detail that matters is multi-region placement, automated failover, and rolling deployment practices for low-latency resilient agent serving. Option D is the right call because it gives the platform team levers to tune behavior without rewriting the entire agent loop. Post-training quantization plus NIM deployment gives portability across GPU memory profiles while preserving high-performance inference. FP32-only deployment is too rigid for mixed hospital hardware. Within the NVIDIA stack, a production stack should connect DCGM, Prometheus, Grafana, HPA, and model-serving latency so scaling follows the real bottleneck. The selected option specifically D states “Deploy agents using model optimizations with post-training quantization with Nvidia NIM deployment for portable performance across different GPU platforms and memory configurations.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. The rejected options are weaker because fixed clusters, manual scaling, or single-node deployments waste accelerators during quiet periods and fail predictably during launch spikes. That is the difference between an agent that works in a notebook and an agent that remains reliable in production.

使用 NVIDIA NIM 容器部署智能体并采用面向 CPU 优化的推理，以规避 GPU 内存限制并确保在不同医院基础设施配置上表现一致。
使用 NVIDIA TensorRT 优化部署模型，保持原始 FP32 精度格式且不做任何量化或内存优化，要求所有部署站点均配备 32GB 以上 GPU 内存。

使用模型优化并采用训练后量化，配合 Nvidia NIM 部署，以在不同 GPU 平台和内存配置上获得可移植的性能。 D 真正重要的实现细节是多区域部署、自动故障转移以及面向低延迟高韧性智能体服务的滚动发布实践。选项 D 是正确选择，因为它给平台团队提供了无需重写整个智能体循环即可调整行为的手段。训练后量化加上 NIM 部署能在保持高性能推理的同时，适配不同的 GPU 内存规格。仅支持 FP32 的部署对混杂的医院硬件而言过于僵化。在 NVIDIA 技术栈内部，生产级技术栈应把 DCGM、Prometheus、Grafana、HPA 与模型服务延迟串联起来，使扩缩跟随真正的瓶颈。具体来说，所选项 D 为“使用模型优化并采用训练后量化，配合 Nvidia NIM 部署，以在不同 GPU 平台和内存配置上获得可移植的性能。”，它契合的是运维需求而非字面上的措辞匹配。被排除的选项更弱，因为固定集群、手动扩缩或单节点部署会在业务清淡期浪费加速器，并在启动峰值期以可预测的方式失败。这正是“在笔记本里能跑”的智能体与“在生产中依然可靠”的智能体之间的差别。

questions.q: You are rolling out a multimodal conversational agent on NVIDIA’s stack: the model is containerized as a TensorRT-LLM engine, served via Triton Inference Server behind NIM microservices for routing and scaling, and protected by NeMo Guardrails for safety and compliance. During early testing, end-to-end latency exceeds your target budget, and you need to tune batching, model precision, and guardrail checks while maintaining both throughput and enforcement of safety policies. Which configuration change is most effective for reducing latency under these constraints while still enforcing NeMo Guardrails policies?
questions.qZh: 你正在 NVIDIA 技术栈上推出一个多模态对话智能体：模型以 TensorRT-LLM engine 的形式容器化，由 Triton Inference Server 提供服务，并由 NIM 微服务承担路由与扩缩，同时由 NeMo Guardrails 提供安全与合规保护。在早期测试中，端到端延迟超出了你的目标预算，你需要在保持吞吐和安全策略执行力的同时，调优批处理、模型精度和护栏检查。在这些约束下，哪种配置变更最能有效降低延迟，同时仍能执行 NeMo Guardrails 策略？
o: Quantize the TensorRT-LLM engine to FP16, tune Triton’s dynamic batching, and integrate NeMo Guardrails alongside inference to run policy checks in parallel.
Quantize the TensorRT-LLM engine to INT8, disable dynamic batching, and invoke Guardrails checks synchronously within the inference path.
Deploy separate Triton servers for model inference and guardrail validation, routing requests sequentially and merging outputs at the application layer.

Keep FP32 precision, increase batch size aggressively, and perform Guardrails checks in a downstream microservice after inference. A This lines up with NVIDIA guidance because TensorRT-LLM and NIM reduce inference overhead, but they still need serving-level tuning to avoid queue buildup under concurrency. FP16/TensorRT-LLM optimization, tuned Triton batching, and parallelized guardrail checks reduce latency without removing safety controls. Synchronous sequential guardrails would inflate tail latency. In a GPU-backed agent deployment, Option A maps closest to how the NVIDIA stack expects orchestration, inference, and control policies to be separated. The selected option specifically A states “Quantize the TensorRT-LLM engine to FP16, tune Triton’s dynamic batching, and integrate NeMo Guardrails alongside inference to run policy checks in parallel.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. The practical pattern is matching model precision, batch windows, model instances, and GPU memory behavior to the latency service-level objective. The losing choices mostly optimize for short-term convenience; hardware upgrades alone do not fix poor batching, serial ensembles, guardrail overhead, or KV-cache pressure. This is exactly where NVIDIA’s stack is strongest: separating acceleration, orchestration, policy, and observability.
oZh: 将 TensorRT-LLM engine 量化到 FP16，调优 Triton 的动态批处理，并将 NeMo Guardrails 与推理并行整合以并行执行策略检查。
将 TensorRT-LLM engine 量化到 INT8，禁用动态批处理，并在推理路径中同步调用 Guardrails 检查。
为模型推理和护栏校验分别部署独立的 Triton 服务器，顺序路由请求，并在应用层合并输出。

保持 FP32 精度，大幅增大 batch size，并在推理之后于下游微服务中执行 Guardrails 检查。 A 这与 NVIDIA 的指导一致，因为 TensorRT-LLM 和 NIM 能降低推理开销，但仍需在服务层做调优，以避免高并发下的队列积压。FP16/TensorRT-LLM 优化、调优后的 Triton 批处理以及并行化的护栏检查，可以在不移除安全管控的前提下降低延迟。同步串行的护栏检查会抬高尾延迟。在 GPU 支撑的智能体部署中，选项 A 最贴近 NVIDIA 技术栈对编排、推理与控制策略相分离的预期。具体来说，所选项 A 为“将 TensorRT-LLM engine 量化到 FP16，调优 Triton 的动态批处理，并将 NeMo Guardrails 与推理并行整合以并行执行策略检查。”，它契合的是运维需求而非字面上的措辞匹配。实用的模式是让模型精度、批处理窗口、模型实例数和 GPU 内存行为与延迟服务级别目标相匹配。落选的选项大多是在优化短期便利性；仅靠硬件升级无法解决糟糕的批处理、串行集成、护栏开销或 KV cache 压力。这正是 NVIDIA 技术栈的强项所在：把加速、编排、策略和可观测性分离开来。

questions.q: What is RAG Fusion primarily designed to achieve?
questions.qZh: RAG Fusion 的主要设计目标是什么？
o: Creating a separate, dedicated database for storing all the retrieved chunks.
Minimizing the need for retrieval, allowing the LLM to generate responses directly from its internal knowledge.
Blending information from multiple retrieved chunks into a single response generated by the LLM.

Automatically translating and integrating all retrieved chunks into a single language. C RAG Fusion improves generation by blending evidence from multiple retrieved chunks. It is about combining retrieved context, not eliminating retrieval. In a GPU-backed agent deployment, Option C maps closest to how the NVIDIA stack expects orchestration, inference, and control policies to be separated. The selected option specifically C states “Blending information from multiple retrieved chunks into a single response generated by the LLM.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. The correct implementation surface is retriever isolation, vector index quality, reranking, freshness-aware ingestion, query expansion, and retrieval guardrails. This lines up with NVIDIA guidance because NeMo Guardrails can add retrieval rails around RAG context, while the serving layer remains independent from the vector database. The distractors fail because keyword-only retrieval misses semantic matches, while unfiltered concatenation can pollute the answer with weak evidence. This choice gives engineering teams the knobs they need for continuous tuning after deployment. The retrieval layer should be independently measured for recall, relevance, freshness, and latency before blaming the generator.
oZh: 创建一个独立的专用数据库，用于存储所有检索到的文本块。
尽量减少对检索的需求，让大语言模型直接依据其内部知识生成回答。
把来自多个检索文本块的信息融合到由大语言模型生成的单一回答中。

自动将所有检索到的文本块翻译并整合为同一种语言。 C RAG Fusion 通过融合来自多个检索文本块的证据来改进生成效果。它关注的是组合检索到的上下文，而不是取消检索。在 GPU 支撑的智能体部署中，选项 C 最贴近 NVIDIA 技术栈对编排、推理与控制策略相分离的预期。具体来说，所选项 C 为“把来自多个检索文本块的信息融合到由大语言模型生成的单一回答中。”，它契合的是运维需求而非字面上的措辞匹配。正确的实现面包括检索器隔离、向量索引质量、reranking、关注新鲜度的摄取、查询扩展以及检索护栏。这与 NVIDIA 的指导一致，因为 NeMo Guardrails 可以在 RAG 上下文周围增加检索护栏，而服务层仍与向量数据库保持独立。干扰项之所以失败，是因为仅用关键词的检索会漏掉语义匹配，而未经筛选的拼接则可能用弱证据污染答案。这一选择为工程团队提供了部署后持续调优所需的旋钮。在责怪生成器之前，应当先独立度量检索层的召回率、相关性、新鲜度和延迟。

questions.q: You are designing an AI-powered drafting assistant for contract lawyers. The assistant suggests standard clauses and highlights potential risks based on past agreements. questions.qZh: 你正在为合同律师设计一款由 AI 驱动的起草助手。该助手会依据以往协议建议标准条款并标注潜在风险。资深律师必须对每条建议进行审阅、接受、修改或拒绝，需要了解某条条款被推荐的原因，并提供反馈以帮助改进助手。哪种设计特性对于实现有效的人在环监督、透明度和信任最为关键？
o: Display suggested clauses with links to additional details about provenance and risk highlighting in a side panel, allowing users to access more context as needed.
Insert suggested clauses into the draft and highlight changes for review at the end, inviting users to provide detailed feedback on clauses they wish to flag for improvement.
Present batch “accept all” or “reject all” controls for suggested clauses, with explanations and feedback collected in a summary report after draft review.

Show inline “why” explanations for each suggestion, highlight precedent and risk factors, and include accept/modify/reject controls with immediate feedback capture for model refinement. D Lawyers need inline explanations, provenance, risk factors, and accept/modify/reject controls. Batch acceptance weakens accountability. The durable control mechanism is interfaces that show recommendations, evidence, risk drivers, and immediate accept/modify/reject actions. The selected option specifically D states “Show inline “why” explanations for each suggestion, highlight precedent and risk factors, and include accept/modify/reject controls with immediate feedback capture for model refinement.”, which matches the operational requirement rather than a superficial wording match. Option D wins because it optimizes the system boundary around the risky component rather than hoping the base model behaves consistently. The NVIDIA implementation angle is not cosmetic here: NVIDIA-style production governance pairs guardrails and observability with user-facing controls so interventions are traceable. Human review must be designed into the workflow rather than added as an after-the-fact manual workaround. esxcli system module parameters set -m nvidia -p “NVreg_RegistryDwords=RmPVMRL=0x@1"

o: Use NCCL_TESTS_SPLIT= “DIV 8” with point-to-point tests
Use all_reduce_perf –b 8 –e 16G –f2 –g 8 with NCCL_TESTS_SPLIT= “AND 0x1”
Use all_reduce_perf –b 8 –e 16G –f2 –g 8 without splits
Use reduce_scatter_pref –b 8 –e 16G –f2 –g 4

使用 all_reduce_perf –b 8 –e 16G –f2 –g 8，且不进行分组划分
使用 reduce_scatter_pref –b 8 –e 16G –f2 –g 4

Review the system BIOS to ensure GPU overclocking is enabled for maximum performance.

确认每台 DGX 系统都连接到冗余且额定参数合适的 PDU，并且所有电源均报告标称输入。

所有收发器的通道功率差异 < 3dB。

Update the GPU tray first, then the motherboard tray, and reboot the BMC after all updates are complete.
Stop all GPU activity, update and reboot the BMC, update motherboard and tray components, perform a cold reset, and verify completion.

o: To save time, simultaneously update all nodes in the cluster without draining or diagnostics.
Drain nodes from the scheduler, run pre-update diagnostics, update firmware in batches, and verify health post-update before scaling to the next batch.
Drain nodes from the scheduler, update firmware in batches, skip diagnostics and verify health post-update before scaling to the next batch.
Update nodes that have reported faults, leaving others on older firmware.
