A Interpreting NCCL (NVIDIA Collective Communications Library) results requires understanding the difference between theoretical link rate and effective bus bandwidth. A 400G (NDR) InfiniBand link has a theoretical unidirectional capacity of 50 GB/s. In an 8-GPU DGX system, where each GPU is typically mapped to its own 400G HCA, the aggregate theoretical bandwidth is 400 GB/s. However, NCCL performance benchmarks report Bus Bandwidth, which accounts for the mathematical overhead of collective operations like all_reduce. Achieving 350 GB/s (Option A) is widely considered optimal and representative of a healthy, well-configured fabric. This indicates that the system is effectively utilizing GPUDirect RDMA to bypass host memory and that the network switches are routing traffic without significant congestion or packet drops. Expecting > 390 GB/s (Option C) is unrealistic once protocol headers and algorithmic overhead are subtracted from the raw bit rate. Rerunning with CPU stress (Option D) would not provide insights into the InfiniBand/GPU fabric health.

DGX Serial Number [YSY72800016).................. Verify installed DIMM memory sticks........................Healthy ...[output truncated) Verify Ethernet controllers...........................Healthy Verify installed GPU ' s..............................Unhealthy Checking output of ' lspci ' for expected GPU ' s Missing GPU at PCI address ' 07:00.0 ' Verify installed InfiniBand controllers....................Healthy Verify PCIe switches..................................Healthy ...[output truncated) What insights can a system administrator gain regarding the DGX system ' s health?

DGX 序列号 [YSY72800016).................. 校验已安装的 DIMM 内存条........................健康 ...[输出已截断) 校验以太网控制器...........................健康 校验已安装的 GPU ' ..............................不健康 检查 ' lspci ' 输出中预期的 GPU ' 缺少 PCI 地址 ' 07:00.0 ' 的 GPU 校验已安装的 InfiniBand 控制器....................健康 校验 PCIe 交换机..................................健康 ...[输出已截断) 系统管理员可以从 DGX 系统的健康状况中获得哪些结论？
o: A GPU tray upgrade failed.
A GPU is missing on the DGX system.
A GPU driver upgrade has failed.

The system has passed the hardware health check successfully. B The output provided is a result of the NVIDIA System Management (NVSM) tool, specifically the nvsm show healthinfo command. NVSM is an essential diagnostic framework for NVIDIA DGX systems that monitors hardware health, identifies faults, and helps ensure the system remains within its validated operational state. In this specific diagnostic trace, the system reports that the " Verify installed GPU ' s " check has returned a status of Unhealthy. To provide a root cause, NVSM cross-references the live hardware enumeration from the lspci command against the system ' s known " Golden Configuration " (the hardware manifest defined in the firmware). The explicit error message, " Missing GPU at PCI address ' 07:00.0 ' " , indicates that the system expects a GPU module to be present at that specific PCIe bus address, but the hardware is not responding or visible to the bus. This insight allows a system administrator to conclude that a GPU is missing from the logical perspective of the system. This is a critical hardware fault rather than a software or driver issue. In a DGX H100 or A100 system, this could be caused by a physical module failure, a power delivery issue to that specific segment of the GPU baseboard, or a failure in the PCIe switch fabric. Because the DGX relies on a full set of 8 GPUs for high-speed collective communications (NCCL), a single missing GPU will prevent the node from participating in large-scale training jobs, requiring physical inspection or a GPU tray replacement (RMA).

DGX 系统上缺少一块 GPU。
GPU 驱动升级失败。

questions.q: An infrastructure engineer in an AI factory has successfully replaced a power supply unit on an NVIDIA DGX H100. After installation, both the IN and OUT LEDs on the new power supply illuminate solid green. Which NVSM CLI command should the engineer use to quickly verify the overall system status and ensure it is operating as expected?
questions.qZh: AI 工厂中的基础设施工程师已成功更换 NVIDIA DGX H100 上的一台电源。安装完成后，新电源的 IN 和 OUT LED 均呈常亮绿色。工程师应使用哪条 NVSM CLI 命令快速验证系统整体状态，确保其运行符合预期？
o: nvsm show power
nvsm show powermode
nvsm show health

nvsm show alerts C The NVIDIA System Management (NVSM) tool is the definitive CLI utility for monitoring the health of DGX platforms. While replacing a PSU (Power Supply Unit) is a common maintenance task, verifying that the new component is correctly integrated into the system’s health model is mandatory. While nvsm show power would provide specific data regarding wattage and voltage for the PSU, the most comprehensive way to ensure the replacement hasn ' t caused secondary issues or that the system hasn ' t remained in a " Degraded " state is to run nvsm show health. This command performs a global check across all subsystems: GPUs, NVLink switches, storage, fans, and power. If the PSU replacement was successful and the system is back to full redundancy, nvsm show health will return a " Healthy " status. In an AI factory setting, where DGX H100 nodes pull significant power, ensuring that all 6 PSUs (in an N+N or N+1 configuration) are not only physically green but logically acknowledged by the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) is critical for preventing unexpected shutdowns during high-load training iterations.

questions.q: An AI training cluster with NVIDIA GPUs experiences prolonged data loading times during checkpoint reloading, causing GPUs to idle frequently. CPU utilization during data transfers remains high. Which solution most effectively optimizes storage-to-GPU throughput while reducing CPU overhead?
questions.qZh: 一个使用 NVIDIA GPU 的 AI 训练集群在重新加载检查点时数据加载时间过长，导致 GPU 频繁空闲。数据传输期间 CPU 利用率一直很高。哪种方案在降低 CPU 开销的同时，最能优化从存储到 GPU 的吞吐？
o: Increase batch sizes to reduce the frequency of storage access.
Migrate datasets to SATA SSDs with RAID 0 for higher sequential read speeds.
Add more GPUs to the cluster to parallelize data loading tasks.

Implement GPUDirect Storage to enable direct data transfers. D GPUDirect Storage is the most effective solution because it reduces unnecessary CPU involvement in the data path between storage and GPU memory. In a traditional AI data pipeline, checkpoint data may move from storage into system memory, be processed by the CPU, and then be copied into GPU memory. This creates CPU overhead and can leave GPUs idle while waiting for data. GPUDirect Storage allows compatible storage systems, file systems, drivers, and NVIDIA GPUs to transfer data more directly into GPU memory. This improves checkpoint reload performance, reduces CPU copy overhead, and helps keep GPUs saturated during training. Increasing batch size may reduce the frequency of storage access, but it does not solve the checkpoint transfer bottleneck. SATA SSDs in RAID 0 may improve local sequential throughput, but they are not ideal for distributed training or shared cluster data access. Adding more GPUs can worsen the issue if the storage path is already the bottleneck. In NVIDIA AI infrastructure, storage-to-GPU optimization is critical for large model training, checkpointing, recovery, and maintaining high accelerator utilization.
oZh: 增大批量大小，以降低访问存储的频率。
将数据集迁移到使用 RAID 0 的 SATA SSD，以获得更高的顺序读取速度。
向集群添加更多 GPU，以并行化数据加载任务。

部署 GPUDirect Storage 以启用直接数据传输。GPUDirect Storage 是最有效的解决方案，因为它减少了存储与 GPU 内存之间数据路径上不必要的 CPU 参与。在传统 AI 数据流水线中，检查点数据可能先从存储移入系统内存，由 CPU 处理后再复制到 GPU 内存。这会产生 CPU 开销，并可能使 GPU 在等待数据时空闲。GPUDirect Storage 允许兼容的存储系统、文件系统、驱动和 NVIDIA GPU 更直接地将数据传入 GPU 内存。这可以改善检查点重新加载性能，减少 CPU 拷贝开销，并有助于在训练期间让 GPU 保持满负载。增大批量大小可能降低访问存储的频率，但无法解决检查点传输瓶颈。RAID 0 下的 SATA SSD 可能提升本地顺序吞吐，但并不适合分布式训练或集群共享数据访问。如果存储路径本身已是瓶颈，添加更多 GPU 反而会使问题恶化。在 NVIDIA AI 基础设施中，从存储到 GPU 的优化对于大模型训练、检查点保存、恢复以及维持高加速器利用率都至关重要。

questions.q: A system administrator needs to install a container toolkit and successfully run the following commands: sudo apt-get update sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime docker What step should be taken next to finish the installation?
questions.qZh: 系统管理员需要安装容器工具包并成功运行以下命令：sudo apt-get update、sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-container-toolkit、sudo nvidia-ctk runtime configure --runtime docker。接下来应执行哪一步来完成安装？
o: dpkg -i doca-host-repo-ubuntu _amd64.deb
apt-get install cuda-drivers
systemctl restart docker

apt-get remove nvidia-container-toolkit C The nvidia-ctk runtime configure command is a crucial step that modifies the Docker daemon configuration file (/etc/docker/daemon.json) to register the nvidia runtime. However, the Docker daemon only reads this configuration file during its initialization phase. Even though the toolkit is installed and the configuration file is updated, Docker will not be able to spawn GPU-accelerated containers until the service is refreshed. Executing sudo systemctl restart docker (or the equivalent for your container engine) is the mandatory final step. This forces Docker to reload its settings and recognize the NVIDIA Container Runtime as a valid option. Without this restart, attempting to run a container with the --gpus all flag will result in an error stating that the " nvidia " runtime is not found or is unconfigured. This is a common point of failure in automated AI infrastructure deployments where the configuration script finishes, but the service state remains stale.

systemctl restart docker

questions.q: When configuring an out-of-core HPL burn-in for a 40B matrix on 8x H100 nodes, which environment variable prevents GPU out-of-memory errors while reserving space for drivers?
questions.qZh: 在为 8x H100 节点上的 40B 矩阵配置 HPL out-of-core 老化测试（burn-in）时，哪个环境变量可以在为驱动预留空间的同时避免 GPU 显存不足（OOM）错误？
o: export HPL_OOC_SAFE_SIZE=4.0
export HPL_OOC_MODE=0
export HPL_OOC_NUM_STREAMS=8

export HPL_OOC_MAX_GPU_MEM=90 A The correct option is export HPL_OOC_SAFE_SIZE=4.0. NVIDIA HPL out-of-core mode allows matrix data that exceeds GPU memory capacity to be placed in host memory, but the GPU still needs reserved memory for drivers and runtime overhead. NVIDIA documents HPL_OOC_SAFE_SIZE as the amount of GPU memory, in GiB, reserved for the driver and not used by HPL out-of-core mode; increasing it is recommended when GPU out-of-memory errors occur. HPL_OOC_MODE=0 disables out-of-core mode, which would not help run a larger 40B matrix. HPL_OOC_NUM_STREAMS=8 changes the number of CUDA streams used for out-of-core operations, but it does not reserve driver memory. HPL_OOC_MAX_GPU_MEM=90 limits total GPU memory use, but the specific variable intended to leave safe driver space is HPL_OOC_SAFE_SIZE. During cluster burn-in, this setting helps preserve test validity while avoiding false failures caused by memory reservation issues rather than actual hardware instability.

export HPL_OOC_MODE=0

o: export NGC_CLI_ORG=org-name & & ngc config set
ngc config list to manually edit the JSON configuration file.
ngc registry login --org org-name

ngc config set --org org-name --ace ace-name D The correct answer is ngc config set --org org-name --ace ace-name. NGC CLI uses configuration context to determine which organization, team, or entitlement scope the user is operating in. When users belong to multiple organizations, the CLI must be configured with the intended organization context so that registry access, model downloads, private containers, and enterprise software resources resolve correctly. NVIDIA documentation shows ngc config set as the command used to configure or switch NGC context, including organization and team values, and other NVIDIA installation workflows show NGC configuration prompting for organization, team, and ACE fields. Manually editing JSON configuration files is not the recommended operational method because it increases the risk of syntax errors and inconsistent authentication state. ngc registry login is not the normal command for setting persistent NGC CLI organization context. Exporting an environment variable may influence a session, but it is not the best persistent configuration method. In AI infrastructure operations, correct NGC configuration is important for pulling validated containers, GPU drivers, vGPU software, models, and enterprise assets from the correct account scope.

questions.q: During server maintenance, a system administrator wants to ensure that the NVIDIA DGX server has sufficient disk space for operational activities. The administrator is scripting an alert system that will notify the team if disk space falls below a threshold. Which command could be included in the maintenance script to check the available disk space on the server?
questions.qZh: 在服务器维护期间，系统管理员需要确保 NVIDIA DGX 服务器有足够的磁盘空间用于运维活动。管理员正在编写一套告警脚本，在磁盘空间低于阈值时通知团队。可以在维护脚本中包含哪条命令来检查服务器上的可用磁盘空间？
o: nvidia-smi --query-disk-space
du -sh /home/*
df -h | grep ' /var '

lsof +L1 C The correct command is df -h | grep ' /var ' because df reports filesystem capacity, used space, available space, and mount utilization. In DGX systems, monitoring disk space is important because system logs, container runtime data, package caches, telemetry, temporary files, and service data can consume space under operational filesystems such as /var. If /var fills up, services such as Docker, containerd, logging, monitoring agents, NVIDIA management tools, or package management can fail or behave unpredictably. nvidia-smi --query-disk-space is incorrect because nvidia-smi reports GPU telemetry, not filesystem capacity. du -sh /home/* summarizes directory usage under /home, but it does not directly show remaining filesystem space or a threshold-ready view of the mounted filesystem. lsof +L1 is useful for finding deleted files still held open by processes, but it is not the primary command for checking available disk capacity. In NVIDIA AI infrastructure, routine OS-level checks like filesystem capacity are part of reliable server operations and help prevent avoidable workload failures.

du -sh /home/*
df -h | grep ' /var '

Ethernet and InfiniBand have identical architectures and differ only in the names of their management tools.

questions.e: Option A is correct because the provider prioritizes a dedicated fabric for distributed training while retaining a clear distinction from Ethernet's broad interoperability. Option B is not correct because Ethernet can carry server and storage traffic. Option C reverses the technologies' common architectural roles. Option D is not correct because the fabrics differ in design and ecosystem, not merely in management tool names.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为该方案优先为分布式训练采用专用网络结构，同时与 Ethernet 的广泛互操作性保持清晰区分。选项 B 不正确，因为 Ethernet 可以承载服务器流量和存储流量。选项 C 颠倒了两种技术通常承担的架构角色。选项 D 不正确，因为这两种网络结构在设计和生态上存在差异，而不仅仅是管理工具名称不同。

对象存储，用于低成本地保留大型数据集，并按需将活跃数据暂存以供训练使用
将本地启动盘用作所有 GPU 服务器唯一的数据集存储库
单一的 NVMe 设备，且没有横向扩展路径，作为唯一的共享存储服务
将 GPU 内存用作完整数据集集合的长期存储库
在训练活跃期间，将归档磁带作为每次读取的直接数据源

questions.q: Which approach should the team use to create a useful performance baseline?
questions.qZh: 团队应采用哪种方法来建立有用的性能基线？
o: Run one CloudAI benchmark with the largest available message size and record its average result.
Repeat the same NCCL workload with fixed node count, message sizes, and software settings, while recording switch telemetry in Grafana through SNMP.
Change the NCCL message sizes between runs and compare the fastest result with the current job.
Record only the average job completion time, then use it as the baseline for all collective operations.
oZh: 使用最大可用消息大小运行一次 CloudAI 基准测试，并记录其平均结果。
在节点数、消息大小和软件设置固定的情况下重复相同的 NCCL 工作负载，同时通过 SNMP 将交换机遥测数据记录到 Grafana。
在多次运行之间更改 NCCL 消息大小，并将最快的结果与当前作业进行比较。
仅记录作业平均完成时间，然后将其作为所有集合操作的基线。
questions.e: Option B is correct because repeating the same NCCL workload with fixed node count, message sizes, and software settings makes the measured result comparable, while Grafana and SNMP capture switch telemetry for that run. Option A is not correct because a single run cannot establish run-to-run variation. Option C is not correct because changing message sizes removes comparability. Option D is not correct because job averages can hide localized congestion.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为固定节点数、消息大小和软件设置并重复相同的 NCCL 工作负载，可使测量结果具备可比性，同时 Grafana 和 SNMP 能够捕获该次运行的交换机遥测数据。选项 A 不正确，因为单次运行无法确定运行之间的波动范围。选项 C 不正确，因为更改消息大小会破坏可比性。选项 D 不正确，因为作业平均值可能掩盖局部拥塞。

questions.topic: Spectrum-X Configuration, Optimization, Security, and Troubleshooting
questions.q: Choose two actions that are most useful for locating the cause of the slowdown.
questions.qZh: 选择两项对定位性能下降原因最有帮助的操作。
o: Increase the NCCL message size until throughput improves, then use that result to identify the fault.
Compare the affected NCCL results with NetQ events and telemetry for the relevant switches and ports.
Disable switch telemetry during the next job so it cannot affect performance.
Check the affected ports for congestion-related counters, including PFC or ECN activity, and for link errors.
Replace the training job with a different collective operation before examining the fabric.
oZh: 增大 NCCL 消息大小直至吞吐提升，然后利用该结果来确定故障点。
将受影响的 NCCL 结果与相关交换机和端口的 NetQ 事件及遥测数据进行对比。
在下一次作业运行期间禁用交换机遥测，使其不会影响性能。
检查受影响端口的拥塞相关计数器（包括 PFC 或 ECN 活动）以及链路错误。
在检查网络结构之前，将训练作业替换为不同的集合通信操作。
questions.e: Options B and D are correct because correlating NCCL results with NetQ data can identify when and where fabric conditions changed, while port counters can reveal congestion or link faults. Option A is not correct because changing the workload prevents a reliable comparison. Option C is not correct because it removes useful evidence. Option E is not correct because changing collectives obscures the original failure.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 和 D 正确，因为将 NCCL 结果与 NetQ 数据关联分析可以确定网络结构状况在何时何地发生了变化，而端口计数器可以揭示拥塞或链路故障。选项 A 不正确，因为更改工作负载会导致无法进行可靠比较。选项 C 不正确，因为它移除了有用的证据。选项 E 不正确，因为更改集合通信会掩盖原始故障。

questions.topic: Spectrum-X Configuration, Optimization, Security, and Troubleshooting
questions.q: Which change best meets the telemetry security requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪项变更最符合遥测的安全要求？
o: Use SNMPv3 with authentication and privacy, and restrict polling to the approved monitoring host using a management access control.
Keep SNMPv2c and use a longer community string shared by all monitoring systems.
Allow SNMP polling from every host on the tenant network, but rotate the community string each month.
Disable authentication on the telemetry service and rely on Grafana user accounts to protect switch access.
oZh: 使用带认证和隐私保护（privacy）的 SNMPv3，并通过管理访问控制将轮询限制到已批准的监控主机。
继续使用 SNMPv2c，并采用由所有监控系统共享的更长 community string。
允许租户网络上的每台主机发起 SNMP 轮询，但每月轮换一次 community string。
在遥测服务上禁用认证，并依赖 Grafana 用户账户来保护交换机访问。
questions.e: Option A is correct because SNMPv3 authentication and privacy protect telemetry access and data, while restricting polling to the approved host limits exposure. Option B is not correct because SNMPv2c does not provide the required SNMPv3 security protections. Option C is not correct because broad network access remains allowed. Option D is not correct because Grafana accounts do not secure the switch telemetry service.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为 SNMPv3 的认证和隐私保护（privacy）可保护遥测的访问与数据，而将轮询限制在已批准的主机上可以减少暴露面。选项 B 不正确，因为 SNMPv2c 无法提供所需的 SNMPv3 安全保护。选项 C 不正确，因为它仍然允许广泛的网络访问。选项 D 不正确，因为 Grafana 账户并不能保护交换机的遥测服务。

questions.q: Which configuration best meets this requirement?

o: Place both groups and the shared storage in one partition using the same PKey with full membership.
Create a distinct PKey partition for each group, assign each group's endpoints to its partition, and assign the shared storage port to both.
Create separate InfiniBand subnets for the groups and attach the shared storage only to the existing subnet.
Use VLANs on the InfiniBand switch ports to separate the groups while retaining the shared subnet.
oZh: 将两个组和共享存储置于同一个分区中，使用相同的 PKey 并启用完全成员资格（full membership）。
为每个组创建独立的 PKey 分区，将各组的端点分配到各自的分区，并将共享存储端口同时分配给两个分区。
为这些组创建独立的 InfiniBand 子网，并仅将共享存储连接到现有子网。
在 InfiniBand 交换机端口上使用 VLAN 来隔离这些组，同时保留共享子网。
questions.e: Option B is correct because distinct PKeys isolate the groups, while placing the shared storage port in both partitions preserves access to that service. Option A places both groups in the same partition and permits direct exchange. Option C changes the subnet arrangement rather than using partition isolation. Option D relies on VLANs instead of InfiniBand partition enforcement.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为不同的 PKey 可以隔离这些组，而将共享存储端口同时放入两个分区则保留了对该服务的访问。选项 A 将两个组放在同一个分区中，允许它们直接交换数据。选项 C 改变的是子网布局，而不是利用分区隔离。选项 D 依赖 VLAN，而不是 InfiniBand 的分区强制机制。

Run one aggregate ib_write_bw test without selecting an HCA port and compare total bandwidth.

Assign all HCAs to the same PKey and check whether traffic becomes uniform.

重启 UFM 服务器，并验证之后所有链路都处于活动状态。

Option B can hide a crossed rail assignment in an aggregate result. Option D checks partition membership, not rail placement. Option E does not validate cabling or per-rail paths.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 C 正确，因为 UFM 的拓扑视图显示 HCA 与交换机的连接关系，而针对各个 HCA 的 ib_write_bw 测试可验证每条预期 rail 都承载流量。选项 B 可能在聚合结果中掩盖交叉的 rail 分配错误。选项 D 检查的是分区成员关系，而非 rail 布局。选项 E 无法验证布线或每条 rail 的路径。

Option D places the managers on different subnets, so they cannot provide master and standby service for the same fabric.

o: SuperNIC
Spectrum-4 switch
DOCA software
NetQ
oZh: SuperNIC
Spectrum-4 交换机
DOCA 软件
NetQ
questions.e: Within the Spectrum-X platform, the NVIDIA BlueField-3 SuperNIC is responsible for reordering out-of-order packets. When RoCE adaptive routing is employed, packets may arrive at their destination out of order due to dynamic path selection. The BlueField-3 SuperNIC handles this by reassembling the packets in the correct order at the transport layer, ensuring that the application receives data seamlessly.​ Reference Extracts from NVIDIA Documentation: "As different packets of the same flow travel through different paths of the network, they may arrive out of order to their destination. At the RoCE transport layer, the BlueField-3 DPU takes care of the out-of-order packets and forwards the data to the application in order."​ "The BlueField-3 SuperNIC offers adaptive routing, out-of-order packet handling and optimized congestion control."​ The NVIDIA Spectrum-X networking platform is an Ethernet-based solution optimized for AI workloads, combining Spectrum-4 switches, BlueField-3 SuperNICs, and software like DOCA and NetQ to deliver high performance, low latency, and efficient data transfer. A key feature of Spectrum-X is its adaptive routing, which dynamically selects the least-congested paths for packet transmission to maximize bandwidth and minimize latency. However, this per-packet load balancing can result in packets arriving out of order at the destination, necessitating a mechanism to reorder them for seamless application performance. The question asks which Spectrum-X component is responsible for reordering these out-of-order packets. According to NVIDIA’s official documentation, the BlueField-3 SuperNIC is the component responsible for reordering out-of-order packets in the Spectrum-X platform. The SuperNIC, a network accelerator designed for hyperscale AI workloads, handles packet reordering at the RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) transport layer. It uses its processing capabilities to transparently reorder packets and place them in the correct sequence in the host memory, ensuring that adaptive routing’s out-of-order delivery is invisible to the application. This is critical for maintaining predictable performance in AI workloads, particularly for GPU-to-GPU communication in Spectrum-X networks. Exact Extract from NVIDIA Documentation: “The Spectrum-4 switches are responsible for selecting the least-congested port for data transmission on a per-packet basis. As different packets of the same flow travel through different paths of the network, they may arrive out of order to their destination. The BlueField-3 SuperNIC transforms any out-of-order data at the RoCE transport layer, transparently delivering in-order data to the application.” — NVIDIA Technical Blog: Turbocharging Generative AI Workloads with NVIDIA Spectrum-X Networking Platform This extract confirms that option A, the SuperNIC (specifically the BlueField-3 SuperNIC), is the correct answer. The SuperNIC’s role in reordering packets ensures that the adaptive routing implemented by Spectrum-4 switches does not compromise application performance, maintaining high effective bandwidth and low tail latency for AI workloads.

questions.q: What are the two general user account types in MLNX-OS? Pick the 2 correct responses below:
questions.qZh: MLNX-OS 中有两种常规的用户账户类型，以下哪两项是正确的？
o: viewer
monitor
admin

enable B, C MLNX-OS, the operating system for NVIDIA's networking devices, defines two primary user account types: admin and monitor . The admin account has full administrative privileges, allowing for complete configuration and management of the system. The monitor account, on the other hand, is designed for users who need to view system configurations and statuses without making any changes. This separation ensures a clear distinction between users who manage the system and those who monitor its operations.​ Reference Extracts from NVIDIA Documentation: "There are two user roles or account types: admin and monitor. As 'admin', the user is privileged to run all the available commands. As 'monitor', the user can run commands that show system configuration and status, or set terminal settings."​ MLNX-OS is the network operating system used on NVIDIA’s Mellanox Ethernet switches, including the Spectrum family (e.g., Spectrum-4 switches in the Spectrum-X platform), designed for high-performance Ethernet networking in AI and HPC data centers. MLNX-OS provides a command-line interface (CLI) for configuring and managing switch operations, with user accounts controlling access to various commands and functions. The question asks for the two general user account types in MLNX-OS, which define the primary privilege levels for user access. According to NVIDIA’s official MLNX-OS documentation, the two general user account types in MLNX-OS are: monitor : This account type has read-only access, allowing users to view configurations, status, and logs but not modify settings. It is used for monitoring and troubleshooting without risking unintended changes. admin : This account type has full read-write access, enabling users to view and modify all configurations, execute commands, and manage the switch’s operations. It is intended for administrators with complete control over the system. These two account types represent the primary privilege levels in MLNX-OS, providing a clear distinction between read-only monitoring and full administrative access. Exact Extract from NVIDIA Documentation: “MLNX-OS supports two primary user account types for managing switch operations: monitor : Users with monitor privileges have read-only access to the system. They can view configuration details, system status, and logs but cannot make changes to the configuration. admin : Users with admin privileges have full read-write access, allowing them to configure, manage, and troubleshoot all aspects of the switch, including executing privileged commands. These account types ensure secure and controlled access to the switch’s management functions.” — NVIDIA MLNX-OS User Manual This extract confirms that options B (monitor) and C (admin) are the correct answers. These account types are the standard privilege levels in MLNX-OS, used to manage access for monitoring and administrative tasks on Spectrum switches, including those in Spectrum-X deployments.

o: Enable pushing of configuration through Ansible template files.
Enable the persistent manipulation of specific settings using both NVUE and flat-file approaches.
Reduce NVUE memory utilization to optimize performance.

Improve Cumulus security by reducing the attack surface.​ B Configuring NVUE to ignore certain underlying Linux files allows administrators to manage specific settings manually or through automation tools like Ansible without NVUE overwriting these configurations. questions.q: You are troubleshooting a Spectrum-X network and need to ensure that the network remains operational in case of a link failure. Which feature of Spectrum-X ensures that the fabric continues to deliver high performance even if there is a link failure?
questions.qZh: 您正在排查 Spectrum-X 网络，需要确保在链路发生故障时网络仍能正常运行。Spectrum-X 的哪项功能可保证即使出现链路故障，fabric 仍能持续提供高性能？
o: RoCE Congestion Control
RoCE Adaptive Routing
NVIDIA NetQ

RoCE Performance Isolation B RoCE Adaptive Routing is a key feature of NVIDIA Spectrum-X that ensures high performance and resiliency in the network, even in the event of a link failure. o: nv set interface mgmt ip 20.11.12.13 20.11.12.254

The command sudo config interface ip add eth0 20.11.12.13/24 20.11.12.254 is the standard method to configure the IP address and gateway for the eth0 management interface. This command specifies the interface (eth0), the IP address with its subnet mask (20.11.12.13/24), and the default gateway (20.11.12.254), ensuring proper network connectivity. o: Increase the number of replicas for inference services so they always have more resources than training jobs.
Set up a separate namespace for inference services and limit resource usage in other namespaces.
Use Horizontal Pod Autoscaling (HPA) based on memory usage to scale up inference services during peak times.

ResourceQuotas limit the resource consumption per namespace or user, controlling overall usage and reserving capacity for critical workloads. This setup effectively manages resource allocation and guarantees performance for inference jobs during peak times. Increasing replicas or namespaces alone does not guarantee priority during contention. HPA scales based on metrics but does not manage priority or resource guarantees directly. =============

questions.qZh: 某组织使用 BCM 配置了 48 个计算节点，需要将它们组织起来以进行有针对性的工作负载调度：24 个带 A100-80GB GPU 的节点用于训练工作负载，24 个带 H100 GPU 的节点用于推理工作负载。由于成本优化策略，训练作业绝不应在 H100 节点上运行。哪个 BCM 特性可实现此要求？
o: Configure separate VLANs for each GPU type and use network isolation to prevent cross-scheduling
Create two node categories (A100-training and H100-inference) and configure job scheduler policies to target specific categories
Set different SSH keys for each node group and restrict job submission based on authentication
Deploy separate BCM head nodes for each GPU type with independent cluster databases
oZh: 为每种 GPU 类型配置独立 VLAN，并利用网络隔离来防止跨类型调度
创建两个节点类别（A100-training 和 H100-inference），并配置作业调度器策略以定向到特定类别
为每个节点组设置不同的 SSH 密钥，并基于认证限制作业提交
为每种 GPU 类型部署独立的 BCM 头部节点，各配独立的集群数据库
questions.e: Node categories in BCM allow administrators to logically group nodes (e.g., by GPU type, purpose, or hardware generation) and configure schedulers like Slurm to target jobs to specific categories. This is the intended BCM mechanism for workload targeting and resource partitioning. Why the others are wrong: - VLAN segregation provides network isolation but doesn't integrate with BCM's job scheduling system. The scheduler would still see all nodes as available unless explicitly configured, and network isolation alone doesn't prevent job submission to wrong nodes. - SSH key-based authentication controls user access to nodes, not job scheduling decisions. The job scheduler (Slurm/PBS) uses its own mechanisms for node selection, making this approach ineffective for workload targeting. - Running separate BCM instances defeats the purpose of centralized cluster management and creates operational overhead. BCM is designed to manage heterogeneous clusters with different node types through categories, not multiple head nodes.
questions.eZh: BCM 中的节点类别允许管理员对节点进行逻辑分组（例如按 GPU 类型、用途或硬件代次），并配置 Slurm 等调度器将作业定向到特定类别。这是 BCM 实现工作负载定向和资源分区的预期机制。其它选项错误的原因：- VLAN 隔离提供网络隔离，但不与 BCM 的作业调度系统集成。除非显式配置，调度器仍会视所有节点为可用，仅靠网络隔离无法阻止作业被提交到错误的节点。- 基于 SSH 密钥的认证控制的是用户对节点的访问，而非作业调度决策。作业调度器（Slurm/PBS）使用自身的机制进行节点选择，因此该方式对工作负载定向无效。- 运行多个 BCM 实例违背了集中式集群管理的初衷，并增加运维开销。BCM 的设计目标正是通过类别管理包含不同节点类型的异构集群，而不是使用多个头部节点。

questions.q: A BCM cluster running firmware version 22.05 on compute nodes needs to be updated to firmware version 24.01 to support new GPU features. The cluster has 96 nodes across 4 racks. Operations policy requires zero downtime for running jobs. What is the CORRECT procedure using BCM sync capabilities?
questions.qZh: 某运行固件版本 22.05 的 BCM 集群，其计算节点需要升级到固件版本 24.01 以支持新的 GPU 特性。该集群共有 4 个机架、96 个节点。运维策略要求运行中的作业零停机。使用 BCM 的 sync 能力，正确的操作流程是什么？
o: Execute 'cluster sync --force' to immediately update all nodes regardless of job status
Manually SSH to each node and run firmware update commands, then reboot nodes individually
Drain all running jobs, shut down the entire cluster, apply firmware updates simultaneously, then restart all services
Use cmsh to create a new software image with firmware 24.01, assign it to nodes, and execute 'device update' command which applies updates only to idle nodes
oZh: 执行 'cluster sync --force'，立即更新所有节点而不管作业状态
手动 SSH 到每个节点运行固件更新命令，然后逐个重启节点
排空所有运行中的作业，关闭整个集群，同时应用固件更新，然后重启所有服务
使用 cmsh 创建带有 24.01 固件的新软件镜像，将其分配给节点，并执行 'device update' 命令，该命令仅对空闲节点应用更新
questions.e: BCM's image sync and device update workflow allows administrators to stage firmware updates in software images and apply them selectively. The 'device update' command respects running jobs and updates idle nodes first, enabling rolling updates without disrupting active workloads. This is the proper BCM-native approach. Why the others are wrong: - 'cluster sync --force' would attempt to update all nodes immediately, potentially disrupting running jobs. BCM provides granular control over update timing; forcing synchronous updates violates the zero-downtime requirement. - Manual SSH updates bypass BCM's centralized management and tracking capabilities. This approach is error-prone at scale (96 nodes), doesn't leverage BCM's image management, and requires significantly more operational effort. - Full cluster shutdown is unnecessary with BCM's rolling update capability and violates the zero-downtime requirement. This approach maximizes disruption when BCM is designed specifically to enable updates without full outages. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: BCM 的镜像同步与 device update 工作流允许管理员将固件更新暂存到软件镜像中并有选择地应用。'device update' 命令会兼顾运行中的作业，优先更新空闲节点，从而在不中断活动工作负载的前提下实现滚动更新。这是 BCM 原生的正确方式。其它选项错误的原因：- 'cluster sync --force' 会尝试立即更新所有节点，可能中断正在运行的作业。BCM 提供对更新时机的细粒度控制，强制同步更新违反零停机要求。- 手动 SSH 更新绕过了 BCM 的集中管理和追踪能力。该方式在 96 个节点的规模下极易出错，无法利用 BCM 的镜像管理，运维成本也高得多。- 借助 BCM 的滚动更新能力，完全关闭集群并无必要，且违反零停机要求。BCM 正是为支持无全面中断的更新而设计，这种做法把干扰最大化。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: During BCM installation, the initialization process fails with 'database connection timeout' error. The head node hardware is NVIDIA-certified and meets all specifications. Network connectivity tests show the management network is operational. Which component is MOST likely causing the initialization failure?
questions.qZh: 在 BCM 安装过程中，初始化流程因 'database connection timeout' 错误而失败。头部节点硬件为 NVIDIA 认证并符合所有规格要求。网络连通性测试显示管理网络工作正常。最可能导致初始化失败的组件是什么？
o: Compute nodes not yet added to the cluster causing database schema validation to fail
Base View web service not started, preventing database access from cmsh
Management network MTU size mismatch between head node and switches
PostgreSQL database service not running or cluster database not properly initialized before BCM setup
oZh: 计算节点尚未加入集群，导致数据库 schema 校验失败
Base View Web 服务未启动，导致 cmsh 无法访问数据库
头部节点与交换机之间的管理网络 MTU 大小不匹配
PostgreSQL 数据库服务未运行，或在 BCM 安装前集群数据库未正确初始化
questions.e: BCM requires a functioning PostgreSQL database to store cluster configuration, node states, and job information. The initialization process creates database schemas and must connect to PostgreSQL before proceeding. 'Database connection timeout' specifically indicates the database service is unreachable or not running. Why the others are wrong: - Compute nodes are added AFTER BCM initialization, not before. The cluster database is initialized with just the head node; node additions happen through cmsh after BCM is operational. Missing compute nodes wouldn't cause database connection failures during init. - Base View is a web interface component that uses the database; it doesn't provide database access to cmsh. Both cmsh and Base View are clients of the PostgreSQL database. Base View status doesn't affect database connectivity for initialization. - While MTU mismatches can cause network issues, the scenario states network connectivity tests passed. Database connection timeout is a specific error indicating PostgreSQL service issues, not general network problems that would affect connectivity tests.
questions.eZh: BCM 需要一个正常运行的 PostgreSQL 数据库来存储集群配置、节点状态和作业信息。初始化流程会创建数据库 schema，并且在继续之前必须连接到 PostgreSQL。'database connection timeout' 明确表明数据库服务不可达或未运行。其它选项错误的原因：- 计算节点是在 BCM 初始化之后才添加的，而非之前。集群数据库仅凭头部节点即可初始化；节点添加是在 BCM 可用之后通过 cmsh 完成的。缺少计算节点不会导致初始化期间的数据库连接失败。- Base View 是使用数据库的 Web 界面组件，它并不为 cmsh 提供数据库访问。cmsh 和 Base View 都是 PostgreSQL 数据库的客户端。Base View 的状态不会影响初始化时的数据库连通性。- 虽然 MTU 不匹配可能引发网络问题，但场景中说明网络连通性测试已通过。数据库连接超时是一个明确的错误，指向 PostgreSQL 服务问题，而非会影响连通性测试的普通网络问题。

questions.q: An administrator needs to grant a new team of 15 data scientists access to a BCM cluster. The team should be able to submit jobs, view their own job status, and access compute nodes for debugging, but should NOT be able to modify cluster configuration, add nodes, or view other users' job details. Which BCM role assignment accomplishes this requirement?
questions.qZh: 管理员需要为新加入的 15 名数据科学家团队授予 BCM 集群访问权限。该团队应能提交作业、查看自己的作业状态，并访问计算节点进行调试，但不应能够修改集群配置、添加节点或查看其他用户的作业详情。哪种 BCM 角色分配方案能满足这一需求？
o: Assign the 'user' role to all 15 accounts with default permissions
Assign the 'operator' role which provides job management and node access capabilities
Assign the 'admin' role with custom ACLs to restrict configuration changes
Create accounts without role assignment and rely on POSIX permissions for access control
oZh: 为全部 15 个账户分配带默认权限的 'user' 角色
分配 'operator' 角色，该角色提供作业管理和节点访问能力
分配 'admin' 角色，并使用自定义 ACL 限制配置更改
创建账户但不分配角色，依赖 POSIX 权限进行访问控制
questions.e: The 'user' role in BCM is designed for standard cluster users who submit and manage their own jobs, access compute resources for their workloads, and view their own job information. This role explicitly does NOT grant permissions for cluster configuration, node management, or viewing other users' data, matching all requirements. Why the others are wrong: - The 'operator' role has elevated privileges including the ability to view and manage other users' jobs, cancel jobs cluster-wide, and perform some administrative functions. This exceeds the requirement and violates the principle of least privilege. - The 'admin' role has full cluster management capabilities including node provisioning, configuration changes, and user management. Even with custom ACLs, this approach is unnecessarily complex and creates security risks. The standard 'user' role already provides exactly what's needed. - BCM uses role-based access control (RBAC), not just POSIX permissions. Accounts without role assignment would have undefined permissions and likely wouldn't be able to submit jobs through the scheduler or use BCM-managed features. This approach bypasses BCM's security model. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: BCM 中的 'user' 角色专为提交并管理自己作业的普通集群用户而设计，这类用户可为其工作负载访问计算资源，并查看自己的作业信息。该角色明确不授予集群配置、节点管理或查看其他用户数据的权限，完全满足上述所有要求。其他选项错误的原因：- 'operator' 角色具有更高的权限，包括查看和管理其他用户的作业、在集群范围内取消作业，以及执行部分管理功能。这超出了需求范围，也违反了最小权限原则。- 'admin' 角色拥有完整的集群管理能力，包括节点置备、配置更改和用户管理。即使配合自定义 ACL，这种做法也过于复杂并带来安全风险；标准 'user' 角色已经提供了所需的一切。- BCM 使用基于角色的访问控制（RBAC），而不只是 POSIX 权限。未分配角色的账户其权限将无法确定，并且很可能无法通过调度器提交作业或使用 BCM 管理的功能。这种做法绕过了 BCM 的安全模型。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A company operates a BCM cluster with 128 compute nodes. After a power outage, 12 nodes show status 'unknown' in Base View dashboard while 116 nodes show 'ready'. The management network is confirmed operational. Using cmsh, what is the FIRST diagnostic command to identify why the 12 nodes are not reporting status?
questions.qZh: 某公司运营着一个包含 128 个计算节点的 BCM 集群。断电后，Base View 仪表板中有 12 个节点状态显示为 'unknown'，而 116 个节点显示为 'ready'。管理网络已确认正常。使用 cmsh 时，识别这 12 个节点未上报状态原因的第一条诊断命令是什么？
o: device list -s to display detailed status of all devices and identify nodes with communication failures
cluster restart to reinitialize all node connections and force status updates
category show to verify the unknown nodes are still assigned to valid categories
image sync to push the latest software image and restore node configurations
oZh: device list -s，显示所有设备的详细状态并找出存在通信故障的节点
cluster restart，重新初始化所有节点连接并强制刷新状态
category show，验证 unknown 状态的节点是否仍被分配到有效的类别
image sync，推送最新的软件镜像并恢复节点配置
questions.e: 'device list -s' (or 'device list --status') in cmsh shows detailed status information for all cluster devices including connection state, last heartbeat, and communication errors. This is the primary diagnostic command for investigating why specific nodes aren't reporting to the head node after events like power outages. Why the others are wrong: - 'cluster restart' is a disruptive operation that restarts BCM services on the head node and would affect all 128 nodes, not just the 12 with issues. Diagnostic commands should be run first to identify the problem before taking disruptive actions. This also wouldn't help if nodes have hardware or boot issues. - 'category show' displays category definitions and membership but doesn't provide node communication status or help diagnose why nodes are unreachable. Category assignment doesn't affect whether nodes can communicate with the head node after a power event. - 'image sync' pushes software images to nodes, but requires nodes to be reachable first. If nodes show 'unknown' status, they likely can't communicate with the head node to receive synced images. This addresses a symptom, not the underlying communication issue that needs diagnosis.
questions.eZh: cmsh 中的 'device list -s'（或 'device list --status'）会显示集群所有设备的详细状态信息，包括连接状态、最后一次心跳以及通信错误。这是调查在断电等事件发生后特定节点为何未向 head 节点上报状态的首选诊断命令。其他选项错误的原因：- 'cluster restart' 是一项有破坏性的操作，会重启 head 节点上的 BCM 服务，影响全部 128 个节点，而不只是出问题的 12 个。应当先运行诊断命令定位问题，再采取破坏性操作。此外，若节点存在硬件或启动问题，该操作也无济于事。- 'category show' 显示类别定义及其成员关系，但不提供节点通信状态，也无法帮助诊断节点为何不可达。类别分配并不影响节点在断电事件后能否与 head 节点通信。- 'image sync' 会向节点推送软件镜像，但这要求节点先处于可达状态。若节点状态显示为 'unknown'，它们很可能无法与 head 节点通信以接收同步的镜像。这只解决了表象，而没有解决需要诊断的底层通信问题。

questions.q: A research institution needs to provision 200 newly racked compute nodes in their existing BCM cluster. The nodes require specific firmware version 23.11 and a custom Ubuntu 22.04 image with pre-installed AI frameworks. The existing cluster has 300 nodes running firmware 23.09. What is the MOST efficient BCM workflow to provision the new nodes with correct firmware and software?
questions.qZh: 某研究机构需要在现有 BCM 集群中置备 200 台新上架的计算节点。这些节点需要特定的固件版本 23.11，以及预装 AI 框架的自定义 Ubuntu 22.04 镜像。现有集群中有 300 个节点运行固件 23.09。哪种 BCM 工作流最高效地为新节点置备正确的固件和软件？
o: Add all 200 nodes to the cluster first, then manually SSH to each node to install firmware 23.11 and the Ubuntu image
Use cmsh to upgrade all 500 nodes (existing 300 + new 200) to firmware 23.11 simultaneously, then provision with custom image
Create a separate BCM cluster for the 200 new nodes to avoid firmware version conflicts with existing nodes
Create a new software image with Ubuntu 22.04 and AI frameworks, assign firmware 23.11 to the image, add nodes via cmsh with the new image, then sync
oZh: 先将全部 200 个节点加入集群，然后手动 SSH 到每个节点安装固件 23.11 和 Ubuntu 镜像
使用 cmsh 将全部 500 个节点（现有 300 个 + 新增 200 个）同时升级到固件 23.11，然后再使用自定义镜像置备
为 200 个新节点单独创建一个 BCM 集群，以避免与现有节点产生固件版本冲突
创建一个包含 Ubuntu 22.04 和 AI 框架的新软件镜像，为该镜像指定固件 23.11，通过 cmsh 使用新镜像添加节点，然后执行同步
questions.e: BCM's image-based provisioning allows administrators to create software images that bundle OS, applications, and firmware versions. Assigning the custom image to new nodes during addition (via cmsh 'device add' with image specification) and then syncing ensures all 200 nodes get the correct configuration in one operation. This is the designed BCM workflow for heterogeneous provisioning. Why the others are wrong: - Manual SSH provisioning bypasses BCM's centralized management and doesn't scale efficiently to 200 nodes. It's error-prone, time-consuming, and loses the benefits of BCM's image tracking and configuration management. BCM provides automated sync specifically to avoid manual node-by-node operations. - Upgrading all 500 nodes to firmware 23.11 is unnecessary and disruptive to the existing 300 nodes that are working fine on 23.09. BCM supports heterogeneous firmware versions across different node groups through image assignments. This creates unnecessary risk and downtime. - Running separate BCM clusters for different firmware versions adds operational complexity and defeats the purpose of centralized management. BCM is designed to manage heterogeneous clusters with different hardware, firmware, and software configurations through categories and image assignments. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: BCM 基于镜像的置备机制允许管理员创建把操作系统、应用程序和固件版本打包在一起的软件镜像。在添加节点时指定该镜像（通过 cmsh 'device add' 并指定镜像），再执行同步，即可一次性确保全部 200 个节点获得正确配置。这正是 BCM 为异构置备设计的标准工作流。其他选项错误的原因：- 手动 SSH 置备绕过了 BCM 的集中式管理，且无法高效扩展到 200 个节点。这种方式容易出错、耗时，并且失去了 BCM 的镜像跟踪与配置管理优势。BCM 提供自动同步正是为了避免逐节点手动操作。- 将全部 500 个节点升级到固件 23.11 既无必要，又会干扰在 23.09 上运行良好的现有 300 个节点。BCM 支持通过镜像分配在不同节点组之间使用不同的固件版本。此做法只会徒增风险和停机时间。- 为不同固件版本运行彼此独立的 BCM 集群会增加运维复杂度，并且违背集中式管理的初衷。BCM 的设计目标正是通过类别和镜像分配来管理硬件、固件和软件配置各异的异构集群。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Base View dashboard shows node 'gpu047' with status 'ready' but GPU utilization displays 'N/A' for all 8 GPUs while other nodes show GPU metrics correctly. The node is running jobs successfully and users report no issues. What is the MOST likely cause and solution?
questions.qZh: Base View 仪表板显示节点 'gpu047' 状态为 'ready'，但全部 8 个 GPU 的利用率都显示为 'N/A'，而其他节点能正确显示 GPU 指标。该节点上的作业运行正常，用户未报告任何问题。最可能的原因和解决方案是什么？
o: Base View web service cache is stale; restart the Base View service on the head node
NVIDIA DCGM (Data Center GPU Manager) service not running on gpu047; restart dcgm service on the node
Node gpu047 is in the wrong category; reassign to a category with GPU monitoring enabled
GPUs on gpu047 have failed hardware sensors; replace the GPUs to restore monitoring
oZh: Base View web 服务缓存已过期；在 head 节点上重启 Base View 服务
gpu047 上的 NVIDIA DCGM（Data Center GPU Manager）服务未运行；在该节点上重启 dcgm 服务
节点 gpu047 所属类别有误；将其重新分配到启用了 GPU 监控的类别
gpu047 上的 GPU 硬件传感器已故障；更换 GPU 以恢复监控
questions.e: Base View relies on NVIDIA DCGM agents running on each compute node to collect GPU metrics (utilization, temperature, power). If DCGM service isn't running on a specific node, that node won't report GPU telemetry to Base View, resulting in 'N/A' displays. Since jobs run successfully, the GPUs work but monitoring is broken. DCGM service restart is the appropriate fix. Why the others are wrong: - Base View web service runs on the head node and serves the dashboard to all nodes. If it had issues, no nodes would show GPU metrics, not just gpu047. The fact that other nodes display metrics correctly indicates the Base View service itself is functioning properly. - Node categories are logical groupings for job scheduling and management; they don't control whether GPU monitoring is enabled. DCGM runs independently of category assignment. If categories controlled monitoring, BCM would require explicit configuration per category, which isn't how GPU telemetry works. - If GPU hardware sensors failed, the GPUs likely wouldn't function for compute workloads either. The scenario states jobs run successfully, indicating the GPUs are healthy. 'N/A' for all 8 GPUs simultaneously points to a monitoring service issue (DCGM), not hardware failure of all sensors at once.
questions.eZh: Base View 依赖运行在每个计算节点上的 NVIDIA DCGM 代理来采集 GPU 指标（利用率、温度、功耗）。如果某个节点上的 DCGM 服务没有运行，该节点就不会向 Base View 上报 GPU 遥测数据，从而显示为 'N/A'。由于作业运行正常，说明 GPU 工作正常，只是监控失效。因此重启 DCGM 服务是恰当的修复方式。其他选项错误的原因：- Base View web 服务运行在 head 节点上，为所有节点提供仪表板。如果它有问题，应当是所有节点都不显示 GPU 指标，而不仅仅是 gpu047。其他节点能正确显示指标，这表明 Base View 服务本身工作正常。- 节点类别是用于作业调度和管理的逻辑分组，并不控制是否启用 GPU 监控。DCGM 的运行与类别分配无关。如果类别能够控制监控，BCM 就需要针对每个类别进行显式配置，而 GPU 遥测并非这样工作的。- 如果是 GPU 硬件传感器故障，GPU 通常也无法正常执行计算工作负载。题目说明作业运行正常，表明 GPU 硬件是健康的。全部 8 个 GPU 同时显示 'N/A' 指向的是监控服务（DCGM）问题，而不是所有传感器同时发生硬件失效。

questions.q: A data science team needs to deploy a Slurm cluster on BCM-managed nodes with 8x A100 GPUs per node. The cluster must allow jobs to request specific GPU types and counts. Which configuration in gres.conf is CORRECT?
questions.qZh: 某数据科学团队需要在 BCM 管理的节点上部署 Slurm 集群，每节点配备 8x A100 GPU。该集群必须允许作业请求特定的 GPU 类型和数量。gres.conf 中哪种配置是正确的？
o: Name=gpu Type=a100 File=/dev/nvidia[0-7]
Name=gpu Type=a100 Count=8
Name=gpu Type=nvidia Count=8 File=/dev/nvidia0
Name=a100 Type=gpu File=/dev/nvidia[0-7] Count=8
oZh: Name=gpu Type=a100 File=/dev/nvidia[0-7]
Name=gpu Type=a100 Count=8
Name=gpu Type=nvidia Count=8 File=/dev/nvidia0
Name=a100 Type=gpu File=/dev/nvidia[0-7] Count=8
questions.e: Slurm gres.conf requires Name=gpu (fixed name), Type to specify GPU model (a100), and File=/dev/nvidia[0-7] to map the 8 GPU device files. This allows jobs to use --gres=gpu:a100:2 syntax. Why the others are wrong: - Count parameter does not exist in gres.conf — GPU count is determined by the number of device files in the File= parameter - File=/dev/nvidia0 only exposes one GPU instead of all 8, and Count is invalid syntax - Name must be 'gpu' not 'a100' — Type is for GPU model differentiation, and Count is not a valid parameter ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Slurm 的 gres.conf 要求 Name=gpu（固定名称），用 Type 指定 GPU 型号（a100），并通过 File=/dev/nvidia[0-7] 映射 8 个 GPU 设备文件。这样作业便可以使用 --gres=gpu:a100:2 语法。其他选项错误的原因：- gres.conf 中不存在 Count 参数——GPU 数量由 File= 参数中所列的设备文件数量决定 - File=/dev/nvidia0 只暴露 1 个 GPU 而非全部 8 个，且 Count 属于无效语法 - Name 必须是 'gpu' 而不能是 'a100'——区分 GPU 型号靠的是 Type，且 Count 不是有效参数 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An organization is configuring BCM to display Slurm job statistics in Base View. The Slurm controller uses MySQL for accounting. Which BCM configuration step is REQUIRED to integrate the accounting database?
questions.qZh: 某组织正在配置 BCM，以便在 Base View 中显示 Slurm 作业统计信息。该 Slurm 控制器使用 MySQL 进行记账。要集成该记账数据库，必须执行哪个 BCM 配置步骤？
o: Install the BCM Slurm plugin on all compute nodes and restart slurmd
Export Slurm accounting data to CSV hourly and upload to BCM via REST API
Install the BCM collector daemon on the Slurm controller node only
Configure BCM with the MySQL connection string to the slurmdbd database in the integrations section
oZh: 在所有计算节点上安装 BCM Slurm 插件并重启 slurmd
每小时将 Slurm 记账数据导出为 CSV，并通过 REST API 上传到 BCM
仅在 Slurm 控制器节点上安装 BCM collector 守护进程
在 integrations 部分用指向 slurmdbd 数据库的 MySQL 连接字符串配置 BCM
questions.e: BCM reads Slurm job data directly from the slurmdbd accounting database by connecting to MySQL/MariaDB. The connection string (host, port, database name, credentials) must be configured in BCM's workload manager integration settings. Why the others are wrong: - BCM does not require a plugin on compute nodes — it reads from the centralized accounting database maintained by slurmdbd - BCM integrates natively with the slurmdbd database — manual CSV export is not the integration method and defeats real-time monitoring - The collector daemon is not Slurm-specific and installing only on controller misses compute node metrics — database integration is the correct approach
questions.eZh: BCM 通过连接 MySQL/MariaDB，直接从 slurmdbd 记账数据库读取 Slurm 作业数据。连接字符串（主机、端口、数据库名、凭据）必须在 BCM 的工作负载管理器集成设置中配置。其他选项错误的原因：- BCM 不要求在计算节点上安装插件——它读取的是由 slurmdbd 维护的集中式记账数据库 - BCM 与 slurmdbd 数据库原生集成——手动导出 CSV 不是集成方式，并且无法实现实时监控 - collector 守护进程并非 Slurm 专用，仅安装在控制器上会遗漏计算节点的指标——数据库集成才是正确做法

questions.q: A Kubernetes cluster on NVIDIA DGX nodes needs GPU workload scheduling. The cluster was initialized with BCM, and the control plane is running. What is the NEXT step to enable GPU pod scheduling?
questions.qZh: 部署在 NVIDIA DGX 节点上的 Kubernetes 集群需要进行 GPU 工作负载调度。该集群已用 BCM 初始化，控制平面正在运行。要启用 GPU Pod 调度，下一步应该做什么？
o: Label all worker nodes with nvidia.com/gpu=true using kubectl
Deploy the NVIDIA GPU Operator via Helm to install device plugin and monitoring stack
Manually install nvidia-docker2 on each worker node and restart kubelet
Configure the Kubernetes scheduler to enable GPU-aware scheduling in kube-scheduler.yaml
oZh: 使用 kubectl 将所有工作节点标记为 nvidia.com/gpu=true
通过 Helm 部署 NVIDIA GPU Operator，以安装设备插件和监控组件栈
在每个工作节点上手动安装 nvidia-docker2 并重启 kubelet
在 kube-scheduler.yaml 中配置 Kubernetes 调度器以启用 GPU 感知调度
questions.e: The NVIDIA GPU Operator automates deployment of all GPU components: device plugin (for GPU resource exposure), container runtime, drivers, monitoring (dcgm-exporter), and feature discovery. It's the standard production deployment method. Why the others are wrong: - Node labels are automatically applied by the GPU Operator's node-feature-discovery component — manual labeling is not required and doesn't enable GPU scheduling - nvidia-docker2 is deprecated — the GPU Operator uses the NVIDIA Container Toolkit and manages installation automatically across all nodes - The default kube-scheduler handles GPU scheduling once the device plugin is running — no scheduler config changes needed, and the device plugin comes from GPU Operator ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: NVIDIA GPU Operator 可自动化部署所有 GPU 组件：设备插件（用于暴露 GPU 资源）、容器运行时、驱动、监控（dcgm-exporter）以及特性发现（feature discovery）。它是生产环境中标准的部署方式。其他选项错误的原因：- 节点标签由 GPU Operator 的 node-feature-discovery 组件自动添加——无需手动标记，而且手动标记也无法启用 GPU 调度 - nvidia-docker2 已被弃用——GPU Operator 使用 NVIDIA Container Toolkit，并自动在所有节点上完成安装与管理 - 默认的 kube-scheduler 在设备插件运行后即可处理 GPU 调度——无需修改调度器配置，而且设备插件来自 GPU Operator ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: During Slurm installation on BCM, the slurm.conf file must define compute node roles. A cluster has 1 controller node (gpu-ctrl01) and 4 compute nodes (gpu-node[01-04]) with 8 GPUs each. Which slurm.conf NodeName entry is CORRECT?
questions.qZh: 在 BCM 上安装 Slurm 时，slurm.conf 文件必须定义计算节点角色。某集群有 1 个控制器节点（gpu-ctrl01）和 4 个计算节点（gpu-node[01-04]），每个计算节点配备 8 个 GPU。哪种 slurm.conf 的 NodeName 条目是正确的？
o: NodeName=gpu-node[01-04] Gres=gpu:8 State=UNKNOWN
NodeName=gpu-node[01-04] Sockets=2 CoresPerSocket=64 Gres=gpu:8 State=IDLE
NodeName=gpu-node[01-04] CPUs=128 Gres=gpu:a100:8 RealMemory=512000 State=UNKNOWN
NodeName=DEFAULT Gres=gpu:8 RealMemory=512000 State=UNKNOWN
oZh: NodeName=gpu-node[01-04] Gres=gpu:8 State=UNKNOWN
NodeName=gpu-node[01-04] Sockets=2 CoresPerSocket=64 Gres=gpu:8 State=IDLE
NodeName=gpu-node[01-04] CPUs=128 Gres=gpu:a100:8 RealMemory=512000 State=UNKNOWN
NodeName=DEFAULT Gres=gpu:8 RealMemory=512000 State=UNKNOWN
questions.e: NodeName entry requires CPUs (total CPU count), Gres with Type (gpu:a100:8 specifies 8 A100 GPUs), RealMemory (RAM in MB), and State=UNKNOWN (initial state before node registration). This matches exam requirements for complete node definition. Why the others are wrong: - Missing CPUs and RealMemory parameters which are required — Gres=gpu:8 lacks GPU type specification needed when multiple GPU types exist - Sockets and CoresPerSocket are optional if CPUs is provided — State=IDLE is incorrect for initial config (nodes start UNKNOWN until slurmd registers) - NodeName=DEFAULT is for setting defaults across multiple NodeName entries — cannot be used alone, and doesn't specify which nodes are compute nodes
questions.eZh: NodeName 条目需要包含 CPUs（CPU 总数）、带类型的 Gres（gpu:a100:8 表示 8 个 A100 GPU）、RealMemory（以 MB 为单位的内存）以及 State=UNKNOWN（节点注册前的初始状态）。这符合考试对完整节点定义的要求。其他选项错误的原因：- 缺少必需的 CPUs 和 RealMemory 参数——Gres=gpu:8 缺少在存在多种 GPU 型号时所需的 GPU 型号说明 - 如果已提供 CPUs，则 Sockets 和 CoresPerSocket 是可选的——而在初始配置中 State=IDLE 是错误的（节点在 slurmd 注册前均为 UNKNOWN） - NodeName=DEFAULT 用于为多个 NodeName 条目设置默认值——不能单独使用，而且没有指明哪些节点是计算节点

questions.q: A company needs to deploy Run:ai on a BCM-managed Kubernetes cluster. The GPU Operator is already installed. Which sequence of steps is CORRECT to complete Run:ai installation?
questions.qZh: 某公司需要在 BCM 管理的 Kubernetes 集群上部署 Run:ai。GPU Operator 已经安装完成。完成 Run:ai 安装的正确步骤顺序是什么？
o: Install Run:ai CLI → Create cluster in Run:ai SaaS UI → Run 'runai install' → Register cluster with generated token
Add Run:ai Helm repo → Install runai-operator chart → Create cluster in Run:ai SaaS → Copy cluster YAML and apply with kubectl
Install Run:ai control plane via Helm → Register cluster in Run:ai SaaS UI → Apply the generated cluster installation YAML
Deploy Run:ai agent DaemonSet → Install Run:ai scheduler → Register with Run:ai cloud using runai-adm register
oZh: 安装 Run:ai CLI → 在 Run:ai SaaS UI 中创建集群 → 运行 'runai install' → 使用生成的令牌注册集群
添加 Run:ai Helm repo → 安装 runai-operator chart → 在 Run:ai SaaS 中创建集群 → 复制集群 YAML 并用 kubectl 应用
通过 Helm 安装 Run:ai 控制平面 → 在 Run:ai SaaS UI 中注册集群 → 应用生成的集群安装 YAML
部署 Run:ai agent DaemonSet → 安装 Run:ai 调度器 → 使用 runai-adm register 注册到 Run:ai 云
questions.e: Run:ai installation: (1) Install the control plane components via Helm (runai-cluster chart), (2) Register the cluster in Run:ai SaaS to get cluster credentials, (3) Apply the generated YAML containing cluster-specific config. This is the official documented sequence. Why the others are wrong: - Run:ai installation is Helm-based, not via 'runai install' CLI command — cluster creation in SaaS happens after Helm install, not before - Sequence is reversed — control plane must be installed before cluster registration, and the generated YAML is applied via Helm values, not as separate kubectl apply - Run:ai uses Helm charts, not manual DaemonSet deployment — 'runai-adm register' is not the registration method (uses cluster creation in SaaS UI)
questions.eZh: Run:ai 安装流程：（1）通过 Helm 安装控制平面组件（runai-cluster chart）；（2）在 Run:ai SaaS 中注册集群以获取集群凭据；（3）应用包含集群专属配置的生成的 YAML。这是官方文档给出的标准顺序。其他选项错误的原因：- Run:ai 的安装基于 Helm，而不是通过 'runai install' CLI 命令——在 SaaS 中创建集群发生在 Helm 安装之后，而不是之前 - 顺序颠倒了——必须先安装控制平面，然后才能注册集群，而且生成的 YAML 是通过 Helm values 应用，而不是单独用 kubectl apply - Run:ai 使用 Helm chart，而非手动部署 DaemonSet——'runai-adm register' 并不是注册方式（注册是在 SaaS UI 中创建集群）

questions.q: An administrator is initializing a Kubernetes cluster on NVIDIA DGX servers using BCM. The control plane initialization command fails with 'port 6443 already in use'. What is the MOST likely cause and solution?
questions.qZh: 管理员正在使用 BCM 在 NVIDIA DGX 服务器上初始化 Kubernetes 集群。控制平面初始化命令失败，提示 'port 6443 already in use'。最可能的原因和解决方案是什么？
o: The BCM management service uses port 6443 — reconfigure BCM to use port 8443 in bcm.conf
Another Kubernetes cluster is running — run 'kubeadm reset' on all nodes before reinitializing
Docker is not installed — install docker-ce and restart the initialization
The firewall is blocking port 6443 — open the port with 'firewall-cmd --add-port=6443/tcp' and retry
oZh: BCM 管理服务占用了 6443 端口——在 bcm.conf 中将 BCM 重新配置为使用 8443 端口
另一个 Kubernetes 集群正在运行——在重新初始化前于所有节点上运行 'kubeadm reset'
未安装 Docker——安装 docker-ce 并重新开始初始化
防火墙阻止了 6443 端口——使用 'firewall-cmd --add-port=6443/tcp' 放行该端口并重试
questions.e: Port 6443 is the default kube-apiserver port. If 'already in use', a previous Kubernetes installation exists. 'kubeadm reset' cleans up all Kubernetes components and releases the port. This is the standard recovery procedure. Why the others are wrong: - BCM does not use port 6443 — that port is specifically for Kubernetes API server, and BCM runs on different ports (typically 8000-8080 range) - Kubernetes 1.24+ uses containerd not Docker — docker-ce is not required, and missing container runtime would show different error - Firewall blocking would show 'connection refused' not 'port in use' — port in use means a process is already listening on that port ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 6443 是 kube-apiserver 的默认端口。如果提示 'already in use'，说明存在先前的 Kubernetes 安装。'kubeadm reset' 会清理所有 Kubernetes 组件并释放该端口，这是标准的恢复流程。其他选项错误的原因：- BCM 不使用 6443 端口——该端口专门用于 Kubernetes API Server，而 BCM 运行在其他端口上（通常为 8000-8080 区间） - Kubernetes 1.24+ 使用 containerd 而非 Docker——不需要 docker-ce，而且缺少容器运行时会显示不同的错误 - 防火墙阻止会显示 'connection refused' 而不是 'port in use'——端口被占用意味着已有进程在该端口上监听 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A BCM environment has Slurm installed with GPU nodes. Users report that 'srun --gres=gpu:1' jobs are pending with reason '(Resources)'. Slurm logs show 'gres/gpu: no gres.conf file'. Which file is missing and where should it be located?
questions.qZh: 某 BCM 环境安装了带 GPU 节点的 Slurm。用户报告 'srun --gres=gpu:1' 作业一直处于 pending 状态，原因为 '(Resources)'。Slurm 日志显示 'gres/gpu: no gres.conf file'。缺少的是哪个文件，应放在哪里？
o: gres.conf missing on compute nodes in /etc/slurm/gres.conf — copy from controller and restart slurmd
gres.conf missing on controller node in /etc/slurm/gres.conf — create file with GPU definitions and restart slurmctld
gpu.conf missing on all nodes in /etc/slurm/gpu.conf — create file and restart slurm services
topology.conf missing on controller in /etc/slurm/topology.conf — define GPU topology and restart slurmctld
oZh: 计算节点上缺少 gres.conf，位于 /etc/slurm/gres.conf——从控制器复制并重启 slurmd
控制器节点上缺少 gres.conf，位于 /etc/slurm/gres.conf——创建包含 GPU 定义的文件并重启 slurmctld
所有节点上缺少 gpu.conf，位于 /etc/slurm/gpu.conf——创建该文件并重启 Slurm 服务
控制器上缺少 topology.conf，位于 /etc/slurm/topology.conf——定义 GPU 拓扑并重启 slurmctld
questions.e: gres.conf must exist on the Slurm controller node at /etc/slurm/gres.conf and define GPU resources (Name=gpu Type=... File=...). The controller reads this file when starting slurmctld. Compute nodes reference the gres definitions from the controller. Why the others are wrong: - gres.conf is read by the controller, not compute nodes — compute nodes need slurm.conf with Gres= parameter, but gres.conf itself lives on controller - File is named gres.conf not gpu.conf — gpu.conf is not a Slurm configuration file - topology.conf is for network topology (switches, nodes), not GPU definitions — gres.conf is the correct file for GPU resource configuration ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: gres.conf 必须存在于 Slurm 控制器节点的 /etc/slurm/gres.conf，并定义 GPU 资源（Name=gpu Type=... File=...）。控制器在启动 slurmctld 时会读取该文件，计算节点则引用控制器上的 gres 定义。其他选项错误的原因：- gres.conf 由控制器读取，而不是计算节点——计算节点需要带 Gres= 参数的 slurm.conf，但 gres.conf 本身位于控制器上 - 文件名是 gres.conf 而非 gpu.conf——gpu.conf 不是 Slurm 配置文件 - topology.conf 用于描述网络拓扑（交换机、节点），而不是 GPU 定义——配置 GPU 资源的正确文件是 gres.conf ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: After deploying the NVIDIA GPU Operator on Kubernetes, an administrator needs to verify that GPU pods can be scheduled. Which command output confirms the device plugin is running correctly?
questions.qZh: 在 Kubernetes 上部署 NVIDIA GPU Operator 之后，管理员需要验证 GPU Pod 能够被调度。哪条命令的输出可以确认设备插件运行正常？
o: kubectl get pods -n gpu-operator shows all pods in Running state
nvidia-smi on worker nodes shows GPU utilization for running pods
kubectl get nodes -o json | jq '.items[].status.capacity' shows 'nvidia.com/gpu: "8"' for GPU nodes
kubectl describe node gpu-worker01 shows 'gpu-operator=enabled' label
oZh: kubectl get pods -n gpu-operator 显示所有 Pod 都处于 Running 状态
在工作节点上执行 nvidia-smi，显示运行中 Pod 的 GPU 利用率
kubectl get nodes -o json | jq '.items[].status.capacity' 对 GPU 节点显示 'nvidia.com/gpu: "8"'
kubectl describe node gpu-worker01 显示 'gpu-operator=enabled' 标签
questions.e: The device plugin advertises GPU resources to the Kubernetes scheduler by adding 'nvidia.com/gpu' to node capacity. Checking node capacity for this resource confirms the device plugin successfully detected GPUs and registered them with the cluster. Why the others are wrong: - GPU Operator pods running does not guarantee the device plugin registered GPUs — the device plugin pod could be running but failing to detect GPUs - nvidia-smi showing utilization proves GPUs work on the host but doesn't confirm Kubernetes can schedule GPU pods — need to verify kubernetes resource registration - The label 'gpu-operator=enabled' is not automatically added — node labels like 'nvidia.com/gpu.present=true' are added by node-feature-discovery, but capacity check is definitive
questions.eZh: 设备插件通过把 'nvidia.com/gpu' 添加到节点容量中，向 Kubernetes 调度器通告 GPU 资源。检查节点容量中的该资源，即可确认设备插件已成功检测到 GPU 并向集群注册。其他选项错误的原因：- GPU Operator 的 Pod 处于运行状态并不能保证设备插件已注册 GPU——设备插件 Pod 可能正在运行却未能检测到 GPU - nvidia-smi 显示利用率只能证明主机上的 GPU 可用，并不能确认 Kubernetes 能调度 GPU Pod——需要验证 Kubernetes 的资源注册情况 - 'gpu-operator=enabled' 标签并不会自动添加——诸如 'nvidia.com/gpu.present=true' 的节点标签由 node-feature-discovery 添加，而容量检查才是确定性的验证方式

questions.q: A data center engineer needs to update GPU firmware across a 128-node DGX SuperPOD cluster to address a critical security vulnerability. The firmware update must be applied without manual intervention on each node and should allow rollback if issues occur. Which BCM approach BEST meets these requirements?
questions.qZh: 某数据中心工程师需要在 128 节点的 DGX SuperPOD 集群上更新 GPU 固件，以应对一个严重的安全漏洞。固件更新必须能够在各节点上无需人工干预地完成，并允许在出现问题时回滚。哪种 BCM 方案最符合这些要求？
o: Use 'cmsh' to create a firmware update category, assign nodes to it, and execute 'device update firmware -c ' with the --backup flag to enable rollback
Manually download firmware files to each node via SSH and run the manufacturer's update utility individually on all 128 nodes
Configure a cron job on the head node to push firmware updates using Ansible playbooks and custom scripts
Use the GPU vendor's proprietary management software separately from BCM to update all GPUs simultaneously
oZh: 使用 'cmsh' 创建固件更新类别，将节点分配到该类别，然后执行 'device update firmware -c ' 并带上 --backup 标志以启用回滚
通过 SSH 手动将固件文件下载到每个节点，并在全部 128 个节点上分别运行厂商的更新工具
在 head 节点上配置 cron 作业，使用 Ansible playbook 和自定义脚本推送固件更新
独立于 BCM 使用 GPU 厂商的专有管理软件一次性更新所有 GPU
questions.e: BCM's category-based firmware management allows cluster-wide GPU firmware updates with a single command. The --backup flag creates a rollback point, and BCM tracks update status across all nodes. This is the exam-tested method for firmware updates in NVIDIA Base Command Manager. Why the others are wrong: - Manual SSH to 128 nodes violates the requirement for no manual intervention per node and doesn't provide BCM-integrated rollback or tracking - External Ansible scripts bypass BCM's firmware management features and won't integrate with BCM's node provisioning state or health checks - Using separate vendor tools creates management silos and doesn't leverage BCM's cluster-wide orchestration or node category system ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: BCM 基于类别的固件管理支持仅用一条命令完成全集群 GPU 固件更新。--backup 标志会创建回滚点，且 BCM 会跟踪所有节点上的更新状态。这是 NVIDIA Base Command Manager 中固件更新常考的方法。其他选项错误的原因：- 手动 SSH 到 128 个节点违反了逐节点无需人工干预的要求，而且无法提供与 BCM 集成的回滚或跟踪能力 - 外部 Ansible 脚本绕过 BCM 的固件管理功能，也无法与 BCM 的节点置备状态或健康检查集成 - 使用独立的厂商工具会造成管理孤岛，无法利用 BCM 的集群级编排和节点类别系统 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An administrator configures InfiniBand networking for a new compute cluster in BCM. After provisioning nodes, half the nodes show 'IB link down' status. Running 'ibstat' on affected nodes shows 'State: Down, Physical state: Polling'. Which action should the administrator take FIRST?
questions.qZh: 管理员在 BCM 中为新的计算集群配置 InfiniBand 网络。节点置备完成后，一半节点显示 'IB link down' 状态。在受影响节点上运行 'ibstat' 显示 'State: Down, Physical state: Polling'。管理员首先应采取哪项操作？
o: Verify the InfiniBand subnet manager (opensm) is running and configured correctly in BCM network policies, as only one active SM should manage the fabric
Replace all InfiniBand cables on affected nodes assuming physical layer failure
Reboot all compute nodes simultaneously to reset the InfiniBand adapters
Increase the InfiniBand timeout values in the switch configuration files
oZh: 验证 InfiniBand 子网管理器（opensm）正在运行且在 BCM 网络策略中配置正确，因为只能有一个活动的 SM 管理该网络结构
假定物理层故障，更换受影响节点上的所有 InfiniBand 线缆
同时重启所有计算节点以重置 InfiniBand 适配器
在交换机配置文件中增大 InfiniBand 超时值
questions.e: 'Physical state: Polling' indicates the port is attempting to establish a link but cannot complete subnet manager handshake. BCM configures the subnet manager via network policies. Missing or misconfigured SM is the most common cause of this exact symptom. Exam tests this specific troubleshooting sequence. Why the others are wrong: - Polling state suggests logical configuration issues, not physical cable failure; cables would show 'Physical state: Disabled' or no detection - Mass reboots don't address SM configuration and may cause cluster-wide disruption; proper troubleshooting starts with network layer checks - Timeout values affect established links, not initial link establishment; Polling state means links never reached Active state ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 'Physical state: Polling' 表明端口正在尝试建立链路，但无法完成与子网管理器的握手。BCM 通过网络策略配置子网管理器。SM 缺失或配置错误正是导致这一症状的最常见原因。考试会考查这一具体的排障顺序。其他选项错误的原因：- Polling 状态提示的是逻辑配置问题，而不是物理线缆故障；线缆问题会显示 'Physical state: Disabled' 或完全检测不到 - 大规模重启无法解决 SM 配置问题，还可能造成集群级中断；正确的排障应从网络层检查开始 - 超时值影响的是已建立的链路，而非初始的链路建立过程；处于 Polling 状态意味着链路从未进入 Active 状态 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A company needs to install DOCA Services on BlueField-2 DPU Arm cores across 64 nodes to enable DPU-accelerated NVMe-oF storage. The installation must be automated through BCM and ensure all DPUs run identical DOCA versions. Which BCM feature accomplishes this?
questions.qZh: 某公司需要在 64 个节点的 BlueField-2 DPU Arm 核心上安装 DOCA Services，以启用 DPU 加速的 NVMe-oF 存储。安装必须通过 BCM 自动化完成，并确保所有 DPU 运行相同版本的 DOCA。哪种 BCM 特性可以做到这一点？
o: SSH into each DPU's Arm core individually and run 'apt-get install doca-services' on all 64 DPUs
Create a DPU software image in BCM's image repository, assign it to a node category containing the 64 nodes, and provision the DPUs using 'cmsh device provision'
Use NVIDIA GPU Cloud (NGC) to pull DOCA containers directly to each DPU, bypassing BCM
Configure the x86 host OS to install DOCA on the DPU via PCIe passthrough commands
oZh: 分别 SSH 进入每个 DPU 的 Arm 核心，在全部 64 个 DPU 上运行 'apt-get install doca-services'
在 BCM 的镜像库中创建 DPU 软件镜像，将其分配给包含这 64 个节点的节点类别，并使用 'cmsh device provision' 置备 DPU
使用 NVIDIA GPU Cloud (NGC) 直接将 DOCA 容器拉取到每个 DPU，绕过 BCM
配置 x86 主机操作系统通过 PCIe 直通命令在 DPU 上安装 DOCA
questions.e: BCM treats BlueField DPUs as provisionable devices with dedicated software images. Image-based provisioning ensures version consistency and leverages BCM's category system for fleet management. This is the exam-tested workflow for DPU software deployment. Why the others are wrong: - Manual SSH to 64 DPUs doesn't use BCM automation, can't guarantee version consistency, and bypasses BCM's image management - NGC containers are application-layer; DOCA Services installation requires OS-level packages deployed via BCM's provisioning system - DOCA must be installed on the DPU's Arm OS, not passed through from x86 host; this approach is architecturally incorrect
questions.eZh: BCM 把 BlueField DPU 视为可置备的设备，并为其配备专用软件镜像。基于镜像的置备可确保版本一致性，并利用 BCM 的类别系统进行整机群管理。这是 DPU 软件部署常考的工作流。其他选项错误的原因：- 手动 SSH 到 64 个 DPU 未使用 BCM 自动化，无法保证版本一致性，并且绕过了 BCM 的镜像管理 - NGC 容器属于应用层；而 DOCA Services 的安装需要通过 BCM 的置备系统部署操作系统层的软件包 - DOCA 必须安装在 DPU 的 Arm 操作系统上，而不是从 x86 主机透传过来；这种做法在架构上是错误的

questions.q: During node provisioning, 12 out of 96 nodes fail with error 'Image sync failed: connection timeout to repository'. The administrator verifies network connectivity from the head node to the image repository server on port 443. Which BCM troubleshooting step should be performed NEXT?
questions.qZh: 在节点置备过程中，96 个节点中有 12 个失败，错误信息为 'Image sync failed: connection timeout to repository'。管理员已确认从 head 节点到镜像仓库服务器 443 端口的网络连通性正常。接下来应执行哪个 BCM 排障步骤？
o: Restart the bcm-server service on the head node to reset all provisioning jobs
Delete and recreate the entire node category containing the failing nodes
Increase the repository connection timeout value in bcm.conf from default 30 seconds to 300 seconds
Check if the 12 failing nodes can reach the image repository by examining DHCP/PXE logs and verifying node network configuration in 'cmsh show node' output
oZh: 在 head 节点上重启 bcm-server 服务，以重置所有置备作业
删除并重建包含失败节点的整个节点类别
在 bcm.conf 中将仓库连接超时值从默认的 30 秒增大到 300 秒
通过查看 DHCP/PXE 日志并检查 'cmsh show node' 输出中的节点网络配置，确认这 12 个失败节点能否访问镜像仓库
questions.e: Head node connectivity confirms repository is reachable, so the issue is node-level network config. DHCP/PXE logs reveal if nodes received correct IP, gateway, and DNS to reach the repository. 'cmsh show node' shows assigned network parameters. Exam tests this specific troubleshooting progression. Why the others are wrong: - Restarting bcm-server doesn't fix node network misconfigurations and would interrupt all active provisioning, not just the 12 failures - Deleting categories doesn't address the root cause (node network config) and destroys provisioning metadata needed for debugging - Timeout increases mask the underlying network problem; nodes with correct network config sync in under 30 seconds
questions.eZh: head 节点的连通性已确认仓库可达，因此问题出在节点级网络配置上。DHCP/PXE 日志可以揭示节点是否获得了正确的 IP、网关和 DNS，从而能否访问仓库；'cmsh show node' 会显示所分配的网络参数。考试会考查这一具体的排障推进顺序。其他选项错误的原因：- 重启 bcm-server 无法修复节点的网络配置错误，还会中断所有正在进行的置备，而不只是这 12 个失败节点 - 删除类别无法解决根本原因（节点网络配置），反而会破坏排障所需的置备元数据 - 增大超时时间只是掩盖底层的网络问题；网络配置正确的节点在 30 秒内即可完成同步

questions.q: A cluster administrator needs to generate a monthly report showing GPU utilization percentage, power consumption in watts, and completed job count per node for capacity planning. Which BCM command provides this data?
questions.qZh: 集群管理员需要生成月度报告，展示每个节点的 GPU 利用率百分比、以瓦为单位的功耗以及已完成作业数，以供容量规划使用。哪条 BCM 命令能够提供这些数据？
o: cmsh report generate --type usage --metrics gpu util,power,jobs --period monthly
nvidia-smi dmon -s puc monthly report.csv
cat /var/log/bcm/job history.log | grep completed
bcm-export --nodes all --data gpu metrics --format csv
oZh: cmsh report generate --type usage --metrics gpu util,power,jobs --period monthly
nvidia-smi dmon -s puc monthly report.csv
cat /var/log/bcm/job history.log | grep completed
bcm-export --nodes all --data gpu metrics --format csv
questions.e: BCM's 'report generate' command aggregates telemetry data collected from nodes over specified periods. The --type usage flag targets utilization/performance metrics. This is the exam-tested reporting mechanism in BCM for historical cluster analytics. Why the others are wrong: - nvidia-smi dmon provides real-time monitoring, not historical aggregation across the cluster or job correlation - Raw log parsing doesn't provide GPU utilization or power data, only job completion events without metrics - bcm-export is not a standard BCM command; the exam tests 'cmsh report generate' for usage reporting
questions.eZh: BCM 的 'report generate' 命令会汇总在指定周期内从节点采集的遥测数据。--type usage 标志用于获取利用率/性能类指标。这是 BCM 中用于历史集群分析的报告机制，也是常考内容。其他选项错误的原因：- nvidia-smi dmon 提供的是实时监控，而非跨集群的历史聚合，也不做作业关联 - 解析原始日志无法提供 GPU 利用率或功耗数据，只能得到不含指标的作业完成事件 - bcm-export 并非标准的 BCM 命令；考试考查的是用于用量报告的 'cmsh report generate'

questions.q: After a BCM upgrade, nodes show 'health: degraded' status in 'cmsh show health'. The administrator runs 'cmsh show health -v' and sees 'bcm-agent: CRITICAL - last heartbeat 180 seconds ago' on 24 nodes. Node SSH access works normally. What is the MOST likely cause?
questions.qZh: BCM 升级后，节点在 'cmsh show health' 中显示 'health: degraded' 状态。管理员运行 'cmsh show health -v' 并在 24 个节点上看到 'bcm-agent: CRITICAL - last heartbeat 180 seconds ago'。节点的 SSH 访问正常。最可能的原因是什么？
o: Network latency between head node and compute nodes exceeds the heartbeat threshold
Nodes require BMC firmware updates to be compatible with the new BCM version
The BCM license expired and disabled monitoring for nodes beyond the license limit
The bcm-agent service failed to restart automatically on those nodes after the BCM upgrade; run 'cmsh device execute -c systemctl restart bcm-agent' to recover them
oZh: head 节点与计算节点之间的网络延迟超过了心跳阈值
节点需要更新 BMC 固件才能与新的 BCM 版本兼容
BCM 许可证过期，禁用了超出许可限制的节点的监控
BCM 升级后 bcm-agent 服务在这些节点上未能自动重启；运行 'cmsh device execute -c systemctl restart bcm-agent' 使其恢复
questions.e: Agent heartbeat failure with working SSH indicates the bcm-agent daemon isn't running, not network or hardware issues. BCM upgrades sometimes require manual agent restart. 'device execute' allows cluster-wide service management. Exam tests this specific post-upgrade troubleshooting scenario. Why the others are wrong: - 180-second heartbeat gap exceeds normal latency; network issues would affect SSH too, which works normally - BMC firmware doesn't affect bcm-agent daemon operation; agent runs in the node OS, not BMC - License expiration would prevent provisioning or show license errors, not selective agent heartbeat failures ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: SSH 正常但 Agent 心跳失败，说明 bcm-agent 守护进程没有在运行，而不是网络或硬件问题。BCM 升级有时需要手动重启 Agent，而 'device execute' 支持集群范围的服务管理。考试会考查这一升级后的排障场景。其他选项错误的原因：- 180 秒的心跳间隔超出正常延迟范围；网络问题也会影响 SSH，而 SSH 工作正常 - BMC 固件不影响 bcm-agent 守护进程的运行；Agent 运行在节点操作系统中，而不是 BMC 中 - 许可证过期会导致置备失败或显示许可证错误，而不是选择性地出现 Agent 心跳失败 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A data center needs to update BMC firmware on 200 compute nodes to version 3.47 to fix an IPMI vulnerability. The current version is 3.42. BCM must verify BMC accessibility before attempting updates and skip nodes with unreachable BMCs. Which command sequence accomplishes this?
questions.qZh: 某数据中心需要在 200 个计算节点上把 BMC 固件更新到 3.47 版本，以修复 IPMI 漏洞。当前版本为 3.42。BCM 必须在尝试更新前验证 BMC 的可达性，并跳过 BMC 不可达的节点。哪种命令序列可以做到这一点？
o: cmsh device update bmc --version 3.47 --verify-ipmi --skip-unreachable -c compute nodes
ipmitool -H -U admin -P password fwum update bmc 3.47.bin (manually on all 200 nodes)
cmsh device provision --force --image bmc-3.47 -c compute nodes
ansible-playbook update bmc.yml --extra-vars 'version=3.47' --limit compute nodes
oZh: cmsh device update bmc --version 3.47 --verify-ipmi --skip-unreachable -c compute nodes
ipmitool -H -U admin -P password fwum update bmc 3.47.bin（在全部 200 个节点上手动执行）
cmsh device provision --force --image bmc-3.47 -c compute nodes
ansible-playbook update bmc.yml --extra-vars 'version=3.47' --limit compute nodes
questions.e: BCM's 'device update bmc' command handles cluster-wide BMC firmware updates. The --verify-ipmi flag checks IPMI connectivity before update attempts. --skip-unreachable prevents failures on inaccessible BMCs. This is the exam-tested method for safe BMC updates at scale. Why the others are wrong: - Manual ipmitool usage on 200 nodes violates automation requirement and doesn't integrate with BCM's tracking or rollback features - 'device provision' is for OS provisioning, not firmware updates; --image expects OS images, not BMC firmware files - External Ansible bypasses BCM's firmware management, doesn't leverage BCM's IPMI connectivity tracking, and creates management fragmentation
questions.eZh: BCM 的 'device update bmc' 命令可完成全集群的 BMC 固件更新。--verify-ipmi 标志会在更新尝试前检查 IPMI 连通性，--skip-unreachable 则可避免在不可达的 BMC 上失败。这是大规模安全更新 BMC 固件常考的方法。其他选项错误的原因：- 在 200 个节点上手动使用 ipmitool 违反自动化要求，也无法与 BCM 的跟踪或回滚功能集成 - 'device provision' 用于操作系统置备，而不是固件更新；--image 期望的是操作系统镜像，而非 BMC 固件文件 - 外部 Ansible 绕过 BCM 的固件管理，无法利用 BCM 的 IPMI 连通性跟踪，还会造成管理碎片化

questions.q: An administrator provisions 32 new nodes with ConnectX-7 NICs. Provisioning completes successfully, but 'cmsh show node' displays 'NIC firmware: NOT SYNCED' for all 32 nodes. The cluster's existing nodes run ConnectX-7 firmware version 28.35.1012. What should the administrator do to resolve this?
questions.qZh: 管理员置备了 32 台配备 ConnectX-7 网卡的新节点。置备成功完成，但 'cmsh show node' 对全部 32 个节点都显示 'NIC firmware: NOT SYNCED'。集群现有节点运行的是 ConnectX-7 固件版本 28.35.1012。管理员应如何解决？
o: Ignore the warning since 'NOT SYNCED' doesn't affect network functionality
Manually download Mellanox Firmware Tools (MFT) and run mlxfwmanager on each node individually
Add the ConnectX-7 firmware version 28.35.1012 image to BCM's firmware repository and run 'cmsh device update nic --sync --version 28.35.1012 -c new nodes' to align firmware versions
Reprovision all 32 nodes with the --force-firmware flag to overwrite NIC firmware
oZh: 忽略该警告，因为 'NOT SYNCED' 不影响网络功能
手动下载 Mellanox Firmware Tools (MFT)，并在每个节点上分别运行 mlxfwmanager
将 ConnectX-7 固件版本 28.35.1012 镜像添加到 BCM 的固件仓库，并运行 'cmsh device update nic --sync --version 28.35.1012 -c new nodes' 以统一固件版本
