使用 --force-firmware 标志重新置备全部 32 个节点，以覆盖网卡固件
questions.e: NOT SYNCED indicates NIC firmware doesn't match BCM's expected version for the cluster. BCM's 'device update nic --sync' command synchronizes NIC firmware to a specified version across selected nodes. This ensures cluster-wide firmware consistency. Exam tests this specific firmware sync workflow. Why the others are wrong: - NOT SYNCED can cause RoCE compatibility issues, performance degradation, and failed InfiniBand collective operations; must be resolved - Manual MFT usage bypasses BCM's firmware tracking, doesn't scale to 32 nodes efficiently, and creates version drift over time - 'device provision' updates OS images; NIC firmware requires separate 'device update nic' commands, not OS reprovisioning ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: NOT SYNCED 表示网卡固件与 BCM 预期的集群版本不一致。BCM 的 'device update nic --sync' 命令可以把所选节点的网卡固件同步到指定版本，从而确保全集群固件一致。这是该固件同步工作流常考的内容。其他选项错误的原因：- NOT SYNCED 可能引发 RoCE 兼容性问题、性能下降以及 InfiniBand 集合通信操作失败；必须加以解决 - 手动使用 MFT 绕过 BCM 的固件跟踪，无法高效扩展到 32 个节点，并且随着时间推移会造成版本漂移 - 'device provision' 更新的是操作系统镜像；网卡固件需要使用单独的 'device update nic' 命令，而不是重新置备操作系统 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A research lab runs mixed workloads: 10 data scientists need interactive Jupyter sessions on A100 GPUs, while 5 ML engineers run multi-day training jobs on H100 GPUs. The admin needs to prevent training jobs from blocking interactive work. Which Slurm configuration BEST achieves this?
questions.qZh: 某研究实验室运行混合工作负载：10 名数据科学家需要在 A100 GPU 上进行交互式 Jupyter 会话，同时 5 名 ML 工程师在 H100 GPU 上运行长达数天的训练作业。管理员需要防止训练作业阻塞交互式工作。哪种 Slurm 配置能最好地实现这一点？
o: Create one partition with Priority=1000 for data scientists and Priority=500 for ML engineers in slurm.conf
Create two partitions (interactive a100 and training h100), set interactive a100 to OverSubscribe=EXCLUSIVE and training h100 to OverSubscribe=YES
Create two QOS policies: qos interactive with Priority=10000 and MaxWall=04:00:00, qos training with Priority=5000 and MaxWall=168:00:00, assign to respective user groups
Use scontrol to set all A100 nodes to State=RESERVED for data scientists during business hours
oZh: 在 slurm.conf 中创建一个分区，为数据科学家设置 Priority=1000，为 ML 工程师设置 Priority=500
创建两个分区（interactive a100 和 training h100），将 interactive a100 设置为 OverSubscribe=EXCLUSIVE，将 training h100 设置为 OverSubscribe=YES
创建两个 QOS 策略：qos interactive 设置 Priority=10000 和 MaxWall=04:00:00，qos training 设置 Priority=5000 和 MaxWall=168:00:00，并分别分配给相应的用户组
使用 scontrol 在工作时间内将所有 A100 节点设置为 State=RESERVED（供数据科学家使用）
questions.e: QOS policies directly control job priority and time limits per user group. Priority=10000 ensures interactive jobs preempt training jobs, MaxWall=04:00:00 prevents interactive users from hogging GPUs, and MaxWall=168:00:00 allows week-long training. This is the standard approach for multi-tenant GPU clusters. Why the others are wrong: - Partition Priority affects node selection, not job preemption between user groups. Both user types would still compete for resources within their partition. - OverSubscribe controls whether multiple jobs share a node, not job priority. EXCLUSIVE on interactive would waste GPU resources, and doesn't guarantee priority over training jobs. - State=RESERVED requires manual scontrol commands on schedule and removes nodes from scheduling entirely. Not scalable and doesn't provide dynamic preemption. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: QOS 策略可以直接按用户组控制作业优先级和时间限制。Priority=10000 确保交互式作业可以抢占训练作业，MaxWall=04:00:00 防止交互式用户长期占用 GPU，而 MaxWall=168:00:00 则允许长达一周的训练。这是多租户 GPU 集群的标准做法。其他选项错误的原因：- 分区的 Priority 影响的是节点选择，而非用户组之间的作业抢占。两类用户仍会在各自分区内竞争资源。- OverSubscribe 控制的是多个作业能否共享同一节点，而非作业优先级。在 interactive 上设置 EXCLUSIVE 会浪费 GPU 资源，且无法保证其优先于训练作业。- State=RESERVED 需要按计划手动执行 scontrol 命令，并会将节点完全排除在调度之外。不可扩展，且无法提供动态抢占。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An admin configures MIG on an A100-80GB node to provide fractional GPU access. The gres.conf contains: 'Name=gpu Type=a100-1g.10gb File=/dev/nvidia0 Cores=0-7 Count=7'. A user submits 'sbatch --gres=gpu:a100-1g.10gb:2 train.sh' but the job stays PENDING with reason 'ReqNodeNotAvail, Reserved for maintenance'. What is the issue?
questions.qZh: 管理员在 A100-80GB 节点上配置 MIG，以提供 GPU 分数共享访问。gres.conf 中包含：'Name=gpu Type=a100-1g.10gb File=/dev/nvidia0 Cores=0-7 Count=7'。用户提交 'sbatch --gres=gpu:a100-1g.10gb:2 train.sh'，但作业一直处于 PENDING 状态，原因显示为 'ReqNodeNotAvail, Reserved for maintenance'。问题出在哪里？
o: The node is in DRAIN state; run 'scontrol update NodeName=node01 State=RESUME' to return it to service
The gres.conf uses 'Count=7' but A100-80GB only supports 7 MIG instances; change to Count=8 to match hardware limit
MIG slices must be pre-created with 'nvidia-smi mig -cgi 1g.10gb,1g.10gb,...' before Slurm can allocate them; gres.conf only declares what exists
The job requested 2 MIG slices but cores 0-7 are insufficient; change Cores=0-15 to provide enough CPU cores per GPU slice
oZh: 节点处于 DRAIN 状态；运行 'scontrol update NodeName=node01 State=RESUME' 使其恢复服务
gres.conf 使用了 'Count=7'，而 A100-80GB 仅支持 7 个 MIG 实例；改为 Count=8 以匹配硬件限制
MIG 分片必须先用 'nvidia-smi mig -cgi 1g.10gb,1g.10gb,...' 预先创建，Slurm 才能为其分配；gres.conf 仅声明已存在的实例
作业请求了 2 个 MIG 分片，但 Cores 0-7 不足；将 Cores=0-15 改为每个 GPU 分片提供足够的 CPU 核心
questions.e: gres.conf is declarative—it tells Slurm what MIG instances exist, but does NOT create them. The admin must run 'nvidia-smi mig -cgi 1g.10gb -C' seven times (or use nvidia-mig-parted) to physically create the MIG slices on the GPU before Slurm can allocate them. The error 'Reserved for maintenance' is misleading; Slurm sees 0 available MIG resources. Why the others are wrong: - State=RESUME fixes DRAIN state, but the error 'ReqNodeNotAvail, Reserved for maintenance' here indicates Slurm cannot find matching gres resources, not node state. If node were DRAIN, error would explicitly say 'NodeState=DRAIN'. - A100-80GB supports 7×1g.10gb MIG slices (correct), so Count=7 is accurate. The issue is the slices don't physically exist on the GPU yet. - Cores in gres.conf specify CPU affinity for NUMA optimization, not a requirement. The job would run with any core assignment; missing MIG instances is the blocker. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: gres.conf 是声明式的——它告诉 Slurm 存在哪些 MIG 实例，但并不创建它们。管理员必须运行 'nvidia-smi mig -cgi 1g.10gb -C' 七次（或使用 nvidia-mig-parted），在 GPU 上物理创建出 MIG 分片，Slurm 才能进行分配。错误信息 'Reserved for maintenance' 具有误导性；Slurm 实际看到的是 0 个可用的 MIG 资源。其他选项错误的原因：- State=RESUME 可以修复 DRAIN 状态，但此处错误 'ReqNodeNotAvail, Reserved for maintenance' 表明 Slurm 找不到匹配的 gres 资源，而非节点状态问题。若节点处于 DRAIN，错误会明确显示 'NodeState=DRAIN'。- A100-80GB 支持 7 个 1g.10gb MIG 分片（正确），因此 Count=7 是准确的。问题在于这些分片尚未在 GPU 上物理创建。- gres.conf 中的 Cores 用于指定 CPU 亲和性以优化 NUMA，而不是硬性要求。作业在任何核心分配下都能运行；缺少 MIG 实例才是阻塞点。

questions.q: A Slurm cluster has 20 users across 3 departments. The admin wants to enforce: Marketing can use max 4 GPUs simultaneously, Engineering max 12 GPUs, Research unlimited. Fair-share must prioritize users who haven't run jobs recently. Which sacctmgr commands achieve this?
questions.qZh: 某个 Slurm 集群有 3 个部门共 20 名用户。管理员希望实施以下限制：Marketing 最多同时使用 4 块 GPU，Engineering 最多 12 块 GPU，Research 不限。公平共享（fair-share）必须优先调度近期没有运行作业的用户。哪些 sacctmgr 命令可以实现这一点？
o: sacctmgr add account marketing,engineering,research Cluster=ai-cluster; sacctmgr add qos marketing qos MaxTRESPerUser=gres/gpu=4; sacctmgr add qos eng qos MaxTRESPerUser=gres/gpu=12; sacctmgr modify account marketing set QOS=marketing qos; sacctmgr modify account engineering set QOS=eng qos

sacctmgr add account marketing,engineering,research; sacctmgr modify account marketing set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=4 FairShare=100; sacctmgr modify account engineering set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=12 FairShare=100; sacctmgr modify account research set FairShare=100; set PriorityType=priority/multifactor and PriorityWeightFairshare=50000 in slurm.conf

sacctmgr add account marketing set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=4; sacctmgr add account engineering set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=12; sacctmgr add account research set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=9999; sacctmgr modify cluster ai-cluster set FairShare=1

sacctmgr add qos marketing qos set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=4 Priority=1000; sacctmgr add qos eng qos set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=12 Priority=2000; sacctmgr add user dept=marketing set QOS=marketing qos; PriorityType=priority/multifactor in slurm.conf with PriorityWeightFairshare=10000
oZh: sacctmgr add account marketing,engineering,research Cluster=ai-cluster; sacctmgr add qos marketing qos MaxTRESPerUser=gres/gpu=4; sacctmgr add qos eng qos MaxTRESPerUser=gres/gpu=12; sacctmgr modify account marketing set QOS=marketing qos; sacctmgr modify account engineering set QOS=eng qos

sacctmgr add account marketing,engineering,research; sacctmgr modify account marketing set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=4 FairShare=100; sacctmgr modify account engineering set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=12 FairShare=100; sacctmgr modify account research set FairShare=100; 在 slurm.conf 中设置 PriorityType=priority/multifactor 和 PriorityWeightFairshare=50000

sacctmgr add account marketing set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=4; sacctmgr add account engineering set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=12; sacctmgr add account research set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=9999; sacctmgr modify cluster ai-cluster set FairShare=1

sacctmgr add qos marketing qos set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=4 Priority=1000; sacctmgr add qos eng qos set GrpTRES=gres/gpu=12 Priority=2000; sacctmgr add user dept=marketing set QOS=marketing qos; 在 slurm.conf 中设置 PriorityType=priority/multifactor 且 PriorityWeightFairshare=10000
questions.e: GrpTRES limits total simultaneous GPU use per account (4 for marketing, 12 for engineering). FairShare=100 for all accounts ensures equal starting priority, then PriorityWeightFairshare=50000 in slurm.conf makes fair-share the dominant factor—users who haven't run jobs recently get higher priority. This is the standard multi-tenant fair-share setup. Why the others are wrong: - MaxTRESPerUser limits per-user, not total account usage. One marketing user could use 4 GPUs, blocking all others. Also, assigning QOS to account affects all users equally, no fair-share between users. - GrpTRES is correct for account limits, but 'sacctmgr modify cluster set FairShare=1' is invalid syntax. Fair-share is configured in slurm.conf with PriorityType=priority/multifactor and requires per-account FairShare values. - GrpTRES belongs on accounts, not QOS. Priority on QOS sets static priority, not dynamic fair-share. 'sacctmgr add user dept=marketing' is invalid—users are added to accounts, not filtered by department field. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: GrpTRES 限制每个账户同时使用的 GPU 总量（marketing 为 4，engineering 为 12）。为所有账户设置 FairShare=100 可确保初始优先级相同，随后 slurm.conf 中的 PriorityWeightFairshare=50000 使公平共享成为主导因素——近期没有运行作业的用户将获得更高优先级。这是多租户公平共享的标准配置。其他选项错误的原因：- MaxTRESPerUser 限制的是单个用户，而非账户总用量。一个 marketing 用户就可能占用 4 块 GPU，阻塞其他所有人。此外，把 QOS 分配给账户意味着对所有用户一视同仁，用户之间并没有公平共享。- GrpTRES 用于账户限制是正确的，但 'sacctmgr modify cluster set FairShare=1' 是无效语法。公平共享在 slurm.conf 中通过 PriorityType=priority/multifactor 配置，并且需要为各账户分别设置 FairShare 值。- GrpTRES 属于账户而非 QOS。QOS 上的 Priority 设置的是静态优先级，而非动态的公平共享。'sacctmgr add user dept=marketing' 是无效的——用户是被添加到账户中的，而不是按 department 字段过滤。

questions.q: During a maintenance window, an admin needs to drain node12 (currently running 3 jobs) and node13 (idle). After maintenance, both nodes must return to service automatically when jobs finish. What is the correct sequence of scontrol commands?
questions.qZh: 在维护窗口期间，管理员需要 drain 掉 node12（当前运行着 3 个作业）和 node13（空闲）。维护结束后，两个节点都必须在作业完成时自动恢复服务。正确的 scontrol 命令序列是什么？
o: scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=DOWN Reason='Maintenance'; wait for jobs to finish; scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=RESUME
scontrol update NodeName=node12 State=DRAIN Reason='Maintenance'; scontrol update NodeName=node13 State=DOWN Reason='Maintenance'; after maintenance, scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=IDLE
scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=DRAIN Reason='Maintenance'; nodes auto-resume when jobs complete, no further action needed
scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=DRAIN Reason='Maintenance'; after maintenance, scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=RESUME
oZh: scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=DOWN Reason='Maintenance'; 等待作业完成; scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=RESUME
scontrol update NodeName=node12 State=DRAIN Reason='Maintenance'; scontrol update NodeName=node13 State=DOWN Reason='Maintenance'; 维护结束后，scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=IDLE
scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=DRAIN Reason='Maintenance'; 节点在作业完成后自动恢复，无需进一步操作
scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=DRAIN Reason='Maintenance'; 维护结束后，scontrol update NodeName=node12,node13 State=RESUME
questions.e: State=DRAIN prevents new jobs from starting but allows running jobs to complete—perfect for node12 with active jobs. node13 goes DRAIN immediately (it's idle). After maintenance, State=RESUME clears the DRAIN flag and returns both to IDLE/ALLOCATED state. This is the standard maintenance workflow. Why the others are wrong: - State=DOWN kills running jobs immediately—data loss for the 3 jobs on node12. DOWN is for emergency hardware failures, not planned maintenance. - node13 should also be DRAIN (not DOWN) unless hardware is failed. State=IDLE is not valid with scontrol update—nodes transition to IDLE automatically when RESUME is issued and no jobs are running. - DRAIN nodes do NOT auto-resume. They stay DRAINED until explicitly set to RESUME. Jobs complete, but node remains unavailable for new work—a common mistake causing nodes to stay offline after maintenance. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: State=DRAIN 会阻止新作业启动，但允许正在运行的作业完成——非常适合有活动作业的 node12。node13 会立即进入 DRAIN（因为它本就空闲）。维护结束后，State=RESUME 清除 DRAIN 标志，使两个节点回到 IDLE/ALLOCATED 状态。这是标准的维护流程。其他选项错误的原因：- State=DOWN 会立即终止正在运行的作业——会导致 node12 上 3 个作业的数据丢失。DOWN 用于紧急硬件故障，而非计划内维护。- 除非硬件已损坏，否则 node13 也应设为 DRAIN（而非 DOWN）。State=IDLE 对 scontrol update 无效——执行 RESUME 且没有正在运行的作业时，节点会自动转为 IDLE。- DRAIN 节点不会自动恢复。它们会一直保持 DRAINED 状态，直到被显式设置为 RESUME。作业会完成，但节点仍然无法接收新任务——这是导致维护结束后节点长期离线的常见误区。

questions.q: A company allocates GPU hours quarterly: each user gets 1000 GPU-hours, unused hours don't roll over. The admin must enforce this with Slurm accounting and prevent users from exceeding their quota. Which configuration is correct?
questions.qZh: 某公司按季度分配 GPU 时长：每位用户获得 1000 GPU-hours，未使用的时长不结转。管理员必须通过 Slurm accounting 实施这一限制，并防止用户超出配额。哪种配置是正确的？
o: Create QOS with MaxTRESMins=gres/gpu=60000 (1000 hours × 60 min); reset with 'sacctmgr modify qos normal set MaxTRESMins=gres/gpu=60000' quarterly
Configure MaxWall=1000:00:00 per user in QOS; track usage with 'sreport cluster AccountUtilizationByUser Start=2026-01-01 End=2026-03-31'
Set GrpTRESRunMins=gres/gpu=60000 on each account; reset quarterly by deleting and recreating accounts with 'sacctmgr delete account' and 'sacctmgr add account'
Use GrpTRESMins=gres/gpu=60000 on the user account; run 'sacctmgr modify user name=alice set GrpTRESMins=gres/gpu=60000' quarterly for each user
oZh: 创建 QOS 并设置 MaxTRESMins=gres/gpu=60000（1000 小时 × 60 分钟）；每季度用 'sacctmgr modify qos normal set MaxTRESMins=gres/gpu=60000' 重置
在 QOS 中为每位用户配置 MaxWall=1000:00:00；用 'sreport cluster AccountUtilizationByUser Start=2026-01-01 End=2026-03-31' 跟踪用量
在每个账户上设置 GrpTRESRunMins=gres/gpu=60000；每季度通过 'sacctmgr delete account' 和 'sacctmgr add account' 删除并重建账户来重置
在用户账户上使用 GrpTRESMins=gres/gpu=60000；每季度为每位用户运行 'sacctmgr modify user name=alice set GrpTRESMins=gres/gpu=60000'
questions.e: GrpTRESMins on user account enforces total accumulated GPU-minutes over time (60000 min = 1000 hours). Once a user consumes 1000 GPU-hours, new jobs are held. Quarterly reset via 'sacctmgr modify user' updates the limit. This is the standard approach for time-based GPU quotas. Why the others are wrong: - MaxTRESMins limits the duration of a SINGLE job, not cumulative usage. A user could submit 100 jobs of 10 hours each and exceed 1000 total hours. - MaxWall limits individual job walltime, not cumulative hours. sreport only reports usage; it doesn't enforce limits. User could run unlimited jobs under 1000 hours each. - GrpTRESRunMins limits CONCURRENT running GPU-minutes (e.g., max 10 GPUs running at once), not cumulative over quarter. Deleting accounts loses historical accounting data and disrupts users.
questions.eZh: 用户账户上的 GrpTRESMins 可以限制一段时间内累计消耗的 GPU 分钟数（60000 分钟 = 1000 小时）。一旦用户消耗完 1000 GPU-hours，新作业将被挂起。通过 'sacctmgr modify user' 即可实现季度重置。这是基于时间的 GPU 配额的标准做法。其他选项错误的原因：- MaxTRESMins 限制的是单个作业的时长，而非累计用量。用户可以提交 100 个各 10 小时的作业，从而超出 1000 小时总量。- MaxWall 限制的是单个作业的挂钟时间，而非累计小时数。sreport 只做统计报告，并不实施限制。用户可以在每个作业 1000 小时以下的情况下无限提交作业。- GrpTRESRunMins 限制的是并发运行的 GPU 分钟数（例如最多同时运行 10 块 GPU），而非季度内的累计量。删除账户会丢失历史计费数据并干扰用户。

questions.q: An admin runs 'squeue -o %Q' and sees job priorities: job1=50000, job2=120000, job3=85000. Job2 is from a new user who has never run jobs; job1 and job3 are from heavy users. The slurm.conf has PriorityWeightAge=1000, PriorityWeightFairshare=10000, PriorityWeightJobSize=500. Job2 has been pending for 5 minutes. What is the PRIMARY contributor to job2's high priority?
questions.qZh: 管理员运行 'squeue -o %Q' 查看作业优先级：job1=50000，job2=120000，job3=85000。job2 来自一位从未运行过作业的新用户；job1 和 job3 来自重度用户。slurm.conf 中有 PriorityWeightAge=1000、PriorityWeightFairshare=10000、PriorityWeightJobSize=500。job2 已处于 PENDING 状态 5 分钟。造成 job2 高优先级的最主要因素是什么？
o: PriorityWeightAge: job2 has been pending longer than other jobs in the queue
PriorityWeightJobSize: job2 requests more GPUs than job1 and job3, increasing priority
PriorityWeightFairshare: new user has high fair-share value (near 1.0) because they haven't consumed resources
Job2's QOS has Priority=100000 set, overriding multifactor priority calculation
oZh: PriorityWeightAge：job2 在队列中等待的时间比其他作业更长
PriorityWeightJobSize：job2 请求的 GPU 数多于 job1 和 job3，从而提高了优先级
PriorityWeightFairshare：新用户的公平共享值很高（接近 1.0），因为他没有消耗过资源
job2 所属 QOS 设置了 Priority=100000，覆盖了多因子优先级计算
questions.e: PriorityWeightFairshare=10000 is 10× higher than Age (1000) and 20× higher than JobSize (500), making fair-share the dominant factor. A new user has fair-share near 1.0 (perfect share), contributing ~10000 priority points. Heavy users have low fair-share (<0.5), contributing <5000 points. The 70000-point gap (120000 vs 50000) is primarily from fair-share. Why the others are wrong: - Age contributes PriorityWeightAge × (minutes pending / PriorityMaxAge). At 5 minutes and PriorityMaxAge default (7 days), Age contributes ~5 points—negligible compared to 70000-point gap. - JobSize contributes PriorityWeightJobSize × (requested cpus / total cpus). Even requesting 100% of cluster resources only adds 500 points, far less than fair-share contribution. - QOS Priority adds a fixed value to total priority but doesn't replace multifactor. If QOS Priority=100000, job2 priority would be ~110000+ (100000 + multifactor), not exactly 120000. Fair-share explains the observed value.
questions.eZh: PriorityWeightFairshare=10000 是 Age（1000）的 10 倍、JobSize（500）的 20 倍，使公平共享成为主导因素。新用户的公平共享值接近 1.0（完美共享），贡献约 10000 个优先级分数。重度用户的公平共享值较低（<0.5），贡献不足 5000 分。70000 分的差距（120000 对 50000）主要来自公平共享。其他选项错误的原因：- Age 的贡献为 PriorityWeightAge ×（等待分钟数 / PriorityMaxAge）。等待 5 分钟且 PriorityMaxAge 为默认值（7 天）时，Age 仅贡献约 5 分——与 70000 分的差距相比可忽略不计。- JobSize 的贡献为 PriorityWeightJobSize ×（请求的 CPU 数 / 总 CPU 数）。即便请求整个集群 100% 的资源，也只增加 500 分，远少于公平共享的贡献。- QOS 的 Priority 会向总优先级增加一个固定值，但并不取代多因子计算。若 QOS Priority=100000，job2 的优先级应约为 110000 以上（100000 + 多因子），而不是正好 120000。公平共享可以解释所观测到的数值。

questions.q: A cluster has 8 nodes: 4×A100 (80GB each), 4×H100 (80GB each). The admin creates partitions: 'partition=a100 partition Nodes=node[01-04] Default=NO' and 'partition=h100 partition Nodes=node[05-08] Default=YES'. A user submits 'sbatch --partition=a100 partition --gres=gpu:2 train.sh' but the job stays PENDING with 'Resources'. The gres.conf has 'NodeName=node[01-04] Name=gpu Type=a100 File=/dev/nvidia[0-3] Count=4'. What is missing?
questions.qZh: 某集群有 8 个节点：4×A100（各 80GB），4×H100（各 80GB）。管理员创建了分区：'partition=a100 partition Nodes=node[01-04] Default=NO' 和 'partition=h100 partition Nodes=node[05-08] Default=YES'。用户提交 'sbatch --partition=a100 partition --gres=gpu:2 train.sh'，但作业一直处于 PENDING 状态并显示 'Resources'。gres.conf 中有 'NodeName=node[01-04] Name=gpu Type=a100 File=/dev/nvidia[0-3] Count=4'。缺少什么？
o: The slurm.conf must include 'GresTypes=gpu' before Slurm can allocate gres resources
The partition must be set to State=UP; run 'scontrol update PartitionName=a100 partition State=UP'
The user must specify the GPU type explicitly: 'sbatch --partition=a100 partition --gres=gpu:a100:2 train.sh'
The partition configuration must include 'DefMemPerGPU=80000' to match the A100 80GB memory
oZh: slurm.conf 必须包含 'GresTypes=gpu'，Slurm 才能分配 gres 资源
分区必须设置为 State=UP；运行 'scontrol update PartitionName=a100 partition State=UP'
用户必须显式指定 GPU 类型：'sbatch --partition=a100 partition --gres=gpu:a100:2 train.sh'
分区配置必须包含 'DefMemPerGPU=80000' 以匹配 A100 80GB 内存
questions.e: GresTypes=gpu in slurm.conf is MANDATORY—it tells Slurm to enable gres scheduling. Without this line, Slurm ignores gres.conf entirely and cannot allocate GPUs, even if gres.conf is correct. This is the 1 mistake when setting up GPU clusters. After adding GresTypes=gpu, restart slurmctld. Why the others are wrong: - Partitions are State=UP by default when created. State=DOWN would show 'PartitionDown' error, not 'Resources'. The partition is UP but gres scheduling is disabled globally. - Specifying 'gpu:a100:2' is optional; 'gpu:2' works if partition only has one GPU type. The real issue is GresTypes=gpu is missing, so Slurm doesn't recognize gres requests at all. - DefMemPerGPU is for memory scheduling optimization, not gres functionality. Jobs can run without it; Slurm just won't track GPU memory as a schedulable resource. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: slurm.conf 中的 GresTypes=gpu 是必需的——它告诉 Slurm 启用 gres 调度。缺少这一行，Slurm 会完全忽略 gres.conf，即使 gres.conf 配置正确也无法分配 GPU。这是搭建 GPU 集群时的头号错误。添加 GresTypes=gpu 之后，需要重启 slurmctld。其他选项错误的原因：- 分区创建后默认即为 State=UP。若为 State=DOWN，错误会显示 'PartitionDown'，而不是 'Resources'。分区本身是 UP 的，问题在于全局的 gres 调度未启用。- 指定 'gpu:a100:2' 是可选的；如果分区只有一种 GPU 类型，'gpu:2' 也能工作。真正的问题是缺少 GresTypes=gpu，Slurm 根本识别不了 gres 请求。- DefMemPerGPU 用于内存调度优化，而非 gres 功能本身。没有它作业照样可以运行，只是 Slurm 不会把 GPU 内存作为可调度资源来跟踪。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An admin needs to configure a partition for spot/preemptible workloads where jobs can be killed at any time, and a partition for guaranteed workloads. Spot partition should have 10× lower priority but access to all nodes. Which slurm.conf entries are correct?
questions.qZh: 管理员需要配置一个用于 spot/可抢占工作负载的分区（作业可随时被终止），以及一个用于保证型工作负载的分区。Spot 分区的优先级应低 10 倍，但可访问所有节点。哪些 slurm.conf 条目是正确的？
o: PartitionName=spot Nodes=node[01-32] Priority=100 PreemptMode=REQUEUE Default=NO; PartitionName=guaranteed Nodes=node[01-32] Priority=1000 PreemptMode=OFF Default=YES
PartitionName=spot Nodes=node[01-32] Priority=100 Shared=FORCE:1 Default=NO; PartitionName=guaranteed Nodes=node[01-32] Priority=1000 Shared=NO Default=YES; PreemptType=preempt/qos in global config

PartitionName=spot Nodes=node[01-32] PriorityTier=1 OverSubscribe=YES Default=NO; PartitionName=guaranteed Nodes=node[01-32] PriorityTier=2 OverSubscribe=NO Default=YES; enable preemption with PreemptType=preempt/partition prio

PartitionName=spot Nodes=node[01-32] QOS=spot qos Default=NO; PartitionName=guaranteed Nodes=node[01-32] QOS=guaranteed qos Default=YES; configure QOS with 'sacctmgr add qos spot qos Preempt=guaranteed qos Priority=100'
oZh: PartitionName=spot Nodes=node[01-32] Priority=100 PreemptMode=REQUEUE Default=NO; PartitionName=guaranteed Nodes=node[01-32] Priority=1000 PreemptMode=OFF Default=YES
PartitionName=spot Nodes=node[01-32] Priority=100 Shared=FORCE:1 Default=NO; PartitionName=guaranteed Nodes=node[01-32] Priority=1000 Shared=NO Default=YES; 在全局配置中设置 PreemptType=preempt/qos

PartitionName=spot Nodes=node[01-32] PriorityTier=1 OverSubscribe=YES Default=NO; PartitionName=guaranteed Nodes=node[01-32] PriorityTier=2 OverSubscribe=NO Default=YES; 通过 PreemptType=preempt/partition prio 启用抢占

PartitionName=spot Nodes=node[01-32] QOS=spot qos Default=NO; PartitionName=guaranteed Nodes=node[01-32] QOS=guaranteed qos Default=YES; 将 QOS 配置为 'sacctmgr add qos spot qos Preempt=guaranteed qos Priority=100'
questions.e: PriorityTier is the partition-level priority (higher tier = higher priority). PreemptType=preempt/partition prio enables partition-based preemption: jobs in tier 2 (guaranteed) preempt tier 1 (spot). Both partitions can share nodes (OverSubscribe=YES on spot allows packing). This is the standard setup for spot/guaranteed workloads. Why the others are wrong: - Priority in partition config is deprecated (replaced by PriorityTier). PreemptMode is a QOS/job setting, not partition setting. PreemptMode=REQUEUE on partition is invalid syntax. - Shared=FORCE:1 limits jobs per node (resource management), not preemption. PreemptType=preempt/qos requires QOS-based preemption setup, but no QOS is assigned to partitions here—won't enable preemption. - QOS assigned to partitions is non-standard (QOS is assigned to users/accounts). The example is conceptually right but 'sacctmgr add qos spot qos Preempt=guaranteed qos' is backwards—guaranteed qos should preempt spot qos, not vice versa. Also, partition-level QOS doesn't integrate with PreemptType cleanly.
questions.eZh: PriorityTier 是分区级别的优先级（tier 越高优先级越高）。PreemptType=preempt/partition prio 启用基于分区的抢占：tier 2（guaranteed）中的作业可以抢占 tier 1（spot）中的作业。两个分区可以共享节点（在 spot 上设置 OverSubscribe=YES 允许密集装箱）。这是 spot/guaranteed 工作负载的标准配置。其他选项错误的原因：- 分区配置中的 Priority 已被弃用（由 PriorityTier 取代）。PreemptMode 是 QOS/作业的设置，而非分区设置。在分区上设置 PreemptMode=REQUEUE 是无效语法。- Shared=FORCE:1 限制的是每个节点上的作业数（资源管理），而非抢占。PreemptType=preempt/qos 需要基于 QOS 的抢占配置，但这里并未给分区分配任何 QOS——无法启用抢占。- 给分区分配 QOS 属于非标准做法（QOS 是分配给用户/账户的）。该选项在概念上是对的，但 'sacctmgr add qos spot qos Preempt=guaranteed qos' 方向反了——应该是 guaranteed qos 抢占 spot qos，而不是相反。另外，分区级别的 QOS 也无法与 PreemptType 良好配合。

questions.q: A data science team needs to run 12 small training jobs simultaneously on a single A100 GPU to maximize utilization. Each job requires 0.5 GPU and 20GB memory. The cluster uses Run:ai for workload orchestration. Which configuration BEST enables this requirement?
questions.qZh: 某数据科学团队需要在单块 A100 GPU 上同时运行 12 个小型训练作业，以最大化利用率。每个作业需要 0.5 块 GPU 和 20GB 内存。集群使用 Run:ai 进行工作负载编排。哪种配置最能满足该需求？
o: Enable MIG with 7x 1g.10gb profile on the A100 and assign one MIG slice per job
Deploy NVIDIA device plugin with time-slicing configuration and set replicas=12
Create 12 separate Run:ai projects each with 0.08 GPU quota (1/12 of A100)
Enable Run:ai fractional GPU allocation with 0.5 GPU quota per job and bin-packing scheduler
oZh: 在 A100 上启用 MIG，使用 7x 1g.10gb 配置，并为每个作业分配一个 MIG 分片
部署 NVIDIA device plugin 并配置时间分片（time-slicing），设置 replicas=12
创建 12 个独立的 Run:ai project，每个配置 0.08 GPU 配额（A100 的 1/12）
启用 Run:ai 的 GPU 分数分配，每个作业配额 0.5 GPU，并使用 bin-packing 调度器
questions.e: Run:ai fractional GPU allocation allows multiple jobs to share a single GPU by allocating portions (0.5 GPU) and using bin-packing to maximize utilization. This is the designed use case for Run:ai's core feature. Why the others are wrong: - MIG 7x 1g.10gb gives only 7 slices maximum, not 12. Also, each job needs 0.5 GPU (50% of resources) which doesn't map to 1g.10gb profile (1/7th = 14% of GPU). - Time-slicing is a device plugin feature that enables time-sharing but doesn't provide the memory isolation and quota enforcement that Run:ai fractional GPU provides. Also not the primary Run:ai feature being tested. - Creating 12 separate projects is administrative overhead and doesn't leverage Run:ai's bin-packing scheduler. Projects are for team isolation, not individual job quotas. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Run:ai 的 GPU 分数分配允许多个作业通过分配部分资源（0.5 GPU）共享同一块 GPU，并使用 bin-packing 最大化利用率。这正是 Run:ai 核心功能的设计目标。其他选项错误的原因：- MIG 7x 1g.10gb 最多只能提供 7 个分片，而不是 12 个。而且每个作业需要 0.5 块 GPU（50% 的资源），与 1g.10gb 配置（1/7 ≈ 14% 的 GPU）并不对应。- 时间分片是 device plugin 的一项功能，可以实现共享，但它并不提供 Run:ai GPU 分数分配所具备的内存隔离和配额管控能力。同时它也不是本次考察的 Run:ai 主要特性。- 创建 12 个独立的 project 会带来管理开销，且没有利用 Run:ai 的 bin-packing 调度器。Project 是用于团队隔离，而非单个作业的配额。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An administrator is configuring GPU monitoring for a Kubernetes cluster. After installing GPU Operator, which component exposes GPU metrics in Prometheus format for monitoring GPU utilization, memory, temperature, and power consumption?
questions.qZh: 管理员正在为 Kubernetes 集群配置 GPU 监控。安装 GPU Operator 之后，哪个组件会以 Prometheus 格式暴露 GPU 指标，用于监控 GPU 利用率、内存、温度和功耗？
o: nvidia-device-plugin
nvidia-container-toolkit
nvidia-dcgm-exporter
gpu-feature-discovery
oZh: nvidia-device-plugin
nvidia-container-toolkit
nvidia-dcgm-exporter
gpu-feature-discovery
questions.e: nvidia-dcgm-exporter is the GPU Operator component that collects GPU telemetry via DCGM (Data Center GPU Manager) and exposes metrics in Prometheus format for monitoring stacks. Why the others are wrong: - nvidia-device-plugin advertises GPU resources to kubelet and schedules pods to GPU nodes. It does not export metrics. - nvidia-container-toolkit enables GPU access in containers by modifying container runtime. It does not collect or export metrics. - gpu-feature-discovery labels nodes with GPU properties (product name, CUDA version, etc.) but does not export runtime metrics like utilization or temperature.
questions.eZh: nvidia-dcgm-exporter 是 GPU Operator 的组件之一，它通过 DCGM（Data Center GPU Manager）采集 GPU 遥测数据，并以 Prometheus 格式暴露指标供监控栈使用。其他选项错误的原因：- nvidia-device-plugin 向 kubelet 通告 GPU 资源，并将 Pod 调度到 GPU 节点，它并不导出指标。- nvidia-container-toolkit 通过修改容器运行时来为容器提供 GPU 访问能力，它既不采集也不导出指标。- gpu-feature-discovery 用 GPU 属性（产品名称、CUDA 版本等）给节点打标签，但不会导出利用率、温度这类运行时指标。

questions.q: A company runs distributed training jobs on an 8-GPU node. Jobs must start only when all 8 GPUs are available simultaneously to avoid deadlock. Which Run:ai scheduling policy should be configured?
questions.qZh: 某公司在 8-GPU 节点上运行分布式训练作业。作业必须等到 8 块 GPU 同时可用时才能启动，以避免死锁。应该配置哪种 Run:ai 调度策略？
o: Gang scheduling with min replicas=8 to ensure atomic allocation
Fairness scheduling to distribute GPUs equally across jobs
Bin-packing to maximize GPU utilization density
Over-quota scheduling to allow bursting beyond project limits
oZh: 使用 Gang scheduling（成组调度），设置 min replicas=8 以确保原子化分配
使用公平调度（Fairness scheduling），在作业之间平均分配 GPU
使用 Bin-packing，以最大化 GPU 利用率密度
使用超额调度（Over-quota），允许超出 project 限制进行突发使用
questions.e: Gang scheduling ensures all replicas (GPUs) required by a distributed training job are allocated atomically. If 8 GPUs aren't available, the job waits. This prevents partial allocation and deadlock in distributed training. Why the others are wrong: - Fairness scheduling distributes resources fairly over time but doesn't guarantee atomic allocation. A job could get 4 GPUs now and wait indefinitely for the remaining 4. - Bin-packing maximizes node utilization but doesn't address atomic allocation requirement. It could place 8 GPUs across multiple nodes or partially allocate. - Over-quota allows exceeding project quotas when cluster has spare capacity. It doesn't solve the atomic allocation problem for distributed training. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Gang scheduling 确保分布式训练作业所需的全部副本（GPU）以原子化方式完成分配。如果 8 块 GPU 不可用，作业就会等待。这避免了分布式训练中的部分分配和死锁。其他选项错误的原因：- 公平调度随时间公平地分配资源，但不保证原子化分配。作业可能现在拿到 4 块 GPU，然后无限期等待剩余的 4 块。- Bin-packing 最大化节点利用率，但无法满足原子化分配的要求。它可能把 8 块 GPU 分散到多个节点上，或只做部分分配。- Over-quota 允许在集群有空闲容量时超出 project 配额，但它无法解决分布式训练中的原子化分配问题。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An administrator needs to enable MIG on an A100 GPU in a Kubernetes cluster and expose each MIG instance as a separate schedulable resource. After configuring MIG profiles on the GPU, what is the REQUIRED nvidia-device-plugin configuration?
questions.qZh: 管理员需要在 Kubernetes 集群中的 A100 GPU 上启用 MIG，并把每个 MIG 实例作为独立的可调度资源暴露出来。在 GPU 上配置好 MIG 配置之后，nvidia-device-plugin 需要哪种必需配置？
o: Set MIG strategy to 'mixed' to expose both full GPU and MIG instances
Enable time-slicing mode with MIG profile replicas in ConfigMap
Set MIG strategy to 'single' and label nodes with nvidia.com/mig.config
Deploy separate device plugin DaemonSet for each MIG geometry
oZh: 将 MIG 策略设置为 'mixed'，以同时暴露整卡 GPU 和 MIG 实例
在 ConfigMap 中启用时间分片模式并配置 MIG profile 副本
将 MIG 策略设置为 'single'，并用 nvidia.com/mig.config 给节点打标签
为每种 MIG geometry 部署独立的 device plugin DaemonSet
questions.e: MIG strategy 'single' exposes each MIG instance as a separate resource. Nodes must be labeled with MIG configuration (nvidia.com/mig.config) so the device plugin discovers and advertises MIG instances to Kubernetes scheduler. Why the others are wrong: - 'mixed' strategy is not a valid nvidia-device-plugin MIG strategy. The valid strategies are 'none' (default) and 'single'. - Time-slicing is a separate feature from MIG. Time-slicing shares GPUs via temporal multiplexing, while MIG provides hardware-level partitioning. They are not combined in this way. - Only one device plugin DaemonSet is needed. The single instance detects MIG configuration from node labels and advertises resources like nvidia.com/mig-1g.10gb, nvidia.com/mig-2g.20gb, etc.
questions.eZh: MIG 策略 'single' 会把每个 MIG 实例作为独立资源暴露出来。必须用 MIG 配置（nvidia.com/mig.config）给节点打标签，device plugin 才能发现这些 MIG 实例并将其通告给 Kubernetes 调度器。其他选项错误的原因：- 'mixed' 不是 nvidia-device-plugin 有效的 MIG 策略。有效的策略只有 'none'（默认）和 'single'。- 时间分片是与 MIG 相互独立的特性。时间分片通过时分复用来共享 GPU，而 MIG 提供的是硬件级分区，两者不能以这种方式组合使用。- 只需要一个 device plugin DaemonSet。该实例会从节点标签中检测 MIG 配置，并通告 nvidia.com/mig-1g.10gb、nvidia.com/mig-2g.20gb 等资源。

questions.q: A team has a Run:ai project with GPU quota of 4.0 and over-quota limit of 8.0. Currently, the team has 4 jobs using 4.0 GPUs total. They submit a 5th job requesting 2.0 GPUs. The cluster has 10 idle GPUs. What happens?
questions.qZh: 某团队有一个 Run:ai project，GPU 配额为 4.0，超额（over-quota）上限为 8.0。当前该团队有 4 个作业，共占用 4.0 块 GPU。他们提交了第 5 个作业，请求 2.0 块 GPU。集群中有 10 块空闲 GPU。会发生什么？
o: Job is rejected because quota is fully consumed at 4.0 GPUs
Job is queued and starts only after other jobs release GPU quota
Job starts immediately using 2.0 GPUs from the over-quota allowance
Job starts with 1.0 GPU (half requested) due to fractional GPU bin-packing
oZh: 作业被拒绝，因为 4.0 块 GPU 的配额已被完全占用
作业进入排队，只有在其他作业释放 GPU 配额后才启动
作业立即启动，使用超额额度中的 2.0 块 GPU
作业以 1.0 块 GPU（请求量的一半）启动，原因是分数 GPU 的 bin-packing
questions.e: Over-quota allows projects to use more than their guaranteed quota when cluster has idle capacity. Current usage is 4.0 (at quota), over-quota limit is 8.0, so the project can consume 4.0 more. The 2.0 GPU job starts using over-quota allocation. Why the others are wrong: - Jobs are not rejected at quota limit if over-quota is configured and cluster has capacity. Over-quota exists specifically to allow bursting. - Jobs don't need to wait at quota limit if over-quota headroom exists. The project has 4.0 GPUs of over-quota headroom remaining (8.0 limit - 4.0 current). - Fractional GPU doesn't automatically reduce job requests. A job requesting 2.0 GPUs will get 2.0 GPUs (or wait). The fractional feature allows submitting jobs with requests like 0.5 GPU, not automatic resizing. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 当集群存在空闲容量时，Over-quota 允许 project 使用超出保证配额的部分。当前用量为 4.0（已达配额），超额上限为 8.0，因此该 project 还可以再消耗 4.0 块 GPU。这个请求 2.0 块 GPU 的作业会使用超额配额启动。其他选项错误的原因：- 如果配置了超额且集群有容量，作业不会在达到配额时被拒绝。超额机制的存在正是为了允许突发使用。- 如果存在超额余量，作业在达到配额时也不必等待。该 project 仍有 4.0 块 GPU 的超额余量（8.0 上限 - 当前 4.0）。- 分数 GPU 不会自动缩减作业请求。一个请求 2.0 块 GPU 的作业要么拿到 2.0 块 GPU，要么继续等待。分数特性允许提交 0.5 GPU 这类请求，而不是自动调整规模。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which command creates a Kubernetes namespace called 'ml-team-a' with a hard resource quota limiting the namespace to consuming a maximum of 8 NVIDIA GPUs?
questions.qZh: 哪条命令可以创建名为 'ml-team-a' 的 Kubernetes namespace，并通过硬性资源配额将该 namespace 限制为最多使用 8 块 NVIDIA GPU？
o: kubectl create namespace ml-team-a --quota=nvidia.com/gpu=8
kubectl apply -f namespace.yaml with resourceQuota: nvidia.com/gpu: 8
kubectl create namespace ml-team-a && kubectl create quota gpu-limit --hard=nvidia.com/gpu=8 -n ml-team-a
runai create project ml-team-a --gpu-quota 8
oZh: kubectl create namespace ml-team-a --quota=nvidia.com/gpu=8
kubectl apply -f namespace.yaml，其中包含 resourceQuota: nvidia.com/gpu: 8
kubectl create namespace ml-team-a && kubectl create quota gpu-limit --hard=nvidia.com/gpu=8 -n ml-team-a
runai create project ml-team-a --gpu-quota 8
questions.e: Creating a namespace and ResourceQuota are two separate operations. First create the namespace, then create a ResourceQuota object with --hard=nvidia.com/gpu=8 in that namespace. This is the correct kubectl syntax. Why the others are wrong: - kubectl create namespace does not support a --quota flag. Namespace creation and quota creation are separate API objects. - This describes applying a YAML file but the syntax shown is invalid. ResourceQuota is a separate object, not a field under namespace. Also, 'kubectl apply -f' requires a file path, not inline YAML shown this way. - This is Run:ai project creation, not Kubernetes namespace/quota creation. While Run:ai projects create namespaces underneath, the question asks specifically for the Kubernetes command.
questions.eZh: 创建 namespace 和 ResourceQuota 是两个独立的操作。先创建 namespace，然后在该 namespace 中用 --hard=nvidia.com/gpu=8 创建 ResourceQuota 对象。这才是正确的 kubectl 语法。其他选项错误的原因：- kubectl create namespace 不支持 --quota 参数。namespace 的创建与配额的创建是两个独立的 API 对象。- 该选项描述的是应用一个 YAML 文件，但所示语法无效。ResourceQuota 是独立对象，而不是 namespace 下的字段。此外，'kubectl apply -f' 需要文件路径，而不是这里展示的内联 YAML。- 这是 Run:ai 的 project 创建，而不是 Kubernetes 的 namespace/配额创建。虽然 Run:ai project 会在底层创建 namespace，但题目明确询问的是 Kubernetes 命令。

questions.q: A production cluster has nodes with A100 GPUs configured with MIG profile 3g.20gb (3 instances per GPU). The nvidia-device-plugin is installed with MIG strategy 'single'. A pod requests 'nvidia.com/gpu: 1'. What happens?
questions.qZh: 某生产集群中的节点配有 A100 GPU，MIG 配置为 3g.20gb（每块 GPU 3 个实例）。nvidia-device-plugin 以 MIG 策略 'single' 安装。某个 Pod 请求 'nvidia.com/gpu: 1'。会发生什么？
o: Pod is scheduled to one full A100 GPU, ignoring MIG configuration
Pod fails to schedule because nvidia.com/gpu resource is not exposed when MIG is enabled
Pod is scheduled to one 3g.20gb MIG instance, consuming 1/3 of an A100
Pod is scheduled to three 3g.20gb MIG instances spanning the full A100
oZh: Pod 被调度到一块完整的 A100 GPU 上，忽略 MIG 配置
Pod 调度失败，因为启用 MIG 后 nvidia.com/gpu 资源不会被暴露
Pod 被调度到一个 3g.20gb MIG 实例上，占用 A100 的 1/3
Pod 被调度到占满整个 A100 的三个 3g.20gb MIG 实例上
questions.e: When nvidia-device-plugin uses MIG strategy 'single', it exposes MIG instances as resources like nvidia.com/mig-3g.20gb, NOT nvidia.com/gpu. Pods must request the specific MIG resource type. Requesting nvidia.com/gpu will fail to schedule because that resource is not advertised. Why the others are wrong: - MIG strategy 'single' does not expose nvidia.com/gpu. It only exposes MIG-specific resources. The pod cannot be scheduled to a full GPU using this request. - Pods requesting nvidia.com/mig-3g.20gb would get one MIG instance, but this pod requests nvidia.com/gpu which is not exposed. The pod remains pending. - The scheduler cannot map nvidia.com/gpu to three MIG instances. Each MIG instance is a separate schedulable resource. A pod requesting one resource gets one MIG instance (if it requested the correct resource type). ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 当 nvidia-device-plugin 使用 MIG 策略 'single' 时，它暴露的是 nvidia.com/mig-3g.20gb 这类资源，而不是 nvidia.com/gpu。Pod 必须请求具体的 MIG 资源类型。请求 nvidia.com/gpu 将因该资源未被通告而调度失败。其他选项错误的原因：- MIG 策略 'single' 不会暴露 nvidia.com/gpu，只暴露 MIG 专属资源。使用该请求无法把 Pod 调度到整卡 GPU 上。- 请求 nvidia.com/mig-3g.20gb 的 Pod 才会获得一个 MIG 实例，但这个 Pod 请求的是 nvidia.com/gpu，而它并未被暴露，因此 Pod 会一直处于 pending 状态。- 调度器无法把 nvidia.com/gpu 映射到三个 MIG 实例。每个 MIG 实例都是独立的可调度资源。请求一个资源的 Pod 会得到一个 MIG 实例（前提是请求了正确的资源类型）。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An administrator installs the Run:ai control plane and wants to submit jobs from the command line. What is the correct sequence of steps?
questions.qZh: 管理员安装了 Run:ai 控制平面，并希望从命令行提交作业。正确的步骤顺序是什么？
o: Install kubectl → create Run:ai CRDs → deploy Run:ai operator → submit jobs with kubectl apply
Install runai CLI → deploy Run:ai scheduler to cluster → create kubeconfig → submit jobs with runai exec
Install runai CLI → authenticate with runai login → configure cluster context → submit jobs with runai submit
Deploy Run:ai control plane → install nvidia-device-plugin → configure MIG → submit jobs via Web UI only
oZh: 安装 kubectl → 创建 Run:ai CRD → 部署 Run:ai operator → 用 kubectl apply 提交作业
安装 runai CLI → 将 Run:ai scheduler 部署到集群 → 创建 kubeconfig → 用 runai exec 提交作业
安装 runai CLI → 用 runai login 认证 → 配置集群上下文 → 用 runai submit 提交作业
部署 Run:ai 控制平面 → 安装 nvidia-device-plugin → 配置 MIG → 仅通过 Web UI 提交作业
questions.e: The correct Run:ai CLI workflow is: install the runai CLI binary, authenticate to the control plane with 'runai login', configure cluster context (or it auto-detects from kubeconfig), then submit jobs with 'runai submit' command. Why the others are wrong: - While Run:ai uses CRDs and operators underneath, users do not manually create CRDs or deploy operators when the control plane is already installed. The runai CLI is the primary interface, not kubectl apply for Run:ai jobs. - 'runai exec' is for executing commands in running jobs, not submitting new jobs. The scheduler is deployed as part of control plane installation, not a separate manual step after CLI install. - Run:ai provides both CLI and Web UI. The CLI is a primary interface for job submission, not 'Web UI only'. Also, nvidia-device-plugin and MIG configuration are cluster setup steps, not part of the Run:ai CLI job submission flow.
questions.eZh: 正确的 Run:ai CLI 工作流是：安装 runai CLI 二进制文件，用 'runai login' 向控制平面认证，配置集群上下文（或从 kubeconfig 自动检测），然后用 'runai submit' 命令提交作业。其他选项错误的原因：- 虽然 Run:ai 底层使用 CRD 和 operator，但在控制平面已安装的情况下，用户并不需要手动创建 CRD 或部署 operator。runai CLI 才是主要接口，Run:ai 作业不是用 kubectl apply 提交的。- 'runai exec' 用于在运行中的作业里执行命令，而不是提交新作业。scheduler 是作为控制平面安装的一部分部署的，而不是在安装 CLI 之后单独手动部署的步骤。- Run:ai 同时提供 CLI 和 Web UI。CLI 是提交作业的主要接口，而非“仅 Web UI”。此外，nvidia-device-plugin 和 MIG 配置属于集群搭建步骤，不属于 Run:ai CLI 的作业提交流程。

questions.q: A data science team needs to deploy a Llama 3.1 70B model for inference on Kubernetes. They require automatic scaling based on GPU utilization and want to use NVIDIA's optimized containers. Which deployment approach BEST meets these requirements?
questions.qZh: 某数据科学团队需要在 Kubernetes 上部署 Llama 3.1 70B 模型用于推理。他们要求基于 GPU 利用率自动扩缩容，并希望使用 NVIDIA 的优化容器。哪种部署方式最能满足这些需求？
o: Deploy a custom TensorFlow Serving container and configure horizontal pod autoscaling based on CPU metrics
Deploy Triton Inference Server with the model in ONNX format and configure cluster autoscaling only
Deploy NVIDIA NIM microservice from NGC with GPU resource requests and HPA configured for nvidia.com/gpu metric
Deploy the model using KServe with CPU-only pods and enable request-based autoscaling
oZh: 部署自定义的 TensorFlow Serving 容器，并基于 CPU 指标配置水平 Pod 自动扩缩容
部署 Triton Inference Server，将模型转换为 ONNX 格式，并且仅配置集群自动扩缩容
从 NGC 部署 NVIDIA NIM 微服务，设置 GPU 资源请求，并针对 nvidia.com/gpu 指标配置 HPA
使用 KServe 部署该模型，Pod 仅使用 CPU，并启用基于请求量的自动扩缩容
questions.e: NVIDIA NIM (NVIDIA Inference Microservices) are pre-built, optimized containers specifically designed for deploying LLMs on Kubernetes with GPU support. Setting GPU resource requests (nvidia.com/gpu) in the pod spec enables proper GPU allocation, and HPA can scale based on GPU utilization metrics exposed by NVIDIA DCGM. Why the others are wrong: - TensorFlow Serving is not optimized for Llama models (PyTorch-based) and CPU metrics don't reflect GPU utilization for inference scaling - Triton can serve the model but ONNX conversion for 70B models is complex and may lose optimizations; cluster autoscaling alone doesn't handle pod-level scaling - CPU-only deployment cannot efficiently serve a 70B parameter model which requires GPU acceleration; KServe adds unnecessary complexity when NIM provides ready-to-use solution ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: NVIDIA NIM（NVIDIA Inference Microservices）是预构建的、经过优化的容器，专为在 Kubernetes 上部署大语言模型（LLM）并支持 GPU 而设计。在 Pod spec 中设置 GPU 资源请求（nvidia.com/gpu）可实现正确的 GPU 分配，而 HPA 可以依据 NVIDIA DCGM 暴露的 GPU 利用率指标进行扩缩容。其他选项错误的原因：- TensorFlow Serving 并未针对 Llama 模型（基于 PyTorch）做优化，且 CPU 指标无法反映推理扩缩容所需的 GPU 利用率 - Triton 可以提供该模型的服务，但 70B 模型的 ONNX 转换过程复杂且可能损失优化效果；仅配置集群自动扩缩容无法处理 Pod 级别的扩缩容 - 仅使用 CPU 部署无法高效服务 700 亿参数模型，因为它需要 GPU 加速；当 NIM 已提供开箱即用的方案时，KServe 只会徒增复杂度 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An ML engineer configures Triton Inference Server to serve three models simultaneously. The models have varying batch sizes: Model A (batch 1-8), Model B (batch 1-16), Model C (batch 1-32). Which Triton configuration setting ensures optimal throughput while preventing memory overflow?
questions.qZh: 某 ML 工程师配置 Triton Inference Server 以同时提供三个模型的服务。这些模型的批大小各不相同：Model A（批 1-8）、Model B（批 1-16）、Model C（批 1-32）。哪种 Triton 配置设置能在防止内存溢出的同时确保最佳吞吐？
o: Configure dynamic batching with max queue delay microseconds and model-specific max batch size in each model's config.pbtxt
Set max batch size to 32 globally and enable preferred batch size delays for all models
Use sequence batching instead of dynamic batching to control batch formation per model
Set instance group count to 3 with KIND GPU and let Triton automatically manage batching
oZh: 配置动态批处理，设置最大队列延迟（微秒），并在每个模型的 config.pbtxt 中设置各自的 max batch size
全局将 max batch size 设为 32，并为所有模型启用 preferred batch size 延迟
使用序列批处理（sequence batching）代替动态批处理，以控制每个模型的批形成
将 instance group count 设为 3 且 KIND 为 GPU，让 Triton 自动管理批处理
questions.e: Dynamic batching with max queue delay microseconds allows Triton to accumulate requests up to each model's specific max batch size before inference, optimizing GPU utilization. Each model's config.pbtxt must specify its own max batch size to prevent memory overflow while maximizing throughput through controlled batch formation. Why the others are wrong: - Global max batch size would force smaller models to wait for batches they cannot handle, and preferred batch size doesn't prevent the 70B model from exceeding memory with batch 32 - Sequence batching is for stateful models (like RNNs) where requests must maintain order; it doesn't solve the batch size optimization problem for independent inference requests - Instance groups control model parallelism, not batch formation; Triton won't automatically determine safe batch sizes without explicit configuration in config.pbtxt
questions.eZh: 动态批处理配合最大队列延迟（微秒）可以让 Triton 在推理前将请求累积到各模型特定的 max batch size，从而优化 GPU 利用率。每个模型的 config.pbtxt 必须指定各自的 max batch size，以在通过受控的批形成最大化吞吐的同时防止内存溢出。其他选项错误的原因：- 全局的 max batch size 会迫使较小的模型等待其无法承载的批次，而且 preferred batch size 并不能防止 70B 模型在批大小为 32 时超出内存 - 序列批处理适用于有状态模型（如 RNN），其中请求必须保持顺序；它并不能解决独立推理请求的批大小优化问题 - instance group 控制的是模型并行，而不是批形成；如果没有在 config.pbtxt 中显式配置，Triton 不会自动确定安全的批大小

questions.q: A researcher needs to run a distributed training job on 4 nodes, with 8 A100 GPUs per node, using PyTorch DDP and NCCL. Which Slurm sbatch script configuration correctly allocates resources for this multi-node training job?
questions.qZh: 某研究人员需要在 4 个节点上运行分布式训练作业，每节点 8 块 A100 GPU，使用 PyTorch DDP 和 NCCL。哪种 Slurm sbatch 脚本配置能正确为这个多节点训练作业分配资源？
o: --nodes=4 --gres=gpu:8 --ntasks-per-node=8 --cpus-per-task=8
--nodes=4 --gres=gpu:8 --ntasks=4 --cpus-per-task=16
--nodes=4 --gres=gpu:32 --ntasks=32 --cpus-per-task=4
--nodes=4 --gres=gpu:a100:8 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=128
oZh: --nodes=4 --gres=gpu:8 --ntasks-per-node=8 --cpus-per-task=8
--nodes=4 --gres=gpu:8 --ntasks=4 --cpus-per-task=16
--nodes=4 --gres=gpu:32 --ntasks=32 --cpus-per-task=4
--nodes=4 --gres=gpu:a100:8 --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=128
questions.e: For PyTorch DDP with NCCL, each GPU runs one process. --nodes=4 allocates 4 nodes, --gres=gpu:8 requests 8 GPUs per node, --ntasks-per-node=8 creates 8 tasks (processes) per node matching the GPU count, and --cpus-per-task=8 assigns CPU cores to each process. This gives 32 total processes (4 nodes × 8 GPUs) for distributed training. Why the others are wrong: - --ntasks=4 creates only 4 total tasks across all nodes instead of 8 per node (32 total), underutilizing 28 GPUs that would sit idle - --gres=gpu:32 requests 32 GPUs per node (128 total) which exceeds hardware capacity; --ntasks=32 creates 32 tasks per node instead of total, resulting in 128 tasks for 32 GPUs - --ntasks=1 creates only one task total across all nodes, leaving 31 GPUs unused; --cpus-per-task=128 is excessive and may exceed node CPU count ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 对于使用 NCCL 的 PyTorch DDP，每块 GPU 运行一个进程。--nodes=4 分配 4 个节点，--gres=gpu:8 请求每节点 8 块 GPU，--ntasks-per-node=8 创建每节点 8 个任务（进程）以匹配 GPU 数量，--cpus-per-task=8 为每个进程分配 CPU 核心。这样总共得到 32 个进程（4 节点 × 8 GPU）用于分布式训练。其他选项错误的原因：- --ntasks=4 只在所有节点上创建 4 个任务，而不是每节点 8 个（共 32 个），会让 28 块 GPU 闲置未被利用 - --gres=gpu:32 请求每节点 32 块 GPU（总计 128 块），超出硬件容量；--ntasks=32 创建的是每节点 32 个任务而非总数，结果在 32 块 GPU 上产生 128 个任务 - --ntasks=1 只在所有节点上创建一个任务，导致 31 块 GPU 闲置；--cpus-per-task=128 过大，可能超出节点 CPU 数量 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: During a multi-node NCCL training job across 8 nodes with InfiniBand interconnect, the job hangs at initialization. NCCL DEBUG=INFO shows 'Net/IB: No device found'. Which environment variable configuration resolves this issue?
questions.qZh: 在一个跨 8 个节点、使用 InfiniBand 互联的 NCCL 训练作业中，作业在初始化阶段挂起。NCCL DEBUG=INFO 显示 'Net/IB: No device found'。哪种环境变量配置可以解决该问题？
o: export NCCL IB HCA=mlx5 0 and export NCCL IB DISABLE=0
export NCCL IB DISABLE=1 and export NCCL SOCKET IFNAME=eth0
export NCCL DEBUG=WARN and export NCCL P2P DISABLE=1
export NCCL SOCKET IFNAME=ib0 and export NCCL NET GDR LEVEL=0
oZh: export NCCL IB HCA=mlx5 0 并 export NCCL IB DISABLE=0
export NCCL IB DISABLE=1 并 export NCCL SOCKET IFNAME=eth0
export NCCL DEBUG=WARN 并 export NCCL P2P DISABLE=1
export NCCL SOCKET IFNAME=ib0 并 export NCCL NET GDR LEVEL=0
questions.e: NCCL IB HCA=mlx5 0 explicitly specifies the InfiniBand device name (mlx5 is Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX HCA), and NCCL IB DISABLE=0 ensures InfiniBand is enabled (it's default but explicit here). The 'No device found' error means NCCL cannot auto-detect the IB device, so explicit specification is required. Why the others are wrong: - NCCL IB DISABLE=1 disables InfiniBand entirely and falls back to Ethernet (eth0), which defeats the purpose of having InfiniBand and severely degrades multi-node bandwidth from 200Gbps to 10-25Gbps - Changing DEBUG level to WARN and disabling P2P doesn't address the device detection issue; P2P DISABLE affects GPU-Direct RDMA within a node, not inter-node IB connectivity - ib0 is typically the IP-over-IB interface, not the native RDMA device NCCL needs; NCCL NET GDR LEVEL controls GPU-Direct RDMA but doesn't fix device detection ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: NCCL IB HCA=mlx5 0 显式指定了 InfiniBand 设备名称（mlx5 是 Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX HCA），而 NCCL IB DISABLE=0 确保启用 InfiniBand（默认即启用，此处显式声明）。'No device found' 错误意味着 NCCL 无法自动检测到 IB 设备，因此必须显式指定。其他选项错误的原因：- NCCL IB DISABLE=1 会完全禁用 InfiniBand 并回退到以太网（eth0），这既失去了使用 InfiniBand 的意义，又会让多节点带宽从 200Gbps 严重降至 10-25Gbps - 把 DEBUG 级别改为 WARN 并禁用 P2P 无法解决设备检测问题；P2P DISABLE 影响的是节点内的 GPU-Direct RDMA，而非节点间的 IB 互联 - ib0 通常是 IP-over-IB 接口，而不是 NCCL 所需的原生 RDMA 设备；NCCL NET GDR LEVEL 控制 GPU-Direct RDMA，但无法修复设备检测问题 ⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A team wants to submit a distributed training job using Run:ai that requires 4 worker pods with 8 GPUs each, gang scheduling to ensure all pods start together, and PyTorch distributed launch. Which runai submit command correctly configures this job?
questions.qZh: 某团队希望通过 Run:ai 提交一个分布式训练作业，需要 4 个 worker Pod、每个 Pod 8 块 GPU，使用 gang scheduling 确保所有 Pod 同时启动，并采用 PyTorch 分布式启动方式。以下哪个 runai submit 命令能正确配置该作业？
o: runai submit train-job --replicas 4 --gpu 8 --gang-scheduling --distributed-launch torch --command 'python train.py'
runai submit train-job --workers 4 --gpu 8 --image pytorch:latest --command 'python train.py'
runai submit train-job --workers 4 --gpu 32 --gang-scheduling --command 'torchrun train.py'
runai submit train-job --workers 4 --gpu-per-worker 8 --scheduling-policy gang --command 'python -m torch.distributed.launch train.py'
oZh: runai submit train-job --replicas 4 --gpu 8 --gang-scheduling --distributed-launch torch --command 'python train.py'
runai submit train-job --workers 4 --gpu 8 --image pytorch:latest --command 'python train.py'
runai submit train-job --workers 4 --gpu 32 --gang-scheduling --command 'torchrun train.py'
runai submit train-job --workers 4 --gpu-per-worker 8 --scheduling-policy gang --command 'python -m torch.distributed.launch train.py'
questions.e: --replicas 4 creates 4 worker pods, --gpu 8 allocates 8 GPUs per pod (32 total), --gang-scheduling ensures all pods start together or none start (critical for distributed training), and --distributed-launch torch automatically sets up PyTorch DDP environment variables (MASTER ADDR, MASTER PORT, RANK, WORLD SIZE). Why the others are wrong: - --workers flag is not a valid Run:ai parameter; the correct flag is --replicas. Without --gang-scheduling, pods start independently which can cause distributed training initialization failures - --gpu 32 requests 32 GPUs total (not per pod), resulting in uneven GPU distribution. --gang-scheduling flag is correct but the GPU allocation is wrong, and torchrun requires proper environment variables that --distributed-launch sets up - --gpu-per-worker is not a valid Run:ai flag (correct is --gpu which applies per replica), and --scheduling-policy is incorrect (correct is --gang-scheduling). Manual torch.distributed.launch is unnecessary when --distributed-launch handles it
questions.eZh: --replicas 4 创建 4 个 worker Pod，--gpu 8 为每个 Pod 分配 8 块 GPU（合计 32 块），--gang-scheduling 确保所有 Pod 要么同时启动、要么都不启动（这对分布式训练至关重要），而 --distributed-launch torch 会自动配置 PyTorch DDP 环境变量（MASTER_ADDR、MASTER_PORT、RANK、WORLD_SIZE）。其它选项错误的原因： - --workers 不是有效的 Run:ai 参数，正确的参数是 --replicas。缺少 --gang-scheduling 时各 Pod 独立启动，可能导致分布式训练初始化失败 - --gpu 32 表示总共申请 32 块 GPU（而非每个 Pod），会造成 GPU 分配不均 - --gang-scheduling 本身正确，但 GPU 分配有误，而且 torchrun 需要正确的环境变量，而这正是 --distributed-launch 所设置的 - --gpu-per-worker 不是有效的 Run:ai 参数（正确的是 --gpu，作用于每个 replica），--scheduling-policy 也不正确（正确的是 --gang-scheduling）。当 --distributed-launch 已经处理这些时，手动使用 torch.distributed.launch 是不必要的

questions.q: An organization runs mixed workloads: inference services requiring low latency and training jobs that can tolerate delays. They deploy both on the same Kubernetes cluster with GPUs. Which scheduling strategy BEST optimizes GPU utilization while meeting SLA requirements?
questions.qZh: 某组织运行混合工作负载：一部分是需要低延迟的推理服务，另一部分是可以容忍延迟的训练作业。两者都部署在同一个带 GPU 的 Kubernetes 集群上。以下哪种调度策略在满足 SLA 要求的同时最能优化 GPU 利用率？
o: Use Run:ai with guaranteed quotas for inference workloads and best-effort quotas for training workloads, enabling preemption for training jobs
Deploy inference on dedicated GPU nodes with taints and training on separate nodes without taints, using cluster autoscaling for both
Configure all workloads with the same priority class and let Kubernetes default scheduler handle GPU allocation with resource requests
Use time-based scheduling: inference jobs run during business hours, training jobs run at night with cron-based job submission
oZh: 使用 Run:ai，为推理工作负载设置 guaranteed quota，为训练工作负载设置 best-effort quota，并为训练作业启用抢占（preemption）
将推理部署在带 taint 的专用 GPU 节点上，训练部署在无 taint 的独立节点上，两者都使用集群自动扩缩容
为所有工作负载配置相同的 priority class，由 Kubernetes 默认调度器通过 resource requests 处理 GPU 分配
使用基于时间的调度：推理作业在工作时间运行，训练作业在夜间通过 cron 方式提交
questions.e: Run:ai's quota system allows guaranteed quotas for inference (ensuring resources are always available for low-latency SLA), best-effort quotas for training (can use idle resources), and preemption (training jobs can be paused when inference needs GPUs). This maximizes utilization by letting training use idle GPUs while protecting inference SLAs through guaranteed allocation and preemption. Why the others are wrong: - Dedicated nodes with taints provide isolation but waste GPU resources when inference doesn't fully utilize its dedicated GPUs, while training sits idle. This is resource-inefficient and increases cost - Same priority for all workloads means training jobs can starve inference jobs during contention, violating low-latency SLAs. Default Kubernetes scheduler doesn't understand workload-specific requirements or implement intelligent preemption - Time-based scheduling assumes predictable load patterns and wastes GPU resources during off-hours for inference (GPUs sit idle at night). Modern inference workloads often have 24/7 requirements, and manual cron scheduling is inflexible
questions.eZh: Run:ai 的 quota 体系支持为推理设置 guaranteed quota（确保低延迟 SLA 所需的资源始终可用），为训练设置 best-effort quota（可以使用闲置资源），以及抢占机制（在推理需要 GPU 时训练作业可被暂停）。这样既让训练使用闲置 GPU 提高利用率，又通过 guaranteed 分配和抢占保护推理 SLA。其它选项错误的原因： - 带 taint 的专用节点虽然提供了隔离，但当推理无法充分利用其专用 GPU 时会造成 GPU 资源浪费，而训练节点又闲置，这既浪费资源又增加成本 - 所有工作负载使用相同优先级，意味着资源竞争时训练作业可能让推理作业饥饿，违反低延迟 SLA。Kubernetes 默认调度器并不理解工作负载的差异化需求，也不支持智能抢占 - 基于时间的调度假设负载模式可预测，且在非高峰时段浪费 GPU 资源（夜间推理的 GPU 闲置）。现代推理工作负载通常有 7×24 小时需求，基于 cron 的手动调度缺乏灵活性

questions.q: A data scientist launches a Slurm job with srun for multi-node training but notices NCCL performance is 10x slower than expected. NCCL DEBUG output shows 'Using network Socket'. The cluster has 100Gbps Ethernet. What is the MOST likely cause?
questions.qZh: 某数据科学家用 srun 提交了一个多节点训练的 Slurm 作业，却发现 NCCL 性能比预期慢了 10 倍。NCCL DEBUG 输出显示 'Using network Socket'。该集群配备 100Gbps 以太网。最可能的原因是什么？
o: The Slurm job did not request exclusive node access, causing network contention with other jobs
NCCL IB DISABLE was accidentally set to 1, forcing fallback to socket communication
NCCL is using TCP sockets instead of RDMA because NCCL SOCKET IFNAME is not set to the correct high-speed interface
The training script uses DataParallel instead of DistributedDataParallel, limiting NCCL efficiency
oZh: Slurm 作业未申请独占节点访问，导致与其他作业发生网络争用
NCCL_IB_DISABLE 被误设为 1，强制回退到 socket 通信
由于 NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME 未设置为正确的高速网络接口，NCCL 使用 TCP socket 而非 RDMA
训练脚本使用 DataParallel 而非 DistributedDataParallel，限制了 NCCL 的效率
questions.e: 'Using network Socket' indicates NCCL defaulted to TCP sockets, likely because it auto-selected a low-speed interface (like 1Gbps management network) instead of the 100Gbps data network. NCCL SOCKET IFNAME should be set to the high-speed interface name (e.g., 'eth1' or 'enp94s0f0') to force NCCL to use the correct network for inter-node communication. Why the others are wrong: - While node sharing can cause contention, 10x slowdown specifically with 'Using network Socket' message indicates wrong network interface selection, not contention. Exclusive access would help but doesn't fix the interface issue - If NCCL IB DISABLE=1 was set (and there's InfiniBand), the message would be similar, but the question states 100Gbps Ethernet (not IB). The issue is socket interface selection on Ethernet, not IB being disabled - DataParallel vs DistributedDataParallel affects scaling efficiency but wouldn't cause NCCL to report 'Using network Socket' or cause 10x slowdown on network communication. This is a network configuration issue, not a code issue ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 'Using network Socket' 表明 NCCL 默认使用了 TCP socket，很可能是因为它自动选中了低速接口（例如 1Gbps 管理网络）而不是 100Gbps 数据网络。NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME 应设置为高速接口名（例如 'eth1' 或 'enp94s0f0'），以强制 NCCL 在节点间通信时使用正确的网络。其它选项错误的原因： - 虽然共享节点确实会引发争用，但伴随 'Using network Socket' 的 10 倍性能下降明确指向网络接口选择错误，而非争用。独占访问虽有帮助，但无法解决接口问题 - 若设置了 NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1（且存在 InfiniBand），报错信息会类似，但题目说明是 100Gbps 以太网（而非 IB）。问题在于以太网上的 socket 接口选择，而不是 IB 被禁用 - DataParallel 与 DistributedDataParallel 影响的是扩展效率，但不会让 NCCL 报告 'Using network Socket'，也不会导致网络通信慢 10 倍。这是网络配置问题，而非代码问题 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A Triton Inference Server deployment serves a BERT model and a GPT-2 model. BERT averages 10ms per request, GPT-2 averages 100ms. Both receive 100 requests/sec. To minimize p95 latency for BERT without degrading GPT-2 throughput, which configuration should be applied?
questions.qZh: 某 Triton Inference Server 部署同时提供 BERT 模型和 GPT-2 模型服务。BERT 平均每个请求 10ms，GPT-2 平均 100ms。两者每秒都接收 100 个请求。为了在不降低 GPT-2 吞吐的前提下最小化 BERT 的 p95 延迟，应采用哪种配置？
o: Enable dynamic batching for BERT with max queue delay microseconds=5000 and GPT-2 with max queue delay microseconds=50000
Enable dynamic batching for both models with the same max queue delay microseconds value
Configure separate instance groups: BERT with 10 instances, GPT-2 with 1 instance, both on the same GPU
Deploy BERT and GPT-2 on separate Triton server instances with dedicated GPUs for each
oZh: 为 BERT 启用动态批处理，设置 max_queue_delay_microseconds=5000；为 GPT-2 设置 max_queue_delay_microseconds=50000
为两个模型启用动态批处理，并使用相同的 max_queue_delay_microseconds 值
配置独立的 instance group：BERT 10 个实例，GPT-2 1 个实例，两者都放在同一块 GPU 上
将 BERT 和 GPT-2 部署在各自使用专用 GPU 的独立 Triton server 实例上
questions.e: Different max queue delay values optimize for each model's latency characteristics. BERT's 10ms inference allows shorter queue delay (5ms = 5000μs) to minimize latency impact while still batching. GPT-2's 100ms inference can tolerate longer queuing (50ms = 50000μs) to build larger batches for throughput. This balances BERT's latency SLA with GPT-2's throughput needs. Why the others are wrong: - Same max queue delay for both models either degrades BERT latency (if too long for GPT-2's needs) or prevents GPT-2 from effective batching (if too short for BERT's needs). Different models need different batching strategies - Multiple instances create GPU memory overhead for duplicated model weights. BERT's 10 instances would replicate the model 10x in GPU memory. This wastes memory and doesn't address the actual issue of balancing latency vs throughput through batching - Separate servers with dedicated GPUs doubles infrastructure cost and prevents GPU sharing benefits. Triton is designed for multi-model serving on shared GPUs precisely to avoid this inefficiency
questions.eZh: 不同的 max_queue_delay_microseconds 取值可针对每个模型的延迟特征分别优化。BERT 推理耗时 10ms，允许较短的排队延迟（5ms = 5000μs），既能最小化延迟影响又仍可进行批处理；GPT-2 推理耗时 100ms，可以容忍更长的排队时间（50ms = 50000μs），以构建更大的批次提升吞吐。这样在 BERT 的延迟 SLA 与 GPT-2 的吞吐需求之间取得平衡。其它选项错误的原因： - 两个模型使用相同的 max_queue_delay_microseconds，要么损害 BERT 的延迟（取值满足 GPT-2 需求时过长），要么阻碍 GPT-2 有效批处理（取值满足 BERT 需求时过短）。不同模型需要不同的批处理策略 - 多个实例会因模型权重复制而产生 GPU 显存开销。BERT 的 10 个实例意味着模型在显存中被复制 10 倍，浪费显存且未解决通过批处理平衡延迟与吞吐这一实际问题 - 使用专用 GPU 的独立 server 会使基础设施成本翻倍，也无法获得 GPU 共享的收益。Triton 正是为在共享 GPU 上提供多模型服务而设计的，以避免这种低效

questions.q: A research team needs guaranteed access to 8 GPUs for production training jobs, but should be able to use up to 16 GPUs when the cluster is idle. Which Run:ai project configuration BEST meets these requirements?
questions.qZh: 某研究团队需要为生产训练作业保证 8 块 GPU 的访问，同时在集群空闲时应能够使用最多 16 块 GPU。以下哪种 Run:ai 项目配置最能满足这些要求？
o: Set GPU quota to 16 and enable over-quota to false
Set GPU quota to 8, enable over-quota to true, and set node affinity for 16 nodes
Set guaranteed quota to 8 GPUs and over-quota limit to 16 GPUs
Create two projects: one with 8 GPUs guaranteed and another with 8 GPUs best-effort
oZh: 将 GPU quota 设为 16，并将 over-quota 设为 false
将 GPU quota 设为 8，启用 over-quota（over-quota = true），并为 16 个节点设置 node affinity
将 guaranteed quota 设为 8 块 GPU，over-quota limit 设为 16 块 GPU
创建两个项目：一个保证 8 块 GPU，另一个 best-effort 8 块 GPU
questions.e: Run:ai projects support guaranteed quota (resources always available) and over-quota limit (maximum resources when cluster has capacity). Setting guaranteed to 8 ensures production access, over-quota to 16 allows burst usage. Why the others are wrong: - Setting quota to 16 without over-quota would guarantee 16 GPUs always, wasting resources when team doesn't need them - Node affinity controls placement, not resource limits. Over-quota is a limit setting, not a boolean flag - Two projects adds management overhead and doesn't provide seamless bursting - user would need to submit to different projects ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Run:ai 项目支持 guaranteed quota（资源始终可用）和 over-quota limit（集群有富余时的最大资源量）。将 guaranteed 设为 8 可保障生产作业访问，over-quota 设为 16 则允许突发使用。其它选项错误的原因： - 只设 quota 为 16 而不启用 over-quota，等于始终保证 16 块 GPU，在团队不需要时浪费资源 - node affinity 控制的是资源放置而非资源上限。over-quota 是一个上限设置项，而非布尔开关 - 两个项目会增加管理开销，且无法实现无缝突发，用户需要分别向不同项目提交作业 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An administrator needs to ensure that namespace 'ml-team-a' cannot exceed 32 GB GPU memory total across all pods. Which Kubernetes object should be created?
questions.qZh: 某管理员需要确保命名空间 'ml-team-a' 下所有 Pod 的 GPU 显存总量不超过 32 GB。应创建哪个 Kubernetes 资源对象？
o: LimitRange with container GPU memory limit of 32Gi
ResourceQuota with nvidia.com/gpu: 4 assuming 8GB GPUs
ResourceQuota with requests.nvidia.com/gpu-memory: 32Gi
PodSecurityPolicy with GPU memory constraints
oZh: 使用 LimitRange，将容器 GPU 显存上限设为 32Gi
使用 ResourceQuota，设置 nvidia.com/gpu: 4（假设 GPU 为 8GB）
使用 ResourceQuota，设置 requests.nvidia.com/gpu-memory: 32Gi
使用带有 GPU 显存约束的 PodSecurityPolicy
questions.e: ResourceQuota enforces aggregate resource limits per namespace. GPU memory is controlled by limiting total GPU count. With 8GB GPUs, quota of 4 GPUs = 32GB total. GPU memory is not a separate resource quota type in standard Kubernetes. Why the others are wrong: - LimitRange sets default/max limits per pod/container, not total namespace limits. Would allow unlimited pods each with 32GB - requests.nvidia.com/gpu-memory is not a valid Kubernetes resource quota field - GPUs are counted as discrete devices - PodSecurityPolicy controls security context, not resource allocation, and is deprecated in Kubernetes 1.25+ ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: ResourceQuota 可对每个命名空间的资源总量实施限制。GPU 显存是通过限制 GPU 总数量来控制的。对于 8GB 的 GPU，quota 为 4 块 GPU 即等于 32GB 总量。在标准 Kubernetes 中，GPU 显存并不是独立的资源 quota 类型。其它选项错误的原因： - LimitRange 设置的是每个 Pod/容器的默认值与上限，而非命名空间总量上限，那样会允许任意数量的 Pod 各自占用 32GB - requests.nvidia.com/gpu-memory 不是有效的 Kubernetes 资源 quota 字段，GPU 是以离散设备计数的 - PodSecurityPolicy 控制的是安全上下文而非资源分配，且在 Kubernetes 1.25+ 中已被弃用 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A data scientist needs to pull the latest NVIDIA PyTorch container with CUDA 12.2 support. After authenticating with 'docker login nvcr.io', which command should they run?
questions.qZh: 某数据科学家需要拉取支持 CUDA 12.2 的最新 NVIDIA PyTorch 容器。在使用 'docker login nvcr.io' 完成认证后，应运行哪条命令？
o: docker pull nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:latest
docker pull nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:24.01-py3
docker pull pytorch/pytorch:cuda12.2
docker pull nvcr.io/pytorch:cuda12.2-cudnn8
oZh: docker pull nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:latest
docker pull nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch:24.01-py3
docker pull pytorch/pytorch:cuda12.2
docker pull nvcr.io/pytorch:cuda12.2-cudnn8
questions.e: NGC containers use versioned tags (YY.MM format like 24.01) with Python version suffix. Tag 'latest' is not recommended for reproducibility. The nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch repository contains official NVIDIA-optimized images. Version 24.01 includes CUDA 12.2. Why the others are wrong: - Using 'latest' tag is not recommended - non-reproducible and exam emphasizes version pinning for production workloads - pytorch/pytorch is Docker Hub repository, not NGC. NGC images have NVIDIA optimizations (DALI, Apex, etc.) that Docker Hub versions lack - Incorrect registry path - missing 'nvidia' organization. NGC format is nvcr.io/nvidia/
questions.eZh: NGC 容器使用带版本号的 tag（YY.MM 格式，如 24.01），并带 Python 版本后缀。不推荐使用 'latest' tag，因为它无法保证可复现性。nvcr.io/nvidia/pytorch 仓库提供官方 NVIDIA 优化镜像，24.01 版本包含 CUDA 12.2。其它选项错误的原因： - 使用 'latest' tag 不被推荐：不可复现，而考试强调生产工作负载应固定版本 - pytorch/pytorch 是 Docker Hub 上的仓库，而非 NGC；NGC 镜像包含 Docker Hub 版本所缺少的 NVIDIA 优化（如 DALI、Apex 等） - 注册表路径错误：缺少 'nvidia' 组织名。NGC 的格式是 nvcr.io/nvidia/

questions.q: A Slurm cluster has three research groups. Group A should get 50% priority share, Group B 30%, and Group C 20%. Which configuration implements fair-share scheduling correctly?
questions.qZh: 某 Slurm 集群中有三个研究组：A 组应获得 50% 的份额，B 组 30%，C 组 20%。以下哪种配置能正确实现 fair-share 调度？
o: Set FairShareWeight=50,30,20 in slurm.conf and enable PriorityType=priority/multifactor
Set PriorityWeight=50,30,20 per account and enable FairShareDampeningFactor=1
Configure partition weights with Weight=50,30,20 and set PriorityFlags=FAIR TREE
Create accounts A, B, C with Shares=50,30,20 in sacctmgr and set PriorityType=priority/multifactor
oZh: 在 slurm.conf 中设置 FairShareWeight=50,30,20，并启用 PriorityType=priority/multifactor
为每个 account 设置 PriorityWeight=50,30,20，并启用 FairShareDampeningFactor=1
配置 partition 权重 Weight=50,30,20，并设置 PriorityFlags=FAIR TREE
在 sacctmgr 中创建 account A、B、C，Shares=50,30,20，并设置 PriorityType=priority/multifactor
questions.e: Fair-share is configured via sacctmgr by creating accounts with Shares values. PriorityType=priority/multifactor must be enabled in slurm.conf to use fair-share. Shares are relative weights (50:30:20 ratio). Why the others are wrong: - FairShareWeight is not a valid slurm.conf parameter - fair-share configuration is done via sacctmgr database, not config file - PriorityWeight affects how factors combine in multifactor priority, not fair-share allocation. FairShareDampeningFactor is a tuning parameter, not the primary config - Partitions have Weight for backfill priority, not fair-share. FAIR TREE is a flag for hierarchical fair-share calculation, but Shares must still be set via sacctmgr ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: fair-share 通过 sacctmgr 配置，即创建带 Shares 取值的 account。必须在 slurm.conf 中启用 PriorityType=priority/multifactor 才能使用 fair-share。Shares 是相对权重（50:30:20 的比例）。其它选项错误的原因： - FairShareWeight 不是有效的 slurm.conf 参数，fair-share 的配置通过 sacctmgr 数据库完成，而非配置文件 - PriorityWeight 影响的是 multifactor 优先级中各因子的组合方式，与 fair-share 分配无关。FairShareDampeningFactor 是调优参数，不是主要配置 - partition 的 Weight 用于回填优先级，而非 fair-share。FAIR TREE 是用于分层 fair-share 计算的标志位，但 Shares 仍必须通过 sacctmgr 设置 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: GPU utilization shows 0% in nvidia-smi but the training job reports it is running. What is the MOST likely cause?
questions.qZh: nvidia-smi 中 GPU 利用率显示为 0%，但训练作业却报告正在运行。最可能的原因是什么？
o: The GPU is in P8 power state and needs to be set to P0 performance mode
DCGM is blocking GPU access and needs to be restarted
The GPU is in exclusive process mode and the second process cannot access it
The application is using CPU-only path or GPU kernels are not launching due to a CUDA error
oZh: GPU 处于 P8 电源状态，需要设置为 P0 性能模式
DCGM 阻止了 GPU 访问，需要重启
GPU 处于 exclusive process 模式，第二个进程无法访问
应用走了仅 CPU 的执行路径，或因 CUDA 错误导致 GPU kernel 未能启动
questions.e: 0% utilization with job running indicates compute kernels are not executing on GPU. Common causes: code defaulting to CPU, CUDA OOM preventing kernel launch, misconfigured device IDs. Check application logs for CUDA errors. Why the others are wrong: - P8 is idle power state, but even in P8 nvidia-smi would show utilization when kernels run - GPU auto-boosts to P0. P-state is result of low utilization, not cause - DCGM is a monitoring tool that runs alongside nvidia-smi - it does not block GPU access or affect workload execution - Exclusive mode would prevent process from starting (process creation fails), not allow it to run with 0% utilization. You'd see 'device busy' error on launch
questions.eZh: 作业在运行但利用率为 0%，说明计算 kernel 未在 GPU 上执行。常见原因：代码默认走 CPU、CUDA OOM 阻止 kernel 启动、设备 ID 配置错误。应检查应用日志中的 CUDA 错误。其它选项错误的原因： - P8 是空闲电源状态，但即使处于 P8，只要有 kernel 运行，nvidia-smi 也会显示利用率；GPU 会自动升频到 P0，P-state 是低利用率的结果而非原因 - DCGM 是与 nvidia-smi 并行运行的监控工具，它不会阻止 GPU 访问，也不影响工作负载执行 - exclusive 模式会导致进程根本无法启动（进程创建失败），而不是允许进程运行却利用率为 0%，启动时你会看到 'device busy' 错误

questions.q: An NGC catalog search needs to find all containers optimized for LLM training that support multi-node scaling. Which NGC catalog filter combination is MOST appropriate?
questions.qZh: 需要在 NGC 目录中查找所有针对大语言模型训练优化且支持多节点横向扩展的容器。以下哪种 NGC 目录过滤组合最合适？
o: Category: Training, Search: 'transformer', Filter: Distributed training
Category: Inference, Tag: Triton, Filter: Model parallelism
Category: HPC, Tag: MPI, Search: 'language model'
Category: AI/ML Frameworks, Tag: NeMo, Filter: Multi-GPU support
oZh: Category: Training，Search: 'transformer'，Filter: Distributed training
Category: Inference，Tag: Triton，Filter: Model parallelism
Category: HPC，Tag: MPI，Search: 'language model'
Category: AI/ML Frameworks，Tag: NeMo，Filter: Multi-GPU support
questions.e: NeMo framework containers are specifically optimized for LLM training with built-in multi-node support via Megatron-LM. AI/ML Frameworks category contains training-optimized containers. NeMo supports data and model parallelism for scaling. Why the others are wrong: - NGC doesn't have a top-level 'Training' category - frameworks are under AI/ML Frameworks. 'Distributed training' is a feature tag but less specific than NeMo - Triton is for inference serving, not training. While inference can use model parallelism, question asks for training workloads - HPC category contains simulation/modeling containers, not LLM training. MPI is low-level communication, not a framework - NeMo/Megatron use MPI internally but framework containers are better match
questions.eZh: NeMo 框架容器专门针对大语言模型训练优化，并通过 Megatron-LM 内置多节点支持。AI/ML Frameworks 类别包含面向训练优化的容器，NeMo 支持数据并行和模型并行以实现横向扩展。其它选项错误的原因： - NGC 没有顶层的 'Training' 类别，框架位于 AI/ML Frameworks 之下。'Distributed training' 虽是一个特性 tag，但不如 NeMo 具体 - Triton 用于推理服务而非训练；推理确实可以使用模型并行，但题目要求的是训练工作负载 - HPC 类别包含仿真与建模容器，并非大语言模型训练；MPI 是底层通信而非框架，NeMo/Megatron 在内部使用 MPI，但框架容器仍是更合适的选择

questions.q: After running 'dcgmi diag -r 3', the output shows 'Fail' for GPU 2 memory test. What should be the NEXT troubleshooting step?
questions.qZh: 运行 'dcgmi diag -r 3' 后，输出显示 GPU 2 的内存测试为 'Fail'。下一步排查应该怎么做？
o: Run nvidia-smi -r to reset the GPU and re-run the diagnostic
Increase GPU power limit with nvidia-smi -pl 350 and retry the test
Run 'dcgmi health -g 2' to check if GPU is still responsive before filing support ticket
Check 'dcgmi diag -r 3 -i 2' output for specific error codes and GPU serial number to file RMA
oZh: 运行 nvidia-smi -r 重置 GPU，然后重新运行诊断
使用 nvidia-smi -pl 350 提高 GPU 功耗上限，然后重试测试
运行 'dcgmi health -g 2' 检查 GPU 是否仍有响应，然后再提交支持工单
查看 'dcgmi diag -r 3 -i 2' 的输出，获取具体错误码和 GPU 序列号，以提交 RMA 申请
questions.e: Memory test failure indicates hardware issue. Next step: isolate GPU with -i flag, capture specific error codes and serial number for RMA. Level 3 diagnostic is comprehensive - failure indicates hardware replacement needed. Why the others are wrong: - nvidia-smi -r resets GPU but doesn't fix hardware memory errors. Memory test failures are not transient - reset won't help and wastes time - Power limit affects performance/throttling, not memory errors. Memory test failure is hardware defect, not power-related issue - dcgmi health checks basic responsiveness. If diag level 3 failed, health will likely fail too. Need error details and serial number, not another test
questions.eZh: 内存测试失败意味着存在硬件问题。下一步：用 -i 参数单独隔离该 GPU，记录具体错误码和序列号用于 RMA。3 级诊断是全面的，失败说明需要更换硬件。其它选项错误的原因： - nvidia-smi -r 重置 GPU 无法修复硬件内存错误。内存测试失败不是瞬时故障，重置无效且浪费时间 - 功耗上限影响的是性能与降频，与内存错误无关。内存测试失败属于硬件缺陷，而非功耗问题 - dcgmi health 只检查基本响应状态。既然 3 级诊断已经失败，health 很可能同样失败。此处需要的是错误细节和序列号，而不是再做一次测试

questions.q: A Run:ai administrator needs to ensure that when multiple teams submit jobs simultaneously, Team Alpha's jobs always start before Team Beta's jobs if resources are limited. Both teams have guaranteed quotas. Which configuration achieves this?
questions.qZh: 某 Run:ai 管理员需要确保在多个团队同时提交作业、资源有限时，Team Alpha 的作业总是先于 Team Beta 的作业启动。两个团队都有 guaranteed quota。以下哪种配置可以实现这一点？
o: Set Team Alpha project priority weight to 100 and Team Beta to 50
Set Team Alpha guaranteed quota higher than Team Beta
Enable preemption on Team Beta project with Team Alpha as higher priority
Set Team Alpha node affinity to exclusive and Team Beta to shared
oZh: 将 Team Alpha 项目的 priority weight 设为 100，Team Beta 设为 50
将 Team Alpha 的 guaranteed quota 设置得高于 Team Beta
在 Team Beta 项目上启用抢占，并将 Team Alpha 设为更高优先级
将 Team Alpha 的 node affinity 设为 exclusive，Team Beta 设为 shared
questions.e: Run:ai project priority weight determines scheduling order when multiple projects compete for resources above guaranteed quota. Higher weight = higher priority. Weight 100 vs 50 ensures Team Alpha jobs schedule first. Why the others are wrong: - Guaranteed quota ensures minimum resources, doesn't affect scheduling priority when quotas are met. Both teams get their guaranteed amount regardless of quota size - Preemption allows evicting running jobs, which is more aggressive than question requires. Question asks for scheduling order, not job eviction - Node affinity controls placement on specific nodes, not scheduling priority between teams. Doesn't ensure Team Alpha schedules first ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Run:ai 项目的 priority weight 决定多个项目在超出 guaranteed quota 竞争资源时的调度顺序，权重越高优先级越高。100 与 50 的对比可确保 Team Alpha 的作业先被调度。其它选项错误的原因： - guaranteed quota 保证的是最低资源量，在 quota 已满足时不影响调度优先级。两个团队无论 quota 大小都能拿到各自保证的份额 - 抢占允许驱逐正在运行的作业，比题目要求的方式更激进。题目要求的是调度顺序，而非作业驱逐 - node affinity 控制在特定节点上的放置，而非团队之间的调度优先级，无法保证 Team Alpha 先调度 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A data scientist running a containerized training workload receives the error 'nvidia-container-cli: initialization error with device' when starting a Docker container with '--gpus all'. The NVIDIA driver version is 535.104.05 and nvidia-smi works correctly on the host. Which action will MOST likely resolve this issue?
questions.qZh: 某数据科学家运行容器化训练工作负载，在启动带 '--gpus all' 的 Docker 容器时收到错误 'nvidia-container-cli: initialization error with device'。NVIDIA 驱动版本为 535.104.05，且主机上的 nvidia-smi 工作正常。以下哪项操作最有可能解决该问题？
o: Downgrade the NVIDIA driver to version 470.x to match the container runtime requirements
Restart the Docker daemon and verify the NVIDIA Container Toolkit is installed with 'nvidia-ctk --version'
Add the '--privileged' flag to the docker run command to grant full device access
Rebuild the container image with CUDA 12.0 base image instead of CUDA 11.8
oZh: 将 NVIDIA 驱动降级到 470.x 版本，以匹配容器运行时的要求
重启 Docker daemon，并用 'nvidia-ctk --version' 验证 NVIDIA Container Toolkit 是否已安装
在 docker run 命令中添加 '--privileged' 标志以授予完整的设备访问权限
使用 CUDA 12.0 基础镜像而非 CUDA 11.8 重新构建容器镜像
questions.e: The 'nvidia-container-cli: initialization error' typically indicates the NVIDIA Container Toolkit is not properly installed or the Docker daemon hasn't been restarted after toolkit installation. Verifying toolkit installation with 'nvidia-ctk --version' and restarting Docker daemon are standard troubleshooting steps. The daemon must reload /etc/docker/daemon.json to recognize the NVIDIA runtime. Why the others are wrong: - Driver version 535.x is modern and compatible; downgrading is unnecessary and driver 470.x is outdated for current CUDA versions - The --privileged flag is a security risk and doesn't address the root cause of container toolkit misconfiguration - Container image CUDA version mismatch causes different errors (CUDA version incompatibility); this specific error is runtime/toolkit related ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 'nvidia-container-cli: initialization error' 通常说明 NVIDIA Container Toolkit 未正确安装，或安装后 Docker daemon 未重启。通过 'nvidia-ctk --version' 验证 toolkit 安装状态并重启 Docker daemon 是标准排查步骤。daemon 必须重新加载 /etc/docker/daemon.json 才能识别 NVIDIA runtime。其它选项错误的原因： - 535.x 是较新的版本且完全兼容，无需降级，470.x 对当前 CUDA 版本而言已经过时 - --privileged 标志存在安全风险，且并未触及容器 toolkit 配置错误的根因 - 容器镜像的 CUDA 版本不匹配会引发其它错误（CUDA 版本不兼容），该具体错误属于运行时/toolkit 相关问题 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。
