questions.q: An 8-GPU DGX A100 system shows degraded multi-GPU training performance. Running 'nvidia-smi nvlink --status' shows 'Link 0: inactive' for several connections. Which step should be taken FIRST to diagnose this NVLink issue?
questions.qZh: 某 8-GPU 的 DGX A100 系统出现多 GPU 训练性能下降。运行 'nvidia-smi nvlink --status' 显示若干连接的 'Link 0: inactive'。诊断该 NVLink 问题时应首先采取哪一步？
o: Replace the NVSwitch hardware components connecting the GPUs
Check if the nvidia-fabricmanager service is running with 'systemctl status nvidia-fabricmanager'
Update the NVIDIA driver to the latest production branch version
Reduce the batch size in the training script to lower GPU memory pressure
oZh: 更换连接 GPU 的 NVSwitch 硬件组件
使用 'systemctl status nvidia-fabricmanager' 检查 nvidia-fabricmanager 服务是否在运行
将 NVIDIA 驱动更新到最新的生产分支版本
减小训练脚本中的 batch size，以降低 GPU 显存压力
questions.e: On DGX/HGX systems with NVSwitch (A100, H100), the fabric manager service is REQUIRED for NVLink to function. Inactive NVLink connections are a primary symptom of fabric manager not running. This is the first diagnostic step before hardware replacement. The service manages NVSwitch configuration and must be active for multi-GPU topologies. Why the others are wrong: - Hardware replacement is premature without software diagnostics; fabric manager issues are far more common than hardware failures - Driver updates don't typically resolve fabric manager service issues; the service must be explicitly started and enabled - Batch size affects memory usage, not NVLink connectivity status; inactive links indicate a connectivity/service issue, not workload sizing
questions.eZh: 在采用 NVSwitch 的 DGX/HGX 系统（A100、H100）上，fabric manager 服务是 NVLink 正常工作的必要条件。NVLink 连接处于 inactive 状态正是 fabric manager 未运行的主要症状。在考虑更换硬件之前，这应是第一步诊断。该服务负责管理 NVSwitch 配置，且多 GPU 拓扑必须依赖它处于活动状态。其它选项错误的原因： - 未做软件诊断就更换硬件为时过早；fabric manager 问题远比硬件故障常见 - 更新驱动通常无法解决 fabric manager 服务问题，该服务必须显式启动并设为开机自启 - batch size 影响的是显存占用，而非 NVLink 连接状态；链路 inactive 说明是连接/服务问题，而不是工作负载规模问题

questions.q: A user attempts to use GPUDirect Storage for fast data loading but receives errors when running a GDS-enabled application. The nvidia-fs kernel module is loaded (verified with 'lsmod | grep nvidia fs'). Which file must be correctly configured for GDS to function?
questions.qZh: 某用户尝试使用 GPUDirect Storage 实现快速数据加载，但在运行启用 GDS 的应用时收到错误。nvidia-fs 内核模块已加载（通过 'lsmod | grep nvidia_fs' 验证）。要让 GDS 正常工作，必须正确配置哪个文件？
o: /etc/modprobe.d/nvidia.conf with NVreg EnableGpuFirmware=1 parameter
/etc/cufile.json with correct 'mountpoint' entries for the storage devices
/etc/docker/daemon.json with the default-runtime set to nvidia
/usr/local/cuda/version.txt verifying CUDA toolkit 11.4 or later is installed
oZh: /etc/modprobe.d/nvidia.conf，并设置 NVreg_EnableGpuFirmware=1 参数
/etc/cufile.json，为存储设备配置正确的 'mountpoint' 条目
/etc/docker/daemon.json，将 default-runtime 设置为 nvidia
/usr/local/cuda/version.txt，确认已安装 CUDA Toolkit 11.4 或更高版本
questions.e: GPUDirect Storage requires /etc/cufile.json to specify which storage mountpoints are GDS-enabled. Even if nvidia-fs driver is loaded, applications need this configuration to identify GDS-capable paths. The file contains 'allow compat mode', 'poll mode', and 'mountpoint' directives that control GDS behavior. Missing or incorrect mountpoint configuration is a common GDS troubleshooting issue. Why the others are wrong: - NVreg EnableGpuFirmware parameter relates to GPU firmware loading, not GPUDirect Storage functionality - Docker daemon.json configures container runtime, irrelevant to GDS which operates at kernel/driver level for direct storage access - CUDA toolkit version matters for compilation but cufile.json is the runtime configuration that GDS applications read for storage path mapping ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: GPUDirect Storage 要求 /etc/cufile.json 指定哪些存储挂载点已启用 GDS。即使 nvidia-fs 驱动已加载，应用也需要该配置来识别支持 GDS 的路径。该文件包含 'allow compat mode'、'poll mode' 和 'mountpoint' 等指令，用于控制 GDS 行为。缺少或错误的 mountpoint 配置是 GDS 常见问题。其它选项错误的原因： - NVreg_EnableGpuFirmware 参数与 GPU 固件加载有关，与 GPUDirect Storage 功能无关 - Docker 的 daemon.json 配置的是容器运行时，与工作在内核/驱动层、直接访问存储的 GDS 无关 - CUDA Toolkit 版本影响编译，而 cufile.json 才是 GDS 应用读取的运行时配置，用于存储路径映射 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: During distributed training across 4 nodes with InfiniBand, NCCL operations hang indefinitely. Running 'nvidia-smi topo -m' shows 'NIC0 NODE' connections. Which command will provide the MOST detailed diagnostic information about the NCCL communication failure?
questions.qZh: 在使用 InfiniBand 的 4 节点分布式训练中，NCCL 操作无限挂起。运行 'nvidia-smi topo -m' 显示为 'NIC0 NODE' 连接。以下哪条命令能提供关于 NCCL 通信故障最详细的诊断信息？
o: Execute 'ibstatus' to verify InfiniBand port state is ACTIVE and LID is assigned
Run the training script with 'NCCL DEBUG=INFO' environment variable and examine the NCCL bootstrap and ring initialization logs
Use 'lspci | grep Mellanox' to confirm InfiniBand adapters are detected by the system
Run 'nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE' to check GPU clock throttling status
oZh: 执行 'ibstatus' 验证 InfiniBand 端口状态为 ACTIVE 且已分配 LID
使用 'NCCL_DEBUG=INFO' 环境变量运行训练脚本，并检查 NCCL 的 bootstrap 与 ring 初始化日志
使用 'lspci | grep Mellanox' 确认系统已识别 InfiniBand 适配器
运行 'nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE' 检查 GPU 时钟降频状态
questions.e: NCCL DEBUG=INFO is the primary diagnostic tool for NCCL communication issues. It shows bootstrap exchange, transport selection (IB vs IP), ring formation, and where communication hangs occur. The logs will reveal if NCCL falls back to IP instead of using InfiniBand, timeout errors, or rank coordination failures. This provides the most specific information about WHAT is failing in NCCL. Why the others are wrong: - ibstatus checks InfiniBand hardware state but doesn't show NCCL-specific communication patterns or where in the NCCL protocol the hang occurs - lspci confirms hardware detection but doesn't diagnose why NCCL can't use the adapters or where communication breaks down - GPU clock throttling affects compute performance, not NCCL communication hangs which are network/synchronization related
questions.eZh: NCCL_DEBUG=INFO 是排查 NCCL 通信问题的主要诊断工具。它会显示 bootstrap 交换、传输方式选择（IB 还是 IP）、ring 构建过程，以及挂起发生的位置。日志能揭示 NCCL 是否回退到 IP 而未使用 InfiniBand、是否出现超时错误或 rank 协同失败，从而最具体地说明 NCCL 中到底是哪个环节出了问题。其它选项错误的原因： - ibstatus 检查 InfiniBand 硬件状态，但无法显示 NCCL 特有的通信模式，也无法定位挂起发生在 NCCL 协议的哪个环节 - lspci 只能确认硬件识别情况，无法诊断 NCCL 为何无法使用这些适配器或通信在何处中断 - GPU 时钟降频影响的是计算性能，而 NCCL 通信挂起属于网络/同步问题

questions.q: A container fails to start with 'Error response from daemon: could not select device driver "nvidia" with capabilities: [[gpu]]'. The /etc/docker/daemon.json file exists. Which configuration is REQUIRED in this file to resolve the error?
questions.qZh: 某容器启动失败，报错 'Error response from daemon: could not select device driver "nvidia" with capabilities: [[gpu]]'。/etc/docker/daemon.json 文件已存在。要解决该错误，该文件中必须包含哪种配置？
o: { "exec-opts": ["native.cgroupdriver=systemd"], "storage-driver": "overlay2" }
{ "gpus": "all", "nvidia-driver-capabilities": "compute,utility" }
{ "default-runtime": "nvidia", "runtimes": { "nvidia": { "path": "nvidia-container-runtime", "runtimeArgs": [] } } }
{ "insecure-registries": ["nvcr.io"], "default-ulimits": { "memlock": { "Hard": -1, "Soft": -1 } } }
oZh: { "exec-opts": ["native.cgroupdriver=systemd"], "storage-driver": "overlay2" }
{ "gpus": "all", "nvidia-driver-capabilities": "compute,utility" }
{ "default-runtime": "nvidia", "runtimes": { "nvidia": { "path": "nvidia-container-runtime", "runtimeArgs": [] } } }
{ "insecure-registries": ["nvcr.io"], "default-ulimits": { "memlock": { "Hard": -1, "Soft": -1 } } }
questions.e: The error 'could not select device driver "nvidia"' means Docker doesn't recognize the NVIDIA runtime. The daemon.json MUST define the 'nvidia' runtime in the 'runtimes' section pointing to nvidia-container-runtime. Setting 'default-runtime' to 'nvidia' makes it the default, but the key requirement is registering the runtime with the correct path. This exact JSON structure is documented in NVIDIA Container Toolkit installation guides. Why the others are wrong: - exec-opts and storage-driver configure Docker's general operation, not GPU access; they don't register the NVIDIA runtime - These aren't valid daemon.json directives; --gpus is a docker run flag, not a daemon configuration option - insecure-registries and ulimits are unrelated to runtime selection; they configure registry access and resource limits respectively ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 报错 'could not select device driver "nvidia"' 意味着 Docker 无法识别 NVIDIA runtime。daemon.json 必须通过 'runtimes' 段定义指向 nvidia-container-runtime 的 'nvidia' runtime。将 'default-runtime' 设为 'nvidia' 可使其成为默认 runtime，但关键在于用正确的路径注册该 runtime。这一 JSON 结构在 NVIDIA Container Toolkit 安装指南中有明确文档。其它选项错误的原因： - exec-opts 和 storage-driver 配置的是 Docker 的通用行为，而非 GPU 访问，它们不会注册 NVIDIA runtime - 这些不是有效的 daemon.json 配置项；--gpus 是 docker run 的参数，不是守护进程配置项 - insecure-registries 和 ulimits 与 runtime 选择无关，它们分别配置镜像仓库访问和资源限制 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An administrator needs to verify GPUDirect RDMA is working correctly between GPUs and InfiniBand NICs. Which combination of checks confirms GPUDirect RDMA is functional?
questions.qZh: 某管理员需要验证 GPU 与 InfiniBand 网卡之间的 GPUDirect RDMA 是否工作正常。以下哪种检查组合可以确认 GPUDirect RDMA 功能正常？
o: Check 'nvidia-smi nvlink --status' shows all links active AND run 'ibv devinfo' to list InfiniBand devices
Confirm 'lsmod | grep nv peer mem' shows the module loaded AND verify 'NCCL IB DISABLE=0' is set (or unset, as 0 is default) before running NCCL tests
Verify '/proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/ /information' contains peer memory entries AND restart the nvidia-persistenced daemon
Run 'gdsio -f /dev/nvme0n1' to test direct GPU storage access AND confirm InfiniBand subnet manager is running
oZh: 检查 'nvidia-smi nvlink --status' 显示所有链路均为 active，并运行 'ibv devinfo' 列出 InfiniBand 设备
确认 'lsmod | grep nv_peer_mem' 显示模块已加载，并在运行 NCCL 测试前验证 'NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0'（或未设置，因为默认即为 0）
验证 '/proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/<gpu-id>/information' 中包含 peer memory 条目，并重启 nvidia-persistenced 守护进程
运行 'gdsio -f /dev/nvme0n1' 测试 GPU 直接访问存储，并确认 InfiniBand subnet manager 正在运行
questions.e: GPUDirect RDMA requires: (1) nv peer mem kernel module to enable peer-to-peer memory access between GPUs and NICs, and (2) NCCL configured to USE InfiniBand (NCCL IB DISABLE=0, which is the default). These two checks directly verify the GPUDirect RDMA stack is loaded and NCCL will attempt to use it. NCCL tests with these settings confirm end-to-end functionality. Why the others are wrong: - NVLink status is GPU-to-GPU connectivity, separate from GPU-to-NIC GPUDirect RDMA; ibv devinfo only shows IB hardware detection, not GPU integration - Peer memory proc entries are informational; nvidia-persistenced manages driver persistence, not GPUDirect RDMA functionality - gdsio tests GPUDirect Storage (different technology); subnet manager is necessary for IB but doesn't confirm GPU-NIC peer memory is working ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: GPUDirect RDMA 需要：(1) nv_peer_mem 内核模块，以在 GPU 与网卡之间启用点对点内存访问；(2) NCCL 配置为使用 InfiniBand（NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0，默认值即为 0）。这两项检查直接验证 GPUDirect RDMA 栈已加载，且 NCCL 会尝试使用它。在此配置下运行 NCCL 测试即可确认端到端功能。其它选项错误的原因： - NVLink 状态反映的是 GPU 之间的连接，与 GPU 到网卡的 GPUDirect RDMA 是两回事；ibv devinfo 只能显示 IB 硬件识别情况，无法体现 GPU 集成 - proc 中的 peer memory 条目仅供信息参考；nvidia-persistenced 管理的是驱动持久化，而非 GPUDirect RDMA 功能 - gdsio 测试的是 GPUDirect Storage（另一项技术）；subnet manager 对 IB 是必要的，但无法确认 GPU 与网卡之间的 peer memory 是否工作 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A 2-node training job with 8 GPUs per node experiences NCCL hangs during all reduce operations. Running 'ibstatus' on both nodes shows 'State: Active' and 'Physical state: LinkUp'. Which diagnostic step will BEST identify the root cause?
questions.qZh: 某 2 节点、每节点 8 块 GPU 的训练作业在 all reduce 操作期间出现 NCCL 挂起。在两个节点上运行 'ibstatus' 均显示 'State: Active' 和 'Physical state: LinkUp'。以下哪一步诊断最有助于定位根本原因？
o: Execute 'nvidia-smi dmon -s u' to monitor GPU utilization patterns during the hang
Check '/var/log/messages' for InfiniBand driver errors or firmware alerts
Verify CUDA driver version matches across both nodes with 'cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version'
Run 'nccl-tests/build/all reduce perf -b 8 -e 128M -f 2 -g 8' with 'NCCL DEBUG=INFO' and check for 'Ring XX : waiting for connections' timeouts
oZh: 执行 'nvidia-smi dmon -s u' 在挂起期间监控 GPU 利用率变化
查看 '/var/log/messages' 中是否有 InfiniBand 驱动错误或固件告警
使用 'cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version' 验证两个节点的 CUDA 驱动版本是否一致
在 'NCCL_DEBUG=INFO' 下运行 'nccl-tests/build/all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 128M -f 2 -g 8'，检查是否出现 'Ring XX : waiting for connections' 超时
questions.e: Since ibstatus confirms basic IB connectivity, the issue is in NCCL layer. Running nccl-tests (specifically all reduce perf which tests collective operations) with NCCL DEBUG=INFO will show WHERE the hang occurs: during bootstrap, ring formation, or data transfer. The 'waiting for connections' message indicates which ranks can't communicate, revealing if it's a network routing, firewall, or NCCL configuration issue. This is the standard NCCL troubleshooting methodology. Why the others are wrong: - GPU utilization monitoring shows compute activity but won't reveal NCCL communication protocol failures or which ranks are stuck - System logs may show hardware errors but won't provide NCCL-specific protocol debugging that shows the exact communication failure point - Driver version mismatch causes startup errors or undefined behavior, not mid-operation hangs on established connections; NCCL DEBUG is more diagnostic
questions.eZh: 既然 ibstatus 已确认基本 IB 连通性，问题就出在 NCCL 层。在 NCCL_DEBUG=INFO 下运行 nccl-tests（尤其是用于测试集合通信操作的 all_reduce_perf）可以显示挂起发生的位置：在 bootstrap 阶段、ring 构建阶段还是数据传输阶段。'waiting for connections' 信息表明哪些 rank 无法通信，从而揭示问题是网络路由、防火墙还是 NCCL 配置导致。这是标准的 NCCL 排查方法。其它选项错误的原因： - 监控 GPU 利用率只能反映计算活动，无法揭示 NCCL 通信协议失败或哪些 rank 卡住 - 系统日志可能显示硬件错误，但无法提供 NCCL 特有的协议级调试信息，无法指出确切的通信失败位置 - 驱动版本不一致会导致启动报错或未定义行为，而不会在已建立的连接上运行中途挂起；NCCL DEBUG 的诊断价值更高

questions.q: After installing NVIDIA Container Toolkit on Ubuntu 22.04, a user runs 'docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.0.0-base-ubuntu22.04 nvidia-smi' but receives 'docker: Error response from daemon: failed to create shim task'. What is the MOST likely cause?
questions.qZh: 在 Ubuntu 22.04 上安装 NVIDIA Container Toolkit 后，用户运行 'docker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:12.0.0-base-ubuntu22.04 nvidia-smi' 却收到 'docker: Error response from daemon: failed to create shim task'。最可能的原因是什么？
o: The CUDA container image version (12.0.0) is incompatible with the host NVIDIA driver version
The Docker daemon was not restarted after installing nvidia-container-toolkit; run 'sudo systemctl restart docker'
The '--gpus all' flag requires Docker Engine version 20.10 or later; upgrade Docker
SELinux is blocking GPU device access; set 'setenforce 0' to disable SELinux temporarily
oZh: CUDA 容器镜像版本（12.0.0）与主机 NVIDIA 驱动版本不兼容
安装 nvidia-container-toolkit 后未重启 Docker daemon；运行 'sudo systemctl restart docker'
'--gpus all' 标志要求 Docker Engine 20.10 或更高版本；需要升级 Docker
SELinux 阻止了 GPU 设备访问；设置 'setenforce 0' 临时禁用 SELinux
questions.e: The 'failed to create shim task' error after toolkit installation almost always means Docker daemon hasn't reloaded its configuration to recognize the NVIDIA runtime. The installation modifies /etc/docker/daemon.json but Docker must be restarted to read this file and register the nvidia-container-runtime. This is a commonly missed post-installation step explicitly mentioned in NVIDIA's official setup documentation. Why the others are wrong: - Container CUDA version can be higher than host driver supports specific features, but 'shim task' error is a Docker runtime error, not CUDA compatibility - The --gpus flag is indeed a Docker 19.03+ feature, but the specific 'shim task' error indicates runtime configuration issue, not missing Docker functionality - Ubuntu 22.04 uses AppArmor not SELinux by default; even if SELinux were present, this specific error is Docker runtime related, not MAC policy blocking ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 安装 toolkit 后出现 'failed to create shim task' 错误，几乎总是意味着 Docker daemon 尚未重新加载配置以识别 NVIDIA runtime。安装过程会修改 /etc/docker/daemon.json，但必须重启 Docker 才能读取该文件并注册 nvidia-container-runtime。这是 NVIDIA 官方安装文档中明确提到、却常被忽略的安装后步骤。其它选项错误的原因： - 容器 CUDA 版本可能高于主机驱动所支持的特性，但 'shim task' 错误是 Docker runtime 错误，而非 CUDA 兼容性问题 - --gpus 确实是 Docker 19.03+ 的特性，但该具体的 'shim task' 错误表明是 runtime 配置问题，而非缺少 Docker 功能 - Ubuntu 22.04 默认使用 AppArmor 而非 SELinux；即使存在 SELinux，该具体错误仍属于 Docker runtime 相关问题，而非 MAC 策略拦截 ⚠️ 考试中容易被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: You have 120 minutes for the NCP-AIO exam consisting of 30 MCQs and 3 hands-on labs. After spending 50 minutes on MCQs, you have completed 2 labs in 55 minutes total. You have 15 minutes remaining and one lab with 4 tasks left. Which approach BEST maximizes your score?
questions.qZh: NCP-AIO 考试共 30 道选择题（MCQ）和 3 个动手实验（lab），考试时长为 120 分钟。在选择题上花费 50 分钟后，你总共用 55 分钟完成了 2 个实验。你还剩 15 分钟，并且最后一个实验还有 4 个任务未完成。哪种做法最有利于最大化你的得分？
o: Return to review all flagged MCQ questions first, then attempt the final lab with remaining time
Attempt all 4 tasks in the final lab sequentially, submitting whatever is completed when time expires
Request a time extension from the proctor due to lab environment performance issues
Quickly scan all 4 lab tasks, complete the 2 easiest tasks fully with verification, skip the others
oZh: 先回头复查所有标记出来的选择题，然后用剩余时间完成最后一个实验
按顺序完成最后一个实验的全部 4 个任务，时间耗尽时提交已完成的部分
以实验环境性能问题为由向监考员申请延长考试时间
快速浏览全部 4 个实验任务，完整完成其中最容易的 2 个并做好验证，其余跳过
questions.e: With only 15 minutes left and 4 tasks remaining, completing 2 tasks fully with proper verification yields guaranteed partial credit. Labs award partial credit per task completed correctly. Attempting all 4 tasks risks incomplete/unverified work that may score zero. Why the others are wrong: - MCQs are already submitted (40-minute window is past), and changing answers rarely improves scores when rushed - Sequential completion risks running out of time with all tasks incomplete or unverified, resulting in zero credit for the entire lab - Time extensions are not granted for normal exam conditions; lab performance issues must be documented during the exam window ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 只剩 15 分钟且还剩 4 个任务时，完整完成 2 个任务并做好验证可以稳定获得部分分数。实验按正确完成的任务逐项给分。尝试全部 4 个任务可能导致完成度不足或未经验证，从而得零分。其他选项为何错误：- 选择题已经提交（40 分钟的窗口已过），匆忙改答案很少能提分 - 按顺序完成可能导致时间耗尽时所有任务都未完成或未验证，整个实验得零分 - 正常考试条件下不批准延时；实验环境性能问题必须在考试窗口内记录 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: During the exam, a lab task requires configuring GPU resource limits in Kubernetes. You are unsure of the exact syntax for nvidia.com/gpu resource requests. Which action is MOST efficient?
questions.qZh: 考试期间，某实验任务要求在 Kubernetes 中配置 GPU 资源限制。你不确定 nvidia.com/gpu 资源请求的确切语法。哪种做法最高效？
o: Search the internet using the exam workstation browser to find GPU resource configuration examples
Skip this task and return to it after completing other labs, hoping to remember the syntax
Run 'kubectl explain pod.spec.containers.resources' to view the resource field structure and syntax
Use 'nvidia-smi' output to determine GPU count and manually write the YAML from memory
oZh: 使用考试工作站的浏览器搜索互联网，查找 GPU 资源配置示例
跳过该任务，完成其他实验后再回来，指望能记住语法
运行 'kubectl explain pod.spec.containers.resources' 查看资源字段的结构和语法
使用 'nvidia-smi' 输出确定 GPU 数量，然后凭记忆手动编写 YAML
questions.e: 'kubectl explain' provides immediate, exam-environment documentation of resource field structure and accepted values (including nvidia.com/gpu syntax). This is faster than external searching and uses permitted documentation. Why the others are wrong: - Internet access is restricted during the exam; only specified NVIDIA documentation (BCM docs, man pages, kubectl help) is accessible - Skipping wastes the current context you have loaded; syntax lookup takes 30 seconds vs. potentially forgetting to return - nvidia-smi shows available GPUs but doesn't provide Kubernetes YAML syntax; manual memory is error-prone under time pressure
questions.eZh: 'kubectl explain' 可即时提供考试环境内关于资源字段结构和可用取值（包括 nvidia.com/gpu 语法）的文档。这比外部搜索更快，且使用的是允许查阅的文档。其他选项为何错误：- 考试期间互联网访问受限，只能访问指定的 NVIDIA 文档（BCM 文档、man 页面、kubectl help） - 跳过会浪费你当前已经掌握的上下文；查语法只需 30 秒，而你未必还记得回头做 - nvidia-smi 显示可用的 GPU，但不提供 Kubernetes 的 YAML 语法；在时间压力下靠记忆手写容易出错

questions.q: An MCQ asks: 'Which component is responsible for GPU-to-GPU communication in a DGX SuperPOD?' Options include NVSwitch NVOS, Fabric Manager, NCCL, and InfiniBand HCAs. You are uncertain between Fabric Manager and NVSwitch NVOS. What is the BEST approach?
questions.qZh: 某道选择题问：'在 DGX SuperPOD 中，负责 GPU 之间通信的组件是哪一个？' 选项包括 NVSwitch NVOS、Fabric Manager、NCCL 和 InfiniBand HCA。你在 Fabric Manager 和 NVSwitch NVOS 之间犹豫不决。哪种做法最好？
o: Select NVSwitch NVOS because it is the operating system running on NVSwitch ASICs for packet routing
Flag the question, continue with remaining questions, and return if time permits to reconsider
Eliminate NCCL and InfiniBand first, then guess randomly between Fabric Manager and NVSwitch NVOS
Select Fabric Manager because it manages NVLink fabric topology and is the userspace control layer
oZh: 选择 NVSwitch NVOS，因为它是运行在 NVSwitch ASIC 上用于数据包路由的操作系统
标记该题，继续完成剩余题目，若时间允许再回来重新考虑
先排除 NCCL 和 InfiniBand，然后在 Fabric Manager 与 NVSwitch NVOS 之间随机猜测
选择 Fabric Manager，因为它管理 NVLink 网络拓扑并且是用户态控制层
questions.e: Fabric Manager is the userspace daemon that manages NVLink topology and enables GPU-to-GPU communication. This is a 'which component is responsible' question (not 'which software runs on the switch'), making Fabric Manager correct. When you have domain knowledge to differentiate, use it rather than flagging. Why the others are wrong: - NVSwitch NVOS runs on the switch hardware but is not the 'component responsible' from a system architecture perspective; this is a common trap - Flagging wastes the mental work you've already done narrowing to two options; if you have reasoning (Fabric Manager = userspace control), commit - Random guessing ignores your knowledge that Fabric Manager manages NVLink fabric; educated guessing based on partial knowledge scores better ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Fabric Manager 是管理 NVLink 拓扑并实现 GPU 间通信的用户态守护进程。本题问的是'哪个组件负责'（而不是'哪个软件运行在交换机上'），因此答案是 Fabric Manager。当你已经具备可用于区分的领域知识时，应当使用它，而不是标记跳过。其他选项为何错误：- NVSwitch NVOS 运行在交换机硬件上，但从系统架构角度看并不是'负责的组件'；这是常见陷阱 - 标记会浪费你已经完成的甄别工作；如果你有推理依据（Fabric Manager = 用户态控制），就应当确定下来 - 随机猜测忽略了'Fabric Manager 管理 NVLink 网络结构'这一已知信息；基于部分知识的合理推测得分更高 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A lab task states: 'Configure a Slurm partition with 4 nodes, each providing 8 A100 GPUs as a consumable resource.' After creating the partition, which verification command confirms the configuration is correct?
questions.qZh: 某实验任务要求：'配置一个包含 4 个节点的 Slurm partition，每个节点提供 8 个 A100 GPU 作为可消耗资源。' 创建 partition 之后，哪条验证命令可以确认配置正确？
o: scontrol show partition | grep -i gpu
sinfo -o '%P %D %G' to display partition name, node count, and GRES (GPU count)
sacct --format=Partition,AllocGRES to show GPU allocation history
srun --gres=gpu:8 -N 4 nvidia-smi to test GPU access across all nodes
oZh: scontrol show partition | grep -i gpu
sinfo -o '%P %D %G'，显示 partition 名称、节点数和 GRES（GPU 数量）
sacct --format=Partition,AllocGRES，用于显示 GPU 分配历史
srun --gres=gpu:8 -N 4 nvidia-smi，用于测试所有节点上的 GPU 访问
questions.e: 'sinfo -o "%P %D %G"' shows partition name, total node count (should be 4), and GRES (GPU) configuration. This directly verifies the task requirements: 4 nodes and GPU resources configured. Fast and definitive. Why the others are wrong: - 'scontrol show partition' provides verbose output but doesn't concisely show node count and GRES; requires parsing multiple lines - 'sacct' shows job history, not current partition configuration; no jobs have run yet, so this provides no useful verification - 'srun' tests GPU access but requires job scheduling; if allocation fails, you don't know if it's config or scheduler issue; takes longer than sinfo
questions.eZh: 'sinfo -o "%P %D %G"' 显示 partition 名称、节点总数（应为 4）以及 GRES（GPU）配置，直接验证了任务要求：4 个节点以及已配置的 GPU 资源。快速且结论明确。其他选项为何错误：- 'scontrol show partition' 输出较为冗长，无法简洁地同时呈现节点数与 GRES，且需要解析多行内容 - 'sacct' 显示的是作业历史，而非当前 partition 配置；此时尚无作业运行，因此无法提供有效验证 - 'srun' 测试 GPU 访问，但需要作业调度；若分配失败，你无法判断是配置问题还是调度器问题；耗时也比 sinfo 长

questions.q: You complete a lab task to deploy a PyTorch pod in Kubernetes requesting 2 GPUs. The pod shows 'Pending' status. You have 8 minutes left in the lab. Which troubleshooting sequence is MOST time-efficient?
questions.qZh: 你完成了在 Kubernetes 中部署一个请求 2 块 GPU 的 PyTorch pod 这一实验任务。该 pod 处于 'Pending' 状态。实验还剩 8 分钟。哪种排障顺序最省时间？
o: Run 'kubectl describe pod ' to check events, then 'kubectl get nodes -o json | grep nvidia.com/gpu' to verify GPU availability
Delete and recreate the pod with different resource requests, then check if it schedules successfully
Run 'nvidia-smi' on all nodes to confirm GPUs are detected, then check pod YAML syntax for errors
Review Base Command Manager documentation for Kubernetes GPU scheduling requirements and reconfigure the pod
oZh: 运行 'kubectl describe pod ' 查看事件，然后运行 'kubectl get nodes -o json | grep nvidia.com/gpu' 验证 GPU 可用性
删除该 pod 并以不同的资源请求重新创建，然后查看是否能成功调度
在所有节点上运行 'nvidia-smi' 确认 GPU 已被识别，然后检查 pod YAML 语法错误
查阅 Base Command Manager 文档中关于 Kubernetes GPU 调度的要求，并重新配置 pod
questions.e: 'kubectl describe pod' immediately shows scheduling failure reasons (e.g., 'Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu'). Checking node GPU capacity with grep confirms if GPUs exist. This is a 30-second diagnosis. With 8 minutes left, you can fix and verify. Why the others are wrong: - Deleting and recreating without diagnosing wastes time; if root cause is no GPUs available, recreation fails identically - Running nvidia-smi on multiple nodes is slow (SSH/console access per node); kubectl commands are faster; YAML syntax errors would show in describe events - Reading documentation takes 3-5 minutes; with 8 minutes left, diagnose first, document-read only if describe output is unclear ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 'kubectl describe pod' 会立即显示调度失败的原因（例如 'Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu'）。用 grep 检查节点 GPU 容量可确认 GPU 是否存在。整个诊断只需 30 秒。剩下 8 分钟，足以完成修复和验证。其他选项为何错误：- 不做诊断就删除重建会浪费时间；如果根本原因是无可用 GPU，重建仍会以同样方式失败 - 在多个节点上运行 nvidia-smi 很慢（每个节点都要 SSH 或切换到控制台）；kubectl 命令更快；而 YAML 语法错误会在 describe 的事件中显示 - 读文档需要 3–5 分钟；只剩 8 分钟时应先诊断，只有在 describe 输出不清楚时才去读文档 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An MCQ asks: 'A company needs to manage a multi-node GPU cluster with job scheduling, resource quotas, and user access control. Which NVIDIA solution is BEST?' Options: Base Command Manager, Mission Control, Run:ai, DGX OS. You recall Run:ai handles quotas but are unsure if BCM does too. What should you consider?
questions.qZh: 某道选择题问：'某公司需要管理一个多节点 GPU 集群，涵盖作业调度、资源配额和用户访问控制。哪一款 NVIDIA 解决方案最好？' 选项为：Base Command Manager、Mission Control、Run:ai、DGX OS。你记得 Run:ai 能处理配额，但不确定 BCM 是否也能。你应该考虑什么？
o: Run:ai is better because it specializes in quota management and resource orchestration for Kubernetes environments
Mission Control is best because it provides fleet management and monitoring for multiple DGX systems centrally
DGX OS is best because it comes pre-installed on DGX systems and includes all necessary cluster management tools
Base Command Manager provides comprehensive job scheduling (Slurm/Kubernetes), resource management, and multi-user access control, making it the best enterprise cluster management solution
oZh: Run:ai 更好，因为它专精于 Kubernetes 环境中的配额管理和资源编排
Mission Control 最好，因为它为多个 DGX 系统集中提供集群管理和监控
DGX OS 最好，因为它预装在 DGX 系统上，并包含所有必要的集群管理工具
Base Command Manager 提供全面的作业调度（Slurm/Kubernetes）、资源管理和多用户访问控制，因此是企业级集群管理的最佳方案
questions.e: The question asks for 'multi-node cluster management' with job scheduling, quotas, AND user access control. BCM provides all three via integrated Slurm/K8s, RBAC, and resource policies. This is the comprehensive solution. Watch for 'BEST' wording—it means 'most complete fit.' Why the others are wrong: - Run:ai excels at quota/orchestration but typically operates within an existing K8s cluster; it doesn't provide the base job scheduling infrastructure that BCM does - Mission Control monitors/manages DGX fleets but doesn't provide job scheduling or user access control; it's fleet ops, not workload management - DGX OS is a node-level OS; it doesn't provide cluster-wide job scheduling or multi-user management without additional software like BCM ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 本题要求的是兼具作业调度、配额和用户访问控制的'多节点集群管理'。BCM 通过集成的 Slurm/K8s、RBAC 和资源策略提供这三项能力，是最全面的方案。注意'最好（BEST）'这一措辞——它意味着'最完整的匹配'。其他选项为何错误：- Run:ai 擅长配额管理和编排，但通常运行在已有的 K8s 集群中；它并不提供 BCM 那样的基础作业调度基础设施 - Mission Control 用于监控和管理 DGX 集群，但不提供作业调度和用户访问控制；它是集群运维工具，而非工作负载管理工具 - DGX OS 是节点级操作系统；不借助 BCM 等额外软件，它无法提供集群范围的作业调度或多用户管理 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: You have 40 minutes allocated for 30 MCQs. After 25 minutes, you have answered 20 questions and flagged 3 uncertain questions. Which strategy BEST uses the remaining 15 minutes?
questions.qZh: 你分配了 40 分钟完成 30 道选择题。25 分钟后，你已回答 20 题，并标记了 3 道不确定的题目。哪种策略最能利用剩余的 15 分钟？
o: Answer the remaining 10 questions at normal pace (1 min each), then use 5 minutes to review all 3 flagged questions
Speed through the remaining 10 questions (30 sec each), then spend 10 minutes researching flagged questions using kubectl help and documentation
Answer the remaining 10 questions at normal pace (1.5 min each), leaving no time for flagged questions, to ensure quality answers
Return to the 3 flagged questions immediately, spend 3 minutes each reconsidering them, then rush the final 10 questions in 6 minutes
oZh: 按正常节奏（每题 1 分钟）完成剩余 10 题，然后用 5 分钟复查全部 3 道标记题
快速完成剩余 10 题（每题 30 秒），然后花 10 分钟用 kubectl help 和文档研究标记题
按正常节奏（每题 1.5 分钟）完成剩余 10 题，确保答案质量，从而不留时间复查标记题
立即返回 3 道标记题，每题花 3 分钟重新思考，然后用 6 分钟仓促完成最后 10 题
questions.e: Maintaining 1 min/question pace for the final 10 ensures quality answers (10 minutes), leaving 5 minutes to reconsider flagged questions. You've already done initial analysis on flagged questions; 5 minutes is enough to apply fresh perspective. This balances completion and review. Why the others are wrong: - MCQs cannot be researched using lab environment tools (kubectl/docs); MCQ and lab sections are separate; documentation doesn't help MCQ recall - 1.5 min/question uses all 15 minutes with no review time; flagged questions remain guesses; the goal is to improve flagged answers, not just finish - Reversing priority means rushing fresh questions (higher error rate) to spend more time on questions you've already analyzed; diminishing returns
questions.eZh: 最后 10 题保持每题 1 分钟的节奏可保证答案质量（10 分钟），并留出 5 分钟重新审视标记题。你已经对标记题做过初步分析；5 分钟足以带着新的视角重新判断。这在完成与复查之间取得了平衡。其他选项为何错误：- 选择题无法用实验环境的工具（kubectl/文档）来研究；选择题与实验是两个独立部分；文档对回忆答案没有帮助 - 每题 1.5 分钟会用完 15 分钟且没有复查时间；标记题仍然是猜测；目标是改进标记题的答案，而不仅仅是把题做完 - 颠倒优先级意味着仓促应对新题（错误率更高），却花更多时间在已经分析过的题目上；边际收益递减

questions.q: A lab verification checklist includes: 'Run sinfo to confirm partition exists, run scontrol show node to verify GPU GRES, submit test job with srun, check job completion with sacct.' You complete the first three steps successfully, but 'sacct' shows no output. You have 5 minutes left. What should you do?
questions.qZh: 某实验验证清单包括：'运行 sinfo 确认 partition 存在，运行 scontrol show node 验证 GPU GRES，使用 srun 提交测试作业，用 sacct 检查作业完成情况。' 你成功完成了前三步，但 'sacct' 没有输出。你还剩 5 分钟。应该怎么做？
o: Resubmit the test job and wait for sacct to populate, as the job may not have completed when you first checked
Mark the task as complete since sinfo and scontrol verified the configuration; the test job is supplementary verification
Check 'squeue' to see if the job is still running, and if empty, verify job completion with 'scontrol show job ' instead of sacct
Review Slurm documentation to understand why sacct has no output, then reconfigure Slurm accounting database
oZh: 重新提交测试作业并等待 sacct 填充数据，因为第一次检查时作业可能尚未完成
将该任务标记为完成，因为 sinfo 和 scontrol 已验证配置无误；测试作业只是补充验证
用 'squeue' 查看作业是否仍在运行，如果为空，则用 'scontrol show job ' 而非 sacct 验证作业完成情况
查阅 Slurm 文档以了解 sacct 没有输出的原因，然后重新配置 Slurm 记账数据库
questions.e: The core task is configuration verification. sinfo and scontrol confirm partition and GPU GRES are configured correctly. The test job (srun) completed successfully (you observed this). sacct requires accounting database setup, which may not be enabled. With 5 minutes left, the configuration is verified—submit and move on. Why the others are wrong: - Resubmitting wastes 2-3 minutes; if sacct has no output, it's likely an accounting setup issue, not job timing; the job already completed via srun - 'scontrol show job' requires the jobid, which you may not have captured; squeue emptiness means job finished; but you already saw srun complete—don't over-verify - Reconfiguring Slurm accounting takes 10+ minutes and requires database setup; this is out of scope for a 5-minute buffer; accept the primary verification passed ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 核心任务是验证配置。sinfo 和 scontrol 已确认 partition 和 GPU GRES 配置正确。测试作业（srun）已成功完成（你已看到）。sacct 需要记账数据库支持，而该数据库可能未启用。仅剩 5 分钟，配置已验证——提交并继续下一项。其他选项为何错误：- 重新提交会浪费 2–3 分钟；如果 sacct 没有输出，很可能是记账设置问题而非作业时序问题；而且你已通过 srun 看到作业完成 - 'scontrol show job' 需要 jobid，你可能并未记录；squeue 为空说明作业已结束；但你已经看到 srun 完成——不要过度验证 - 重新配置 Slurm 记账需要 10 分钟以上并需要搭建数据库；这超出了 5 分钟缓冲的范围；应接受主要验证已通过 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which composition arc best meets the requirement?

o: Reference
Payload
Inherit
Sublayer

Payload
Inherit
Sublayer
questions.e: The payload arc is correct because the team can keep the asset content outside the loaded stage until the assembly is explicitly loaded, while composing it at the chosen prim. Option A is not correct because a reference composes its target immediately. Option C shares opinions from a class prim, and Option D adds layers to a layer stack rather than providing per-prim load control.
questions.eZh: payload arc 是正确的，因为团队可以将资产内容保留在已加载的 stage 之外，直到显式加载装配体时才将其组合进来，同时在所选的 prim 处完成组合。选项 A 不正确，因为 reference 会立即组合其目标。选项 C 用于从 class prim 共享 opinion，而选项 D 是把 layer 添加到 layer stack，而不是提供按 prim 的加载控制。

o: The local opinion
The inherit opinion
The variant opinion
The reference opinion
The payload opinion
oZh: 本地 opinion
inherit 的 opinion
variant 的 opinion
reference 的 opinion
payload 的 opinion
questions.e: For the property with opinions across these arcs, the local opinion and the inherit opinion are the two strongest choices under LIVERPS. Option A is strongest, and Option B follows it. Option C is weaker because variant opinions follow inherits. Options D and E are weaker because references and payloads follow variant sets.
questions.eZh: 对于在这些 arc 上都有 opinion 的该属性，按照 LIVERPS，本地 opinion 和 inherit 的 opinion 是强度最高的两个选择。选项 A 强度最高，其次是选项 B。选项 C 较弱，因为 variant 的 opinion 排在 inherit 之后。选项 D 和 E 较弱，因为 reference 和 payload 排在 variant set 之后。

Option B composes referenced prim hierarchies beneath prims rather than combining files as layers. questions.q: Which approach allows the damaged plant to differ while preserving native instancing for the rest of the scene?
questions.qZh: 哪种方法既能让受损的植物有所不同，又能为场景其余部分保留原生实例化？
o: Keep the plant instanceable and select the damaged variant on that instance root.
Author geometry edits below the plant instance root in the shot layer.
Edit the shared source geometry used by the intact variant.
Create separate, non-instanceable copies of every plant in the scene.
oZh: 保持该植物为 instanceable，并在该实例根节点上选择受损的 variant。
在 shot layer 中于植物实例根节点之下编写几何体编辑。
编辑完好 variant 所使用的共享源几何体。
为场景中的每株植物创建各自独立的、不可实例化的副本。
questions.e: Option A is correct because a different variant selection on the damaged plant root can produce a separate prototype while leaving the other plants unchanged. Option B is not correct because descendants of a native instance are instance proxies and cannot receive those edits. Option C changes shared source content, and Option D disables instancing for every plant.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为在受损植物的根节点上选择不同的 variant，可以生成独立的 prototype，同时让其他植物保持不变。选项 B 不正确，因为原生实例的后代是 instance proxy，无法接收这些编辑。选项 C 修改了共享的源内容，选项 D 则是对每株植物都禁用了实例化。

questions.q: Choose two. Which changes best meet the team's requirements?
questions.qZh: 选择两项。哪些改动最能满足团队的要求？
o: Use one shared bolt prototype and have the instances refer to it through the PointInstancer prototype relationship and protoIndices.
Author stable ids for the bolts so their identities can be tracked when their array ordering changes between frames.
Create a distinct prototype for each bolt so each one has a unique identity.
Replace the PointInstancer with 12,000 independently authored mesh prims.
Encode each bolt's scene position into a separate copy of the prototype geometry.
oZh: 使用一个共享的螺栓 prototype，并让实例通过 PointInstancer 的 prototype relationship 和 protoIndices 引用它。
为螺栓编写稳定的 id，使其在帧与帧之间数组顺序发生变化时仍可被追踪。
为每个螺栓创建独立的 prototype，使每个螺栓都有唯一的标识。
用 12,000 个独立编写的 mesh prim 替换 PointInstancer。
将每个螺栓的场景位置编码进 prototype 几何体的一份单独副本中。
questions.e: Options A and B are correct because one shared prototype avoids duplicating bolt geometry, while stable ids support tracking individual instances when array ordering changes. Option C recreates the prototype duplication the team wants to remove. Option D increases the number of authored scene prims, and Option E duplicates geometry instead of representing placement with instance transforms.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 B 正确，因为单个共享 prototype 避免了重复螺栓几何体，而稳定的 id 支持在数组顺序变化时追踪各个实例。选项 C 重新引入了团队想要消除的 prototype 重复。选项 D 增加了已编写的场景 prim 数量，选项 E 则是复制几何体，而不是用实例变换来表示摆放位置。

questions.q: Choose two.
questions.qZh: 选择两项。
o: Declare the new prim type in schema.usda and use usdGenSchema to generate its schema code.
Provide plugin metadata and the schema resources so the USD plugin system can discover the schema.
Add the new prim type name as a variant selection in each asset.
Implement an SdfFileFormat plugin for the new prim type.
Store the prim type definition as custom metadata on each scene.
Use a payload to register the prim type when the asset is loaded.
oZh: 在 schema.usda 中声明新的 prim 类型，并使用 usdGenSchema 生成其 schema 代码。
提供 plugin 元数据和 schema 资源，使 USD plugin 系统能够发现该 schema。
在每个 asset 中将新的 prim 类型名称添加为 variant selection。
为新的 prim 类型实现 SdfFileFormat plugin。
将 prim 类型定义作为自定义元数据存储在每个 scene 上。
使用 payload 在 asset 加载时注册该 prim 类型。
questions.e: Options A and B are correct because the schema declaration and generated code define the new prim type, while plugin metadata and resources let USD discover it. Option C is not correct because variant selections choose authored alternatives, not schema types. Option D is not correct because file format plugins handle layer serialization. Options E and F are not correct because scene metadata and payloads do not register schemas.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 B 正确，因为 schema 声明和生成的代码定义了该新 prim 类型，而 plugin 元数据和资源使 USD 能够发现它。选项 C 不正确，因为 variant selection 用于在已编写的备选项之间做选择，而不是选择 schema 类型。选项 D 不正确，因为文件格式 plugin 负责处理 layer 的序列化。选项 E 和 F 不正确，因为场景元数据和 payload 不能注册 schema。

questions.q: Which approach meets the requirement?
questions.qZh: 哪种方法能满足该要求？
o: Author the proxy selection in every asset layer, including assets that currently have no selection.
Set a renderQuality fallback selection to proxy in the USD plugin metadata used by the client applications.
Register proxy as a custom model kind so it is selected when the stage opens.
Register the asset file extension in an SdfFileFormat plugin and use that as the default selection.
oZh: 在每个 asset layer 中编写 proxy selection，包括目前没有 selection 的 asset。
在客户端应用所使用的 USD plugin 元数据中，将 renderQuality 的 fallback selection 设置为 proxy。
将 proxy 注册为自定义 model kind，使其在 stage 打开时被选中。
在 SdfFileFormat plugin 中注册 asset 文件扩展名，并将其用作默认 selection。
questions.e: Option B is correct because USD variant fallback metadata supplies the shared default when a renderQuality selection is not authored, while existing authored selections remain in effect. Option A authors selections in asset layers instead of providing a fallback. Option C registers a model kind, not a variant choice. Option D registers file handling and does not select variants.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为当没有编写 renderQuality 的 selection 时，USD 的 variant fallback 元数据会提供共享的默认值，而已编写的 selection 仍然生效。选项 A 是在 asset layer 中编写 selection，而不是提供 fallback。选项 C 注册的是 model kind，而不是 variant 选项。选项 D 注册的是文件处理方式，并不能选择 variant。

questions.q: Which importer mapping meets the studio requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪种导入器映射方式满足工作室的要求？
o: Set metersPerUnit to 1.0 and copy the source length values unchanged, because stage metadata converts them to meters.
Multiply each length-valued field by 0.001 and set metersPerUnit to 1.0, while leaving normals and angles unchanged.
Multiply all numeric fields, including normals and angles, by 0.001 and set metersPerUnit to 1.0.
Keep the source values unchanged and set metersPerUnit to 0.001, even though the studio requires values to be authored in meters.
oZh: 将 metersPerUnit 设为 1.0，并原样复制源长度值，因为 stage 元数据会将它们转换为米。
将每个以长度表示的字段乘以 0.001，并将 metersPerUnit 设为 1.0，同时保持法线和角度不变。
将所有数值字段（包括法线和角度）乘以 0.001，并将 metersPerUnit 设为 1.0。
保持源值不变并将 metersPerUnit 设为 0.001，尽管工作室要求以米为单位编写数值。
questions.e: Option B is correct because the importer converts millimeter length values to meters and declares a meter-based stage, while leaving normals and angles unchanged. Option A is not correct because metersPerUnit describes the stage units and does not convert authored coordinates. Option C is not correct because normals and angles are not lengths. Option D is not correct because it leaves values in millimeters.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为导入器会把以毫米为单位的长度值转换为米，并声明以米为单位的 stage，同时保持法线和角度不变。选项 A 不正确，因为 metersPerUnit 描述的是 stage 的单位，并不会转换已编写的坐标。选项 C 不正确，因为法线和角度不是长度。选项 D 不正确，因为它的数值仍以毫米为单位。

questions.q: Choose two actions that satisfy the export requirements.
questions.qZh: 选择两项满足导出要求的操作。
o: Call Get once for each animated attribute and write that value at every timestamp in the CSV.
Retrieve authored sample times with GetTimeSamples and evaluate the attribute at each returned time.
Export every attribute from every prim so the target receives all available USD data.

Convert every sample time to seconds before writing it, even though the target uses the same time-code units as the USD stage.

导出每个 prim 的所有属性，让目标接收全部可用的 USD 数据。
使用映射表将已批准的 prim 标识符和属性名转换为目标的键和 CSV 列。
在写入之前把每个采样时间转换为秒，尽管目标使用的 time-code 单位与 USD stage 相同。

Option A is not correct because a single Get call does not retrieve each sample. Option C is not correct because the target accepts only mapped data. Option E is not correct because the target uses the stage's time-code units.

编写一个默认的 xformOp:translate 值，并将其他位置存储在 token 属性中。
