Option B creates separate properties instead of samples on the transform operation. Option C uses relationship targets, which are not animated numeric values. Option D leaves only one transform value time-varying data is not stored in a token attribute.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为时间采样的属性值表示在指定时间码处变化的平移。选项 B 创建的是各自独立的属性，而不是在变换操作上创建样本。选项 C 使用的是 relationship 的 target，那不是可动画的数值。选项 D 只留下一个变换值；随时间变化的数据不能存储在 token 属性中。

questions.q: Which check is the best first step to explain the missing faces?
questions.qZh: 哪项检查是解释面缺失的最佳第一步？
o: Compare the sum of faceVertexCounts with the number of entries in faceVertexIndices, and verify that each index is within the points array.
Check whether the normals array has one value for every point in the mesh.
Compare the authored extent with the calculated bounds of the mesh.
Check whether the subdivisionScheme attribute is set to a supported value.
oZh: 比较 faceVertexCounts 的总和与 faceVertexIndices 中的条目数量，并验证每个索引都处于 points 数组的范围内。
检查 normals 数组是否为 mesh 中的每个点都提供了一个值。
比较已编写的 extent 与 mesh 计算得出的边界。
检查 subdivisionScheme 属性是否设置为受支持的值。
questions.e: Option A is correct because inconsistent face counts, indices, or point references can make mesh faces invalid. Option B is not correct because a normals mismatch can affect shading but does not explain missing faces. Option C is not correct because an extent mismatch can affect bounds or culling, but does not test face connectivity. Option D is not correct because the mesh can display faces without subdivision.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为面数、索引或点引用不一致都可能导致 mesh 的面无效。选项 B 不正确，因为法线不匹配会影响着色，但无法解释面缺失。选项 C 不正确，因为 extent 不匹配会影响边界或剔除，但并未检验面的连通性。选项 D 不正确，因为 mesh 在没有细分的情况下也能显示出面。

questions.q: Choose two. Which actions would best help isolate the cause of the slow first-frame render?
questions.qZh: 选择两项。哪些操作最有助于定位首帧渲染缓慢的原因？
o: Measure stage-open time and first-frame render time separately under the same conditions.
Traverse mesh prims and record point counts, face index counts, and the number of time samples on large attributes.
Flatten the stage before testing, so all authored data is stored in one layer.
Increase render resolution to determine whether the delay is caused by scene complexity.
Remove time samples from all attributes and compare the new render time.
oZh: 在相同条件下分别测量 stage 打开时间与首帧渲染时间。
遍历 mesh prim，记录点数、面索引数量以及大型属性上的时间采样数。
在测试前对 stage 进行 flatten，使所有已编写的数据都存放在同一个 layer 中。
提高渲染分辨率，以确定延迟是否由场景复杂度引起。
移除所有属性的时间采样，并比较新的渲染时间。
questions.e: Options A and B are correct because separate timings distinguish stage loading from rendering, while mesh sizes and sample counts can reveal costly authored data. Option C is not correct because flattening changes the stage and does not isolate the original delay. Option D is not correct because higher resolution changes render workload. Option E is not correct because removing samples alters the asset and may break its intended behavior.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 B 正确，因为分开计时可以区分 stage 加载与渲染，而 mesh 的规模和采样数量能够揭示开销高昂的已编写数据。选项 C 不正确，因为 flatten 会改变 stage，无法隔离出原始的延迟。选项 D 不正确，因为提高分辨率会改变渲染负载。选项 E 不正确，因为移除样本会改变资产，可能破坏其预期行为。

questions.q: Which build configuration best meets the farm requirements?
questions.qZh: 哪种构建配置最能满足渲染农场（farm）的要求？
o: Set PXR_BUILD_PYTHON to OFF and PXR_BUILD_USD_IMAGING to OFF so the build contains only the core libraries.
Set PXR_BUILD_PYTHON to ON, PXR_BUILD_USD_IMAGING to OFF, and PXR_BUILD_USDVIEW to OFF.
Set PXR_BUILD_PYTHON to ON, PXR_BUILD_USD_IMAGING to ON, and PXR_BUILD_USDVIEW to ON so the farm can access the complete artist toolset.
Set PXR_BUILD_PYTHON to OFF, PXR_BUILD_USD_IMAGING to ON, and PXR_BUILD_USDVIEW to OFF.
oZh: 将 PXR_BUILD_PYTHON 设为 OFF、PXR_BUILD_USD_IMAGING 设为 OFF，使构建仅包含核心库。
将 PXR_BUILD_PYTHON 设为 ON、PXR_BUILD_USD_IMAGING 设为 OFF、PXR_BUILD_USDVIEW 设为 OFF。
将 PXR_BUILD_PYTHON 设为 ON、PXR_BUILD_USD_IMAGING 设为 ON、PXR_BUILD_USDVIEW 设为 ON，使渲染农场可以使用完整的美术工具集。
将 PXR_BUILD_PYTHON 设为 OFF、PXR_BUILD_USD_IMAGING 设为 ON、PXR_BUILD_USDVIEW 设为 OFF。
questions.e: Option B is correct because it provides the Python bindings needed by the farm scripts while excluding imaging and usdview, which the headless workers do not use. Option A omits the required Python bindings. Option C adds imaging and usdview dependencies that conflict with the farm's minimal, non-GUI build requirement. Option D omits Python bindings, so the scripts cannot use the USD API.
questions.eZh: 选项 B 正确，因为它提供了渲染农场脚本所需的 Python 绑定，同时排除了无头工作节点并不使用的 imaging 和 usdview。选项 A 缺少所需的 Python 绑定。选项 C 添加了 imaging 和 usdview 依赖，与渲染农场最小化、非 GUI 构建的要求相冲突。选项 D 缺少 Python 绑定，导致脚本无法使用 USD API。

questions.q: Choose two changes that best meet the studio's release requirements.
questions.qZh: 选择两项最能满足工作室发布要求的更改。
o: Publish each approved asset release under an immutable versioned identifier.
Record the exact dependency versions used by each release in a machine-readable manifest.
Have published scenes resolve an unversioned latest asset path so updates propagate automatically.
Replace older release files in place to preserve their existing paths.
Store only the root USD layer because dependencies can be reconstructed from asset names.
oZh: 以不可变的带版本标识符发布每一个已批准的资产版本。
在机器可读的清单中记录每个发布版本所使用的确切依赖版本。
让已发布的场景解析不带版本的 latest 资产路径，以便更新能够自动传播。
就地替换较旧的发布文件，以保留其现有路径。
仅存储根 USD layer，因为依赖关系可以根据资产名称重建。
questions.e: Options A and B are correct because immutable identifiers prevent later edits from changing approved releases, while a dependency manifest records the versions needed for reproducible builds. Option C allows updates to change published results. Option D destroys the earlier release needed for rollback. Option E does not reliably identify the dependencies used.
questions.eZh: 选项 A 和 B 正确，因为不可变标识符可防止后续编辑改动已批准的发布版本，而依赖清单记录了可复现构建所需的版本。选项 C 允许更新改变已发布的结果。选项 D 破坏了回滚所需的早期发布版本。选项 E 无法可靠地确定所使用的依赖关系。

questions.q: Which camera change should the artist make?
questions.qZh: 美术人员应当做出哪一项相机更改？
o: Increase the far value in the camera clipping range to include the distant objects.
Increase the near value in the camera clipping range to include the distant objects.
Increase the camera focal length while leaving the clipping range unchanged.
Change the camera projection from perspective to orthographic.
oZh: 增大相机裁剪范围中的 far 值，以包含远处对象。
增大相机裁剪范围中的 near 值，以包含远处对象。
增大相机焦距，同时保持裁剪范围不变。
将相机投影方式从 perspective 改为 orthographic。
questions.e: Increasing the far clipping value includes the objects at 150 units while preserving the existing framing and perspective. Option B is not correct because increasing the near value clips more nearby geometry. Option C changes field of view, not the visible clipping distance. Option D changes the projection and does not extend the clipping range.
questions.eZh: 增大 far 裁剪值可包含 150 单位处的对象，同时保持现有的构图和透视。选项 B 不正确，因为增大 near 值会裁掉更多近处几何体。选项 C 改变的是视场角，而不是可见的裁剪距离。选项 D 改变的是投影方式，并不会扩展裁剪范围。

questions.q: A material must appear opaque and red in a renderer that supports UsdPreviewSurface. Choose two.
questions.qZh: 某材质在支持 UsdPreviewSurface 的渲染器中必须呈现为不透明的红色。请选择两项。
o: Set the UsdPreviewSurface shader input diffuseColor to the intended red value.
Connect the UsdPreviewSurface shader output to the UsdShadeMaterial surface output.
Connect the material surface output to the shader diffuseColor input.
Set the UsdPreviewSurface shader opacity input to zero.
Set the shader identifier to UsdPreviewSurface and leave the material output unconnected.
Connect the shader displacement output to the material surface output.
oZh: 将 UsdPreviewSurface 着色器输入 diffuseColor 设置为所需的红色值。
将 UsdPreviewSurface 着色器输出连接到 UsdShadeMaterial 的 surface 输出。
将材质的 surface 输出连接到着色器的 diffuseColor 输入。
将 UsdPreviewSurface 着色器的 opacity 输入设置为零。
将着色器标识符设为 UsdPreviewSurface，并且不连接材质输出。
将着色器的 displacement 输出连接到材质的 surface 输出。
questions.e: Authoring the red diffuseColor and connecting the shader output to the material surface output supplies the intended color through the material terminal. Option C reverses the valid connection direction. Option D makes the surface transparent. Option E leaves no surface terminal connection, and Option F connects a displacement output instead of the surface output.
questions.eZh: 创作红色 diffuseColor 并将着色器输出连接到材质的 surface 输出，即可通过材质 terminal 提供所需颜色。选项 C 反转了正确的连接方向。选项 D 会使表面变为透明。选项 E 未留下任何 surface terminal 连接，选项 F 连接的是 displacement 输出而非 surface 输出。

questions.q: Which UsdLuxDistantLight attribute should the lighting artist change to soften the shadows while keeping the light direction and intensity the same?
questions.qZh: 灯光美术应修改 UsdLuxDistantLight 的哪个属性，才能在保持光照方向和强度不变的同时让阴影变得柔和？
o: Increase the light angle.
Increase the light intensity.
Translate the light farther from the scene.
Change the light exposure.
oZh: 增大灯光角度。
增大灯光强度。
将灯光移动到距离场景更远的位置。
更改灯光曝光。
questions.e: Increasing the UsdLuxDistantLight angle enlarges its apparent angular source and softens shadows without changing its direction or intensity. Option B changes brightness rather than source angular size. Option C does not provide the required softness control for a distant light. Option D changes exposure and therefore affects illumination level, not shadow softness.
questions.eZh: 增大 UsdLuxDistantLight 的角度会扩大其表观的角度光源尺寸，在不改变方向或强度的情况下让阴影变柔和。选项 B 改变的是亮度，而非光源的角度尺寸。选项 C 未提供远程灯光所需的柔和度控制手段。选项 D 改变的是曝光，因此影响的是照度水平，而不是阴影柔和度。

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of asset structure in OpenUSD?
questions.qZh: OpenUSD 中资产结构（asset structure）的主要目的是什么？
o: To simplify version control through standardized asset management and tracking
To maximize rendering performance through optimized data organization and caching
To empower the scalability of an organization and ecosystem and promote collaboration
To reduce storage requirements through efficient resource sharing and deduplication
oZh: 通过标准化的资产管理与追踪来简化版本控制
通过优化的数据组织与缓存来最大化渲染性能
赋能组织与生态系统的可扩展性，并促进协作
通过高效的资源共享与去重来降低存储需求
questions.e: The primary purpose of asset structure in OpenUSD is to make content scalable, collaborative, reusable, and understandable across teams and ecosystems. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD guide defines an asset as a “named, versioned, and structured container” that may include composable OpenUSD layers, textures, volumetric data, and other resources. It further states that asset structure facilitates reuse of persistent data and plays an important role in scaling pipelines and ecosystems. The guide emphasizes content flow, seamless collaboration, consistent conventions, parallel and modular workflows, and balancing openness with resilience to change. Option C is correct because it captures the broad organizational goal of asset structure: enabling scalability and collaboration across multiple contributors, workstreams, and downstream consumers. Option A is too narrow; versioning and tracking may be supported by asset metadata or asset management systems, but they are not the central purpose of asset structure. Option B is also too narrow because performance is one principle of scalable structure, not the whole purpose. Option D describes a possible benefit of modularity and reuse, but storage reduction is secondary. This aligns with Content Aggregation → Asset Structure Principles → Why Asset Structure Is Necessary → Legibility, Modularity, Performance, Navigability.
questions.eZh: OpenUSD 中资产结构的主要目的，是让内容在不同团队和生态系统之间具备可扩展性、可协作性、可复用性，并且易于理解。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 指南将资产定义为“具名、带版本且结构化的容器”，其中可以包含可组合的 OpenUSD layer、纹理、体数据以及其他资源。指南进一步指出，资产结构便于持久数据的复用，并在扩展流水线和生态系统方面发挥重要作用。该指南强调内容流转、无缝协作、一致的约定、并行且模块化的工作流，以及在开放性与对变更的韧性之间取得平衡。选项 C 正确，因为它抓住了资产结构在组织层面的总体目标：支持跨多个贡献者、工作流和下游消费方的可扩展性与协作。选项 A 过于狭窄；版本控制和追踪可以由资产元数据或资产管理系统提供支持，但它们并非资产结构的核心目的。选项 B 同样过于狭窄，因为性能只是可扩展结构的一项原则，而不是全部目的。选项 D 描述了模块化与复用可能带来的好处，但降低存储需求属于次要收益。这与 Content Aggregation → Asset Structure Principles → Why Asset Structure Is Necessary → Legibility、Modularity、Performance、Navigability 的内容一致。

questions.q: When constructing an OpenUSD scene, in which scenario is it most appropriate to use a payload instead of a reference?
questions.qZh: 在构建 OpenUSD 场景时，什么情形下最适合使用 payload 而不是 reference？
o: When an asset requires frequent updates, but the asset should default to the latest version.
When deferring the loading of heavy assets until they are needed, thereby improving initial load performance.
When the asset is small and inexpensive to load to ensure efficient transfer over web protocols.
When it's important to ensure that all referenced data is immediately available on stage load.
oZh: 当资产需要频繁更新，且默认应使用最新版本时。
当需要将重量级资产的加载推迟到实际需要时，从而提升初始加载性能。
当资产体积小、加载开销低，可确保通过 Web 协议高效传输时。
当必须确保所有被引用的数据在 stage 加载时立即可用时。
questions.e: A payload is most appropriate when the scene contains heavy assets that should not be fully composed and loaded until needed. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD payload lesson describes payloads as similar to references, but with the added ability to load and unload them on demand. It gives the example of opening a large city scene with all payloads unloaded so the stage loads quickly, then selectively loading only the city block or asset of interest. When loaded, the payloaded layers and their composed dependencies are brought into the scene. Option B is correct because payloads are designed for deferred loading, scalable working sets, reduced initial load time, and lower memory cost. Option A describes versioning or asset-resolution policy, not the primary distinction between payloads and references. Option C does not justify a payload; small inexpensive assets are often fine as references. Option D describes the opposite of payload behavior, because references are composed immediately, while payload traversal can be deferred. This aligns with Composition → References and Payloads, Load/Unload Behavior, Composition Arcs, Scalability, and LIVERPS Strength Ordering .
questions.eZh: 当场景中包含重量级资产，且这些资产不应被完整合成和加载、直到需要时才处理时，使用 payload 最为合适。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD payload 课程将 payload 描述为与 reference 类似，但额外具备按需加载和卸载的能力。课程举例说明：打开一个大型城市场景时保持所有 payload 处于未加载状态，使 stage 能够快速加载，然后有选择地仅加载感兴趣的城市街区或资产。加载时，被 payload 的 layer 及其合成依赖关系会被带入场景。选项 B 正确，因为 payload 的设计目的就是延迟加载、支撑可扩展的工作集、缩短初始加载时间并降低内存开销。选项 A 描述的是版本控制或资产解析策略，而不是 payload 与 reference 之间的主要区别。选项 C 不能作为使用 payload 的理由；体积小、加载开销低的资产通常直接使用 reference 即可。选项 D 描述的恰好与 payload 的行为相反，因为 reference 会立即参与合成，而 payload 的遍历可以延迟。这与 Composition → References and Payloads、Load/Unload Behavior、Composition Arcs、Scalability 和 LIVERPS Strength Ordering 的内容一致。

questions.q: Suppose you had the following layer: #usda 1.0 ( defaultPrim = "ParentXform" ) def Xform "ParentXform" { def Mesh "ChildMesh" { } } If you wanted to add a property to "ParentXform" such that it would automatically propagate to "ChildMesh" without having to add the same property to "ChildMesh", which of the following changes to "ParentXform" would make this work?
o: Add the property as a custom attribute: custom string myProperty = "TestValue"
Add the property as a relationship to : rel myProperty =
Add the property as a primvar, with "constant" interpolation: string primvars:myProperty = "TestValue" ( interpolation = "constant" )
oZh: 将该属性添加为自定义属性：custom string myProperty = "TestValue"
将该属性添加为指向 : 的 relationship：rel myProperty =
将该属性添加为 primvar，并使用 "constant" 插值：string primvars:myProperty = "TestValue" ( interpolation = "constant" )
questions.e: The correct mechanism is a constant-interpolation primvar . NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD glossary defines primvars as primitive variables authored using the primvars: namespace and interpolation metadata such as constant, uniform, vertex, and faceVarying. Primvars are designed to carry geometric or shading-related data in a way that consumers can discover through UsdGeomPrimvarsAPI and UsdGeomPrimvar. ( docs.nvidia.com ) Option C is correct because constant primvars can inherit down the namespace hierarchy. The OpenUSD UsdGeomPrimvar documentation states that constant interpolation primvar values can be inherited by child prims unless those children author their own opinion for the same primvar. ( openusd.org ) This allows primvars:myProperty authored on /ParentXform to be discovered on /ParentXform/ChildMesh without duplicating the property on the mesh. Option A is incorrect because ordinary custom attributes do not automatically propagate to descendant prims. Option B is incorrect because a relationship targets another object; it does not create inherited property data on that target. This aligns with Data Modeling → Primvars, Constant Interpolation, Namespace Inheritance, and Geometric Property Authoring .
questions.eZh: 正确的机制是使用 constant 插值的 primvar。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 术语表将 primvar 定义为使用 primvars: 命名空间以及 constant、uniform、vertex、faceVarying 等插值元数据编写的 primitive 变量。Primvar 旨在承载与几何或着色相关的数据，并且使用方可以通过 UsdGeomPrimvarsAPI 和 UsdGeomPrimvar 发现这些数据。（docs.nvidia.com）选项 C 正确，因为 constant primvar 可以沿 namespace 层级向下继承。OpenUSD 的 UsdGeomPrimvar 文档指出，除非子 prim 为同一个 primvar 编写了自己的意见，否则 constant 插值的 primvar 值可以被子 prim 继承。（openusd.org）这样一来，在 /ParentXform 上编写的 primvars:myProperty，无需在 mesh 上重复该属性，也能在 /ParentXform/ChildMesh 上被发现。选项 A 错误，因为普通自定义属性不会自动传播到后代 prim。选项 B 错误，因为 relationship 指向的是另一个对象，并不会在该目标上创建可继承的属性数据。这与 Data Modeling → Primvars、Constant Interpolation、Namespace Inheritance 和 Geometric Property Authoring 的内容一致。

questions.q: Which of the following are true for SdfChangeBlocks? Choose two.
questions.qZh: 以下关于 SdfChangeBlock 的说法哪些是正确的？选择两项。
o: Notifications are muted for changes done within the block, even after the block exits
Existing metadata and properties can be changed using USD APIs within the same block
It is unsafe to query Prims that are mutating within the same block
It is unsafe to delete or create new PrimSpec hierarchies using Sdf APIs
oZh: 在该 block 内所做的更改，其通知会被屏蔽，即使 block 退出之后也是如此
在同一 block 内可以使用 USD API 修改已有的元数据和属性
在同一 block 内查询正在发生变更的 Prim 是不安全的
使用 Sdf API 删除或创建新的 PrimSpec 层级结构是不安全的
questions.e: Strictly evaluated against the OpenUSD API contract, C is the only fully correct statement as written. SdfChangeBlock groups multiple low-level Sdf edits so that change processing can be delayed and handled efficiently as one batch. The official API documentation states that opening a change block causes Sdf to delay notifications until the outermost block exits; notifications are queued, not permanently muted. Therefore, A is incorrect. The same documentation gives a strong warning that it is not safe to use Usd or other downstream APIs while a change block is open, because those representations may be stale or may hold expired handles to Sdf objects. Therefore, querying mutating prims during the block is unsafe, making C correct. Option B is incorrect because it explicitly says to use USD APIs inside the block, which the official guidance warns against. Option D is also incorrect because the intended safe authoring pattern is to gather required edits first, then apply them directly through the Sdf API inside the change block. This aligns with Pipeline Development → Efficient Authoring, Sdf Layers, SdfChangeBlock, Change Notification, and Bulk Scene Description Mutation .
questions.eZh: 严格按照 OpenUSD API 契约来评判，C 是唯一完全正确的表述。SdfChangeBlock 将多个底层 Sdf 编辑归组，以便将变更处理延迟并作为一批高效处理。官方 API 文档指出，打开 change block 会使 Sdf 延迟发送通知，直到最外层的 block 退出；通知是被排队的，而不是被永久屏蔽，因此 A 错误。同一文档还给出强烈警告：在 change block 处于打开状态时，使用 Usd 或其他下游 API 并不安全，因为这些表示可能已过期，或可能持有指向 Sdf 对象的失效句柄。因此，在 block 内查询正在变更的 prim 是不安全的，C 正确。选项 B 错误，因为它明确建议在 block 内使用 USD API，而官方指南对此提出了警告。选项 D 同样错误，因为推荐的编写模式是先收集所需的编辑，再在 change block 内直接通过 Sdf API 应用。这与 Pipeline Development → Efficient Authoring、Sdf Layers、SdfChangeBlock、Change Notification 和 Bulk Scene Description Mutation 的内容一致。

questions.q: In OpenUSD, a composed stage aggregates opinions from multiple sublayers. Why might an opinion in one layer not take effect in the final composed stage?
questions.qZh: 在 OpenUSD 中，合成后的 stage 会聚合来自多个 sublayer 的意见。为什么某个 layer 中的意见在最终合成结果中可能不生效？
o: Opinions in a layer only affect the composed stage if the layer is explicitly referenced in every other layer.
The opinion is authored using the weaker keyword, which explicitly lowers its priority.
OpenUSD prevents opinions from taking effect unless they originate from the root layer.
The layer containing the opinion has a weaker strength in the stage’s layer stack than other layers that override it.
oZh: 只有当某个 layer 被其他每个 layer 显式引用时，其中的意见才会影响合成后的 stage。
该意见使用了较弱的 keyword 编写，从而显式降低了其优先级。
除非意见来自 root layer，否则 OpenUSD 会阻止其生效。
包含该意见的 layer 在该 stage 的 layer stack 中的强度弱于覆盖它的其他 layer。
questions.e: An opinion may not appear in the final composed stage because USD resolves competing opinions according to composition strength. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD material explains that a layer stack is the ordered set of a layer and its recursively gathered sublayers, with the root layer considered strongest, followed by sublayers according to their composed order. It also states that strength ordering determines which opinion is composed into the final stage when multiple layer stacks or layers contribute data for the same prim or property. ( docs.nvidia.com ) Option D is correct because a weaker layer can author a valid opinion, but that opinion can be hidden by a stronger authored opinion on the same target. Option A is incorrect because sublayers do not need to be referenced by every other layer to affect a stage. Option B is incorrect because there is no general “weaker keyword” that lowers priority. Option C is incorrect because opinions from sublayers, references, payloads, variants, inherits, and specializes can all contribute to composition. This aligns with Composition → Sublayers, Layer Stacks, Opinion Strength, and LIVERPS Strength Ordering .
questions.eZh: 某个意见之所以可能不出现在最终合成后的 stage 中，是因为 USD 会依据 composition 强度来解析相互竞争的意见。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 材料指出，layer stack 是某个 layer 与其递归收集到的 sublayer 所构成的有序集合，其中 root layer 强度最高，其后的各 sublayer 按其合成顺序排列。该材料还指出，当多个 layer stack 或 layer 为同一 prim 或属性提供数据时，强度排序决定了最终合成进 stage 的是哪一个意见。（docs.nvidia.com）选项 D 正确，因为较弱的 layer 完全可以编写有效意见，但该意见可能被同一目标上更强的已编写意见所覆盖。选项 A 错误，因为 sublayer 无需被其他每个 layer 引用即可影响 stage。选项 B 错误，因为并不存在通用的、用于降低优先级的“较弱的 keyword”。选项 C 错误，因为来自 sublayer、reference、payload、variant、inherits 和 specializes 的意见都可以参与合成。这与 Composition → Sublayers、Layer Stacks、Opinion Strength 和 LIVERPS Strength Ordering 的内容一致。

questions.q: What geometric attribute should be kept in sync when updating point position values on an object?
questions.qZh: 在更新对象上的点位置值时，应保持同步的几何属性是什么？
o: purpose
xformOps
extent
faceVertexIndices
oZh: purpose
xformOps
extent
faceVertexIndices
questions.e: The geometric attribute that should be kept in sync is extent. In OpenUSD, point position values describe the authored point locations for point-based geometry, while extent represents the local-space geometric range or bounding box of a boundable primitive. The OpenUSD UsdGeomBoundable specification describes extent as a three-dimensional range measuring the authored gprim in its own local space, and states that if extent is authored, it should be authored at every time sample where geometry-affecting properties are authored to ensure correct evaluation. Option C is correct because changing point positions can change the object’s local bounds. If the authored extent is not updated, downstream systems may compute incorrect framing, culling, selection bounds, or bounding-box display. Option A is incorrect because purpose classifies geometry for render, proxy, guide, or default visibility categories. Option B is incorrect because xformOps describe transform operations on the prim, not the local geometric bounds derived from point positions. Option D is incorrect because faceVertexIndices describes mesh topology, not the bounding range. This aligns with Data Modeling → Geometry Attributes, Point-Based Geometry, Boundable Prims, Extent, and Time-Sampled Geometry .
questions.eZh: 应当保持同步的几何属性是 extent。在 OpenUSD 中，点位置值描述的是基于点的几何体所编写的点位位置，而 extent 表示可绑定图元（boundable prim）在局部空间中的几何范围或包围盒。OpenUSD 的 UsdGeomBoundable 规范将 extent 描述为在 gprim 自身局部空间中度量的三维范围，并指出：如果编写了 extent，则应在编写影响几何的属性的每个时间采样处都编写 extent，以确保求值正确。选项 C 正确，因为改变点位置可能改变对象的局部边界。如果已编写的 extent 未同步更新，下游系统可能会计算出错误的取景、剔除、选择范围或包围盒显示。选项 A 错误，因为 purpose 用于将几何体划分为 render、proxy、guide 或 default 可见性类别。选项 B 错误，因为 xformOps 描述的是 prim 上的变换操作，而不是由点位置推导出的局部几何边界。选项 D 错误，因为 faceVertexIndices 描述的是 mesh 拓扑，而非包围范围。这与 Data Modeling → Geometry Attributes、Point-Based Geometry、Boundable Prims、Extent 和 Time-Sampled Geometry 的内容一致。

questions.q: Which of these is the most essential composition arc to put onto the components of a model hierarchy?
questions.qZh: 以下哪一项是应当应用到模型层级（model hierarchy）各组件上最重要的 composition arc？
o: payloads
inherits
variant sets
specializes
oZh: payloads
inherits
variant sets
specializes
questions.e: The most essential composition arc for components in a model hierarchy is the payload . NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD glossary describes payloads as composition arcs similar to references, but with deferred loading for scalability, and specifically notes that payloads are typically added to component asset root prims for efficient scalable composition. ( docs.nvidia.com ) Option A is correct because component models act as the leaf or pruning boundary of the model hierarchy. NVIDIA’s model-kind guidance explains that the model hierarchy is designed to prune traversal at the component boundary, and that component models cannot contain other component models as descendants. ( docs.nvidia.com ) Payloads reinforce that design by allowing large component contents to remain unloaded until needed, improving stage-opening performance and enabling scalable aggregation of large scenes. Option B is incorrect because inherits are mainly for reusable class-style opinions. Option C is useful for alternatives such as LODs or looks, but it is not the essential component-loading mechanism. Option D is a weaker composition mechanism used for specialization and fallback-style refinement. This aligns with Content Aggregation → Asset Structure, Model Hierarchy, Components, Payloads, and Scalable Scene Assembly .
questions.eZh: 模型层级中各组件最重要的 composition arc 是 payload。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 术语表将 payload 描述为与 reference 类似、但通过延迟加载来保证可扩展性的 composition arc，并特别指出：payload 通常添加到组件资产的 root prim 上，以实现高效的可扩展合成。（docs.nvidia.com）选项 A 正确，因为组件模型充当模型层级的叶子节点或遍历剪枝边界。NVIDIA 关于 model kind 的指南说明，模型层级的设计就是在组件边界处剪枝遍历，且组件模型不能包含其他组件模型作为后代。（docs.nvidia.com）Payload 强化了这一设计，它使大型组件内容在需要之前保持未加载状态，从而提升打开 stage 的性能，并支持对大型场景的可扩展聚合。选项 B 错误，因为 inherits 主要用于可复用的 class 风格意见。选项 C 对 LOD 或 look 等备选方案很有用，但它不是关键的组件加载机制。选项 D 是一种较弱的 composition 机制，用于特化以及回退式的细化。这与 Content Aggregation → Asset Structure、Model Hierarchy、Components、Payloads 和 Scalable Scene Assembly 的内容一致。

questions.q: Which of the following best defines the primary function of a specialize composition arc in OpenUSD?
questions.qZh: 以下哪一项最准确地定义了 OpenUSD 中 specialize composition arc 的主要功能？
o: It provides a strong overriding mechanism since opinions expressed by the specialize arc always win.
To broadcast specs from a source prim to destination prims as fallback values if no other opinion exists.
When used additively, these arcs make a prim more functionally and descriptively specialized.
To uniformly broadcast stronger specs from a source prim to destination prims.
oZh: 它提供了强力的覆盖机制，因为 specialize arc 表达的意见总是胜出。
当不存在其他意见时，将 spec 从源 prim 广播到目标 prim，作为回退值。
当以叠加方式使用时，这些 arc 会让 prim 在功能与描述上更加专门化。
将更强的 spec 从源 prim 统一广播到目标 prim。
questions.e: A specialize composition arc broadcasts fallback opinions from a source prim to one or more specializing destination prims. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD glossary defines specializes as a composition arc that broadcasts fallback values from a source prim and applies only when the specializing prim does not already have its own authored opinion. It further explains that specializes is similar to inherits in its broadcast behavior, but differs because specializes contributes fallback values rather than stronger reusable opinions. ( docs.nvidia.com ) Option B is correct because it captures the essential behavior: source specs are supplied as fallback data. Option A is incorrect because specializes is the weakest composition arc in LIVERPS ordering; it does not always win. NVIDIA’s strength-ordering guide states that specializes acts as a new fallback value, winning only when stronger composition choices provide no value. ( docs.nvidia.com ) Option C describes the conceptual naming idea of specialization but not the primary functional mechanism. Option D is incorrect because “stronger specs” describes a different strength behavior. This aligns with Composition → Inherits and Specializes, Fallback Opinions, LIVERPS Strength Ordering .
questions.eZh: specialize composition arc 会把来自源 prim 的回退意见广播到一个或多个执行特化的目标 prim。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 术语表将 specializes 定义为一种 composition arc：它从源 prim 广播回退值，并且仅在执行特化的 prim 尚未拥有自己编写的意见时才生效。该术语表进一步说明，specializes 在广播行为上与 inherits 类似，但区别在于 specializes 提供的是回退值，而不是更强的可复用意见。（docs.nvidia.com）选项 B 正确，因为它抓住了本质行为：源 spec 作为回退数据被提供。选项 A 错误，因为在 LIVERPS 排序中 specializes 是最弱的 composition arc，它并非总是胜出。NVIDIA 的强度排序指南指出，specializes 起到新增回退值的作用，只有当更强的合成选择未提供任何值时才会胜出。（docs.nvidia.com）选项 C 描述的是特化在概念命名上的含义，而非其主要功能机制。选项 D 错误，因为“更强的 spec”描述的是另一种强度行为。这与 Composition → Inherits and Specializes、Fallback Opinions、LIVERPS Strength Ordering 的内容一致。

questions.q: Which of the following statements best describes the purpose of OpenUSD file format plugins?
questions.qZh: 以下哪项陈述最准确地描述了 OpenUSD 文件格式插件的用途？
o: They extend OpenUSD's functionality by allowing it to read and write from various file formats.
They are only used for visualizing OpenUSD data and geometry in 3D applications.
They convert OpenUSD files to other formats without any loss of data or information.
They are designed to compress OpenUSD asset files for faster loading times.
oZh: 它们扩展了 OpenUSD 的功能，使其能够读取和写入各种文件格式。
它们仅用于在 3D 应用中可视化 OpenUSD 数据与几何体。
它们将 OpenUSD 文件转换为其他格式，且不会丢失任何数据或信息。
它们旨在压缩 OpenUSD 资产文件，以加快加载速度。
questions.e: OpenUSD file format plugins belong under the Data Exchange topic because they expand how USD participates in interchange workflows. Their purpose is to allow OpenUSD to read, interpret, and in some cases write data using formats beyond the native USD file types such as .usd, .usda, .usdc, and .usdz. Through these plugins, external file formats can be exposed to USD as layers and can participate in composition arcs such as references, payloads, and sublayers. This allows pipelines to integrate heterogeneous asset sources while still using USD’s scene description model, composition engine, and layer-based workflows. Option A is correct because it directly identifies the function of file format plugins: extending OpenUSD functionality for reading and writing various file formats. Option B is incorrect because visualization is only one possible downstream use of exchanged data, not the purpose of the plugin system. Option C is incorrect because translation between formats does not inherently guarantee lossless preservation of every schema, opinion, or semantic construct. Option D is incorrect because compression is not the primary role of file format plugins. This aligns with the NVIDIA OpenUSD Development Study Guide topic Data Exchange , especially file formats, connectors, and plugin-based interoperability.
questions.eZh: OpenUSD 文件格式插件归属于 Data Exchange 主题，因为它们扩展了 USD 参与数据交换工作流的方式。其目的是让 OpenUSD 能够使用 .usd、.usda、.usdc 和 .usdz 等原生 USD 文件类型之外的格式来读取、解释数据，并在某些情况下写入数据。通过这些插件，外部文件格式可以作为 layer 暴露给 USD，并参与 reference、payload 和 sublayer 等 composition arc。这使流水线在继续使用 USD 的场景描述模型、合成引擎和基于 layer 的工作流的同时，得以集成异构资产来源。选项 A 正确，因为它直接指出了文件格式插件的功能：扩展 OpenUSD 以读取和写入各种文件格式。选项 B 错误，因为可视化只是所交换数据的一种下游用途，而不是插件系统的目的。选项 C 错误，因为格式之间的转换本身并不保证对每个 schema、意见或语义结构都能无损保留。选项 D 错误，因为压缩并不是文件格式插件的主要作用。这与 NVIDIA OpenUSD Development Study Guide 中的 Data Exchange 主题（尤其是文件格式、连接器和基于插件的互操作性）一致。

questions.q: What will be the composed value of /World/Tree/Canopy.primvars:displayColor when you open stage.usda? #usda 1.0 ( defaultPrim = "World" metersPerUnit = 1.0 upAxis = "Z" ) def Xform "World" { def Xform "Tree" ( variantSets = ["foliage_color"] variants = { string foliage_color = "default" } ) { def Cone "Canopy" ( references = [ ] ) { double3 xformOp:translate = (0, 0, 1.3) token[] xformOpOrder = ["xformOp:translate"] } def Cylinder "Trunk" { color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.2, 0.1, 0.05)] double3 xformOp:scale = (0.4, 0.4, 0.4) token[] xformOpOrder = ["xformOp:scale"] } variantSet "foliage_color" = { "default" { } "evergreen" { over "Canopy" { color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.05, 0.15, 0.05)] } } "orange" { over "Canopy" { color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.5, 0.3, 0.05)] } } } } } class "_base_foliage_color" { color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.2, 0.75, 0.1)] }
questions.qZh:
打开 stage.usda 时，/World/Tree/Canopy.primvars:displayColor 的合成值将是什么？
#usda 1.0 ( defaultPrim = "World" metersPerUnit = 1.0 upAxis = "Z" ) def Xform "World" { def Xform "Tree" ( variantSets = ["foliage_color"] variants = { string foliage_color = "default" } ) { def Cone "Canopy" ( references = [ ] ) { double3 xformOp:translate = (0, 0, 1.3) token[] xformOpOrder = ["xformOp:translate"] } def Cylinder "Trunk" { color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.2, 0.1, 0.05)] double3 xformOp:scale = (0.4, 0.4, 0.4) token[] xformOpOrder = ["xformOp:scale"] } variantSet "foliage_color" = { "default" { } "evergreen" { over "Canopy" { color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.05, 0.15, 0.05)] } } "orange" { over "Canopy" { color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.5, 0.3, 0.05)] } } } } } class "_base_foliage_color" { color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.2, 0.75, 0.1)] }
o: unset
oZh: 未设置
questions.e: The composed value is [(0.2, 0.75, 0.1)]. The active variant selection on /World/Tree is foliage_color = "default", and the "default" variant contains no authored opinion for Canopy.primvars:displayColor. Therefore, the "evergreen" and "orange" variant opinions are not active and cannot contribute their color values. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD variant-set guidance explains that a variant set provides alternative authored representations, but only the selected variant contributes to the composed result. The remaining contributing opinion is the reference on def Cone "Canopy": references = [ ]. References are composition arcs that bring scene description from a targeted prim into the destination prim without copying it. The referenced class prim /_base_foliage_color authors color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.2, 0.75, 0.1)], so that value composes onto /World/Tree/Canopy. No stronger local or selected-variant opinion overrides it. This follows USD strength ordering, where opinions are resolved through composition arcs and the strongest applicable opinion wins. This aligns with Composition → References, Variant Sets, Selected Variants, and LIVERPS Strength Ordering .
questions.eZh: 合成值为 [(0.2, 0.75, 0.1)]。/World/Tree 上当前激活的变体选择为 foliage_color = "default"，而 "default" 变体中没有为 Canopy.primvars:displayColor 编写任何意见。因此 "evergreen" 和 "orange" 变体的意见未处于激活状态，无法贡献其颜色值。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 变体集指南说明，变体集提供备选的已编写表示，但只有被选中的变体才会对合成结果产生贡献。其余产生贡献的意见来自 def Cone "Canopy" 上的 reference：references = [ ]。Reference 是一种 composition arc，它把目标 prim 的场景描述带入目标 prim，而不做拷贝。被引用的 class prim /_base_foliage_color 编写了 color3f[] primvars:displayColor = [(0.2, 0.75, 0.1)]，因此该值被合成到 /World/Tree/Canopy 上。没有更强的本地意见或被选中变体的意见覆盖它。这遵循 USD 的强度排序：意见通过 composition arc 解析，最强的适用意见胜出。这与 Composition → References、Variant Sets、Selected Variants 和 LIVERPS Strength Ordering 的内容一致。

questions.q: Which of the following statements about debugging complex LIVRPS scenarios are correct?
questions.qZh: 以下关于调试复杂 LIVRPS 场景的陈述哪些是正确的？
o: Local opinions should be checked first when debugging composition issues.
Specialize arcs cannot be overridden, so they can be ignored during debugging.
Payload arcs should be checked before Reference arcs for more efficient debugging.
oZh: 调试 composition 问题时，应首先检查本地意见（local opinions）。
Specialize arc 无法被覆盖，因此调试时可以忽略。
为提高调试效率，应先检查 Payload arc，再检查 Reference arc。
questions.e: Option A is correct because local opinions are the strongest opinions in USD composition strength ordering. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD strength-ordering guide describes LIVRPS, now also written as LIVERPS with relocates included, as the ordered set of composition operations used to determine which opinions win. The order is strongest to weakest: local , inherits, variant sets, relocates, references, payloads, and specializes. When debugging an unexpected value, local opinions should be inspected first because a directly authored opinion in the local layer stack can override opinions arriving through other composition arcs. NVIDIA’s tracing guidance also highlights how complex composition debugging becomes when many prims, properties, layers, and arcs contribute competing opinions. Option B is false because specializes arcs are not unoverrideable; they are the weakest fallback-style opinions in the composition order. Option C is false because references are stronger than payloads in LIVRPS/LIVERPS ordering, so checking payloads before references reverses the standard diagnostic priority. This aligns with Debugging and Troubleshooting → LIVERPS Strength Ordering, Local Opinions, References, Payloads, Specializes, and Composition Diagnostics .
questions.eZh: 选项 A 正确，因为本地意见（local opinions）是 USD 合成强度排序中最强的意见。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 强度排序指南将 LIVRPS（现也写作 LIVERPS，包含 relocates）描述为用于确定哪些意见胜出的 composition 操作的有序集合。其顺序由强到弱为：local、inherits、variant sets、relocates、references、payloads、specializes。调试意外数值时，应先检查本地意见，因为本地 layer stack 中直接编写的意见可以覆盖通过其他 composition arc 传入的意见。NVIDIA 的追踪指南也指出，当大量 prim、属性、layer 和 arc 都贡献相互竞争的意见时，composition 调试会变得非常复杂。选项 B 不成立，因为 specializes arc 并非不可覆盖，它们在合成顺序中是最弱的回退式意见。选项 C 不成立，因为在 LIVRPS/LIVERPS 排序中 references 比 payloads 更强，因此先检查 payload 再检查 reference 会颠倒标准的诊断优先级。这与 Debugging and Troubleshooting → LIVERPS Strength Ordering、Local Opinions、References、Payloads、Specializes 和 Composition Diagnostics 的内容一致。

questions.q: When USD computes the position of a PointInstancer instance, what additional position-related information is used beyond the position information for a given instance?
questions.qZh: 当 USD 计算 PointInstancer 实例的位置时，除了给定实例的位置信息之外，还会使用哪些额外的位置相关信息？
o: USD also uses the transform of the PointInstancer prim, if present, but ignores any transforms set on the prototype root.
USD also uses the transform of the root of the prototype and the transform of the PointInstancer prim itself, if present.
USD uses position information for the instance, and ignores any position information in the prototype root, or the PointInstancer prim itself.
oZh: USD 还会使用 PointInstancer prim 自身的 transform（如果存在），但会忽略在 prototype root 上设置的任何 transform。
USD 还会使用 prototype 根节点的 transform，以及 PointInstancer prim 自身的 transform（如果存在）。
USD 使用实例的位置信息，并忽略 prototype root 或 PointInstancer prim 自身上的任何位置信息。
questions.e: A PointInstancer instance position is not computed from the per-instance positions array alone. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD point-instancing lesson explains that authored positions are in the local coordinate space of the PointInstancer. For the final world-space transform, USD combines multiple transforms: first the prototype root transform , then the instance-specific transform components such as scales[i], orientations[i] , and positions[i], and finally the transform authored on the PointInstancer prim itself. Option B is correct because it includes both additional transform sources that affect the resulting placement: the prototype root’s transform and the PointInstancer prim’s transform. This matters in production asset aggregation because prototypes may carry their own local placement or orientation, while the instancer prim may be moved, rotated, or scaled as a whole. Option A is incomplete because it incorrectly discards the prototype root transform. Option C is incorrect because it treats instance positions as isolated data and ignores the composed transform stack. This aligns with Content Aggregation → Asset Modularity and Instancing → PointInstancer, Prototype Roots, Instance Transforms, and Transform Composition .
questions.eZh: PointInstancer 实例的位置并非仅由每实例的 positions 数组计算得出。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD point-instancing 课程说明，创作（author）的 positions 位于 PointInstancer 的局部坐标系中。对于最终的世界空间 transform，USD 会组合多个 transform：先是 prototype root 的 transform，然后是实例专有的 transform 组件，例如 scales[i]、orientations[i] 和 positions[i]，最后是创作在 PointInstancer prim 自身的 transform。选项 B 正确，因为它包含了另外两个会影响最终放置结果的 transform 来源：prototype root 的 transform 和 PointInstancer prim 的 transform。这一点在生产环境的资产聚合中很重要，因为 prototype 可能带有自己的局部放置或朝向，而 instancer prim 可能被整体移动、旋转或缩放。选项 A 不完整，因为它错误地丢弃了 prototype root 的 transform。选项 C 错误，因为它把实例位置视为孤立数据，忽略了组合后的 transform 栈。这与 Content Aggregation → Asset Modularity and Instancing → PointInstancer、Prototype Roots、Instance Transforms 和 Transform Composition 相符。

questions.q: In the context of UsdGeomMesh, which statement is true about mesh normals?
questions.qZh: 在 UsdGeomMesh 的上下文中，关于网格法线的说法，哪一项是正确的？
o: The number of authored normals must be equal to the number of points in a polygonal mesh.
vertex normals are used for subdivision meshes and faceVarying normals are used only for polygonal meshes.
faceVarying normals are specified per face corner, while vertex normals specify a single normal per point.
oZh: 创作的法线数量必须等于多边形网格中点的数量。
vertex normals 用于细分网格，而 faceVarying normals 仅用于多边形网格。

questions.e: Option C correctly describes the relationship between interpolation and element counts for mesh normals and normal-like primvars. In UsdGeomMesh, vertex interpolation provides one value per mesh point, while faceVarying interpolation provides one value for each face-vertex, meaning each corner of each face can carry its own value. This distinction is essential for representing smooth normals, hard edges, UV seams, and other discontinuities across faces. OpenUSD’s UsdGeomMesh documentation defines vertex interpolation as one element per point and faceVarying interpolation as one element for each face-vertex that defines the mesh topology. Option A is incorrect because authored normals do not always have to match the number of points; the required count depends on the normals interpolation. Face-varying normals, for example, require one value per face corner rather than one per point. Option B is incorrect because normals should generally not be authored on subdivision meshes; subdivision algorithms define their own normals. OpenUSD notes that authored normals should only be used for polygonal meshes where subdivisionScheme = "none". This aligns with Data Modeling → UsdGeomMesh, Normals, Primvar Interpolation, Vertex Data, Face-Varying Data, and Polygonal Mesh Representation .
questions.eZh: 选项 C 正确描述了网格法线及类法线 primvar 在插值方式与元素数量之间的关系。在 UsdGeomMesh 中，vertex 插值为每个网格点提供一个值，而 faceVarying 插值为每个面-顶点提供一个值，也就是说每个面的每个角点都可以携带自己的值。这一区别对于表达平滑法线、硬边、UV 接缝以及跨面的其它不连续至关重要。OpenUSD 的 UsdGeomMesh 文档将 vertex 插值定义为每个点一个元素，将 faceVarying 插值定义为定义网格拓扑的每个面-顶点一个元素。选项 A 错误，因为创作的法线并不总要与点的数量一致；所需数量取决于法线的插值方式。例如，face-varying 法线要求每个面角点一个值，而不是每个点一个值。选项 B 错误，因为细分网格通常不应创作法线，细分算法会自行定义法线。OpenUSD 指出，创作的法线只应用于 subdivisionScheme = "none" 的多边形网格。这与 Data Modeling → UsdGeomMesh、Normals、Primvar Interpolation、Vertex Data、Face-Varying Data 和 Polygonal Mesh Representation 相符。

questions.q: Which is the most appropriate combination of OpenUSD features to consider when trying to solve problems related to artists interaction with LODs, Material variations and Asset Versions?
questions.qZh: 在解决与美术师同 LOD、材质变体以及资产版本交互相关的问题时，最适合考虑的 OpenUSD 特性组合是哪一项？

PrimAdapters, SceneIndex plugins and References
Inherits, Specializes and MaterialX
oZh: VariantSets、Purposes 和 AssetResolvers
PrimAdapters、SceneIndex plugins 和 References
Inherits、Specializes 和 MaterialX
questions.e: The most appropriate combination is VariantSets, Purposes, and AssetResolvers because each feature addresses one of the stated production problems at the correct abstraction level. Variant sets provide artist-facing switches for alternative representations of the same asset, including material variations, geometric variations, and LOD-style alternatives. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD guide states that variant sets define alternative representations that can be switched at runtime, and that variants may override properties, define descendant prims, or author composition arcs. Purposes help separate representation classes such as proxy, render, and guide. NVIDIA’s glossary describes purpose as a UsdGeomImageable attribute used to classify geometry into selective visibility categories, allowing clients to include or exclude categories during rendering, bounding, or interactive traversal. Asset resolvers address asset versioning and storage indirection. NVIDIA’s asset-structure guidance specifically recommends keeping instances within a specific version and leveraging storage and asset-resolver capabilities to keep assets atomic. Option B is more renderer/Hydra-infrastructure focused and does not directly solve artist-facing variation and versioning. Option C contains useful composition and shading tools, but it is not the best combined solution for LODs, material options, and asset versions. This aligns with Pipeline Development → Artist Workflows, Variant Sets, Purpose, Asset Resolution, and Asset Versioning .
questions.eZh: 最合适的组合是 VariantSets、Purposes 和 AssetResolvers，因为每个特性都在恰当的抽象层级上解决了所列生产问题之一。Variant set 为美术师提供用于切换同一资产不同表示形式的开关，涵盖材质变体、几何变体以及 LOD 类的替代表示。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 指南指出，variant set 定义了可在运行时切换的替代表示，variant 可以覆盖属性、定义后代 prim 或创作组合弧（composition arc）。Purposes 有助于区分 proxy、render、guide 等表示类别。NVIDIA 术语表将 purpose 描述为 UsdGeomImageable 上的属性，用于将几何体划分为选择性可见性类别，使客户端在渲染、包围盒计算或交互式遍历时可以包含或排除相应类别。Asset resolver 解决资产版本管理与存储间接寻址问题。NVIDIA 的资产结构指导特别建议将实例保留在特定版本内，并利用存储和 asset resolver 能力保持资产的原子性。选项 B 更偏向渲染器/Hydra 基础设施方向，无法直接解决面向美术师的变体与版本管理问题。选项 C 包含有用的组合与着色工具，但并非针对 LOD、材质选项和资产版本的最佳组合方案。这与 Pipeline Development → Artist Workflows、Variant Sets、Purpose、Asset Resolution 和 Asset Versioning 相符。

questions.q: In what way do variant sets in OpenUSD enhance flexibility in scene descriptions?
questions.qZh: OpenUSD 中的 variant set 是以何种方式增强场景描述的灵活性的？
o: By allowing runtime selection among alternative representations of a prim.
By permanently embedding multiple scene configurations within a single prim.
By enabling automatic resolution of conflicting opinions across layers.
By statically merging all possible variants into one combined representation.
oZh: 通过允许在运行时从一个 prim 的多种替代表示中进行选择。
通过将多种场景配置永久嵌入到单个 prim 中。
通过自动解析跨层的冲突意见。
通过将所有可能的 variant 静态合并为一个组合表示。
questions.e: Variant sets enhance flexibility by allowing a prim to expose named alternatives, where one variant selection contributes its authored opinions to the composed result. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD material describes variant sets as a way to define “alternative representations for a prim and switch between them without duplicating data.” It also explains that a prim may have one or more named variant sets, each containing variant choices, and that the selected variant composes the opinions authored for that choice. Option A is correct because variant sets support selectable alternatives such as different model shapes, material looks, levels of detail, configurations, or composition arcs. This gives downstream tools or stronger layers the ability to choose a representation non-destructively without rewriting the asset. Option B is inaccurate because variants are not permanently merged into the prim; only the selected variant participates in the composed scene. Option C is incorrect because conflict resolution is handled by USD’s composition and value-resolution rules, not automatically by variant sets themselves. Option D is also incorrect because USD does not statically combine every variant into a single representation. This aligns with the NVIDIA OpenUSD Development Study Guide topics Composition → Variant Sets , Composition Arcs , and LIVERPS strength ordering .
questions.eZh: Variant set 通过允许一个 prim 暴露具名的替代方案来增强灵活性，其中被选中的 variant 会将其创作的意见贡献到组合结果中。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD 材料将 variant set 描述为一种为 prim 定义“替代表示并可在不复制数据的情况下切换”的方式。它还说明，一个 prim 可以有一个或多个具名 variant set，每个包含若干 variant 选择，被选中的 variant 会组合该选择下创作的意见。选项 A 正确，因为 variant set 支持可选择的替代方案，例如不同的模型形状、材质外观、细节层级、配置或组合弧。这使下游工具或更强的层能够非破坏性地选择一种表示，而无需重写资产。选项 B 不准确，因为 variant 不会被永久合并进 prim，只有被选中的 variant 参与组合后的场景。选项 C 错误，因为冲突解析由 USD 的组合与取值解析规则处理，而不是由 variant set 自身自动完成。选项 D 同样错误，因为 USD 不会把所有 variant 静态组合成单一表示。这与 NVIDIA OpenUSD Development Study Guide 中的 Composition → Variant Sets、Composition Arcs 和 LIVERPS 强度顺序等主题相符。

questions.q: How does the concept of an edit target (Usd.EditTarget) interact with the stage in OpenUSD?
questions.qZh: 在 OpenUSD 中，编辑目标（Usd.EditTarget）这一概念如何与 stage 交互？
o: It merges edits across all layers automatically for simplified editing of a stage.
It overrides all layers, forcing every change to be written to the root layer.
It specifies the destination layer for authoring changes in a composed stage.

It temporarily disables all sublayer compositions during editing. C An edit target determines where authored opinions are written while working through the composed view of a stage. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD stage material emphasizes that a stage is not simply a file; it is a unified scenegraph populated from multiple data sources called layers. ( docs.nvidia.com ) In that layered environment, a developer often edits a composed prim while needing the resulting opinion to land in a specific contributing layer, variant, or composition context. OpenUSD defines this role through UsdEditTarget: edit targets allow work on the composed stage and its UsdPrim objects while specifying which contributing site in the composition network should receive the authored opinions. ( openusd.org ) Option C is correct because the edit target is the authoring destination, not a composition override mechanism. Option A is incorrect because USD does not automatically merge edits into all layers. Option B is incorrect because edits are not forced to the root layer; developers can target other valid layers or edit contexts. Option D is incorrect because setting an edit target does not disable sublayers or composition arcs. This aligns with Pipeline Development → Layer Authoring, Edit Targets, Non-Destructive Editing, Stage Workflows, and Collaborative Layer Stacks .

它覆盖所有 layer，强制将每项更改写入根 layer。
它指定在合成后的 stage 中进行 authoring 更改时的目标 layer。

questions.q: What is the correct prim type in UsdShade for sharing reusable portions of shading networks, allowing for parameterization?
questions.qZh: 在 UsdShade 中，用于共享着色网络可复用部分并支持参数化的正确 prim 类型是什么？
o: SubNetwork
Custom Schema

NodeGraph C The correct UsdShade prim type is NodeGraph. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD material introduces UsdShade as the schema family used for creating and binding materials, where materials store renderer-facing shading definitions. The OpenUSD UsdShade specification defines UsdShadeNodeGraph as the mechanism for packaging shading networks into reusable units. A node graph can contain shader nodes and nested node graphs, expose public inputs as an interface, provide outputs, and be referenced into larger networks as a reusable building block. Option C is correct because NodeGraph is explicitly designed for reusable and parameterized shading-network structure. It allows a pipeline to encapsulate repeated shading logic while exposing only selected parameters to consuming materials or larger graphs. Option A is incorrect because SubNetwork is not the correct UsdShade prim type in OpenUSD. Option B is incorrect because a custom schema could theoretically define new data models, but it is not the standard UsdShade construct for reusable shader-network packaging. This aligns with Visualization → UsdShade, Materials, Shading Networks, NodeGraph Interfaces, Parameterization, and Reusable Material Components .

Custom Schema

questions.q: When prioritizing ease of interchange and reducing dependencies between different applications in a pipeline, why might codeless schemas, schemas defined purely in .usda files, be preferred over codeful schemas, schemas with generated classes using usdGenSchema?
questions.qZh: 当优先考虑交换的便利性并减少管线中不同应用之间的依赖时，为什么可能更倾向于使用 codeless schema（完全在 .usda 文件中定义的 schema），而不是 codeful schema（使用 usdGenSchema 生成类的 schema）？
o: Codeless schemas enable interchange by loading .usda definitions directly, avoiding the need to compile or link against custom schema code libraries.
Codeless schemas provide more convenient, strongly-typed C++ and Python APIs for property access compared to code generated via usdGenSchema.
Generated schemas cannot define fallback attribute values within their .usda definition, making interchange less consistent across applications.

Only codeless schemas are added to the schema registry, allowing them to participate in property value resolution correctly. A Codeless schemas are preferred when the pipeline goal is portability, easy distribution, and reduced application coupling. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD schema guidance states that schemas define data models and optional APIs for encoding and interchanging 3D and non-3D concepts, and notes a trend toward codeless schemas for easier distribution, with schemas becoming more focused on data modeling rather than behavior implementation. Option A is correct because a codeless schema can be distributed as schema data and plugin metadata without requiring every consuming application to compile, link, or ship custom generated C++/Python schema classes. OpenUSD’s schema-generation documentation identifies codeless schemas as schemas produced without corresponding C++ classes, where only generatedSchema.usda and plugInfo.json are essential for runtime registration. Option B is incorrect because strongly typed convenience APIs are the advantage of codeful generated schemas. Option C is incorrect because fallback values are authored in schema definitions. Option D is incorrect because codeful and codeless schemas can both participate in schema registration and value interpretation. This aligns with Customizing USD → Schemas, API Schemas, Codeless Schemas, Schema Registry, Data Modeling for Interchange .

生成的 schema 无法在其 .usda 定义中定义属性的 fallback 值，导致不同应用之间的交换一致性下降。

questions.q: What sort of plugin implements logic to locate resources such as @mycompany://path/to/my/resource@?
questions.qZh: 哪一类插件实现了定位诸如 @mycompany://path/to/my/resource@ 之类资源的逻辑？
o: Custom schema plugin
Hydra plugin
Asset resolver plugin

Custom metadata plugin C The correct plugin type is an asset resolver plugin . In OpenUSD, asset paths such as @mycompany://path/to/my/resource@ are not interpreted as ordinary strings; they are asset identifiers that must be resolved into concrete resources that USD can consume. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD glossary defines asset resolution as the process of translating an asset path into the actual location of a usable resource and states that USD provides the ArResolver plugin point for custom resolution logic, including external databases, custom storage systems, version-control systems, or studio-specific URI schemes. Option C is correct because a custom asset resolver is precisely where pipeline-specific resource lookup logic belongs. Option A is incorrect because a custom schema plugin defines prim types, API schemas, and properties, not asset-location behavior. Option B is incorrect because Hydra plugins are concerned with imaging, rendering, and scene-index/render-delegate behavior. Option D is incorrect because custom metadata may store extra data, but it does not implement resolution of asset identifiers. This aligns with Pipeline Development → Asset Resolution, ArResolver, Resource Location, Versioned Assets, and Pipeline Integration .

Hydra 插件

questions.q: What is a way to utilize both USDA and USDC as part of a scene?
questions.qZh: 将 USDA 和 USDC 同时用于一个场景的一种方式是什么？
o: Use USDC for prims related to shading and USDA for all other prim types.
Use USDA for non-geometric prims and USDC for geometric and animation data.

Use USDA entirely as USDC is most helpful for when debugging issues with scenes. B A practical mixed-format strategy is to use human-readable USDA for lighter, structural, or non-geometric layers, while using binary USDC for heavier geometry and animation data. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD layer guidance identifies .usd, .usda, and .usdc as USD layer formats, where each layer is a modular source of scene description that can participate in composition. ( docs.nvidia.com ) This means a scene can compose different layers with different encodings through sublayers, references, payloads, and other arcs. Option B is correct because it reflects the common pipeline division: USDA is convenient for inspection, debugging, review, and hand-authored structural opinions, while USDC is better suited for dense numeric data such as meshes, point caches, and time-sampled animation because it is compact and efficient for machine consumption. The official OpenUSD toolset also supports conversion between formats using tools such as usdcat, allowing pipelines to choose the representation that best fits each layer’s purpose. ( openusd.org ) Option A is too rigid; shading data does not require USDC. Option C reverses the usual debugging distinction because USDA is the readable format commonly preferred when inspecting scene text. This aligns with Data Exchange → USD File Formats, Layer Composition, USDA, USDC, and Pipeline File Strategy .
oZh: 对与着色相关的 prim 使用 USDC，对其他所有 prim 类型使用 USDA。
对非几何 prim 使用 USDA，对几何数据和动画数据使用 USDC。

questions.q: Considering the two files cars.usda and parkingLot.usda in the exhibit. When opening a stage with parkingLot.usda as the root layer, you observed this prim hierarchy: ParkingLot car01 You expected this: ParkingLot car01 chassis parkingLot.usda: #usda 1.0 ( upAxis = "Y" ) def Xform "ParkingLot" (kind = "group") { def "car01" (references = @cars.usda@) {} } cars.usda: #usda 1.0 ( upAxis = "Y" ) def Xform "redCar" (kind = "component") { def Mesh "chassis" {} } def Xform "blueCar" (kind = "component") { def Mesh "chassis" {} } What are ways to fix this issue?
questions.qZh: 考虑示例中的两个文件 cars.usda 和 parkingLot.usda。当以 parkingLot.usda 作为根层打开一个 stage 时，你观察到的 prim 层级结构是：ParkingLot car01 而你期望的是：ParkingLot car01 chassis parkingLot.usda: #usda 1.0 ( upAxis = "Y" ) def Xform "ParkingLot" (kind = "group") { def "car01" (references = @cars.usda@) {} } cars.usda: #usda 1.0 ( upAxis = "Y" ) def Xform "redCar" (kind = "component") { def Mesh "chassis" {} } def Xform "blueCar" (kind = "component") { def Mesh "chassis" {} } 有哪些方法可以修复这个问题？
o: Set the defaultPrim in cars.usda
Explicitly set the prim type for car01 in parkingLot.usda
Add a target prim to the reference in parkingLot.usda

Make the ParkingLot prim in parkingLot.usda an assembly kind A, C The missing chassis is caused by an unresolved reference target. In parkingLot.usda, the reference is authored as @cars.usda@ without a target prim path. When a reference omits the target prim path, USD uses the referenced layer’s defaultPrim as the entry point. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD guide states that if no defaultPrim is set, bringing that layer in as a reference or payload resolves as an empty layer and emits a warning. It also identifies defaultPrim as layer metadata and a best practice for stages intended to be referenced or payloaded. Option A fixes the issue by setting, for example, defaultPrim = "redCar" in cars.usda, allowing @cars.usda@ to resolve to /redCar and bring in its chassis. Option C also fixes it by making the reference explicit, for example references = @cars.usda@ . NVIDIA’s data-transformation guidance similarly notes that without defaultPrim, a stage cannot be referenced without specifying a target prim. Option B does not solve reference resolution; assigning a type to car01 would not identify which car to compose. Option D changes model-kind semantics only and does not affect the reference target. This aligns with Composition → References, Default Prim, Target Prim Paths, and Asset Entry Points .

questions.q: Which statement accurately describes a key difference between native instancing and point instancing?
questions.qZh: 哪一陈述准确描述了 native instancing（原生实例化）与 point instancing（点实例化）之间的一个关键差异？
o: Point instancing generates prototypes dynamically, while native instancing uses statically defined prims.
Native instancing can only use a single prototype per scene, while point instancing can use multiple prototypes.
Native instancing requires prototypes to be defined in separate files, while point instancing requires them in the same layer.

Native instances are individually addressable prims in the scene hierarchy after composition, while point instances are not. D The key distinction is addressability and representation. Native, or scenegraph, instancing preserves each instance as a prim in the composed scene hierarchy. Each instance root can have its own path, transform, metadata, and root-level refinements while sharing an implicit prototype generated from matching instanceable composition. OpenUSD’s scenegraph instancing documentation explains that prims bringing in common scene description through composition arcs can share those composed subgraphs rather than duplicating them per prim. Point instancing, by contrast, is a vectorized representation. NVIDIA’s instancing guide states that point instancing represents repeated instances through array attributes such as positions, orientations, scales, prototype indices, and prototype relationships. It is more compact because it does not require a prim for each instance , but this comes with reduced flexibility and addressability. Option D is correct because native instances remain individually addressable scenegraph prims, while point instances are addressed through array elements and IDs rather than unique prim paths. A reverses prototype behavior: native instancing uses implicit prototypes, while point instancing uses explicit prototype relationships. B and C impose restrictions that do not exist. This aligns with Content Aggregation → Scenegraph Instancing, PointInstancer, Prototypes, Addressability, and Scalable Repetition .

Native instancing 要求原型定义在独立文件中，而 point instancing 要求它们位于同一层中。

组合之后，原生实例是场景层级结构中可单独寻址的 prim，而点实例不是。 D 关键区别在于可寻址性和表示方式。Native（或 scenegraph）instancing 会在组合后的场景层级结构中保留每一个实例作为 prim。每个实例根都可以拥有自己的路径、变换、元数据和根级别的精修，同时共享由匹配的 instanceable 组合生成的隐式原型。OpenUSD 的 scenegraph instancing 文档说明，通过组合 arc 引入相同场景描述的 prim 可以共享这些组合后的子图，而不必为每个 prim 复制一份。相比之下，point instancing 是一种向量化表示。NVIDIA 的 instancing 指南指出，point instancing 通过位置、朝向、缩放、原型索引和原型关系等数组属性来表示重复的实例。它更紧凑，因为不需要为每个实例创建 prim，但代价是灵活性和可寻址性降低。选项 D 正确，因为原生实例始终是可单独寻址的 scenegraph prim，而点实例是通过数组元素和 ID 寻址的，而不是通过唯一的 prim 路径。选项 A 颠倒了原型行为：native instancing 使用隐式原型，而 point instancing 使用显式的原型关系。选项 B 和 C 强加了并不存在的限制。这与 Content Aggregation → Scenegraph Instancing、PointInstancer、Prototypes、Addressability 和 Scalable Repetition 相对应。

questions.q: Why is usdchecker an important part of data exchange?
questions.qZh: 为什么 usdchecker 是数据交换中重要的一环？
o: It provides the best assurance that an asset will be consumable downstream.
It verifies that all USD files are in binary format for max efficiency.
It optimizes USD files for faster loading and rendering.

It verifies asset URIs are correctly formed for portability. A usdchecker is important in data exchange because it validates whether exported USD or USDZ assets comply with rules that make them more likely to be interchangeable, renderable, and usable by downstream consumers. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD Asset Validation lesson states that usdchecker validates a USD stage or USDZ package using defined rules to provide the best assurance that an asset will be properly interchangeable and renderable by Hydra. It is presented as part of the data exchange workflow for testing converter output and improving exporter quality. Option A is correct because asset validation directly supports downstream consumption, which is the core goal of data exchange. A converter may write syntactically valid USD but still omit important metadata, invalid extents, default prims, unresolved dependencies, or other requirements that reduce interoperability. Option B is incorrect because usdchecker does not require binary .usdc output. Option C is incorrect because validation is not optimization. Option D is too narrow; URI and asset-path checks may be part of validation, but they are not the primary purpose. This aligns with Data Exchange → Asset Validation, usdchecker, Converter Testing, USDZ Compliance, and Downstream Interoperability .
oZh: 它最大程度地保证资产可被下游使用。
它验证所有 USD 文件均为二进制格式，以达到最高效率。
它优化 USD 文件，以加快加载和渲染。

它验证资产 URI 是否正确构成，以保证可移植性。 A usdchecker 在数据交换中很重要，是因为它能校验导出的 USD 或 USDZ 资产是否符合相关规则，从而使其更有可能被互换、可渲染并被下游消费者使用。NVIDIA 的 Learn OpenUSD Asset Validation 课程指出，usdchecker 使用既定规则校验 USD stage 或 USDZ 包，以最大程度保证资产能被 Hydra 正确互换和渲染。它被作为数据交换工作流的一部分，用于测试转换器输出和提升导出器质量。选项 A 正确，因为资产校验直接支持下游消费，而这正是数据交换的核心目标。转换器可能写出语法上有效的 USD，却仍然遗漏重要元数据、无效的 extents、default prim、未解析的依赖项或其他降低互操作性的要求。选项 B 错误，因为 usdchecker 并不要求二进制 .usdc 输出。选项 C 错误，因为校验不是优化。选项 D 过于狭窄；URI 和资产路径检查可能是校验的一部分，但并非主要目的。这与 Data Exchange → Asset Validation、usdchecker、Converter Testing、USDZ Compliance 和 Downstream Interoperability 相对应。

questions.q: What fundamental data type in USD is most suitable for representing texture files?
questions.qZh: 在 USD 中，哪种基础数据类型最适合表示纹理文件？
o: tokens
strings

asset paths C The most suitable USD data type for representing texture files is an asset path . NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD glossary defines an asset as a named reusable resource and explicitly includes textures among asset examples. It also explains that USD provides a specialized string type called asset so that attributes and metadata referring to external resources can be identified robustly. In USDA syntax, asset-valued strings are delimited with @, such as @textures/albedo.png@. Option C is correct because texture files are external resources that should participate in USD’s asset-resolution system. Using an asset path allows the resolver to map the authored identifier to an actual file location, versioned asset, package member, or site-specific storage location. Option A is incorrect because tokens are compact identifiers best suited to enumerated values such as purpose, interpolation, or role-like names. Option B is less appropriate because ordinary strings do not communicate that the value is an external asset dependency requiring resolution. This distinction is essential for interchange, packaging, relocation, and pipeline portability. This aligns with Data Exchange → Asset Paths, Asset Resolution, Texture Dependencies, Sdf Value Types, and External Resource References .

questions.q: Consider the following prim hierarchies. Each prim hierarchy is represented by nested unordered lists and each list item represents a prim with the following format: PRIM_NAME (KIND). No text within the parentheses means that the kind is unset for that prim. Only evaluate model kind hierarchy correctness and the structural choices. Which prim hierarchies represent valid model kind hierarchies? Choose three.
questions.qZh: 考虑以下 prim 层级结构。每个 prim 层级结构用嵌套的无序列表表示，每个列表项表示一个 prim，格式如下：PRIM_NAME (KIND)。括号内没有文本表示该 prim 未设置 kind。仅评估 model kind 层级的正确性以及结构上的选择。哪些 prim 层级结构表示有效的 model kind 层级？请选择三个。
o: CarA (component) Interior () SteeringWheel () Chasis () Wheels () Wheel_FR () Wheel_RL ()

CarA (component) Interior () SteeringWheel (subcomponent) Chasis () Wheels (group) Wheel_FR (subcomponent) Wheel_RL (subcomponent)

questions.q: What is the primary purpose of a conceptual data mapping document?
questions.qZh: 概念数据映射文档的主要目的是什么？
o: To define the requirements for an end-to-end 3D workflow.
To document the content structure of a 3D scene.
To specify the data storage requirements for USD data.

To document data translation between OpenUSD and other formats. D A conceptual data mapping document primarily records how concepts and data from a source format map into OpenUSD concepts, schemas, prims, properties, and authored scene description. NVIDIA’s Learn OpenUSD Data Extraction lesson states that producing such a document is valuable because it serves as a data specification for extraction implementation, helps stakeholders set requirements and expectations, and helps developers understand which features are supported between two formats and what to expect from the extraction phase. Option B is also too narrow because content structure is only one possible mapped concept. Option C is incorrect because storage requirements are not the core concern. This aligns with Data Exchange → Data Extraction, Conceptual Data Mapping, Format Translation, and Converter Design . questions.q: A team needs a way to toggle visibility of prims for local viewport testing without affecting the saved .usda file when it is shared with others. Which approach BEST meets this requirement?
questions.qZh: 某团队需要一种切换 prim 可见性的方式，用于本地视口测试，同时在 .usda 文件与他人共享时不影响已保存的文件。哪种做法最符合这一要求？
o: Add the override in the session layer
Add an override ("over") in the root layer
Edit the attribute directly on the referenced layer
Create a new prim spec in a sublayer at the bottom of the LayerStack
oZh: 在 session layer 中添加 override
在 root layer 中添加 override（"over"）
直接在引用的 layer 上编辑该 attribute
在 LayerStack 底部的 sublayer 中创建一个新的 prim spec
questions.e: The session layer sits above the root layer in the layer stack and holds transient overrides that are never saved to disk with the root layer file, making it ideal for local, non-persistent toggles. Why the others are wrong: - Root layer edits are saved when the stage is saved, defeating the 'without affecting the saved file' requirement - Editing a referenced layer directly is destructive to shared data other users depend on - Sublayers at the bottom of the stack still persist to disk when saved and contribute weaker, not scratch/transient, opinions ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: session layer 位于 layer 栈中 root layer 之上，保存临时性 override，不会随 root layer 文件一起写入磁盘，因此非常适合本地的、非持久化的开关控制。其他选项为何错误：- 编辑 root layer 会在保存 stage 时被写入，从而违背'不影响已保存文件'的要求 - 直接编辑被引用的 layer 会对其他用户依赖的共享数据造成破坏 - 位于栈底部的 sublayer 在保存时同样会持久化到磁盘，且提供的是更弱的意见，而非暂存/临时意见 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.e: Attributes are typed values and support time-sampled data in addition to a default value, making them the correct object for animated data. Why the others are wrong: - Relationships target other SdfPaths and are not typed, animatable values - Metadata is static configuration data, not time-sampled per-frame values - VariantSets switch between discrete data configurations, not continuous animated values ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Attribute 是带类型的值，除默认值外还支持时间采样数据，因此是承载动画数据的正确对象。其他选项为何错误：- Relationship 指向其他 SdfPath，不是带类型、可动画的值 - Metadata 是静态配置数据，不是按帧采样的值 - VariantSet 用于在彼此独立的数据配置之间切换，而非连续的动画值 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: What is the primary distinction between a USD Stage and a USD Layer?
questions.qZh: USD Stage 与 USD Layer 之间的主要区别是什么？
o: A stage is saved to disk while a layer exists only in memory
A stage is the composed, in-memory result of one or more layers; a layer is a file-backed container of opinions
A layer can contain prims while a stage can only contain attributes
A stage and a layer are interchangeable terms for the same object
oZh: Stage 会保存到磁盘，而 Layer 只存在于内存中
Stage 是一个或多个 Layer 合成后的内存结果；Layer 是以文件为后端的意见（opinion）容器
Layer 可以包含 prim，而 Stage 只能包含 attribute
Stage 和 Layer 是指代同一对象的可互换术语
questions.e: This is the foundational distinction: layers are the file-backed (.usda/.usdc) source of opinions, and the stage is the runtime composition result derived from them. Why the others are wrong: - This reverses the relationship — layers are file-backed, stages are in-memory composition results - Both stages and layers ultimately relate to prims; layers hold prim specs, and the stage represents the composed prims - These are distinct, heavily tested concepts, not synonyms ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 这是最基础的区别：Layer 是以文件为后端的意见来源（.usda/.usdc），而 Stage 是运行时从中合成得出的结果。其他选项为何错误：- 这把关系颠倒了——以文件为后端的是 Layer，Stage 是内存中的合成结果 - Stage 和 Layer 最终都与 prim 相关；Layer 保存 prim spec，Stage 表示合成后的 prim - 这是两个截然不同、且被大量考查的概念，并非同义词 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A base geometry layer and a lighting layer both author an opinion on a prim's displayColor attribute. Both are sublayers of the same root layer, with the lighting layer listed first (stronger) in subLayerPaths. Which opinion wins in the composed stage?
questions.qZh: 一个基础几何 layer 和一个光照 layer 都对某个 prim 的 displayColor attribute 编写了意见。两者都是同一个 root layer 的 sublayer，且光照 layer 在 subLayerPaths 中排在前面（更强）。在合成后的 stage 中，哪个意见生效？
o: The base geometry layer's opinion always wins regardless of order
The lighting layer's opinion wins because it is listed first, and therefore stronger, in the layer stack
Both opinions merge into an averaged value
The session layer's opinion always overrides both since it is implicit
oZh: 基础几何 layer 的意见始终生效，与顺序无关
光照 layer 的意见生效，因为它在 layer 栈中排在前面，因此更强
两个意见会合并成取平均的值
session layer 的意见作为隐式意见始终覆盖两者
questions.e: In a subLayerPaths list, the layer listed first is the strongest opinion source; its value wins during composition. Why the others are wrong: - Sublayer strength is determined by list order, not by department or role - USD composition resolves a single strongest value opinion; it does not average conflicting values - The session layer is not part of this scenario unless explicitly included in the layer stack being discussed ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 在 subLayerPaths 列表中，排在最前面的 layer 是最强的意见来源；合成过程中其值生效。其他选项为何错误：- sublayer 的强弱由列表顺序决定，而不是由用途或角色决定 - USD 合成会解析出唯一的最强值意见；不会对冲突的值取平均 - 除非在所讨论的 layer 栈中明确包含 session layer，否则它不参与本场景 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

Attribute
Reference

questions.eZh: Relationship 可指向一个或多个其他 SdfPath，是用于材质绑定等 prim 间链接的机制。其他选项为何错误：- Attribute 保存带类型的值，而不是指向其他 prim 的路径目标 - Reference 是引入外部 layer 内容的合成 arc，不是已有 prim 之间的逐 prim 链接 - VariantSet 用于在彼此独立的数据变体之间切换，而非基于路径的链接 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

defaultPrim

On the session layer of the consuming stage
As prim-level metadata on the defaultPrim

questions.eZh: upAxis 和 metersPerUnit 属于 layer 级（stage）metadata，把它们编写在文件的 root layer 上，可确保它们随文件一同携带，并在任何时候打开该文件时都被采用。其他选项为何错误：- session layer 是临时的，仅存在于本地 stage 中，且不随文件保存，因此无法保证他人打开该文件时的行为 - upAxis 和 metersPerUnit 是 layer 级 metadata，而非 prim 级 - 它们是 layer metadata，而不是各个属性上的 property 级 metadata ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。
