questions.qZh: 某工作室需要为已有的 UsdGeomMesh prim 添加物理碰撞行为，同时不改变该 prim 的底层类型。哪种做法是正确的？
o: Change the prim's type from Mesh to Physics
Apply a single-apply API schema such as UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI to the existing Mesh prim
Delete the prim and recreate it as a UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI typed prim
Add a multi-apply CollectionAPI instance named "collision"
oZh: 将该 prim 的类型从 Mesh 改为 Physics
将 UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI 这类 single-apply API schema 应用到已有的 Mesh prim 上
删除该 prim 并以 UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI 类型重新创建
添加一个名为 "collision" 的 multi-apply CollectionAPI 实例
questions.e: API schemas add capability/properties without altering the prim's typeName; UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI is a single-apply applied API schema designed exactly for this. Why the others are wrong: - Changing typeName would break the Mesh's IsA schema identity and is not how capability is added in USD. - UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI is not a typed (IsA) schema — it cannot be a prim's type, only an applied API. - CollectionAPI groups prims into named collections for other purposes (e.g. selection sets, binding) — it does not add collision behavior. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: API schema 可以在不改变 prim 的 typeName 的前提下添加能力/属性；UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI 正是一个为此设计的 single-apply applied API schema。其他选项为何错误：- 修改 typeName 会破坏 Mesh 的 IsA schema 身份，在 USD 中并不是添加能力的方式。- UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI 不是 typed（IsA）schema——它不能作为 prim 的类型，只能作为 applied API 使用。- CollectionAPI 将 prim 编入命名的集合，用于其他用途（例如选择集、绑定）——它不会添加碰撞行为。 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which of the following is a multi-apply API schema, requiring an instance name when applied?
questions.qZh: 以下哪个是 multi-apply API schema，应用时需要指定实例名称？
o: UsdGeomModelAPI
UsdCollectionAPI
UsdPhysicsMassAPI
UsdGeomVisibilityAPI
oZh: UsdGeomModelAPI
UsdCollectionAPI
UsdPhysicsMassAPI
UsdGeomVisibilityAPI
questions.e: UsdCollectionAPI is designed to be applied multiple times on the same prim, each with a unique instance name (e.g. apiSchemas = ["CollectionAPI:renderSet"]). Why the others are wrong: - UsdGeomModelAPI is a non-applied convenience API, not a multi-apply schema. - UsdPhysicsMassAPI is single-apply — only one mass definition per prim. - UsdGeomVisibilityAPI is a set of visibility-related properties and is single-apply.
questions.eZh: UsdCollectionAPI 的设计目标就是可以在同一个 prim 上多次应用，每次使用唯一的实例名称（例如 apiSchemas = ["CollectionAPI:renderSet"]）。其他选项为何错误：- UsdGeomModelAPI 是 non-applied 的便捷 API，不是 multi-apply schema。- UsdPhysicsMassAPI 是 single-apply——每个 prim 只能定义一次质量。- UsdGeomVisibilityAPI 是一组与可见性相关的属性，且为 single-apply。

questions.q: In the strongest contributing layer, an attribute has both a default value and time samples authored. What value does Usd value resolution return for a query at a specific time code?
questions.qZh: 在最强的贡献 layer 中，某 attribute 同时编写了默认值和时间采样值。针对某个特定 time code 进行查询时，Usd 值解析会返回什么值？
o: The default value, because defaults always take priority
The average of the default and the nearest time sample
An error, because both cannot be authored simultaneously
The time-sampled value; the default in that same layer is ignored
oZh: 默认值，因为默认值总是优先
默认值与最近时间采样值的平均值
报错，因为两者不能同时编写
时间采样值；同一 layer 中的默认值被忽略
questions.e: Whenever an attribute has time samples in the winning layer, USD value resolution uses time samples exclusively; the default value only matters as a fallback when no time samples exist at all in the resolved opinion. Why the others are wrong: - Defaults are the fallback, not the priority, when time samples exist. - USD never averages default and time-sampled values. - Authoring both is valid and common (default may be used by non-time-aware consumers or before the playback range). ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 只要属性在获胜的 layer 中存在时间采样，USD 值解析就会仅使用时间采样；默认值仅在解析出的意见中完全不存在时间采样时才作为回退。其他选项为何错误：- 存在时间采样时，默认值是回退项而非优先项。- USD 绝不会对默认值和时间采样值取平均。- 同时编写两者是合法且常见的做法（默认值可供不具备时间感知能力的消费方使用，也可在播放范围之前使用）。 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Layer A (strongest) authors time samples for an attribute only at frames 1 through 10. Layer B (weaker) authors time samples for the same attribute at frames 1 through 100. What value is returned when a client queries the attribute at frame 50?
questions.qZh: Layer A（较强）仅为某 attribute 在第 1 至 10 帧编写了时间采样。Layer B（较弱）为同一 attribute 在第 1 至 100 帧编写了时间采样。当客户端在第 50 帧查询该 attribute 时会返回什么值？
o: The held (clamped) value from Layer A's last sample at frame 10
The interpolated value from Layer B's samples near frame 50
A blend of Layer A and Layer B's nearest samples
The default value, since neither layer has an exact sample at frame 50
oZh: Layer A 在第 10 帧最后一个采样的保持（clamp）值
来自 Layer B 在第 50 帧附近采样的插值结果
Layer A 与 Layer B 最近采样的混合结果
默认值，因为两个 layer 在第 50 帧都没有精确的采样
questions.e: Once value resolution selects the strongest layer's opinion for an attribute, only that layer's time samples are used — clamped/held at the boundary sample if the query time falls outside the authored range. Layer B's samples are never consulted. Why the others are wrong: - Weaker layers' time samples are never merged in once a stronger layer has any time samples for that attribute. - USD does not blend samples across layers. - The default value is irrelevant here since the strongest layer already has time samples. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 一旦值解析为某 attribute 选定了最强 layer 的意见，就只会使用该 layer 的时间采样——如果查询时间落在已编写范围之外，则钳制（保持）在边界采样值上。Layer B 的采样永远不会被查阅。其他选项为何错误：- 一旦更强的 layer 对该 attribute 有任何时间采样，较弱 layer 的时间采样就绝不会被合并进来。- USD 不会跨 layer 混合采样。- 这里默认值无关紧要，因为最强 layer 已经有时间采样。 ⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A mesh needs UV coordinates that can be discontinuous across a UV seam, with different values on either side at the same shared vertex. Which primvar interpolation must be used?
questions.qZh: 某个网格需要 UV 坐标，且这些坐标在 UV 接缝处可以是不连续的——在同一个共享顶点的两侧取不同的值。必须使用哪种 primvar 插值方式？
o: constant
vertex
uniform
faceVarying
oZh: constant
vertex
uniform
faceVarying
questions.e: faceVarying stores one value per face-corner (per vertex per face), the only interpolation mode that supports discontinuous values at a shared topological vertex. Why the others are wrong: - constant is a single value for the entire prim — it cannot vary at all. - vertex stores one value per point and is smoothly interpolated by the surface basis — it cannot be discontinuous at a vertex. - uniform stores one value per face, not per corner, so it cannot represent per-corner UV differences.
questions.eZh: faceVarying 为每个面角（每个面中的每个顶点）存储一个值，是唯一支持在共享拓扑顶点处取值不连续的插值模式。其他选项为何错误：- constant 是整个 prim 只有一个值——完全无法变化。- vertex 为每个点存储一个值，并由曲面基函数平滑插值——无法在顶点处不连续。- uniform 是每个面存储一个值，而不是每个面角，因此无法表达按面角区分的 UV 差异。

questions.q: Rigging control geometry that should never appear in a final render or even in standard playback, but should still be inspectable in the viewer, should be assigned which purpose value?
questions.qZh: 对于绑定控制几何体：它不应出现在最终渲染中，甚至不应出现在标准播放中，但仍应能在查看器中被检视。这类几何体应赋予哪个 purpose 值？
o: guide
render
proxy
default
oZh: guide
render
proxy
default
questions.e: guide purpose marks geometry as helper-only content (rig controls, annotations) that is excluded from render and standard traversal by default. Why the others are wrong: - render purpose is for final high-quality geometry meant specifically for rendering — the opposite intent. - proxy purpose is a lightweight stand-in still meant to represent renderable/interactive geometry, not a permanent non-render helper. - default purpose means the prim participates normally in both interactive and render contexts — not hidden from either. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: guide purpose 会将几何体标记为仅作辅助的内容（绑定控制器、标注），默认被排除在渲染和标准遍历之外。其他选项为何错误：- render purpose 用于专门供渲染的最终高质量几何体——意图正好相反。- proxy purpose 是轻量级替身，仍然用来代表可渲染/可交互的几何体，而不是永久性的不渲染辅助对象。- default purpose 表示该 prim 正常参与交互和渲染两种上下文——在两者中都不会被隐藏。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which statement about USD 'kind' and model hierarchy is correct?
questions.qZh: 关于 USD 的 'kind' 与模型层级，下列哪项陈述是正确的？
o: Model hierarchy must be contiguous — if a prim has a kind, all of its ancestors up to the root must also have a kind
Kind is required on every prim in a stage
A 'component' kind prim may contain child prims that are themselves models (group/assembly)
'subcomponent' kind breaks the leaf status of its parent component
oZh: 模型层级必须是连续的——如果某个 prim 拥有 kind，那么它直到根节点的所有祖先也必须拥有 kind
stage 中的每个 prim 都必须具有 kind
kind 为 'component' 的 prim 可以包含本身也是模型（group/assembly）的子 prim
'subcomponent' kind 会破坏其父级 component 的叶子状态
questions.e: Model hierarchy relies on unbroken kind ancestry from the root so that fast traversal APIs (e.g. IsModel) can short-circuit; a gap invalidates the hierarchy for that branch. Why the others are wrong: - Kind is optional metadata; only prims that participate in model hierarchy need it. - A component is by convention a leaf model — it should not contain nested models. - subcomponent explicitly exists to tag a distinguished piece inside a component's namespace without making the component a non-leaf model. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 模型层级依赖从根节点开始不间断的 kind 祖先链，这样快速遍历 API（例如 IsModel）才能提前短路返回；一旦出现断裂，该分支的层级就失效了。其他选项为何错误：- kind 是可选的元数据；只有参与模型层级的 prim 才需要它。- component 按约定是叶子模型——不应包含嵌套的模型。- subcomponent 正是用来在 component 的命名空间内标记某个特定部分，而不会使该 component 变成非叶子模型。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A team is modeling standard geometry, materials, and lights entirely covered by UsdGeom, UsdShade, and UsdLux. They are considering writing a custom typed schema for a 'ConfigurableProp' concept. What is the recommended approach per OpenUSD best practice?
questions.qZh: 某个团队正在建模标准几何体、材质和灯光，这些内容已被 UsdGeom、UsdShade 和 UsdLux 完全覆盖。他们考虑为 'ConfigurableProp' 概念编写自定义 typed schema。按照 OpenUSD 最佳实践，推荐的做法是什么？
o: Always write a custom schema for any studio-specific concept, regardless of existing coverage
Use only API schemas and never author custom typed schemas
Use a codeless schema exclusively without ever considering compiled C++ schemas
Reuse and compose existing standard schemas; only author a custom schema if no existing schema covers the need
oZh: 无论现有 schema 是否已经覆盖，始终为任何工作室特有概念编写自定义 schema
只使用 API schema，绝不编写自定义 typed schema
只使用 codeless schema，完全不考虑编译型 C++ schema
复用并组合现有的标准 schema；只有在没有任何现有 schema 能覆盖该需求时，才编写自定义 schema
questions.e: OpenUSD best practice favors reuse and interoperability first — custom schemas should be a last resort to avoid ecosystem fragmentation and tool incompatibility. Why the others are wrong: - Always customizing ignores available standard coverage and harms interoperability. - API schemas alone can't define a prim's fundamental type; typed schemas still have valid uses. - Codeless vs compiled is an implementation choice, not a rule that avoids evaluating existing schema coverage first.
questions.eZh: OpenUSD 最佳实践优先考虑复用与互操作性——自定义 schema 应作为最后手段，以避免生态碎片化和工具不兼容。其他选项为何错误：- 一律自定义会忽略已有的标准覆盖，损害互操作性。- 仅用 API schema 无法定义 prim 的根本类型；typed schema 仍有其合理用途。- codeless 与编译型之间属于实现方式的选择，而不是可以跳过评估现有 schema 覆盖情况的规则。

questions.q: A studio has a 500GB city environment asset that appears in only 10% of shots. Artists need fast stage-open times for the other 90% of shots. Which composition arc should reference this asset so it can be excluded from memory/load cost when not needed?
questions.qZh: 某工作室有一个 500GB 的城市环境资产，它只出现在 10% 的镜头中。美术师需要其余 90% 的镜头有快速的 stage 打开时间。应使用哪个组合 arc 来引用该资产，使其在不需要时不被计入内存/加载开销？
o: Reference
Sublayer
Inherit
Payload
oZh: Reference
Sublayer
Inherit
Payload
questions.e: Payloads are not loaded by default when a stage opens — content is deferred until explicitly requested via stage.Load(), giving fast opens for heavy, sometimes-needed assets. Why the others are wrong: - Reference always loads its target when the stage opens (unless nested in an unloaded payload), so it doesn't save load cost. - Sublayer merges opinions into the same layer stack/namespace — it isn't used to bring in a separate external asset with deferred loading. - Inherit shares class-based opinions but does not defer loading of heavy geometry data.
questions.eZh: Payload 在 stage 打开时默认不会被加载——内容会被推迟，直到通过 stage.Load() 显式请求，从而让体积庞大、只是偶尔需要的资产保持快速打开。其他选项为何错误：- Reference 会在 stage 打开时始终加载其目标（除非嵌套在未加载的 payload 中），因此并不能节省加载开销。- Sublayer 是把意见合并到同一 layer stack/命名空间中，它不是用来引入独立的外部资产并延迟加载的。- Inherit 共享基于 class 的意见，但不会延迟重型几何数据的加载。

questions.q: In a root layer's subLayers list, which layer contributes the strongest opinions when two sublayers author the same attribute?
questions.qZh: 在根 layer 的 subLayers 列表中，当两个 sublayer 都为同一属性编写意见时，哪一层贡献的意见最强？
o: The layer at the top of the list
The layer at the bottom of the list
The layer that was added most recently, regardless of position
The layer that is alphabetically first by filename
oZh: 列表顶部的 layer
列表底部的 layer
最近添加的 layer，无论其位置如何
按文件名字母序排在最前的 layer
questions.e: USD sublayer strength is determined purely by list position — the top of the subLayers list is the strongest, weakest at the bottom. Why the others are wrong: - Bottom of the list is the weakest layer, the opposite of correct. - Insertion time has no bearing on strength — only the current ordering in the list matters. - Filename or alphabetical order has no effect on composition strength. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: USD 中 sublayer 的强度完全由列表位置决定——subLayers 列表顶部的最强，底部最弱。其他选项为何错误：- 列表底部是最弱的层，与正确结论正好相反。- 插入时间与强度无关——只有列表中的当前顺序才重要。- 文件名或字母序对组合强度没有任何影响。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: What technically constitutes a 'layer stack' in USD?
questions.qZh: 在 USD 中，从技术上讲，什么构成一个 'layer stack'？
o: Every layer loaded anywhere in the current session
Only the single root layer with no sublayers considered
The root layer plus all layers reached recursively through sublayer arcs
Every layer reachable through any composition arc, including references and payloads
oZh: 当前会话中任何位置加载的所有 layer
仅指单个根 layer，不考虑任何 sublayer
根 layer 加上通过 sublayer arc 递归到达的所有 layer
通过任意组合 arc（包括 reference 和 payload）可达的所有 layer
questions.e: A layer stack is defined as a layer and its sublayers, composed recursively into one ordered, flattened namespace. References/payloads bring in and compose separate layer stacks, they do not merge into the caller's local layer stack. Why the others are wrong: - This describes the whole composed scene graph, not the specific 'layer stack' term used in the spec. - Ignoring sublayers is incorrect — they are the defining member of a layer stack. - References and payloads introduce their own distinct layer stacks that get composed together, not folded into the local one. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: layer stack 被定义为一个 layer 及其 sublayer，它们被递归组合成一个有序的扁平命名空间。Reference/payload 会引入并组合各自独立的 layer stack，而不会合并进调用方本地的 layer stack。其他选项为何错误：- 这描述的是整个组合后的场景图，而不是规范中特指的 'layer stack'。- 忽略 sublayer 是不对的——它们正是 layer stack 的构成成员。- Reference 和 payload 会引入各自独立的 layer stack 并被组合在一起，而不是折叠进本地的 layer stack。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: You need to add a small set of override opinions (e.g., adjusted light intensities) on top of an existing environment layer, targeting the exact same prim paths, without pulling in new prim hierarchies from elsewhere or affecting reference/inherit semantics. Which arc is appropriate?
questions.qZh: 你需要在现有环境 layer 之上添加少量覆盖性意见（例如调整后的灯光强度），目标是完全相同的 prim 路径，同时不引入外部的新 prim 层级，也不影响 reference/inherit 的语义。应该使用哪个 arc？
o: Reference
Sublayer
Payload
Specializes
oZh: Reference
Sublayer
Payload
Specializes
questions.e: Sublayers combine layers into a single layer stack over the same prim namespace — ideal for override-only layers like lighting tweaks that don't introduce new assets. Why the others are wrong: - Reference is meant for composing in external/internal content and new prim hierarchies, not simple same-namespace overrides. - Payload behaves like reference but with deferred loading — still meant for bringing in separate content, not namespace-local overrides. - Specializes is for weak, customizable base opinions, not for strong overrides on the same namespace.
questions.eZh: Sublayer 把若干 layer 组合进同一个 layer stack、共用同一 prim 命名空间——非常适合仅用于覆盖的 layer，比如不引入新资产的灯光微调。其他选项为何错误：- Reference 用于组合外部/内部内容及新的 prim 层级，而不是简单的同命名空间覆盖。- Payload 的行为类似 reference，但支持延迟加载——它仍然用于引入独立内容，而非命名空间内的覆盖。- Specializes 用于弱的、可定制的基底意见，而不是同一命名空间上的强覆盖。

questions.q: A pipeline needs to bring in a very large character rig asset that should NOT load automatically when the stage opens, to keep initial scene load fast. Which arc satisfies this requirement?
questions.qZh: 某流程需要引入一个非常大的角色绑定资产，为保证初始场景加载速度，它在 stage 打开时不应自动加载。哪个 arc 满足该要求？
o: Sublayer
Inherit
Reference
Payload
oZh: Sublayer
Inherit
Reference
Payload
questions.e: Payload arcs are explicitly designed for deferred/lazy loading of heavy content — they are not loaded until the client calls stage.Load(). Why the others are wrong: - Sublayer isn't used for bringing in separate external assets — it merges layers into the same namespace. - Inherit is for class-based shared opinions and does not control loading behavior. - Reference loads its content automatically when the stage opens, which does not satisfy the deferred-loading requirement.
questions.eZh: Payload arc 正是为重型内容的延迟/惰性加载而设计的——只有客户端调用 stage.Load() 后才会加载。其他选项为何错误：- Sublayer 不是用来引入独立的外部资产的——它把 layer 合并到同一命名空间中。- Inherit 用于基于 class 的共享意见，并不控制加载行为。- Reference 会在 stage 打开时自动加载其内容，无法满足延迟加载的要求。

questions.q: Which Python API call unloads a payload at a given prim path on an already-open UsdStage?
questions.qZh: 在已经打开的 UsdStage 上，卸载指定 prim 路径处 payload 的 Python API 调用是哪个？
o: stage.Reload()
stage.RemovePrim(path)
stage.Unload(path)
stage.Export()
oZh: stage.Reload()
stage.RemovePrim(path)
stage.Unload(path)
stage.Export()
questions.e: stage.Unload(path) marks the payload at or under the given path as unloaded, removing its contribution from the composed stage without deleting anything from disk. Why the others are wrong: - stage.Reload() re-reads layer content from disk; it does not change payload load state. - stage.RemovePrim() deletes a prim spec entirely — a destructive authoring operation, not a load-state toggle. - stage.Export() writes the current stage to a file; it has nothing to do with payload load state.
questions.eZh: stage.Unload(path) 会把给定路径处或其下方的 payload 标记为未加载，在不删除磁盘上任何内容的前提下移除其对组合后 stage 的贡献。其他选项为何错误：- stage.Reload() 从磁盘重新读取 layer 内容；它并不改变 payload 的加载状态。- stage.RemovePrim() 会彻底删除该 prim spec——这是破坏性的创作操作，而不是加载状态开关。- stage.Export() 把当前 stage 写入文件；它与 payload 的加载状态无关。

questions.q: A prim's payload (Payload B) is nested underneath another prim whose payload (Payload A) is currently unloaded. What happens to Payload B's content?
questions.qZh: 某个 prim 的 payload（Payload B）嵌套在另一个 prim 之下，而后者的 payload（Payload A）当前处于未加载状态。Payload B 的内容会怎样？
o: It loads automatically regardless of Payload A's state
It remains unloaded until Payload A is loaded, and Payload B is itself explicitly loaded
USD raises a composition error because of the nesting
It defaults to loaded since payloads nested in payloads behave like references
oZh: 无论 Payload A 的状态如何，它都会自动加载
在 Payload A 被加载、且 Payload B 自身被显式加载之前，它始终保持未加载
USD 会因这种嵌套而抛出组合错误
由于嵌套在 payload 中的 payload 行为类似 reference，它默认处于已加载状态

questions.e: 'over' authors a non-destructive opinion on an already-defined prim without re-specifying its type or existence. It composes into the existing prim's opinion stack, changing only the requested attribute (displayColor) while leaving the underlying definition, other attributes, and all other instances untouched. Why the others are wrong: - Re-declaring 'def' with the same typeName is unnecessary and non-idiomatic; while it may work, it risks unintentionally resetting other fallback values and is not the non-destructive convention the exam expects. - Deleting and redefining the prim destroys the composition arc from the reference, losing all upstream asset opinions — the opposite of non-destructive editing. - A variant set changes an authored selection across the whole variant arc and is overkill (and non-local) for a one-off, single-instance color tweak in one shot.
questions.eZh: 'over' 在一个已定义的 prim 上创作非破坏性的 opinion，而无需重新指定其类型或存在性。它会组合进该 prim 现有的 opinion 栈，只改变所请求的属性（displayColor），同时保持底层定义、其它属性以及所有其它实例不受影响。其余选项为何错误：- 用相同的 typeName 重新声明 'def' 既无必要也不符合惯例；虽然可能可行，但有意外重置其它回退值的风险，而且不是考试所期望的非破坏式写法。- 删除并重新定义该 prim 会破坏来自 reference 的组合弧，丢失所有上游资产的 opinions —— 与非破坏式编辑正好相反。- variant set 会改变整个 variant 弧上的创作选择，对于单镜头中一次性的单实例颜色调整来说属于过度设计（而且是非局部的）。

questions.q: Which specifier is used on a prim intended purely as an inherit target, so it is excluded from default stage traversal and rendering?

o: class
over
def
payload
oZh: class
over
def
payload
questions.e: Prims declared with the 'class' specifier are abstract. They are marked IsAbstract on the composed UsdPrim and are excluded from default UsdStage traversal (e.g., UsdPrimRange with default predicate) and from rendering, which is exactly the intended behavior for reusable inherit targets. Why the others are wrong: - 'over' only adds opinions to an existing defined prim; it does not create an abstract, traversal-excluded prim. - 'def' defines a concrete prim that is included in default traversal and rendering — not suitable as a hidden inherit-only target. - 'payload' is a composition arc for deferred loading, not a prim specifier. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 使用 'class' specifier 声明的 prim 是抽象的。它们在组合后的 UsdPrim 上被标记为 IsAbstract，并被排除在默认的 UsdStage 遍历（例如使用默认谓词的 UsdPrimRange）和渲染之外，这正是可复用继承目标所期望的行为。其余选项为何错误：- 'over' 只是给已定义的 prim 添加 opinions；它不会创建抽象的、被排除于遍历之外的 prim。- 'def' 定义的是具体的 prim，会包含在默认遍历和渲染中 —— 不适合作为隐藏的纯继承目标。- 'payload' 是用于延迟加载的组合弧，不是 prim specifier。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Where is the currently authored selection for a variant set stored in a USD layer?
questions.qZh: 在 USD 图层中，variant set 当前所创作的选择存储在哪里？
o: In the 'variants' metadata dictionary on the prim, keyed by variant set name
In a dedicated sublayer named after the variant set
As an attribute named 'variantSelection' on the prim's default attributes
In the root layer's 'defaultPrim' metadata field
oZh: 在 prim 上的 'variants' 元数据字典中，以 variant set 名称为键
在以 variant set 命名的专用 sublayer 中
作为 prim 默认属性中名为 'variantSelection' 的属性
在根图层的 'defaultPrim' 元数据字段中
questions.e: Variant selections are stored as list-editable metadata on the prim, in the 'variants' dictionary field, mapping each variant set name to the selected variant name. This is what UsdVariantSet.SetVariantSelection writes and what any stronger layer can non-destructively override. Why the others are wrong: - USD does not create a separate sublayer per variant set automatically; sublayers are a manual, file-level composition mechanism unrelated to variant storage. - There is no standard prim attribute called 'variantSelection'; selection is prim metadata, not an attribute in the property namespace. - 'defaultPrim' metadata identifies which prim in a layer is the entry point when referenced, and has nothing to do with variant selections. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Variant 选择以可列表编辑的元数据形式存储在 prim 上的 'variants' 字典字段中，把每个 variant set 名称映射到所选变体名称。UsdVariantSet.SetVariantSelection 写入的就是它，任何更强的图层都可以非破坏性地覆盖它。其余选项为何错误：- USD 不会自动为每个 variant set 创建一个单独的 sublayer；sublayer 是一种手动、文件级的组合机制，与 variant 的存储无关。- 不存在名为 'variantSelection' 的标准 prim 属性；选择是 prim 元数据，而不是属性命名空间中的属性。- 'defaultPrim' 元数据标识图层在被引用时哪个 prim 是入口点，与 variant 选择无关。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: In LIVRPS composition strength ordering, which arc is weakest overall, meaning its opinions can be overridden by references, payloads, inherits, variants, and local opinions?
questions.qZh: 在 LIVRPS 组合强度排序中，哪一种弧整体最弱，即它的 opinions 可以被 references、payloads、inherits、variants 和 local opinions 覆盖？
o: Inherits
Payloads
References
Specializes
oZh: Inherits
Payloads
References
Specializes
questions.e: The LIVRPS mnemonic (Local, Inherits, Variants, References, Payloads, Specializes) lists arcs from strongest to weakest. Specializes is last, making it the weakest arc — every other arc type's opinions take precedence over a specializes target's opinions. Why the others are wrong: - Inherits is the second-strongest arc, ranking above Variants, References, Payloads, and Specializes. - Payloads rank above Specializes in the ordering; only Specializes is weaker. - References rank above Payloads and Specializes, so they are not the weakest arc. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: LIVRPS 助记符（Local、Inherits、Variants、References、Payloads、Specializes）按从强到弱列出各条弧。Specializes 排在最后，因此是最弱的弧 —— 其它任何类型弧的 opinions 都优先于 specialize 目标的 opinions。其余选项为何错误：- Inherits 是第二强的弧，排在 Variants、References、Payloads 和 Specializes 之上。- Payloads 在排序中强于 Specializes；只有 Specializes 更弱。- References 强于 Payloads 和 Specializes，因此不是最弱的弧。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A lighting artist wants to non-destructively switch a prop between 'clean' and 'damaged' surface looks for different shots, with the choice easily changeable per shot layer and easily inspectable in USD text files. Which approach best fits this requirement?
questions.qZh: 一位灯光美术师希望以非破坏性的方式，在不同镜头中把一个道具在 'clean' 和 'damaged' 两种表面外观之间切换，并且该选择易于在每个镜头图层中修改，也易于在 USD 文本文件中查看。哪一种方式最符合该需求？
o: Author two separate 'def' prims, one per look, and toggle their visibility
Create a variant set (e.g., 'lookVariant') with 'clean' and 'damaged' variants, and override the variant selection per shot
Use an inherits arc pointing at either a 'clean' or 'damaged' class prim depending on the shot
Payload in either the clean or damaged geometry file depending on the shot
oZh: 创作两个独立的 'def' prim，每个外观一个，然后切换它们的可见性
创建一个 variant set（例如 'lookVariant'），包含 'clean' 和 'damaged' 变体，并按镜头覆盖 variant 选择
使用 inherits arc，根据镜头指向 'clean' 或 'damaged' 的 class prim
根据镜头 payload 引入 clean 或 damaged 几何体文件
questions.e: Variant sets are purpose-built for this exact use case: they encapsulate mutually exclusive authored variations under one prim, store the active choice as simple metadata, and allow any stronger layer (like a shot layer) to override the 'variants' selection non-destructively without touching the underlying prim definitions. Why the others are wrong: - Toggling visibility between duplicated 'def' prims is destructive, doubles authored data, and isn't how the exam expects mutually exclusive looks to be modeled. - Inherits is meant for shared class-level opinions with strong precedence, not for switching between mutually exclusive look states per shot. - Payload controls loading/unloading of subtrees for performance, not selection between authored look variations, and switching payload targets per shot is not the idiomatic mechanism for this.
questions.eZh: Variant set 正是为这种用例而生的：它们把互斥的创作变体封装在同一个 prim 下，将当前选择存储为简单的元数据，并允许任何更强的图层（例如镜头图层）非破坏性地覆盖 'variants' 选择，而无需改动底层的 prim 定义。其余选项为何错误：- 在重复的 'def' prim 之间切换可见性是破坏性的，会使创作数据翻倍，而且不是考试所期望的互斥外观建模方式。- Inherits 用于共享的 class 级 opinions，具有很强的优先级，而不是用于按镜头切换互斥的外观状态。- Payload 控制子树出于性能考虑的加载/卸载，不用于在已创作的外观变体之间做选择，按镜头切换 payload 目标也不是惯用机制。

questions.q: What is the core philosophy behind preferring 'over' instead of 'def' when making edits in stronger (e.g., shot-level) layers within a USD pipeline?
questions.qZh: 在 USD 管线中，于更强（例如镜头级）图层里做编辑时，优先使用 'over' 而非 'def' 的核心理念是什么？
o: Because 'over' is required syntax whenever editing a referenced prim
Because 'over' opinions load faster than 'def' opinions at runtime
Because 'def' cannot be used inside reference or payload arcs
Because 'over' composes additional opinions onto an existing prim non-destructively, preserving the original definition and enabling safe, reversible layering
oZh: 因为编辑被引用的 prim 时 'over' 是必需的语法
因为 'over' 的 opinions 在运行时比 'def' 的 opinions 加载更快
因为 'def' 不能在 reference 或 payload 弧内使用
因为 'over' 会把额外的 opinions 非破坏性地组合到已有 prim 上，保留原始定义并支持安全、可逆的分层
questions.e: The non-destructive editing philosophy in USD favors 'over' because it layers additional opinions on top of an existing definition without redeclaring the prim's type or existence, keeping the original authoring intact, reversible, and safely composable across many layers in a large pipeline. Why the others are wrong: - 'over' is a strong convention, not a hard syntax requirement — you technically can re-author 'def', but it is discouraged and not equivalent in behavior. - There is no meaningful runtime performance difference between 'over' and 'def' loading; the distinction is about composition semantics, not speed. - 'def' is perfectly valid inside referenced or payloaded layers — in fact, an asset's own layer typically uses 'def' to originally define the prim before other layers override it.
questions.eZh: USD 中的非破坏式编辑理念之所以偏好 'over'，是因为它把额外的 opinions 叠加到已有定义之上，而无需重新声明 prim 的类型或存在性，从而让原始创作保持完整、可逆，并能在大型管线中跨多层安全地组合。其余选项为何错误：- 'over' 是一种强约定，而非硬性的语法要求 —— 技术上你可以重新创作 'def'，但不推荐，且行为并不等价。- 'over' 与 'def' 的加载之间没有有意义的运行时性能差异；区别在于组合语义，而非速度。- 'def' 在被引用或被 payload 的图层内完全合法 —— 事实上，资产自己的图层通常就用 'def' 最初定义该 prim，之后再由其它图层覆盖它。

questions.q: A studio aggregates 200 external vendor USD assets into a single assembly. Multiple vendors each authored their asset root at the path '/Geom', causing namespace collisions when composed. What is the BEST structural fix?

Manually flatten the stage and rename every colliding prim by hand after composition
Add override opinions on top of the colliding prims to mask the duplication
Convert every vendor reference to a payload arc so the namespaces merge automatically
oZh: 在 assembly 上把每个供应商资产引用到各自唯一命名的子 prim 下，而不是在同一路径上合并
手动 flatten 该 stage，并在组合后逐个手动重命名所有冲突的 prim
在冲突的 prim 上添加 override opinions 来掩盖重复
把每个供应商 reference 转换为 payload arc，使命名空间自动合并
