o: To provide a stable, consistent top-level entry point that encapsulates internal file layout so consumers never need to reference internal structure
To directly increase render performance during path tracing
To store all geometry data directly for the fastest possible disk access
To replace the need for Kind metadata on published assets
oZh: 提供一个稳定、一致的顶层入口，封装内部文件布局，使使用者永远不需要引用内部结构
直接提升路径追踪时的渲染性能
直接存储所有几何体数据，以获得尽可能快的磁盘访问
取代已发布资产对 Kind 元数据的需求
questions.e: The interface layer's core purpose is encapsulation: a single stable reference target that hides internal geom/material/payload file organization from consumers. Why the others are wrong: - Render performance is unrelated to layer structure; it depends on geometry complexity and shading, not the interface pattern - The interface layer is intentionally lightweight and typically does not store geometry inline — geometry lives in composed internal layers - Kind metadata and the interface layer pattern are complementary, not substitutes for each other
questions.eZh: interface 图层的核心目的是封装：一个单一的稳定引用目标，将内部的 geom/material/payload 文件组织对使用者隐藏。其余选项为何错误：- 渲染性能与图层结构无关；它取决于几何体复杂度和着色，而不是 interface 模式。- interface 图层有意保持轻量，通常不会内联存储几何体 —— 几何体存放在被组合的内部图层中。- Kind 元数据与 interface 图层模式是互补关系，而不是彼此的替代品。

questions.q: A studio needs to populate a scene with 2 million trees. Individual trees never need unique material overrides, only occasional hiding of specific trees for camera-frustum culling tests. Which approach BEST meets this requirement?
questions.qZh: 某工作室需要用 200 万棵树填充场景。单棵树从不需要唯一的材质覆盖，只是偶尔需要隐藏特定的树来进行相机视锥剔除测试。哪一种方式最符合该需求？
o: Use a UsdGeomPointInstancer with protoIndices and positions, and drive hidden trees with invisibleIds
Mark each tree prim instanceable=true so they share a single prototype
Reference the tree asset 2 million times without any instancing
Put each tree variation inside a variant set on the prototype prim
oZh: 使用带有 protoIndices 和 positions 的 UsdGeomPointInstancer，并用 invisibleIds 驱动隐藏树木
将每个树 prim 标记为 instanceable=true，使其共享单个 prototype
不使用任何实例化，reference 树资产 200 万次
把每种树木变化放进 prototype prim 上的 variant set 中
questions.e: PointInstancer scales to millions of instances using flat arrays (protoIndices, positions) and invisibleIds is the schema-native mechanism for hiding specific instance ids without touching per-instance scene graph prims. Why the others are wrong: - Native instancing still creates one scenegraph prim per instance; at 2M instances this explodes memory and stage-population time compared to array-based point instancing. - Un-instanced references duplicate the full prototype composition per copy — the worst-case memory/perf option at this scale. - Variant sets on the prototype change the shared definition for every instance at once; they don't provide per-instance culling. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: PointInstancer 使用扁平数组（protoIndices、positions）可扩展到数百万实例，而 invisibleIds 是 schema 原生的机制，可以在不触及逐实例场景图 prim 的情况下隐藏特定实例 id。其余选项为何错误：- 原生实例化仍会为每个实例创建一个场景图 prim；在 200 万实例时，相比基于数组的 point instancing，内存和 stage 填充时间会爆炸。- 未实例化的 reference 会为每份拷贝复制完整的 prototype 组合 —— 在此规模下是内存/性能最差的选项。- prototype 上的 variant set 会一次性改变所有实例共享的定义；它们不提供逐实例的剔除。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: 50 car prims all have instanceable=true and reference the same prototype asset. You must give exactly 5 of them unique paint materials while the other 45 keep sharing the prototype's render data. What is the correct workflow?
questions.qZh: 50 个汽车 prim 都设置了 instanceable=true 并引用同一个 prototype 资产。必须给其中恰好 5 个赋予独有的车漆材质，而其余 45 个继续共享 prototype 的渲染数据。正确的工作流是什么？
o: Author a material binding directly on the instance proxy path for each of the 5 cars
Edit the material binding on the shared prototype prim
Set instanceable=false on just those 5 prims so each becomes its own prototype, then author unique material bindings on them
Add a variant set to the prototype and select a different variant per instance proxy
oZh: 直接在这 5 辆车的 instance proxy 路径上创作材质绑定
在共享的 prototype prim 上编辑材质绑定
只在这 5 个 prim 上设置 instanceable=false，使每个都成为独立的 prototype，然后在它们上面创作独有的材质绑定
为 prototype 添加 variant set，并为每个 instance proxy 选择不同的 variant
questions.e: You cannot author new opinions (like a material binding relationship) on an instance proxy. De-instancing the 5 outliers breaks sharing only for them, turning each into its own composed prototype where a real material override is legal. Why the others are wrong: - Instance proxies are read/inspect paths for the composed result; authoring relationships or new properties on them raises an error — this is the 1 exam trap. - Editing the shared prototype directly changes the material for all 50 instances, not just the 5 target cars. - Variant selection is a composition arc resolved once per prototype; you cannot select a different variant per instance proxy of the same shared prototype. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: 你无法在 instance proxy 上创作新的 opinions（比如材质绑定关系）。对这 5 个例外项取消实例化，只对它们打破共享，使每个都成为自己组合后的 prototype，在那里进行真实的材质覆盖才是合法的。其余选项为何错误：- Instance proxy 是用于查看/检查组合结果的路径；在其上创作关系或新属性会报错 —— 这是本考试的头号陷阱。- 直接编辑共享的 prototype 会改变全部 50 个实例的材质，而不只是目标中的 5 辆车。- Variant 选择是每 prototype 解析一次的组合弧；你不能为同一个共享 prototype 的不同 instance proxy 选择不同的 variant。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which metadata field, when set to true on a referencing prim, causes USD to share the composed result with other identical instances via a prototype?
questions.qZh: 当在某个引用 prim 上设置为 true 时，可以让 USD 通过 prototype 与其它相同实例共享组合结果的元数据字段是哪一个？
o: instanceable = true
instance = true
isPrototype = true
shared = true
oZh: instanceable = true
instance = true
isPrototype = true
shared = true
questions.e: instanceable is the exact boolean metadata field defined on UsdPrim that opts a prim into native instancing/prototype sharing. Why the others are wrong: - "instance" is not a real USD metadata key for this purpose. - "isPrototype" does not exist as authorable metadata — prototypes are computed internally and exposed under a reserved / Prototype N path. - "shared" is not a USD metadata field; it's a distractor invented for the exam.
questions.eZh: instanceable 是定义在 UsdPrim 上的确切布尔元数据字段，用于让 prim 选择加入原生实例化/prototype 共享。其余选项为何错误：- "instance" 并非用于此目的的真实 USD 元数据键。- "isPrototype" 并不是可创作的元数据 —— prototype 是内部计算出来的，并暴露在保留的 / Prototype N 路径下。- "shared" 不是 USD 元数据字段；它是为考试编造的干扰项。

questions.q: What data type does UsdGeomPointInstancer's orientations attribute use to store per-instance rotation?
questions.qZh: UsdGeomPointInstancer 的 orientations 属性使用什么数据类型来存储逐实例的旋转？
o: matrix4d[]
float3[] Euler angles
quath[] (half-precision quaternion array)
quatf[] only, quath is not supported
oZh: matrix4d[]
float3[] 欧拉角
quath[]（半精度四元数数组）
仅 quatf[]，不支持 quath
questions.e: PointInstancer.orientations is authored as quath[] — half-precision quaternions — chosen specifically to reduce memory footprint at massive instance counts. Why the others are wrong: - matrix4d[] would be far heavier per-instance than a quaternion and is not the schema's attribute type. - Euler angles are not used by the schema; quaternions avoid gimbal lock and interpolate cleanly. - quath IS the schema default; quatf is not the standard orientations type for PointInstancer. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: PointInstancer.orientations 以 quath[] 创作 —— 半精度四元数 —— 之所以这样选是专门为了在超大实例数量下减少内存占用。其余选项为何错误：- matrix4d[] 的每实例开销远大于四元数，且不是该 schema 的属性类型。- 该 schema 不使用欧拉角；四元数可避免万向节锁并能平滑插值。- quath 正是该 schema 的默认类型；quatf 不是 PointInstancer 的标准 orientations 类型。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略 —— 请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A visualization needs 300 unique architectural building modules where 40 of them must show a different roof-color variant selection than the rest, and artists frequently pick individual buildings in the viewport to tweak. Which instancing strategy is BEST?
questions.qZh: 某个可视化项目需要 300 个独特的建筑模块，其中 40 个必须显示与其余不同的屋顶颜色变体选择，而且美术师经常在视口中拾取单个建筑进行调整。哪种实例化策略最佳？
o: UsdGeomPointInstancer with a variant-index primvar
A single mesh with baked-in geometry variation, no instancing
Native (prototype) instancing with instanceable=true so each building remains an individually selectable, addressable prim
PointInstancer with protoIndices pointing to 40 different prototype variants baked as separate prototypes, ignoring selection needs
oZh: 带有 variant-index primvar 的 UsdGeomPointInstancer
单个网格，将几何变化烘焙其中，不使用实例化
使用 instanceable=true 的原生（prototype）实例化，使每个建筑仍是可单独选择、可寻址的 prim
PointInstancer，其 protoIndices 指向 40 个不同的 prototype 变体并各自烘焙为独立 prototype，忽略选择需求
questions.e: At a few hundred instances where individual per-instance selection, variant switching, and viewport picking matter, native instancing keeps each instance as its own addressable prim in the hierarchy, which PointInstancer instances are not. Why the others are wrong: - PointInstancer instances are not individually selectable scenegraph prims by default — they exist as index/array entries, making per-instance variant workflows and viewport picking clumsy. - Baking variation into a single mesh eliminates all reuse and per-instance editability, and doesn't scale as a maintainable pipeline. - Routing variant needs through protoIndices technically works for variety but still sacrifices the individual-prim selectability the scenario explicitly requires.
questions.eZh:
在仅有数百个实例、且需要按实例单独选择、变体切换和视口拾取的场景下，原生实例化能让每个实例在层级中保持为各自独立、可寻址的 prim，而 PointInstancer 的实例做不到这一点。其他选项错误的原因：
- PointInstancer 的实例默认不是可单独选择的场景图 prim——它们只是索引/数组条目，导致按实例的变体工作流和视口拾取都很笨拙。
- 把变化烘焙到单个网格中会彻底丧失复用能力和按实例的可编辑性，也无法作为可维护的流水线扩展。
- 通过 protoIndices 表达变体需求在技术上可以实现多样性，但仍然牺牲了场景明确要求的单 prim 可选择性。

questions.q: An artist selects an instanced prim in the viewport and the path resolves to something like /World/Set/Buildings/ Prototype 1/Geom/Mesh instead of the referencing instance's own path. What is this resolved path called?
questions.qZh: 美术师在视口中选择一个实例化的 prim，路径却解析到了类似 /World/Set/Buildings/Prototype 1/Geom/Mesh 的位置，而不是引用该实例自身的路径。这个解析后的路径叫什么？
o: A prototype override
A composition arc target
An instance proxy
A shared reference alias
oZh: prototype 覆盖（prototype override）
合成弧目标（composition arc target）
实例代理（instance proxy）
共享引用别名
questions.e: An instance proxy is the addressable, non-instanceable-looking path USD synthesizes so tools can inspect (and in a limited way override) the composed result of one specific instance without duplicating the shared prototype data. Why the others are wrong: - "Prototype override" is not standard USD terminology. - A composition arc target is a reference/payload/inherit destination, not the resolved per-instance inspection path. - "Shared reference alias" is a made-up term not used in USD documentation or the exam.
questions.eZh:
实例代理（instance proxy）是 USD 合成出来的可寻址路径，看起来不像实例本身，工具借此可以检查（并在有限程度上覆盖）某个具体实例的合成结果，而无需复制共享的 prototype 数据。其他选项错误的原因：
- “Prototype override” 并非标准 USD 术语。
- 合成弧目标是 reference/payload/inherit 的目标，而非解析后的按实例检查路径。
- “Shared reference alias” 是杜撰出来的术语，USD 文档和考试中都没有这一说法。

questions.q: Which relationship on a UsdGeomPointInstancer specifies the set of source prims that instances are drawn from?
questions.qZh: UsdGeomPointInstancer 上的哪个关系指定了实例所来源的源 prim 集合？
o: rel targets
rel prototypes
rel sourcePrims
rel instanceSources
oZh: rel targets
rel prototypes
rel sourcePrims
rel instanceSources
questions.e: prototypes is the exact relationship name on UsdGeomPointInstancer that lists the candidate prims each protoIndices entry indexes into. Why the others are wrong: - "targets" is a generic relationship term, not the schema-defined name. - "sourcePrims" is not the schema attribute name. - "instanceSources" is a plausible-sounding but incorrect distractor name.
questions.eZh:
prototypes 正是 UsdGeomPointInstancer 上用于列出候选 prim 的关系名称，protoIndices 的每个条目索引的就是这些候选 prim。其他选项错误的原因：
- “targets” 是通用的关系术语，并非 schema 定义的名称。
- “sourcePrims” 不是 schema 的属性名称。
- “instanceSources” 听起来合理，但属于错误的干扰项名称。

questions.q: A pipeline needs to permanently hide instance ids 12, 45, and 88 out of 500,000 point-instanced rocks without altering positions or protoIndices arrays for all other instances. Which attribute should be authored?
questions.qZh: 某流水线需要在 500,000 个点实例化的岩石中永久隐藏实例 id 12、45 和 88，且不改动其他所有实例的 positions 或 protoIndices 数组。应当创作（author）哪个属性？
o: protoIndices with those entries set to -1
scales set to 0 for those three indices
invisibleIds listing 12, 45, and 88
positions moved off-screen for those three indices
oZh: 将 protoIndices 中相应条目设为 -1
将这三个索引的 scales 设为 0
列出 12、45、88 的 invisibleIds
将这三个索引的 positions 移到屏幕外
questions.e: invisibleIds is the schema-provided attribute specifically designed to mark instance ids as hidden without disturbing the rest of the per-instance arrays. Why the others are wrong: - protoIndices does not support -1 as a valid 'hide' sentinel in the schema and would break array-index alignment expectations. - Zero-scaling works visually but is a manual hack that still leaves the instance 'active' for computations like bounds/collision, unlike the dedicated invisibleIds mechanism. - Moving positions off-screen is a workaround, not the schema-intended, exam-tested solution, and wastes render/bounds computation. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
invisibleIds 是 schema 专门提供的属性，用于把实例 id 标记为隐藏，同时不影响其余按实例的数组。其他选项错误的原因：
- 在 schema 中，protoIndices 并不支持把 -1 作为合法的“隐藏”哨兵值，那会破坏数组索引对齐的预期。
- 缩放设为 0 在视觉上可行，但属于手动变通做法；实例在包围盒/碰撞等计算中仍处于“活动”状态，这不同于专用的 invisibleIds 机制。
- 把 positions 移到屏幕外是一种绕过办法，并非 schema 设计意图和考试所考查的解决方案，而且会浪费渲染/包围盒计算。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A pipeline engineer needs to hand-author a small override layer that will be diffed in Git and reviewed by artists in a plain text editor. Which format should be used?
questions.qZh: 某流水线工程师需要手动编写一个小型的覆盖层（override layer），要在 Git 中做 diff，并由美术师在纯文本编辑器中审阅。应使用哪种格式？
o: .usdc
.usda
.usdz
compressed .usd
oZh: .usdc
.usda
.usdz
压缩的 .usd
questions.e: .usda is the ASCII text format, fully human-readable and diff-friendly in version control. Why the others are wrong: - .usdc is the binary Crate format — not readable as text and produces unreadable diffs. - .usdz is a package archive, not a raw editable layer. - There is no 'compressed .usd' variant; .usd is format-agnostic (ASCII or Crate), not a compression option.
questions.eZh:
.usda 是 ASCII 文本格式，完全可读，并且在版本控制中便于 diff。其他选项错误的原因：
- .usdc 是二进制的 Crate 格式——无法以文本读取，产生的 diff 也不可读。
- .usdz 是包归档，而不是可直接编辑的原始图层。
- 并不存在“压缩的 .usd”变体；.usd 与格式无关（可以是 ASCII 或 Crate），而不是一种压缩选项。

questions.q: A production scene contains millions of prims and must load as fast as possible at runtime with minimal disk footprint. Which format is BEST?
questions.qZh: 某个生产场景包含数百万个 prim，必须在运行时尽可能快地加载，且磁盘占用最小。哪种格式最佳？
o: .usda
.usdz
.usdc
Plain text .usd
oZh: .usda
.usdz
.usdc
纯文本 .usd
questions.e: .usdc (Crate binary) is compact and optimized for fast parsing/loading, ideal for heavy production scenes. Why the others are wrong: - .usda is text-based, larger and slower to parse at scale. - .usdz is a distribution package format, not intended as the primary authoring/runtime layer format for a pipeline scene. - A plain text .usd file behaves like .usda — large and slow to load, not optimal for millions of prims. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
.usdc（Crate 二进制）体积紧凑，针对快速解析/加载做了优化，非常适合重型生产场景。其他选项错误的原因：
- .usda 基于文本，体积更大，在大规模场景中解析更慢。
- .usdz 是分发包格式，并非流水线场景的主要创作/运行时图层格式。
- 纯文本的 .usd 文件行为与 .usda 相同——体积大、加载慢，对数百万个 prim 而言并不理想。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A developer packages a USDZ file for AR Quick Look. Inside, a material references a texture using the absolute path "/Users/artist/textures/wood.png" instead of a relative path. What happens when the package is opened on another device?
questions.qZh: 某开发者为 AR Quick Look 打包了一个 USDZ 文件。包内某个材质使用绝对路径 "/Users/artist/textures/wood.png" 而非相对路径引用纹理。当该包在另一台设备上打开时会发生什么？
o: The texture resolves correctly because USDZ always converts paths to relative automatically
The viewer downloads the texture from the original artist machine over the network
The texture fails to resolve because USDZ requires all internal references to be relative and self-contained
USDZ ignores materials entirely, so this has no effect
oZh: 纹理能正确解析，因为 USDZ 总是会自动将路径转换为相对路径
查看器通过网络从原美术师的机器上下载该纹理
纹理无法解析，因为 USDZ 要求所有内部引用都必须是相对路径且自包含
USDZ 完全忽略材质，因此没有任何影响
questions.e: USDZ packages must be fully self-contained with relative internal paths; an absolute path pointing to a machine-specific location breaks portability and will fail to resolve elsewhere. Why the others are wrong: - USD does not auto-rewrite absolute paths to relative on packaging — this must be done correctly at authoring/export time. - USDZ has no network-fetch mechanism for missing assets; it is a static, closed archive. - USDZ fully supports material and texture bindings; ignoring materials is not the behavior. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
USDZ 包必须完全自包含并使用相对内部路径；指向某台特定机器位置的绝对路径会破坏可移植性，在其他地方将无法解析。其他选项错误的原因：
- USD 在打包时不会自动把绝对路径改写为相对路径——这必须在创作/导出阶段正确完成。
- USDZ 没有为缺失资源提供网络获取机制；它是一个静态的封闭归档。
- USDZ 完整支持材质和纹理绑定；忽略材质并非其行为。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which zip archive requirement is mandatory for files packed inside a valid USDZ package?
questions.qZh: 对于打包进有效 USDZ 包内的文件，哪项 zip 归档要求是强制性的？
o: Deflate compression at maximum level for smallest file size
Files stored uncompressed (Store method) with 64-byte alignment
AES-256 encryption to protect proprietary geometry
Deflate compression with password protection
oZh: 使用最高级别的 Deflate 压缩以获得最小文件体积
文件以未压缩方式存储（Store 方法）并进行 64 字节对齐
使用 AES-256 加密以保护专有几何体
带密码保护的 Deflate 压缩
questions.e: USDZ requires uncompressed (Store) zip entries aligned to 64-byte boundaries so the archive contents can be memory-mapped directly without decompression. Why the others are wrong: - Deflate compression is explicitly disallowed because it prevents direct memory-mapping. - Encryption is not supported in USDZ and breaks compatibility with AR viewers. - Compression combined with encryption compounds both disallowed behaviors. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
USDZ 要求 zip 条目以未压缩（Store）方式存储并按 64 字节边界对齐，这样归档内容无需解压即可直接做内存映射。其他选项错误的原因：
- Deflate 压缩被明确禁止，因为它会妨碍直接进行内存映射。
- USDZ 不支持加密，而且加密会破坏与 AR 查看器的兼容性。
- 压缩与加密叠加会同时触犯这两项被禁止的行为。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: What is the key distinction between the generic .usd extension and the explicit .usdc extension?
questions.qZh: 通用的 .usd 扩展名与明确的 .usdc 扩展名之间的关键区别是什么？
o: .usd is always ASCII while .usdc is always binary
.usd is format-agnostic and may contain either ASCII or Crate binary content, while .usdc explicitly denotes Crate binary
.usd is a package format while .usdc is a single layer
.usdc is deprecated in favor of .usd
oZh: .usd 始终为 ASCII，而 .usdc 始终为二进制
.usd 与格式无关，可以包含 ASCII 或 Crate 二进制内容，而 .usdc 明确表示 Crate 二进制
.usd 是包格式，而 .usdc 是单个图层
.usdc 已被 .usd 取代而废弃
questions.e: The .usd extension does not indicate encoding — USD determines the actual format (ASCII or Crate) by inspecting the file's magic bytes/header. .usdc explicitly signals Crate binary. Why the others are wrong: - .usd can contain either encoding, it is not always ASCII. - .usdz, not .usd or .usdc, is the package format. - .usdc is an actively used, non-deprecated explicit binary extension. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
.usd 扩展名并不表示编码方式——USD 通过检查文件的 magic bytes/头部来确定实际格式（ASCII 或 Crate）。.usdc 则明确标识为 Crate 二进制。其他选项错误的原因：
- .usd 可以是任一种编码，并非始终为 ASCII。
- 包格式是 .usdz，而不是 .usd 或 .usdc。
- .usdc 是仍在积极使用的、未被废弃的显式二进制扩展名。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: An artist exports a rigged asset from a DCC tool using its native USD exporter. Several custom procedural node attributes have no corresponding USD schema representation. What best describes this export?
questions.qZh: 某美术师使用 DCC 工具原生的 USD 导出器导出一个绑定资产。有若干自定义程序化节点属性在 USD schema 中没有对应的表示形式。以下哪项最能描述这次导出？
o: Lossless conversion, since USD supports all DCC data types
Lossy conversion, since unmapped custom data may be dropped or approximated
Invalid conversion that will always fail to export
Lossless conversion as long as the file is saved as .usdc
oZh: 无损转换，因为 USD 支持所有 DCC 数据类型
有损转换，因为未映射的自定义数据可能被丢弃或近似处理
无效转换，将始终导出失败
只要文件保存为 .usdc 就是无损转换
questions.e: When DCC-specific attributes have no direct USD schema mapping, exporters commonly drop or approximate them, making the round-trip lossy. Why the others are wrong: - USD does not guarantee full coverage of every DCC's proprietary data types. - The export typically succeeds but with reduced fidelity rather than failing outright. - File format (.usdc vs .usda) affects encoding, not schema/data fidelity during conversion.
questions.eZh:
当 DCC 专有属性没有直接的 USD schema 映射时，导出器通常会将其丢弃或近似处理，使得往返转换变成有损的。其他选项错误的原因：
- USD 并不保证覆盖每个 DCC 的所有私有数据类型。
- 导出通常能够成功，只是保真度降低，而不是直接失败。
- 文件格式（.usdc 与 .usda）影响的是编码方式，而不是转换过程中的 schema/数据保真度。

questions.q: Which component in the OpenUSD architecture is responsible for translating an asset path string into an actual resolvable file location, and can be customized per-pipeline?
questions.qZh: 在 OpenUSD 架构中，哪个组件负责将资产路径字符串转换为实际可解析的文件位置，并且可以针对每条流水线进行定制？
o: The Hydra render delegate
The AssetResolver (Ar plugin / ArResolver)
The SdfLayer cache
The UsdStage composition engine
oZh: Hydra 渲染委托（render delegate）
AssetResolver（Ar 插件 / ArResolver）
SdfLayer 缓存
UsdStage 合成引擎
questions.e: The AssetResolver (ArResolver interface) handles resolving asset path strings to actual file locations and can be replaced with custom pipeline-specific resolvers (e.g., for versioning or search paths). Why the others are wrong: - Hydra render delegates handle scene rendering, not asset path resolution. - SdfLayer caching manages loaded layer data, not path-to-location resolution logic. - UsdStage composition assembles layers using already-resolved paths; it relies on the resolver rather than performing resolution itself. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
AssetResolver（ArResolver 接口）负责将资产路径字符串解析为实际的文件位置，并且可以替换为针对特定流水线的自定义解析器（例如用于版本管理或搜索路径）。其他选项错误的原因：
- Hydra 渲染委托负责场景渲染，而不是资产路径解析。
- SdfLayer 缓存管理已加载的图层数据，而不是路径到位置的解析逻辑。
- UsdStage 合成使用已经解析好的路径来组装图层；它依赖解析器，而非自行执行解析。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A studio needs to send a fully self-contained asset (mesh, materials, textures) to an external partner using a different application on a different OS, with zero risk of broken file links. Which delivery strategy is BEST?
questions.qZh: 某工作室需要把一个完全自包含的资产（网格、材质、纹理）发送给外部合作伙伴，对方使用不同操作系统上的不同应用程序，且绝不能出现文件链接断裂的风险。哪种交付策略最佳？
o: Send a .usda layer with anchored absolute paths to the studio's asset server
Send a .usdc layer alongside a separate zip of loose textures
Send a USDZ package with all referenced assets included and relative internal paths
Send a .usd file referencing textures via a network share path
oZh: 发送一个 .usda 图层，其中使用指向该工作室资产服务器的锚定绝对路径
发送 .usdc 图层，并附带一个单独存放零散纹理的 zip 包
发送一个 USDZ 包，其中包含所有被引用的资产并使用相对内部路径
发送一个 .usd 文件，通过网络共享路径引用纹理
questions.e: USDZ bundles the layer and all referenced assets into one uncompressed, self-contained archive using relative paths, guaranteeing portability across machines and applications. Why the others are wrong: - Anchored absolute paths to an internal server will not resolve outside the studio's network/filesystem. - Separating textures from the layer in a loose zip reintroduces manual relinking risk and breaks self-containment. - Network share paths are inherently non-portable outside the originating network. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
USDZ 将图层和所有被引用的资产打包进一个未压缩、自包含的归档中，并使用相对路径，从而保证在不同机器和应用程序之间的可移植性。其他选项错误的原因：
- 指向内部服务器的锚定绝对路径在该工作室网络/文件系统之外无法解析。
- 把纹理与图层分开放在零散 zip 中会重新引入手动重新链接的风险，破坏自包含性。
- 网络共享路径本质上无法在来源网络之外使用。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A pipeline script must create a Sphere prim at /World/Ball and time-sample its radius from frame 1 to frame 24 for an animated pulse effect. Which approach BEST meets this requirement?
questions.qZh: 某个流水线脚本必须在 /World/Ball 处创建一个 Sphere prim，并将其 radius 从第 1 帧到第 24 帧进行时间采样，以实现脉动的动画效果。哪种做法最符合该要求？
o: stage.DefinePrim('/World/Ball', 'Sphere'); prim.GetAttribute('radius').Set(radius at(1))
sphere = UsdGeom.Sphere.Define(stage, '/World/Ball'); for f in range(1,25): sphere.GetRadiusAttr().Set(radius at(f), f)
sphere = UsdGeom.Sphere.Define(stage, '/World/Ball'); sphere.GetRadiusAttr().Set(radius at(12))
prim = stage.DefinePrim('/World/Ball'); prim.CreateRelationship('radius').SetTargets(['/World/RadiusCurve'])
oZh: stage.DefinePrim('/World/Ball', 'Sphere'); prim.GetAttribute('radius').Set(radius at(1))
sphere = UsdGeom.Sphere.Define(stage, '/World/Ball'); for f in range(1,25): sphere.GetRadiusAttr().Set(radius at(f), f)
sphere = UsdGeom.Sphere.Define(stage, '/World/Ball'); sphere.GetRadiusAttr().Set(radius at(12))
prim = stage.DefinePrim('/World/Ball'); prim.CreateRelationship('radius').SetTargets(['/World/RadiusCurve'])
questions.e: Define() returns a typed UsdGeom.Sphere object with a ready-made GetRadiusAttr() accessor, and calling Set(value, time) for each frame authors true time-sampled data across the required range. Why the others are wrong: - Generic DefinePrim() with a string typeName returns a plain Usd.Prim with no schema-specific attribute created automatically; the radius attribute would not even exist unless separately created. - Calling Set() with a single time value only authors one time sample, not an animated range across frames 1-24. - Relationships store Sdf.Path targets to other objects, not scalar animated values; radius must be an authored attribute, not a relationship. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
Define() 返回一个带类型的 UsdGeom.Sphere 对象，并自带开箱即用的 GetRadiusAttr() 访问器；为每一帧调用 Set(value, time) 即可在所需范围内创作出真正的时间采样数据。其他选项错误的原因：
- 使用字符串 typeName 的通用 DefinePrim() 返回的是普通的 Usd.Prim，不会自动创建任何 schema 专有属性；除非另行创建，radius 属性甚至都不存在。
- 只以单个时间值调用 Set() 只会创作一个时间采样，而不是第 1 到 24 帧的动画区间。
- 关系存储的是指向其他对象的 Sdf.Path 目标，而不是标量动画值；radius 必须是一个被创作的属性，而不是关系。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which Sdf.Path string correctly addresses the 'size' attribute authored on the prim /World/Cube?
questions.qZh: 哪个 Sdf.Path 字符串能正确寻址创作在 prim /World/Cube 上的 'size' 属性？
o: Sdf.Path('/World/Cube.size')
Sdf.Path('/World/Cube/size')
Sdf.Path('/World.Cube.size')
Sdf.Path('World/Cube.size')
oZh: Sdf.Path('/World/Cube.size')
Sdf.Path('/World/Cube/size')
Sdf.Path('/World.Cube.size')
Sdf.Path('World/Cube.size')
questions.e: A dot ('.') separates a prim path from a property (attribute or relationship) name in Sdf.Path syntax; slashes only ever separate namespace (child prim) segments. Why the others are wrong: - A slash before 'size' would namespace it as a child prim, not a property — invalid for addressing an attribute. - Placing a dot after 'World' incorrectly treats 'Cube' as a property of World rather than a child prim. - Omitting the leading slash makes this a relative path, which cannot be used to address an absolute stage location directly. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
在 Sdf.Path 语法中，点号（'.'）用于分隔 prim 路径与属性（attribute 或 relationship）名称；斜杠只用于分隔命名空间（子 prim）段。其他选项错误的原因：
- 在 'size' 前使用斜杠会把它当作命名空间下的子 prim，而非属性——这对于寻址属性来说是无效的。
- 把点号放在 'World' 之后，会错误地把 'Cube' 当作 World 的属性，而不是子 prim。
- 省略开头的斜杠会得到一个相对路径，无法直接用于寻址 stage 中的绝对位置。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A pipeline tool needs to build and validate a temporary USD stage entirely in memory without ever writing a file to disk. Which call should it use?
questions.qZh: 某个流水线工具需要完全在内存中构建并验证一个临时 USD stage，且绝不向磁盘写入文件。它应该使用哪个调用？
o: Usd.Stage.CreateNew('/dev/null')
Usd.Stage.Open(None)
Usd.Stage.CreateInMemory()
Sdf.Layer.CreateAnonymous()
oZh: Usd.Stage.CreateNew('/dev/null')
Usd.Stage.Open(None)
Usd.Stage.CreateInMemory()
Sdf.Layer.CreateAnonymous()
questions.e: Usd.Stage.CreateInMemory() creates an anonymous, fully functional stage with no backing file on disk, ideal for scripted validation or tests. Why the others are wrong: - CreateNew() with a null-device path is not a supported or portable USD pattern and still implies file-backed semantics. - Open(None) is not a valid call signature for Usd.Stage.Open and will raise an error. - Sdf.Layer.CreateAnonymous() creates an anonymous layer, not a Usd.Stage, so it lacks stage-level APIs like traversal and prim definition helpers.
questions.eZh:
Usd.Stage.CreateInMemory() 会创建一个匿名且功能完整的 stage，磁盘上没有任何后端文件，非常适合脚本化的校验或测试。其他选项错误的原因：
- 用空设备路径调用 CreateNew() 不是受支持的、可移植的 USD 用法，而且仍然带有基于文件的语义。
- Open(None) 不是 Usd.Stage.Open 的有效调用签名，会抛出错误。
- Sdf.Layer.CreateAnonymous() 创建的是匿名图层，而不是 Usd.Stage，因此缺少遍历、prim 定义辅助函数等 stage 级 API。

questions.q: You are authoring the 'points' attribute on a UsdGeomMesh prim with thousands of vertex positions. Which value type should be passed to Attribute.Set()?
questions.qZh: 你在 UsdGeomMesh prim 上创作包含数千个顶点位置的 'points' 属性。应向 Attribute.Set() 传入哪种值类型？
o: A Vt.Vec3fArray of Gf.Vec3f values
A single Gf.Vec3f value
A Python dictionary of index-to-position pairs
A Gf.Matrix4d representing all positions
oZh: 一个由 Gf.Vec3f 值构成的 Vt.Vec3fArray
单个 Gf.Vec3f 值
一个索引到位置键值对的 Python 字典
一个表示所有位置的 Gf.Matrix4d
questions.e: USD array-valued attributes are stored internally as typed Vt.Array containers; for point3f[] attributes like 'points', the correct construct is Vt.Vec3fArray populated with Gf.Vec3f elements. Why the others are wrong: - A single Vec3f only represents one point, not an array of vertex positions. - USD attributes do not accept arbitrary dictionaries — the schema expects a strongly-typed array matching the attribute's declared Sdf.ValueTypeName. - Matrix4d represents a 4x4 transform, not an array of point positions, and is the wrong shape entirely.
questions.eZh:
USD 中数组类型的属性在内部以带类型的 Vt.Array 容器存储；对于 'points' 这类 point3f[] 属性，正确的构造是填充了 Gf.Vec3f 元素的 Vt.Vec3fArray。其他选项错误的原因：
- 单个 Vec3f 只能表示一个点，而不是一组顶点位置。
- USD 属性不接受任意字典——schema 要求传入与属性所声明 Sdf.ValueTypeName 相符的强类型数组。
- Matrix4d 表示的是 4x4 变换矩阵，而不是一组点位置，形状完全不匹配。

questions.q: What is the key functional difference between a typed schema Define() helper (e.g., UsdGeom.Xform.Define) and the generic Stage.DefinePrim()?
questions.qZh: 带类型 schema 的 Define() 辅助函数（例如 UsdGeom.Xform.Define）与通用的 Stage.DefinePrim() 之间的关键功能差异是什么？
o: Define() only works for Xform prims, while DefinePrim() supports all types
They behave identically; Define() is a deprecated legacy alias for DefinePrim()
DefinePrim() cannot set a typeName at all, only Define() can assign one
Define() sets the typeName and returns a typed schema object with built-in attribute accessors; DefinePrim() requires a typeName string and returns a generic Usd.Prim
oZh: Define() 只适用于 Xform prim，而 DefinePrim() 支持所有类型
两者行为完全相同；Define() 是 DefinePrim() 已废弃的遗留别名
DefinePrim() 完全无法设置 typeName，只有 Define() 才能指定
Define() 会设置 typeName 并返回一个带有内置属性访问器的带类型 schema 对象；DefinePrim() 需要传入 typeName 字符串，并返回通用的 Usd.Prim
questions.e: Typed Define() helpers exist for every core schema (Xform, Sphere, Mesh, etc.), each setting the typeName and returning a convenience wrapper object exposing schema-specific Get/Create Attr() methods; DefinePrim() is schema-agnostic and returns a bare Usd.Prim. Why the others are wrong: - Every core UsdGeom/UsdShade schema class has its own Define() helper, not just Xform. - The two are not interchangeable aliases; Define() adds schema-specific convenience methods that DefinePrim() lacks. - DefinePrim() accepts an optional typeName argument (e.g., stage.DefinePrim(path, 'Sphere')) and can set it just fine, just without the typed wrapper. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
每个核心 schema（Xform、Sphere、Mesh 等）都有对应的带类型 Define() 辅助函数，它们各自设置 typeName，并返回一个便捷包装对象，提供 schema 专有的 Get/Create Attr() 方法；DefinePrim() 与 schema 无关，返回的是裸的 Usd.Prim。其他选项错误的原因：
- 每个核心 UsdGeom/UsdShade schema 类都有自己的 Define() 辅助函数，不只是 Xform。
- 两者并非可以互换的别名；Define() 提供了 DefinePrim() 所缺乏的 schema 专有便捷方法。
- DefinePrim() 接受可选的 typeName 参数（例如 stage.DefinePrim(path, 'Sphere')），完全可以设置 typeName，只是没有带类型的包装对象。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: A tech artist wants attribute 'displayColor' to have a fallback value at all times PLUS a specific override at frame 10. Which code correctly achieves both?
questions.qZh: 某技术美术希望属性 'displayColor' 始终具有一个回退值，同时在第 10 帧还有一个特定的覆盖值。哪段代码能正确实现两者？
o: attr.Set(default val, Usd.TimeCode.Default()); attr.Set(frame10 val, Usd.TimeCode.Default())
attr.Set(frame10 val, 10) only, with no default value authored
attr.Set(default val); attr.Set(frame10 val, 10)
prim.CreateRelationship('displayColor').SetTargets(['/World/Frame10Color'])
oZh: attr.Set(default val, Usd.TimeCode.Default()); attr.Set(frame10 val, Usd.TimeCode.Default())
仅 attr.Set(frame10 val, 10)，未创作默认值
attr.Set(default val); attr.Set(frame10 val, 10)
prim.CreateRelationship('displayColor').SetTargets(['/World/Frame10Color'])
questions.e: Calling Set(value) with no time argument authors the DEFAULT opinion (equivalent to Usd.TimeCode.Default()); calling Set(value, time) separately authors an animated time sample at that frame — both opinions can coexist on the same attribute. Why the others are wrong: - Calling Set() twice with Usd.TimeCode.Default() only ever authors the default value — the second call simply overwrites the first, never producing a frame-10 time sample. - Authoring only a time sample with no default leaves the attribute's default-time query (Usd.TimeCode.Default()) unresolved/falling back to the schema's fallback, not the desired designed default. - Relationships store Sdf.Path targets, not color values, and cannot represent a time-varying scalar/vector attribute. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
不带时间参数调用 Set(value) 会创作 DEFAULT 时间点的取值（等价于 Usd.TimeCode.Default()）；另外单独调用 Set(value, time) 则会在该帧创作出一个动画时间采样——两种取值可以共存于同一个属性上。其他选项错误的原因：
- 两次都带 Usd.TimeCode.Default() 调用 Set() 只会创作默认值——第二次调用只是覆盖第一次，永远不会产生第 10 帧的时间采样。
- 只创作时间采样而没有默认值，会使属性在默认时间（Usd.TimeCode.Default()）的查询无法解析/回退到 schema 的兜底值，而非期望的设计默认值。
- 关系存储的是 Sdf.Path 目标，而不是颜色值，也无法表达随时间变化的标量/向量属性。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which Gf value type is required when authoring the xformOp:transform attribute on a UsdGeomXformable prim?
questions.qZh: 在 UsdGeomXformable prim 上创作 xformOp:transform 属性时，需要使用哪种 Gf 值类型？
o: Gf.Matrix4f
Gf.Vec3d
Gf.Matrix4d
Vt.Matrix4dArray
oZh: Gf.Matrix4f
Gf.Vec3d
Gf.Matrix4d
Vt.Matrix4dArray
questions.e: UsdGeom standardizes all xformOp:transform values on double-precision Gf.Matrix4d; passing any other type raises a value-type mismatch when authoring the attribute. Why the others are wrong: - Gf.Matrix4f is a valid GfMath type but is not the schema-declared value type for xformOp:transform, which is always matrix4d. - Vec3d represents a single 3-component vector (e.g., translate/scale), not a full 4x4 transform matrix. - Vt.Matrix4dArray is an array container for multiple matrices; xformOp:transform is a single scalar matrix4d attribute, not an array.
questions.eZh:
UsdGeom 将所有 xformOp:transform 的取值统一为双精度的 Gf.Matrix4d；在创作该属性时传入其他任何类型都会引发值类型不匹配。其他选项错误的原因：
- Gf.Matrix4f 是有效的 GfMath 类型，但并非 xformOp:transform 声明的值类型，后者始终为 matrix4d。
- Vec3d 表示单个三分量向量（例如位移/缩放），而不是完整的 4x4 变换矩阵。
- Vt.Matrix4dArray 是存放多个矩阵的数组容器；xformOp:transform 是单个 matrix4d 标量属性，而非数组。

questions.q: A developer intends to open an existing stage file for editing but accidentally calls Usd.Stage.CreateNew() on that same file path instead of Usd.Stage.Open(). What happens?
questions.qZh: 某开发者想要打开一个已存在的 stage 文件进行编辑，却误在该文件路径上调用了 Usd.Stage.CreateNew() 而不是 Usd.Stage.Open()。会发生什么？
o: USD raises an error because the file already exists
USD silently treats the call the same as Open() and preserves existing content
USD appends the new empty stage as a sublayer beneath the existing content
The existing file's contents are overwritten/reset, losing all previously authored data
oZh: USD 抛出错误，因为文件已存在
USD 会静默地将该调用视为与 Open() 相同，并保留已有内容
USD 会将新的空 stage 作为 sublayer 附加到已有内容之下
已有文件的内容被覆盖/重置，此前创作的所有数据都会丢失
questions.e: CreateNew() always creates a fresh root layer at the given path, overwriting any existing file — it does not check for or preserve prior content, making it a common destructive pipeline mistake. Why the others are wrong: - CreateNew() does not raise an error on an existing path by default; it silently replaces the file, which is exactly why this is a common exam trap. - CreateNew() and Open() have distinct semantics; CreateNew() never preserves existing content. - CreateNew() does not perform any sublayer composition — it simply creates a brand-new, independent root layer at the path. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
CreateNew() 总是在给定路径上创建一个全新的根图层，覆盖任何已有文件——它不会检查或保留原有内容，因此成为流水线中常见的破坏性失误。其他选项错误的原因：
- CreateNew() 默认不会在已有路径上抛出错误；它会静默替换文件，这正是它常被设为考试陷阱的原因。
- CreateNew() 与 Open() 语义不同；CreateNew() 从不保留已有内容。
- CreateNew() 不做任何 sublayer 合成——它只是在该路径上创建一个全新且独立的根图层。⚠️ 考试中经常被忽略——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: You need to traverse a stage and skip entire subtrees rooted at prims of kind "group" to speed up processing, without visiting their descendants. Which approach is correct?
questions.qZh: 你需要在遍历 stage 时跳过以 kind 为 "group" 的 prim 为根的整个子树，以加快处理速度，同时不访问它们的后代。哪种做法是正确的？
o: Use stage.Traverse() and call prim.GetChildren() recursively, checking kind manually
Use Usd.PrimRange(stage.GetPseudoRoot(), Usd.TraverseInstanceProxies()) and continue on each prim
Use stage.TraverseAll() and filter results afterward with a list comprehension
Use Usd.PrimRange(prim), and call range.PruneChildren() when the iterator is on a "group" kind prim
oZh: 使用 stage.Traverse() 并递归调用 prim.GetChildren()，手动检查 kind
使用 Usd.PrimRange(stage.GetPseudoRoot(), Usd.TraverseInstanceProxies())，并对每个 prim 继续遍历
使用 stage.TraverseAll()，之后用列表推导式过滤结果
使用 Usd.PrimRange(prim)，并在迭代器位于 kind 为 "group" 的 prim 上时调用 range.PruneChildren()
questions.e: Usd.PrimRange exposes PruneChildren(), which must be called while the iterator is positioned on the current prim to stop descent into that prim's children during the same pass — this is the intended pruning mechanism. Why the others are wrong: - Works but reimplements traversal manually instead of using the built-in, more efficient PrimRange pruning API the exam tests - TraverseInstanceProxies() changes which instance content is visited, it has nothing to do with pruning subtrees by kind - TraverseAll() visits inactive/undefined/abstract prims too and post-filtering doesn't avoid the cost of visiting the pruned subtree ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
Usd.PrimRange 提供了 PruneChildren()，必须在迭代器定位到当前 prim 时调用它，才能在同一遍遍历中停止向该 prim 的子节点下降 —— 这正是预期的剪枝机制。其他选项错误的原因：
- 可以工作，但手动重新实现了遍历，而不是使用考试所考查的内置、更高效的 PrimRange 剪枝 API
- TraverseInstanceProxies() 改变的是访问哪些实例内容，与按 kind 剪枝子树无关
- TraverseAll() 也会访问 inactive/undefined/abstract 的 prim，而且事后过滤并不能避免访问被剪枝子树的代价
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: Which call correctly adds a reference to an external asset on a prim from Python?
questions.qZh: 在 Python 中，哪种调用方式可以正确地在 prim 上添加对外部资产的引用？
o: prim.GetReferences().AddReference("/path/to/asset.usd")
prim.GetPayloads().AddPayload("/path/to/asset.usd")
prim.AddReference("/path/to/asset.usd")
Sdf.Reference(prim, "/path/to/asset.usd")
oZh: prim.GetReferences().AddReference("/path/to/asset.usd")
prim.GetPayloads().AddPayload("/path/to/asset.usd")
prim.AddReference("/path/to/asset.usd")
Sdf.Reference(prim, "/path/to/asset.usd")
questions.e: GetReferences() returns a Usd.References object whose AddReference(assetPath, primPath="") method authors a reference arc on the prim. Why the others are wrong: - AddPayload authors a payload arc, which has different load-on-demand semantics — wrong arc type for this requirement - Prim has no AddReference method directly; references must be authored through GetReferences() - Sdf.Reference is a plain data descriptor for a reference target, not a method that authors anything onto a prim
questions.eZh:
GetReferences() 返回一个 Usd.References 对象，其 AddReference(assetPath, primPath="") 方法会在 prim 上创作（author）一条 reference arc。其他选项错误的原因：
- AddPayload 创作的是 payload arc，其按需加载语义不同 —— 对本需求来说是错误的 arc 类型
- Prim 本身没有 AddReference 方法；引用必须通过 GetReferences() 来创作
- Sdf.Reference 只是描述引用目标的普通数据描述符，并不是在 prim 上创作内容的方法

questions.q: Which snippet correctly authors a variant set "shadingVariant" with a variant "red" and selects it?
questions.qZh: 哪段代码能正确地创作变体集 "shadingVariant"（其中包含变体 "red"）并将其选中？
o: vs = prim.GetVariantSet("shadingVariant"); vs.AddVariant("red"); vs.SetVariantSelection("red")
prim.GetVariantSets().SetVariantSelection("shadingVariant", "red")
vs = prim.GetVariantSets().GetVariantSet("shadingVariant"); vs.SetVariantSelection("red")
vs = prim.GetVariantSets().AddVariantSet("shadingVariant"); vs.AddVariant("red"); vs.SetVariantSelection("red")
oZh: vs = prim.GetVariantSet("shadingVariant"); vs.AddVariant("red"); vs.SetVariantSelection("red")
prim.GetVariantSets().SetVariantSelection("shadingVariant", "red")
vs = prim.GetVariantSets().GetVariantSet("shadingVariant"); vs.SetVariantSelection("red")
vs = prim.GetVariantSets().AddVariantSet("shadingVariant"); vs.AddVariant("red"); vs.SetVariantSelection("red")
questions.e: AddVariantSet() authors the variantSet's existence, AddVariant() authors an available option, and SetVariantSelection() authors the selection opinion at the current EditTarget — this is the required sequence. Why the others are wrong: - Prim has no singular GetVariantSet method; sets are accessed via GetVariantSets() - GetVariantSets() has no combined SetVariantSelection(setName, variantName) signature - GetVariantSet retrieves a handle to an existing set but AddVariant was never called, so the "red" variant doesn't exist and selection will fail to resolve any opinions ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
AddVariantSet() 创作 variantSet 的存在性，AddVariant() 创作一个可用选项，SetVariantSelection() 在当前 EditTarget 上创作选择意见 —— 这就是所需的调用顺序。其他选项错误的原因：
- Prim 没有单个的 GetVariantSet 方法；变体集要通过 GetVariantSets() 访问
- GetVariantSets() 没有 SetVariantSelection(setName, variantName) 这种组合签名
- GetVariantSet 只是获取已有变体集的句柄，但从未调用 AddVariant，因此 "red" 变体并不存在，选择操作将无法解析出任何意见
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: Which statement correctly describes Hydra's role in a USD pipeline?
questions.qZh: 哪项陈述正确描述了 Hydra 在 USD 流程中的角色？
o: The Hydra scene delegate authors edits back into the stage's session layer during rendering
Hydra render delegates such as Storm or Arnold can modify prim opinions in the active EditTarget
UsdImagingGL requires stage.SetEditTarget() to be called before every render call
The scene delegate translates USD scene data into the Hydra render index, and the render delegate consumes that index to render, with no path to author back into USD
oZh: Hydra 的 scene delegate 在渲染过程中把编辑回写到 stage 的 session layer 中
诸如 Storm 或 Arnold 之类的 Hydra render delegate 可以修改活动 EditTarget 中的 prim 意见
UsdImagingGL 要求在每次渲染调用之前调用 stage.SetEditTarget()
scene delegate 将 USD 场景数据转换为 Hydra render index，render delegate 消费该 index 进行渲染，不存在回写到 USD 的路径
questions.e: Hydra is strictly a render-only abstraction: scene delegates feed the render index, render delegates rasterize/render from it, and neither writes back to the USD stage. Why the others are wrong: - Scene delegates read scene data for rendering, they never author edits to any layer - Render delegates are consumers of the render index for rendering only, they have no authoring API into USD - Rendering via Hydra does not require or use SetEditTarget at all — EditTarget concerns authoring, not rendering ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
Hydra 严格来说只是一个仅用于渲染的抽象：scene delegate 负责向 render index 提供数据，render delegate 从中光栅化/渲染，两者都不会回写到 USD stage。其他选项错误的原因：
- scene delegate 只是为渲染读取场景数据，从不向任何 layer 创作编辑
- render delegate 只是 render index 的消费方，仅用于渲染，没有面向 USD 的创作 API
- 通过 Hydra 渲染完全不需要也不会使用 SetEditTarget —— EditTarget 关注的是创作而非渲染
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: A stage contains instanceable references. Some prims used for cross-referencing (e.g., material bindings) live inside instanced prototypes and are absent from a default stage.Traverse(). How do you include them as instance proxies?
questions.qZh: 某个 stage 包含可实例化（instanceable）的引用。一些用于交叉引用的 prim（例如材质绑定）位于被实例化的原型内部，在默认的 stage.Traverse() 中不会出现。如何将它们作为 instance proxy 一并包含进来？
o: Call stage.Traverse() a second time
Call prim.SetInstanceable(False) on every prim before traversal
Use Usd.PrimCompositionQuery instead of PrimRange
Use Usd.PrimRange(stage.GetPseudoRoot(), Usd.TraverseInstanceProxies())
oZh: 再次调用 stage.Traverse()
在遍历之前对每个 prim 调用 prim.SetInstanceable(False)
使用 Usd.PrimCompositionQuery 代替 PrimRange
Usd.PrimRange(stage.GetPseudoRoot(), Usd.TraverseInstanceProxies())
questions.e: Usd.TraverseInstanceProxies() is the predicate that allows PrimRange to descend into instanced prototypes and surface their contents as instance proxy prims within the traversal. Why the others are wrong: - Repeating the same traversal call with the same predicate returns the same filtered result - De-instancing every prim defeats the purpose of instancing and is destructive/expensive at scale, unnecessary for read-only inspection - PrimCompositionQuery inspects composition arcs for a single prim; it is not a bulk stage-traversal mechanism ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
Usd.TraverseInstanceProxies() 是一个谓词，它允许 PrimRange 进入被实例化的原型内部，并在遍历中将其内容作为 instance proxy prim 呈现出来。其他选项错误的原因：
- 用同样的谓词重复同样的遍历调用，只会得到相同的过滤结果
- 对每个 prim 取消实例化既违背了实例化的目的，在大规模场景下也具有破坏性且开销高昂，对于只读检查而言完全没必要
- PrimCompositionQuery 用于检查单个 prim 的 composition arc，并不是批量遍历 stage 的机制
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: A stage has root.usd (strongest) with a weaker sublayer override.usd. You want subsequent authoring calls, such as prim.CreateAttribute().Set(), to write into override.usd. Which call achieves this?
questions.qZh: 某个 stage 的 root.usd（最强）带有一个较弱的子层 override.usd。你希望后续的创作调用（例如 prim.CreateAttribute().Set()）写入 override.usd。哪种调用可以实现？
o: stage.GetRootLayer().SetSubLayerPaths(["override.usd"])
stage.SetEditTarget(Usd.EditTarget(overrideLayer))
prim.GetPrimStack()[-1].layer = overrideLayer
Sdf.Layer.FindOrOpen("override.usd").SetDefaultPrim(...)
oZh: stage.GetRootLayer().SetSubLayerPaths(["override.usd"])
stage.SetEditTarget(Usd.EditTarget(overrideLayer))
prim.GetPrimStack()[-1].layer = overrideLayer
Sdf.Layer.FindOrOpen("override.usd").SetDefaultPrim(...)
questions.e: Usd.EditTarget(layer), built from a layer already in the stage's layer stack, passed to stage.SetEditTarget(), routes all subsequent authoring calls to that layer. Why the others are wrong: - SetSubLayerPaths only changes which layers are included and their strength order, it does not target new authoring - PrimStack entries returned by GetPrimStack() are read-only introspection objects and cannot be reassigned to redirect authoring - SetDefaultPrim only marks which prim is the layer's default prim; it has no effect on edit targeting
questions.eZh:
Usd.EditTarget(layer) 由 stage layer stack 中已有的 layer 构建，传入 stage.SetEditTarget() 后，所有后续的创作调用都会被路由到该 layer。其他选项错误的原因：
- SetSubLayerPaths 只改变包含哪些 layer 以及它们的强度顺序，并不会为新的创作指定目标
- GetPrimStack() 返回的 PrimStack 条目是只读的内省对象，无法通过重新赋值来重定向创作
- SetDefaultPrim 只标记该 layer 的默认 prim，对编辑目标没有任何影响

questions.q: You need to determine programmatically whether a prim's winning opinion originated from a reference arc or a direct local-layer override, to debug an unexpected value. Which API is purpose-built for this?
questions.qZh: 你需要在程序中判断某个 prim 胜出的意见究竟来自 reference arc 还是本地 layer 的直接覆盖，以排查异常值。哪个 API 是专为此设计的？
o: prim.GetPrimStack() only, without further processing
Usd.PrimCompositionQuery(prim).GetCompositionArcs()
stage.GetEditTarget().GetLayer()
Usd.PrimRange(prim).IsPostVisit()
oZh: 仅使用 prim.GetPrimStack()，不做任何进一步处理
Usd.PrimCompositionQuery(prim).GetCompositionArcs()
stage.GetEditTarget().GetLayer()
Usd.PrimRange(prim).IsPostVisit()
questions.e: Usd.PrimCompositionQuery(prim).GetCompositionArcs() returns UsdCompositionArc objects that explicitly describe each contributing arc's type (reference, payload, inherit, variant, specialize, etc.) and source layer/path — exactly the tool for this inspection. Why the others are wrong: - PrimStack gives an ordered list of contributing PrimSpecs but doesn't label the arc type each one came from without extra cross-referencing - GetEditTarget().GetLayer() only reveals where new authoring would go, not where existing opinions originated - IsPostVisit() is a PrimRange iteration-order flag unrelated to composition arc inspection
questions.eZh:
Usd.PrimCompositionQuery(prim).GetCompositionArcs() 返回 UsdCompositionArc 对象，明确描述每个贡献 arc 的类型（reference、payload、inherit、variant、specialize 等）以及来源 layer/路径 —— 这正是完成此项检查的合适工具。其他选项错误的原因：
- PrimStack 给出的是贡献 PrimSpec 的有序列表，若不做额外交叉比对，它不会标明每个条目来自哪种 arc
- GetEditTarget().GetLayer() 只能显示新的创作会写入何处，而不能显示已有意见的来源
- IsPostVisit() 是 PrimRange 的迭代顺序标志，与 composition arc 检查无关

questions.q: By default, calling stage.Traverse() with no arguments will SKIP which of the following?
questions.qZh: 默认情况下，不带参数调用 stage.Traverse() 会跳过以下哪一项？
o: Prims with kind "component"
Prims with a variant set authored on them
Inactive prims and prims that are purely "over" (undefined, with no defining spec)
Prims that have a payload arc
oZh: kind 为 "component" 的 prim
创作了变体集的 prim
inactive 的 prim，以及纯粹为 "over" 的 prim（未定义，没有定义性 spec）
带有 payload arc 的 prim
questions.e: The default predicate (UsdPrimDefaultPredicate) requires IsActive && IsDefined && IsLoaded && !IsAbstract, so inactive prims and undefined "over"-only prims are excluded from default traversal. Why the others are wrong: - Kind metadata has no bearing on the default traversal predicate - Having an authored variant set does not affect whether a prim passes the default predicate - Merely having a payload arc doesn't exclude a prim by itself; exclusion relates to load state, not the mere presence of a payload ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
默认谓词（UsdPrimDefaultPredicate）要求 IsActive && IsDefined && IsLoaded && !IsAbstract，因此 inactive 的 prim 以及仅有 "over" 的未定义 prim 会被默认遍历排除。其他选项错误的原因：
- kind 元数据与默认遍历谓词无关
- 是否创作了变体集不影响 prim 是否通过默认谓词
- 仅仅带有 payload arc 本身并不会排除一个 prim；排除与否取决于加载状态，而非 payload 是否存在
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: In usdview, a mesh that appears correctly in the interactive viewport is missing from the final production render. The Composition tab confirms the prim is not overridden or hidden anywhere in the layer stack. What is the MOST likely cause?
questions.qZh: 在 usdview 中，某个 mesh 在交互视图中显示正常，但在最终的产品渲染中却不见了。Composition 标签页确认该 prim 在 layer stack 的任何位置都没有被覆盖或隐藏。最可能的原因是什么？
o: The prim's purpose attribute is set to proxy
The prim is inside an unloaded payload
The prim's visibility attribute is set to invisible
The prim has a variant set with no selection
oZh: 该 prim 的 purpose 属性被设为 proxy
该 prim 位于未加载的 payload 内部
该 prim 的 visibility 属性被设为 invisible
该 prim 有一个未做选择的变体集
questions.e: purpose=proxy means the prim is meant as a lightweight interactive stand-in; render-purpose traversals (used by production renderers) skip it entirely, while the default usdview viewport shows both render and proxy purpose by default. Why the others are wrong: - An unloaded payload would make the prim invisible in usdview too, not just missing from the render - invisible visibility hides the prim everywhere, including the viewport, contradicting the scenario - A variant set with no selection typically falls back to a default, it wouldn't selectively hide geometry only at render time ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
purpose=proxy 表示该 prim 是用作轻量级交互替代物的；而基于 render purpose 的遍历（产品渲染器所用的那种）会完全跳过它，而 usdview 的默认视口默认同时显示 render 和 proxy purpose。其他选项错误的原因：
- 未加载的 payload 会让该 prim 在 usdview 中也不可见，而不只是渲染中缺失
- invisible 的 visibility 会在所有地方隐藏该 prim，包括视图内，与题述情形矛盾
- 未做选择的变体集通常会回退到默认值，不会在只渲染时选择性地隐藏几何体
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: A stage has a prim with both a reference arc and an inherit arc contributing opinions to the same attribute. Using the composition inspector's Index view, which arc's opinion wins by default LIVRPS ordering?
questions.qZh: 某个 stage 中的 prim 同时有 reference arc 和 inherit arc 向同一属性贡献意见。使用 composition inspector 的 Index 视图，按默认的 LIVRPS 顺序哪种 arc 的意见胜出？
o: The reference arc wins because references are stronger than inherits
The inherit arc always wins because inherits are class-based
Whichever arc was added last in the layer wins
The specializes arc wins because it is evaluated first
oZh: reference arc 胜出，因为 reference 比 inherit 更强
inherit arc 总是胜出，因为 inherit 是基于 class 的
以 layer 中最后添加的 arc 为准
specializes arc 胜出，因为它最先被求值
questions.e: LIVRPS strength ordering (Local, Inherits, Variants, References, Payloads, Specializes) places References stronger than Inherits, so a direct opinion from a reference beats one supplied via inherit. Why the others are wrong: - Inherits are weaker than references in LIVRPS, not stronger, despite being class-based - Composition strength is determined by arc type ordering (LIVRPS), not insertion order within a single prim spec - Specializes is the weakest arc in LIVRPS and is not even part of this scenario ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
LIVRPS 强度顺序（Local、Inherits、Variants、References、Payloads、Specializes）中 References 强于 Inherits，因此来自 reference 的直接意见胜过通过 inherit 提供的意见。其他选项错误的原因：
- 在 LIVRPS 中 Inherits 比 references 弱而非强，尽管它是基于 class 的
- 合成强度由 arc 类型的顺序（LIVRPS）决定，而不是由单个 prim spec 内的插入顺序决定
- Specializes 是 LIVRPS 中最弱的 arc，而且本场景中根本不存在它
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: A shot contains 50,000 identical rivet props scattered across a hull mesh, causing the stage to load slowly and consume excessive memory. What is the BEST optimization strategy?
questions.qZh: 某个镜头包含 50,000 个完全相同的铆钉道具，散布在船体网格上，导致 stage 加载缓慢并占用过多内存。哪种优化策略最好？
o: Split the rivets into 50,000 separate USD files loaded via individual references
Set the purpose of all rivets to guide so usdview skips them
Convert each rivet prim into a native instance by setting instanceable=true on a shared prototype
Move all rivet opinions into a single strongest sublayer
oZh: 把铆钉拆分成 50,000 个独立的 USD 文件，通过单独的引用加载
把所有铆钉的 purpose 设为 guide，让 usdview 跳过它们
通过在共享原型上设置 instanceable=true，把每个铆钉 prim 转换为原生实例
把所有铆钉的意见移入单个最强的子层
questions.e: Native instancing lets Pcp share a single composed prototype index across all instances, so identical geometry is computed and stored once in memory instead of 50,000 times — this is the primary scale lever alongside payloads. Why the others are wrong: - Splitting into thousands of separate files increases file I/O and composition overhead without deduplicating memory - Setting purpose to guide changes render/display visibility, not memory usage or load performance, and would incorrectly hide the rivets from renders - Sublayer ordering only affects opinion strength, not the number of times identical geometry is composed and stored
questions.eZh:
原生实例化让 Pcp 在所有实例之间共享同一份合成后的原型索引，因此相同几何体只需在内存中计算和存储一次，而不是 50,000 次 —— 这是与 payload 并列的主要规模化手段。其他选项错误的原因：
- 拆分成数千个独立文件会增加文件 I/O 和合成开销，却并未对内存做去重
- 把 purpose 设为 guide 改变的是渲染/显示的可见性，而不是内存占用或加载性能，而且会错误地把铆钉从渲染中隐藏
- 子层顺序只影响意见强度，不影响相同几何体被合成和存储的次数

questions.q: You need to validate a delivery asset against Pixar's ARKit-compatible USDZ compliance rules before handing it off. Which tool and invocation should you use?
questions.qZh: 在交付之前，你需要按照 Pixar 的 ARKit 兼容 USDZ 合规规则对一个交付资产进行验证。应使用哪个工具和调用方式？
o: usdview --validate asset.usdz
Usd.Stage.Open(asset.usdz, validate=True)
usdcat --check asset.usdz
usdchecker --arkit asset.usdz
oZh: usdview --validate asset.usdz
Usd.Stage.Open(asset.usdz, validate=True)
usdcat --check asset.usdz
usdchecker --arkit asset.usdz
questions.e: usdchecker is the command-line validation tool and the --arkit flag runs the ARKit-specific compliance rule set required for USDZ delivery on Apple platforms. Why the others are wrong: - usdview has no --validate flag; it is an interactive viewer, not a validator - Usd.Stage.Open does not accept a validate keyword argument for compliance checking - usdcat is used to print/convert layer content as text, it has no --check compliance option
questions.eZh:
usdchecker 是命令行验证工具，--arkit 标志会运行 ARKit 专用的合规规则集，这是在 Apple 平台上交付 USDZ 所必需的。其他选项错误的原因：
- usdview 没有 --validate 标志；它是交互式查看器，不是验证器
- Usd.Stage.Open 不接受用于合规检查的 validate 关键字参数
- usdcat 用于以文本形式打印/转换 layer 内容，没有 --check 合规选项

questions.q: Which purpose value should be assigned to interactive rig control handles and locators that animators need to see and select in the viewport but that must never appear in any rendered output?
questions.qZh: 对于动画师需要在视图中看到并选择、但绝不能出现在任何渲染输出中的交互式绑定控制器手柄和定位器，应赋予哪个 purpose 值？
o: default
guide
proxy
render
oZh: default
guide
proxy
render
questions.e: guide purpose is intended for helper geometry such as rig controls, gizmos, and annotations — visible for interactive work but excluded from both proxy and render purpose traversals used by production renderers. Why the others are wrong: - default inherits normal visibility behavior and would still be picked up by render-purpose traversal - proxy is meant as a lightweight stand-in for heavy render geometry, not a non-renderable helper object - render purpose is explicitly for final high-quality render geometry, the opposite of what's needed here ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
guide purpose 正是为绑定控制器、gizmo 和标注等辅助几何体设计的 —— 在交互工作中可见，但在产品渲染器使用的 proxy 和 render purpose 遍历中都会被排除。其他选项错误的原因：
- default 沿用常规可见性行为，仍会被 render purpose 的遍历选中
- proxy 意在作为重型渲染几何体的轻量级替代物，而不是不可渲染的辅助对象
- render purpose 明确用于最终的高质量渲染几何体，与此处的需求正好相反
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: In usdview's Composition tab, what does clicking an individual arc entry in the Index primarily let you inspect?
questions.qZh: 在 usdview 的 Composition 标签页中，点击 Index 里的某个 arc 条目，主要可以查看什么？
o: The animation curves authored on that prim
The render settings applied to that prim in the current renderer
The USD schema version used to author the stage
The specific layer and arc contributing an opinion, along with its position in the LIVRPS strength ordering
oZh: 创作在该 prim 上的动画曲线
当前渲染器中应用于该 prim 的渲染设置
用于创作该 stage 的 USD schema 版本
贡献意见的具体 layer 与 arc，以及它在 LIVRPS 强度顺序中的位置
questions.e: The Index panel enumerates every composition arc contributing to a prim and lets you select one to see its source layer, arc type, and strength position — the core mechanism for tracing why a particular opinion wins. Why the others are wrong: - Animation curves are inspected in the Property/Value panel or a graph editor, not the composition arc index - Render settings live on the render delegate/RenderSettings prim, unrelated to composition arc inspection - Schema version is stage-level metadata visible elsewhere, not per-arc composition detail
questions.eZh:
Index 面板会枚举为某个 prim 贡献意见的每一条 composition arc，你可以选择其中一条来查看其来源 layer、arc 类型和强度位置 —— 这是追踪某条意见为何胜出的核心机制。其他选项错误的原因：
- 动画曲线应在 Property/Value 面板或图编辑器中查看，而不是 composition arc 索引
- 渲染设置位于 render delegate/RenderSettings prim 上，与 composition arc 检查无关
- schema 版本是 stage 级别的元数据，在别处可见，并非逐 arc 的合成细节

questions.q: A studio wants to keep a full city environment stage lightweight to open, only pulling in high-resolution building geometry for blocks currently in camera view. Which mechanism is the PRIMARY lever for this workflow?
questions.qZh: 某工作室希望完整的城市环境 stage 保持轻量、打开迅速，只为当前处于相机视野内的街区拉取高分辨率建筑几何体。对于这一工作流，哪个机制是主要杠杆？
o: Variant sets switching between LOD representations
Specializes arcs overriding building materials
Sublayer ordering to hide distant buildings
Payloads, so unneeded building blocks stay unloaded until explicitly requested
oZh: 在 LOD 表示之间切换的变体集
覆盖建筑材质的 specializes arc
用于隐藏远处建筑的子层顺序
Payload，使不需要的建筑街区在被显式请求前保持未加载状态
questions.e: Payloads are explicitly designed as the deferred-loading mechanism: their contents are excluded from composition until loaded, making them the primary tool for controlling what data is pulled into memory at scale. Why the others are wrong: - Variant sets change which representation is selected but don't inherently defer loading of unselected variants the way payloads do for entire branches - Specializes affects opinion strength for overrides, not whether data is loaded into memory - Sublayer ordering only changes opinion strength; it does not control whether a branch's data is composed or resident in memory
questions.eZh:
Payload 明确就是为延迟加载机制设计的：其内容在加载之前不参与合成，因此它是规模化场景中控制哪些数据被拉入内存的主要工具。其他选项错误的原因：
- 变体集改变的是选择哪个表示，但并不会像 payload 对整个分支那样天然延迟加载未选中的变体
- Specializes 影响的是覆盖时的意见强度，而不是数据是否被加载进内存
- 子层顺序只改变意见强度；它并不控制某个分支的数据是否被合成或常驻内存

questions.q: What is the fundamental difference between a reference arc and a payload arc in USD composition?
questions.qZh: 在 USD 合成中，reference arc 与 payload arc 的根本区别是什么？
o: References only work with .usda files while payloads only work with .usd binary files
Payloads support variant sets while references do not
Payloads are excluded from composition until explicitly loaded, while references are always composed into the stage
References can target multiple prims while payloads can only target one prim
oZh: reference 只对 .usda 文件有效，而 payload 只对 .usd 二进制文件有效
payload 支持变体集而 reference 不支持
payload 在被显式加载之前不参与合成，而 reference 始终会被合成进 stage
reference 可以指向多个 prim，而 payload 只能指向一个 prim
questions.e: The defining behavioral difference is loadability: payload targets are deferred and must be explicitly loaded (via Stage.Load or usdview's Load/Unload), whereas referenced content is always part of the composed stage. Why the others are wrong: - Both arc types work regardless of file format (.usda, .usd, .usdc) - Variant sets can exist under content brought in by either references or payloads; this is not the distinguishing feature - Both arcs can target single or multiple prims/layers depending on authoring; targeting cardinality is not the core distinction ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
最具决定性的行为差异在于可加载性：payload 的目标被延迟，必须显式加载（通过 Stage.Load 或 usdview 的 Load/Unload），而被引用的内容始终是合成后 stage 的一部分。其他选项错误的原因：
- 两种 arc 类型都与文件格式无关（.usda、.usd、.usdc 均可）
- 变体集既可以存在于通过 reference 引入的内容下，也可以存在于通过 payload 引入的内容下；这不是区分特征
- 两种 arc 都可以根据创作方式指向单个或多个 prim/layer；目标数量并非核心区别
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: A prim has three opinions affecting its display color: a local opinion (red) authored directly on the prim in the strongest layer, an inherited class opinion (green), and an opinion brought in through a reference to an asset where the referenced layer sets the color locally (blue). What color does the composed stage show?
questions.qZh: 某个 prim 有三条影响其显示颜色的意见：在最强 layer 中直接创作在 prim 上的本地意见（红色）、继承自 class 的意见（绿色），以及通过引用某个资产引入的意见，其中被引用的 layer 在本地设置了颜色（蓝色）。合成后的 stage 显示什么颜色？
o: Red
Blue
Green
Whichever opinion was authored last, regardless of arc
oZh: 红色
蓝色
绿色
无论来自哪种 arc，以最后创作的意见为准
questions.e: LIVRPS strength ordering places Local opinions above Inherits, Variants, References, Payloads, and Specializes. A directly authored local opinion always wins over any opinion arriving through a weaker arc, no matter where inside that arc it was authored. Why the others are wrong: - Blue is the reference's opinion — references are weaker than local opinions per LIVRPS, so they never override a stronger local opinion. - Green is from Inherits, which is weaker than Local but stronger than References/Payloads/Specializes — it still loses to the local opinion. - Authoring order in real time is irrelevant to composition; only the arc's position in LIVRPS strength ordering matters. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
LIVRPS 强度顺序将 Local 意见排在 Inherits、Variants、References、Payloads 和 Specializes 之上。直接创作的本地意见总是胜过任何通过更弱的 arc 到达的意见，无论该意见是在该 arc 内部的什么位置创作的。其他选项错误的原因：
- 蓝色是 reference 的意见 —— 按 LIVRPS，reference 比本地意见弱，因此永远无法覆盖更强的本地意见
- 绿色来自 Inherits，它弱于 Local 但强于 References/Payloads/Specializes —— 但仍然败给本地意见
- 现实时间中的创作顺序与合成无关；只有 arc 在 LIVRPS 强度顺序中的位置才起作用
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: You need to populate a forest environment with 50,000 trees that share identical geometry but each require unique position, rotation, scale, and a per-instance growth-stage index. Which approach BEST fits this requirement?
questions.qZh: 你需要用 50,000 棵树填充一片森林环境，它们共享相同的几何体，但每棵树都需要各自唯一的位置、旋转、缩放以及按实例区分的生长阶段索引。哪种做法最符合这一需求？
o: Author 50,000 unique prims each with its own geometry
Mark each tree prim individually as instanceable=true via separate references
Use a VariantSet per tree to switch growth stage
Use a UsdGeomPointInstancer referencing a small set of prototype prims, driving positions/orientations/scales/protoIndices via its arrays
oZh: 创作 50,000 个各自带有独立几何体的 prim
通过独立的引用把每个树 prim 分别标记为 instanceable=true
为每棵树使用一个 VariantSet 来切换生长阶段
使用引用少量原型 prim 的 UsdGeomPointInstancer，通过其数组驱动 positions/orientations/scales/protoIndices
questions.e: UsdGeomPointInstancer is purpose-built for large point-cloud style instancing, exposing positions, orientations, scales, and protoIndices arrays for efficient per-instance authoring at scale. Why the others are wrong: - Unique prims per tree destroys the memory and authoring benefits of instancing and doesn't scale to 50,000 instances. - Instanceable references are efficient for hierarchy deduplication but don't natively provide per-instance transform/attribute arrays the way PointInstancer does. - VariantSets are for discrete asset/appearance switching, not for authoring per-instance transforms at scale.
questions.eZh:
UsdGeomPointInstancer 专为大规模点云式实例化而设计，公开 positions、orientations、scales 和 protoIndices 数组，用于在大规模场景中高效地按实例创作。其他选项错误的原因：
- 每棵树一个独立 prim 会失去实例化在内存和创作上的优势，也无法扩展到 50,000 个实例
- 实例化引用在层级去重方面很高效，但不像 PointInstancer 那样原生提供按实例的变换/属性数组
- VariantSet 用于离散的资产/外观切换，而不是用于大规模创作按实例的变换

questions.q: An asset's referenced layer defines a variantSet named 'material' with default selection 'chrome'. A downstream layer, stronger in the composition, authors an explicit variant selection opinion of 'rust' for the same variantSet. What is the final composed material variant?
questions.qZh: 某资产被引用的 layer 定义了一个名为 'material' 的变体集，默认选择为 'chrome'。下游某个在合成中更强的 layer 为同一个变体集创作了显式的变体选择意见 'rust'。最终合成出的材质变体是什么？
o: Chrome, because the reference defines the default
It is a composition error requiring manual resolution
Rust, because a stronger-layer opinion overrides the referenced default selection
It depends on the order the layers were loaded at runtime
oZh: Chrome，因为 reference 定义了默认值
这是合成错误，需要手动解决
Rust，因为更强 layer 的意见会覆盖被引用的默认选择
这取决于运行时 layer 的加载顺序
questions.e: Variant selections are ordinary opinions and follow standard strength ordering: an opinion authored in a stronger layer always overrides a weaker one, including defaults set inside the referenced asset. Why the others are wrong: - Chrome is only the fallback when no stronger opinion exists — here a stronger opinion is present. - This is standard, well-defined composition behavior, not a conflict requiring manual resolution. - Load order of files on disk does not affect LIVRPS strength ordering, which is determined by arc type and layer stack position. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh:
变体选择就是普通意见，遵循标准的强度顺序：在更强 layer 中创作的意见总是覆盖更弱的意见，包括被引用资产内部设置的默认值。其他选项错误的原因：
- Chrome 只是在没有更强意见时的回退值 —— 而这里存在更强的意见
- 这是标准且定义明确的合成行为，不是需要手动解决的冲突
- 磁盘上文件的加载顺序不影响 LIVRPS 强度顺序，后者由 arc 类型和 layer stack 中的位置决定
⚠️ 考试中经常选错 —— 请仔细阅读各选项。

questions.q: Which UsdGeom schema is designed specifically for large-scale, non-hierarchical instancing where per-point scale, orientation, and prototype selection must be authored as arrays?
questions.qZh: 哪个 UsdGeom schema 是专为大规模、非层级式实例化设计的，其中每个点的缩放、朝向和原型选择必须以数组形式创作？
o: UsdGeomXform
UsdGeomScope
UsdGeomModelAPI
UsdGeomPointInstancer
oZh: UsdGeomXform
UsdGeomScope
UsdGeomModelAPI
UsdGeomPointInstancer
questions.e: UsdGeomPointInstancer exposes positions, orientations, scales, and protoIndices as array attributes, purpose-built for scattering large numbers of instances efficiently. Why the others are wrong: - UsdGeomXform only defines a transformable grouping prim; it has no instancing-specific attributes. - UsdGeomScope is a non-transformable grouping construct with no instancing semantics. - UsdGeomModelAPI applies model-kind metadata (component/group/assembly), unrelated to point instancing.
questions.eZh:
UsdGeomPointInstancer 将 positions、orientations、scales 和 protoIndices 暴露为数组属性，专为高效散布大量实例而设计。其他选项错误的原因：
- UsdGeomXform 只定义可变换的分组 prim；它没有实例化专用属性
- UsdGeomScope 是不带变换的分组结构，不含实例化语义
- UsdGeomModelAPI 应用 model kind 元数据（component/group/assembly），与点实例化无关

questions.q: You are writing a Python script that authors thousands of attribute value overrides across many prims and want to avoid triggering a stage recomposition notification after every single edit. Which pattern is correct?
questions.qZh: 你正在编写一个 Python 脚本，需要在许多 prim 上创作（author）数千个属性值覆盖，并且希望避免在每次编辑之后都触发一次 stage 重新组合（recomposition）通知。哪种做法是正确的？
o: Call stage.Save() after each SetAttribute call
Wrap the batch of edits in a with Sdf.ChangeBlock(): context while authoring through the Usd API
Call Usd.Prim.GetAttribute in a tight loop with no batching
Author each edit directly on a new Sdf.Layer with no Usd.Stage involved
oZh: 在每次 SetAttribute 调用之后调用 stage.Save()
在使用 Usd API 进行创作（authoring）时，将这批编辑包裹在 with Sdf.ChangeBlock(): 上下文中
在紧密循环中调用 Usd.Prim.GetAttribute，不做任何批处理
完全不涉及 Usd.Stage，直接在新建的 Sdf.Layer 上创作每一次编辑
questions.e: Sdf.ChangeBlock defers composition change notifications until the block exits, letting many Usd-API-driven edits be authored efficiently as one batched notification instead of one per edit. Why the others are wrong: - Saving after every edit is a costly I/O operation and does nothing to batch in-memory recomposition notifications. - Unbatched edits in a loop trigger a full notification/recomposition cycle per call, which is the exact inefficiency ChangeBlock avoids. - Bypassing Usd.Stage loses schema-aware validation and convenience the exam expects you to use for authoring workflows.
questions.eZh: Sdf.ChangeBlock 会将组合变更通知推迟到代码块退出时才发出，使大量由 Usd API 驱动的编辑能够以一次批量通知的方式高效完成，而不是每次编辑都触发一次通知。其他选项为何错误：- 每次编辑后都保存是代价高昂的 I/O 操作，对内存中的重新组合通知批处理毫无帮助。- 在循环中不做批处理的编辑会导致每次调用都触发完整的通知/重新组合循环，而这正是 ChangeBlock 要避免的效率问题。- 绕过 Usd.Stage 会失去 schema 感知的校验，以及考试期望你在创作工作流中使用的便利性。

questions.q: Which Python call correctly marks a prim as instanceable after adding a reference to an asset?
questions.qZh: 在为某个资产添加引用之后，哪种 Python 调用可以正确地将一个 prim 标记为可实例化（instanceable）？
o: stage.SetInstanceable(prim, True)
prim.SetInstanceable("true")
prim.SetInstanceable(True)
prim.GetVariantSets().SetInstanceable(True)
oZh: stage.SetInstanceable(prim, True)
prim.SetInstanceable("true")
prim.SetInstanceable(True)
prim.GetVariantSets().SetInstanceable(True)
questions.e: Usd.Prim.SetInstanceable(bool) is the correct method on the prim object itself, accepting a Python boolean. Why the others are wrong: - Usd.Stage has no SetInstanceable method — instanceable is metadata set on the Usd.Prim. - The method expects a Python bool, not the string "true"; passing a string is a common scripting mistake that silently misbehaves. - VariantSets have no relation to the instanceable flag; that's a metadata field on the prim, not variant machinery. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: Usd.Prim.SetInstanceable(bool) 是 prim 对象本身上的正确方法，接受一个 Python 布尔值。其他选项为何错误：- Usd.Stage 没有 SetInstanceable 方法——instanceable 是设置在 Usd.Prim 上的元数据。- 该方法期望传入 Python 的 bool，而不是字符串 "true"；传入字符串是常见的脚本编写错误，会在无任何提示的情况下产生错误行为。- VariantSets 与 instanceable 标志无关；那是 prim 上的一个元数据字段，并非变体（variant）机制。⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: The exam has 65 questions in a 90-minute window, and you want to reserve 15 minutes at the end for reviewing flagged questions. Roughly how much time should you budget per question during your first pass?
questions.qZh: 考试共有 65 道题，限时 90 分钟，并且你希望在最后预留 15 分钟用于复查标记出来的题目。第一轮答题时，每道题大约应分配多长时间？
o: ~69 seconds
~50 seconds
~90 seconds
~120 seconds
oZh: 约 69 秒
约 50 秒
约 90 秒
约 120 秒
questions.e: (90 − 15) minutes ÷ 65 questions = 75 ÷ 65 ≈ 1.15 minutes ≈ 69 seconds per question during the first pass. Why the others are wrong: - 50 seconds under-allocates time and assumes a review buffer larger than 15 minutes was reserved. - 90 seconds ignores the 15-minute review buffer and would consume the entire window on the first pass alone. - 120 seconds per question would require roughly 130 minutes for 65 questions, far exceeding the 90-minute window. ⚠️ Frequently missed on the exam — read the options carefully.
questions.eZh: (90 − 15) 分钟 ÷ 65 题 = 75 ÷ 65 ≈ 1.15 分钟 ≈ 第一轮每题约 69 秒。其他选项为何错误：- 50 秒分配的时间过少，并且隐含地假定了比 15 分钟更大的复查缓冲时间。- 90 秒忽略了 15 分钟的复查缓冲时间，仅第一轮就会用完整个考试时长。- 每题 120 秒意味着 65 题大约需要 130 分钟，远远超出 90 分钟的考试时长。⚠️ 考试中常被遗漏——请仔细阅读选项。

questions.q: Which statement correctly differentiates a USD payload from a USD reference?
questions.qZh: 哪种说法正确区分了 USD payload 与 USD reference？
o: A payload is stronger than a reference in composition strength ordering
There is no functional difference between a payload and a reference
A payload can only target prims within the same layer, while a reference can target external files
A payload behaves like a reference but is excluded from the default load set and can be explicitly loaded/unloaded at runtime for performance
oZh: 在组合强度排序（composition strength ordering）中，payload 比 reference 更强
payload 与 reference 在功能上没有区别
payload 只能指向同一 layer 内的 prim，而 reference 可以指向外部文件
payload 的行为与 reference 类似，但被排除在默认加载集合之外，并可在运行时显式加载/卸载以提升性能
questions.e: Payloads compose like references but are deferred by default, letting tools selectively load/unload heavy subtrees at runtime — a key performance mechanism for large scenes. Why the others are wrong: - In LIVRPS ordering, References are stronger than Payloads, not the reverse. - They differ meaningfully in default-load behavior and runtime control, which is precisely why both arcs exist. - Both arcs can target external files or prims within the same layer; the distinguishing factor is load-set behavior, not target scope.
questions.eZh: Payload 与 reference 一样参与组合，但默认被延迟加载，使工具能够在运行时选择性地加载/卸载开销较大的子树——这是大型场景中一项关键的性能机制。其他选项为何错误：- 在 LIVRPS 排序中，References 比 Payloads 更强，而不是相反。- 二者在默认加载行为和运行时控制方面存在实质差异，这正是两种 arc 都存在的原因。- 两种 arc 都可以指向外部文件或同一 layer 内的 prim；真正的区分因素是加载集合的行为，而不是目标范围。
